papers.title: The Post-GCN Decade Revisited: Curvature-Stratified Evaluation of Relational Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation practices in relational learning rely heavily on flat leaderboards that average performance across heterogeneous datasets, implicitly assuming a uniform underlying structure. We show that this assumption introduces systematic bias: it obscures geometry-dependent performance variations and can lead to misleading conclusions about model generalization. In this work, we identify intrinsic geometry as a key latent factor governing model effectiveness. We demonstrate that conventional aggregated metrics mask critical performance trade-offs that only become visible when datasets are stratified by their geometric properties. To address this issue, we introduce a curvature-stratified evaluation framework that partitions datasets into positive, negative, and near-zero curvature regimes. Our benchmark evaluates 18 representative models including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), Graph Foundation Models (GFMs), and tabular learning methods across 14 datasets. We find that model rankings are highly stable within each curvature regime but shift significantly across regimes, indicating that performance is fundamentally geometry-dependent rather than universally transferable. Notably, we identify regimes where GFMs offer diminishing returns compared to geometry-aligned GNNs. Based on these findings, we propose a geometry-aware evaluation protocol that yields more reliable and interpretable comparisons than standard aggregated benchmarks. We release all code, curvature-stratified dataset splits, and evaluation tools to support reproducible and rigorous assessment of future relational learning methods. Code and datasets are provided in our project homepage: https://sirbabbage.github.io/CurvBench_HOME/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前关系学习评估中扁平排行榜忽略数据集的几何结构，引入偏差。作者提出曲率分层评估框架，将数据集按曲率正负零分组，测试18个模型在14个数据集上的表现。发现模型排名在曲率区域内稳定，但跨区域显著变化，性能本质上依赖于几何结构，而非通用迁移。基于此提出几何感知评估协议，并开源代码与数据集。
Motivation: 当前关系学习评估依赖跨异构数据集的平均性能，隐含假设底层结构均匀，导致几何相关性能变化被掩盖，模型泛化结论可能误导。
Method: 提出曲率分层评估框架，将数据集划分为正曲率、负曲率和近零曲率区域，并在此框架下评估18个模型（包括GCN、GFM、表格学习方法）在14个数据集上的表现。
Result: 发现模型排名在同一个曲率区域内高度稳定，但在不同曲率区域间显著变化，表明性能根本上是几何依赖的。特别地，某些曲率区域中GFM相比几何对齐的GNN收益递减。
Conclusion: 几何感知评估协议比标准聚合基准更可靠和可解释。作者开源代码和曲率分层数据集拆分，以支持可重复评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Symb-xMIL: Symbolic Explanations for Multiple Instance Learning in Digital Pathology
authors: Mina Jamshidi Idaji (1 and 2) ((1) Berlin Institute for the Foundations of Learning and Data
(4) Berlin Institute of Health at Charité -- Universitätsmedizin Berlin
BIH Charité Digital Clinician Scientist Program
a partnership between DKFZ and Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU)
papers.abstract_en: Explanations of multiple instance learning (MIL) models are widely used for validation and discovery in digital histopathology. Existing methods primarily rely on heatmaps that highlight influential regions but do not explain how evidence from different tissue regions is combined to produce a prediction. This limits interpretability, especially when decisions depend on interactions between tissue features. We introduce Symbolic explainable MIL (Symb-xMIL), a post-hoc explanation framework that quantifies how a MIL model's behavior aligns with human-readable decision rules, expressed as logical relationships (e.g., AND, OR, NOT) between input features. These alignment scores reveal semantic patterns underlying the model's predictions. We evaluate Symb-xMIL on synthetic and real-world histopathology datasets. On synthetic MIL data, Symb-xMIL reliably recovers ground-truth logical rules. In a clinical tumor detection task, the best-aligned rules uncover heterogeneous decision patterns and expose hidden model errors. On an HPV-prediction task on TCGA-HNSCC, a cohort of head and neck cancer, our framework refines patient survival stratification beyond HPV status with potential clinical relevance. Overall, Symb-xMIL extends MIL explainability beyond visual attribution toward structured, rule-based reasoning, enabling more transparent and semantically grounded interpretation of model predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Symb-xMIL，一个用于数字病理学中多实例学习（MIL）模型的事后解释框架，通过将模型行为与人类可读的决策规则（如AND、OR、NOT）对齐，量化对齐分数，揭示预测的语义模式。在合成数据和真实组织病理学数据集上，Symb-xMIL能可靠恢复真实逻辑规则，在临床肿瘤检测任务中揭示异质决策模式并暴露隐藏错误，在HPV预测任务中改善患者生存分层。
Motivation: 现有MIL解释主要依赖热图突出重要区域，但未解释不同组织区域证据如何组合产生预测，限制了可解释性，尤其是当决策依赖组织特征间的交互时。
Method: 提出事后解释框架Symb-xMIL，通过计算MIL模型行为与逻辑规则（AND、OR、NOT）之间的对齐分数，量化模型决策与可读规则的匹配程度。
Result: 在合成MIL数据上可靠恢复真实逻辑规则；在临床肿瘤检测中揭示异质决策模式并暴露隐藏模型错误；在TCGA-HNSCC头颈癌HPV预测任务上，优化了患者生存分层。
Conclusion: Symb-xMIL将MIL可解释性从视觉归因扩展到结构化、基于规则的推理，实现更透明和语义化的模型预测解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Conditioned Synthesis of Pathological Gaits via Structured Gait-Language Representations
papers.abstract_en: Pathological gait datasets remain scarce due to privacy, recruitment, cost, and movement variability. Our work presents a multimodal LLM-guided framework for pathology-aware 3D gait data synthesis from structured textual descriptions. The proposed method generates fixed-length synthetic skeleton-based gait sequences for pathological gait classification tasks. The framework combines motion tokenisation, pathology-aware language conditioning, LLM-based semantic augmentation, and language-to-gait generation. A key contribution is the proposed pathological tokeniser, which is designed to preserve pathology-specific motion characteristics during discrete representation learning. Experiments suggest that the proposed synthetic sequences improve downstream classification for recurrent classifiers when combined with real data. The best result is obtained using a GRU classifier trained with real and synthetic samples, achieving 92.77\% accuracy under a leave-one-subject-out protocol.
papers.comment: Accepted at CVPR MOMA Workshop 2026 and selected for spotlight presentation at the workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态大语言模型（LLM）引导的框架，用于从结构化文本描述合成病理感知的3D步态数据。框架包括运动标记化、病理感知语言 conditioning、基于LLM的语义增强和语言到步态生成，其中关键贡献是设计了一个病理标记器（pathological tokeniser）以在离散表示学习中保留病理特定运动特征。实验表明，合成的步态序列与真实数据结合可提升递归分类器的下游分类性能，在使用GRU分类器和留一受试者协议下达到92.77%准确率。
Motivation: 病理步态数据集因隐私、招募、成本和运动变异性而稀缺，限制了相关研究。现有数据合成方法未能充分利用结构化文本描述和LLM的语义理解能力。
Method: 提出LLM引导的病理感知3D步态合成框架，包含运动标记化、病理感知语言条件化、LLM语义增强和语言到步态生成模块，并设计了专门保留病理运动特征的病理标记器。
Result: 合成的步态序列与真实数据结合，使基于GRU的分类器在留一受试者协议下达到92.77%准确率，优于仅使用真实数据的模型。
Conclusion: 该框架验证了通过结构化文本描述和LLM语义增强合成病理步态数据的可行性，为缓解数据稀缺问题提供了新途径，但方法依赖于特定分类器架构且仅在公开数据集上验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LoomVideo: Unifying Multimodal Inputs into Video Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Developing unified video generation and editing models capable of interpreting interleaved multimodal inputs is a promising yet challenging frontier field. Existing unified frameworks predominantly rely on massive models (typically 13B parameters or more) and incorporate source video conditions for editing by concatenating sequence tokens. This concatenation inevitably doubles the sequence length, quadrupling the computational complexity of the self-attention mechanism and introducing prohibitive overhead. To address these bottlenecks, we present LoomVideo, a highly efficient 5B-parameter unified architecture for both video generation and editing. LoomVideo replaces the standard text encoder with a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) and employs Deepstack injection mechanism to align multi-layer MLLM features with the Diffusion Transformer (DiT). Crucially, we introduce a zero-overhead Scale-and-Add conditioning approach for video editing. By scaling and directly adding the clean source video latent to the noised target latent, this elegant design eliminates the need for token concatenation, drastically reducing computational cost while maintaining robust capabilities for complex, non-rigid edits. Furthermore, a Negative Temporal RoPE strategy is seamlessly integrated to handle multiple reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our compact 5B model achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance across comprehensive benchmarks, exhibiting exceptional superiority in e-commerce and fashion generation scenarios. Benefiting from the zero-overhead conditioning mechanism, LoomVideo achieves at least a 5.41x acceleration in inference speed compared to models of similar capabilities, paving the way for highly practical and efficient video foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoomVideo，一个 5B 参数的高效统一架构，用于视频生成和编辑。通过用多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 替换标准文本编码器，并引入 Deepstack 注入机制对齐多层 MLLM 特征与扩散 Transformer (DiT)。关键创新是零开销的 Scale-and-Add 条件机制，避免了 token 拼接，显著降低计算复杂度。实验表明，该模型在多个基准上达到最优或极具竞争力的性能，尤其在电商和时尚生成场景中表现优异，推理速度相比类似能力的模型加速至少 5.41 倍。
Motivation: 现有视频生成与编辑的统一框架通常依赖大参数模型（13B 以上），并通过拼接 token 引入源视频条件，导致序列长度翻倍，自注意力计算复杂度翻四倍，带来高昂开销。
Method: 提出 LoomVideo 架构，使用 MLLM 作为文本编码器，通过 Deepstack 注入机制对齐多层级 MLLM 特征与 DiT；对于视频编辑，引入零开销的 Scale-and-Add 条件机制，直接对加噪目标隐变量进行缩放和加法操作，避免 token 拼接；同时集成负时间 RoPE 策略处理多参考图像。
Result: 5B 参数模型在多个基准上达到最先进或极具竞争力的性能，在电商和时尚生成场景中表现突出；推理速度相比类似能力模型加速至少 5.41 倍。
Conclusion: LoomVideo 提供了一种高效实用的视频生成与编辑统一框架，零开销条件机制显著降低计算成本，为实际视频基础模型奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Global-Local Monte Carlo Tree Search in Vision-Language Models for Text-to-3D Indoor Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models have achieved significant reasoning performance in various tasks. However, there are few studies on text-to-3D indoor scene generation with LVLMs. The main challenge is that prevailing LVLM-based methods employ chain-of-thought sequential decision mechanisms that cannot revise earlier decisions, causing error propagation. In this paper, we consider the task as a planning problem constrained by spatial and layout commonsense. To solve this problem, we model it as a tree search problem with global and local trees, which differs from existing sequential decision-making approaches. In the global tree, we place each object iteratively and explore multiple attempts like humans furnishing a room, where the problem space is represented as a tree. To effectively search the tree, we propose a hierarchical scene representation and a PRM-guided MCTS method. This representation abstracts a scene into room level, region level, floor object level, and supported object level. The PRM-guided MCTS method uses the PRM to prune unnecessary branches and the MCTS algorithm to balance exploration and exploitation to get an optimal solution with fewer attempts. In the local tree, it further decomposes the placement of each object into finer sub-steps, including the specific placement parameters. To make the whole appearance of the scene consistent, we leverage pre-trained diffusion image generative models to predict textures for all the objects in the scene. As existing benchmarks for text-to-3D indoor scene generation remain limited in scale and diversity, we collect a new large-scale diverse dataset that contains 65 scene types and 3250 instructions with diverse sizes, layouts, and styles, named 3DTindo-bench, to better assess the capability of the state-of-the-art models. Our experiments show that our method generates more realistic 3D scenes than state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于全局-局部蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的方法，用于文本到3D室内场景生成。该方法将任务建模为树搜索问题，全局树逐步放置物体并利用PRM引导MCTS剪枝与探索，局部树进一步分解物体放置为细粒度子步骤，最后使用扩散模型生成一致的纹理。同时收集了一个包含65种场景类型和3250条指令的新数据集3DTindo-bench。实验表明该方法生成场景比现有方法更真实。
Motivation: 现有LVLM方法采用链式思维顺序决策，无法修正早期错误，导致误差传播；且现有文本到3D室内场景基准规模和多样性有限。
Method: 将任务建模为树搜索问题，提出层次化场景表示（房间、区域、地板物体、支撑物体四级）和PRM引导的MCTS方法（PRM剪枝不必要的分支，MCTS平衡探索与利用）；局部树将每个物体放置分解为具体参数子步骤；使用预训练扩散图像生成模型预测场景所有物体的纹理。
Result: 在收集的3DTindo-bench数据集上，本文方法生成比现有最先进方法更真实的3D场景。
Conclusion: 全局-局部树搜索结合PRM引导的MCTS能有效解决文本到3D室内场景生成中的顺序决策问题，减少误差传播，生成更一致且真实的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast and Robust Convergence Rate for TD(0) with Linear Function Approximation, Universal Learning Steps and I.I.D. Samples
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the finite-time behavior of the TD(0) temporal-difference method with linear function approximation (LFA). We consider on-policy independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples, a constant learning step, and the Polyak-Juditsky averaging method. We establish a new convergence rate, for the Mean-Square Error (MSE) on the approximated function, that is (i) fast in the sense that it admits an optimal dependency in the number of iterations k (i.e., of order 1/k), (ii) robust to ill-conditioning: it only depends on an initial error and modelindependent constants and (iii) sharp up to a multiplicative constant lower than 11. In particular, it does not depend on the smallest eigenvalue of the uncentered covariance matrix of the linear parametrization, unlike all pre-existing O(1/k) rates in the TD(0) literature. We also introduce PCTD(0), a variant of TD(0), which benefits from better convergence properties under an additional assumption of strong mixing on the Markov Chain.
papers.comment: This is an extended version of a paper accepted at AISTATS 2026
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Faithful, Enriched, and Precise: Benchmarking Natural-Science Illustration Generation by T2I models
papers.abstract_en: Scientific illustrations are essential tools for communicating research findings, especially in natural science, where they visualize complex concepts and processes. As Text-to-Image (T2I) models become increasingly capable, researchers have started to use them for scientific illustration generation. However, existing benchmarks often assess outputs at a holistic level, overlooking fine-grained elements, while scientific reasoning ability and output conciseness remain under-quantified. We introduce FEPBench, a benchmark built from carefully selected high-quality scientific illustrations across multiple disciplines and layout types. With the assistance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and human experts, we provide fine-grained atom set annotations and systematically evaluate T2I models along three dimensions: instruction faithfulness, reasoning enrichment, and semantic precision. Our evaluation further decomposes model performance across visual, textual, relation, and layout elements. Results show that even state-of-the-art (SOTA) closed-source models, such as GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro, still suffer from text-rendering bottlenecks, limited reasoning enrichment, and difficulty balancing generation richness with precision. These findings provide practical guidance for improving and deploying T2I models in scientific illustration generation. Benchmark data, atom set annotations, and evaluation code will be released by us.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了FEPBench，一个用于评估文本到图像（T2I）模型在自然科学插图生成中多维度表现的基准。它从多个学科和布局类型中精选高质量插图，借助多模态大语言模型和人类专家提供细粒度原子集注释，从指令忠实度、推理丰富性和语义精确性三个维度评估模型。结果显示，即使最先进的闭源模型也在文本渲染、推理丰富性和生成丰富性与精确性平衡方面存在瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有T2I模型评估基准往往只进行整体评估，忽略了细粒度元素，且缺乏对科学推理能力和输出简洁性的量化。
Method: 构建FEPBench基准，包含跨学科精选插图，利用MLLM和人类专家提供细粒度原子集注释，从指令忠实度、推理丰富性和语义精确性三个维度系统评估T2I模型，并进一步分解视觉、文本、关系和布局元素的表现。
Result: 评估发现，当前最先进的闭源模型（如GPT Image 2和Nano Banana Pro）仍存在文本渲染瓶颈、推理丰富性有限以及难以平衡生成丰富性与精确性的问题。
Conclusion: 这些发现为改进和部署T2I模型在科学插图生成方面提供了实用指导。基准数据、注释和代码将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Finding Most Influential Sets
papers.abstract_en: Identifying most influential sets (MIS) - size-$k$ subsets whose removal maximally changes a target estimand - is typically infeasible because it requires searching over $\binom{n}{k}$ subsets. For estimands with linear-fractional leave-set-out effects, we show that MIS selection reduces to a one-parameter sequence of top-$k$ problems. Dinkelbach's method yields an algorithm with $\mathcal{O}(n)$ cost per iteration and finite termination. For fixed residualized inputs, the algorithm returns a globally optimal set for the univariate ratio objective, including the oracle-residualized partial linear model. With estimated nuisance functions, uniform denominator and generated-score stability imply approximation to the first-order oracle orthogonal-score objective; exact set recovery follows under a separation condition. Simulations and applications show that the method recovers exact MIS that were previously computationally inaccessible.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026, fixed ref
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何高效找出对目标估计量影响最大的大小为k的子集（Most Influential Sets, MIS）。通过将问题转化为一个一参数序列的top-k问题，利用Dinkelbach方法实现每次迭代O(n)的复杂度并有限收敛，能够精确恢复此前计算上无法处理的MIS。
Motivation: 传统MIS查找需要对所有C(n,k)个子集进行搜索，计算量过大，缺乏高效算法。
Method: 针对具有线性分数留出集效应的估计量，将MIS选择简化为一个单参数序列的top-k问题；采用Dinkelbach方法求解，每次迭代复杂度O(n)且有限终止。
Result: 在固定残差化输入下，算法可返回单变量比率目标的全局最优集合；在估计的干扰函数下，均匀分母与生成得分稳定性可逼近一阶正交得分目标，分离条件下可实现精确集合恢复。模拟与应用表明该方法能恢复之前计算不可及的精确MIS。
Conclusion: 本文提出的算法使得此前因计算复杂度而无法处理的MIS问题变得可解，理论上保证了全局最优性。

papers.title: SubtleMemory: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Relational Memory Discrimination in Long-Horizon AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent AI assistants, such as OpenClaw, accumulate large collections of related memories over long-term interactions. As these memories grow, they may reinforce one another, diverge across contexts, or directly conflict, making correct assistance depend on memory relations rather than isolated recall. Existing long-term memory benchmarks rarely probe how agents preserve and utilize such relations during downstream tasks. To address this gap, we introduce SubtleMemory, a benchmark for fine-grained relational memory discrimination in long-running AI agents. SubtleMemory constructs relation-controlled latent semantic artifacts whose variants instantiate complementary, nuanced, or contradictory relations, and embeds them into realistic user-agent histories, requiring agents to recover distributed relational structures during later queries and instructions. The benchmark contains 1,522 evaluation instances over 10 long histories, grounded in 1,090 relation-controlled memory-variant sets and spanning user-related and non-user-related queries. Evaluating six standalone memory systems, two Claw-style agents with native memory modules, and three Claw-style agents with plugin memory modules, we find that current systems remain weak on fine-grained relational memory discrimination. We further introduce diagnostic protocols that reveal distinct capability profiles across memory preservation, retrieval, and downstream reasoning stages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 SubtleMemory 基准，用于评估长期 AI 代理在细粒度关系记忆区分方面的能力。该基准通过构造关系控制的潜在语义变体，嵌入到真实用户-代理历史中，测试代理在后续查询中恢复分布式关系结构的能力。实验评估了多种记忆系统和代理模型，发现当前系统在细粒度关系记忆区分上表现薄弱。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆基准很少测试代理在任务中保持和利用记忆关系的能力，而 AI 助手的正确性往往依赖于记忆之间的关系而非孤立回忆。
Method: 构建关系控制的潜在语义人工制品，其变体体现互补、微妙或矛盾的关系，并将它们嵌入到逼真的用户-代理历史中，要求代理在后续查询和指令中恢复分布式关系结构。基准包含 1,522 个评估实例、10 个长历史，基于 1,090 个关系控制的记忆变体集。
Result: 评估了六种独立记忆系统、两种 Claw 风格代理（原生记忆模块）和三种 Claw 风格代理（插件记忆模块），发现当前系统在细粒度关系记忆区分上表现薄弱。
Conclusion: 引入的诊断协议揭示了记忆保存、检索和下游推理阶段的不同能力特征，表明当前系统在关系记忆区分方面存在显著不足。

papers.title: Beyond Output Matching: Preserving Internal Geometry in NVFP4 LLM Distillatio
papers.abstract_en: Demand for low-precision inference, including NVFP4-based approaches, has grown as large language models are increasingly deployed in latency and cost constrained production environments. Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) helps recover accuracy lost under low bit quantization by training a quantized student to match the output distribution of a frozen higher precision teacher via a KL-divergence loss. In this work, we first provide a representation level diagnosis of QAD: output matching alone can mask internal degradation, because many intermediate activation geometries can yield similar teacher-aligned logits. Using CKA, we show that KL-only QAD can reduce layerwise representational similarity relative to the BF16 teacher, with especially severe drift in RL-post-trained models. This drift correlates with downstream bottlenecks on reasoning and coding tasks, suggesting that low bit recovery requires preserving internal geometry rather than matching outputs alone. Motivated by this finding, we propose \textbf{CKA-QAD}, a CKA-guided representational alignment method for NVFP4 QAD and low bit LLM accuracy recovery. The method adds a lightweight regularizer that preserves internal representational geometry during distillation by aligning layerwise Gram matrices through CKA. Across Nemotron 3 Nano and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, CKA-QAD substantially improves representational alignment and improves downstream reasoning and coding accuracy with modest training overhead. Our findings position CKA-guided representational alignment as a practical complement to output matching for quantized LLM recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对NVFP4低精度推理中的量化感知蒸馏（QAD）问题，发现仅输出匹配会掩盖内部表示退化，导致分层表示相似性下降。提出CKA-QAD方法，通过CKA引导的表示对齐来保持内部几何结构，在Nemotron 3 Nano和Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上提高了推理和编码准确率。
Motivation: 低比特量化蒸馏中，仅用KL散度匹配输出分布可能掩盖内部表示的退化，尤其是在RL后训练模型中，导致推理和编码任务性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出CKA-QAD，在蒸馏过程中加入轻量级正则化项，通过CKA对齐逐层Gram矩阵，保持内部表示几何结构。
Result: 在Nemotron 3 Nano和Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上，CKA-QAD显著改善了表示对齐，并在下游推理和编码任务上提升了准确率，且训练开销较小。
Conclusion: CKA引导的表示对齐可作为输出匹配的有效补充，用于低比特量化LLM的恢复。

papers.title: When Surface Form Changes Moderation Decisions: A Paired Study of Code-Mixed Workflow Instability
papers.abstract_en: Hate moderation is often evaluated as classification on clean English inputs, but deployed systems must route content to actions such as ALLOW, FLAG, or REVIEW. We study how this workflow changes under code-mixed inputs using a paired evaluation setting where the same underlying content is expressed as clean English and Tamil-English code-mix. Under thresholds tuned on clean English development data, code-mixed inputs produce substantial action instability, with a paired clean- to-code-mix decision flip rate of 0.265. The main workflow effects are increased review burden and increased false-flagging of non-hateful content: review rate rises from 0.138 to 0.297 and non-hate false-flag rate rises from 0.069 to 0.104. Tamil-only inputs show stronger degradation overall, suggesting a broader language-coverage limitation rather than the same code-mixed instability pattern. A simple disagreement-based deferral rule reduces automatic errors on stressed inputs, but only by increasing review load. These results show that workflow-level evaluation reveals moderation failures that standard classification summaries can miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究代码混合输入（Tamil-English code-mix）对仇恨言论审核工作流（允许、标记、审查）的影响。通过配对实验，发现相同内容从纯英语变为代码混合时，决策翻转率为0.265，审查负担和非仇恨内容的误标记率显著上升。结果显示工作流级别的评估能揭示传统分类摘要遗漏的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有仇恨言论审核通常基于纯英语输入的分类评估，但实际部署系统需处理多语言和代码混合输入，其工作流稳定性未知。
Method: 采用配对评估设置，比较同一内容在纯英语和Tamil-English代码混合表示下的审核工作流决策，并分析分类阈值、审查率等指标。
Result: 代码混合输入导致决策翻转率0.265，审查率从0.138升至0.297，非仇恨误标记率从0.069升至0.104。Tamil-only输入退化更严重。

papers.title: SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly without wasting resources while waiting. To measure progress on this class of tasks, we introduce SentinelBench, an open-source benchmark for time-evolving monitoring tasks. SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 synthetic web environments, including email, calendars, finance, professional networking, and entertainment. Each environment exposes a live web interface and replays a scripted sequence of events, requiring agents to navigate and reason about web pages whose state shifts underfoot. SentinelBench measures task completion, reaction time, and resource use, exposing the tradeoff between responsiveness and cost. We report results across three models and two browser-agent harnesses, establishing performance baselines for future comparison and demonstrating how agent design choices can dramatically impact key metrics. Together, these results show that SentinelBench distinguishes meaningful differences in agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SentinelBench是一个用于评估长时间运行监控AI代理的开源基准测试，包含100个任务，覆盖10个合成网络环境（如邮件、日历、金融等）。该基准测试通过重放脚本化事件序列，模拟环境状态变化，测量任务完成率、反应时间和资源使用，揭示响应性与成本间的权衡。在3个模型和2个浏览器代理框架上建立了基线性能。
Motivation: 现有AI代理默认采用连续行动模式（如不断调用工具、刷新页面），不适合需要持续注意的长时间任务，浪费资源且效率低。
Method: 构建了SentinelBench基准，包含10个合成网络环境（每个环境有实时网页界面和脚本化事件序列），定义100个监控任务，要求代理在状态变化的环境中导航和推理。
Result: 在3个模型和2个浏览器代理框架上报告了基线结果，展示了任务完成、反应时间和资源消耗的差异，验证了SentinelBench能够区分不同代理设计对关键指标的影响。
Conclusion: SentinelBench为长时间运行监控代理提供了标准化的评估框架，有助于推动更高效的持续注意策略设计。

papers.title: Pixel Cube: Diffusion-based Portrait Video Relighting Through Realistic Lighting Reproduction
papers.abstract_en: We present a diffusion-based method for relighting dynamic portrait videos with photorealism and temporal consistency. Our method is fueled by a hybrid training dataset that consists of real-captured and rendered dynamic portrait videos with diverse subject appearances, facial motions, head poses, and known lighting conditions. Specifically, we construct an LED-based lighting system for realistic lighting emulation and high-speed video relighting data acquisition. By leveraging the image priors embedded in pre-trained video diffusion models, and using per-frame high dynamic range (HDR) environment map as lighting control, we train a high-performance generative model for realistic and identity-preserving dynamic portrait video relighting. In addition to the environment map control, our model uses a synthesized background image to enable control on the camera's exposure level and color tone. Our model can produce temporally consistent relit portrait video that looks realistic and harmonious under a provided new environment and faithfully preserve the subject's expression and fine facial features, including skin tone, wrinkles, and facial hair. Our model generalizes well to unseen data, in terms of the subject appearance, motion, and lighting condition. We perform extensive experiments on relighting in-the-wild videos with various environment maps and demonstrate practical applications on portrait photography. Results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in photorealism, lighting harmony, and temporal consistency.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的方法，用于动态肖像视频的重照明，实现照片级真实感和时间一致性。方法利用混合训练数据集（真实拍摄与渲染的动态肖像视频），构建LED照明系统进行逼真照明模拟和高速视频重照明数据采集。通过预训练视频扩散模型的图像先验，以每帧HDR环境图作为照明控制，训练生成模型。模型还能通过合成背景图像控制曝光和色调。在野外视频上使用各种环境图进行实验，表明在真实感、照明和谐性和时间一致性上达到最优。
Motivation: 动态肖像视频重照明在摄影和影视中有广泛应用，但现有方法难以同时保证照片级真实感、时间一致性和身份保留。缺乏同时具有真实感和已知光照条件的动态肖像数据。
Method: 构建一个LED灯光系统用于真实照明模拟和高速重照明数据采集，创建包含真实拍摄和渲染的混合训练数据集。利用预训练视频扩散模型的图像先验，以逐帧HDR环境图作为照明控制信号训练生成模型，并用合成背景图像控制曝光和色调。
Result: 在野外视频上进行广泛实验，使用各种环境图，结果显示该方法在照片级真实感、照明和谐性和时间一致性上达到最先进性能。模型能保留表情、肤色、皱纹和面部毛发等细节。
Conclusion: 该方法可以产生时间一致、真实和谐的重照明肖像视频，并在未见过的数据上泛化良好。实际应用包括肖像摄影。

papers.title: Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高等教育中AI素养的缺失，提出一个五阶段发展连续体（0-4级）：从“未参与”到“改进”，描述学生从回避或盲目依赖到批判性参与的发展路径。基于北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者），观察到参与者向知情使用和批判性评估的转变，但缺乏严格实验验证。作者强调AI素养是超越工具采用的发展性能力。
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架提供能力定义，但缺乏诊断学习者起点和进展的实用指导，导致学生常处于回避或盲目依赖两个极端。
Method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体（Not Yet Engaged, Uncritical Use, Informed Use, Critical Evaluation, Improvement），并给出与UNESCO/OECD框架对齐的教学路径。通过设计研究在北卡罗来纳州立大学实施课程和研讨会，收集观察性数据。
Result: 参与者行为表现从非参与或盲目使用向知情使用转变；持续且融入学科的经历产生更强的批判性评估和改进导向的证据。但研究缺乏前/后测和对照组，结果属于观察性和实践性。
Conclusion: AI素养应被理解为在学科和社会背景下理解、评估和负责任应用AI的发展性能力，而不仅是工具采用。

papers.title: ECI: Effective Contrastive Information to Evaluate Hard-Negatives
papers.abstract_en: Hard-negative source selection for dense retrieval is usually decided only after fine-tuning and downstream evaluation. We propose $\mathrm{ECI}_{\mathrm{sem}}$, a semantic residual variant of Effective Contrastive Information (ECI) that ranks candidate negative sources using frozen target-encoder embeddings. $\mathrm{ECI}_{\mathrm{sem}}$ is training-free, not label-free: each scored example requires a query, a labeled positive, and an explicit candidate negative. $\mathrm{ECI}_{\mathrm{sem}}$ builds a weighted residual information matrix from target consistency, semantic locality, lexical residuality, and a log-determinant diversity objective. On MS MARCO negative sources, in-family $\mathrm{ECI}_{\mathrm{sem}}$ ranks LLM negatives highest among non-hybrid sources and Dense+LLM highest among hybrid sources, matching the strongest aggregate BEIR transfer results across DistilBERT, E5-base, and Contriever. Controlled ablations show that this alignment depends on using the target encoder family, while additional ablations show stability under sample-size, temperature, tokenizer, and IDF-corpus perturbations. The theory gives a local linearized link to loss reduction, while the empirical study treats downstream evaluation as the final test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ECI_sem，一种基于语义残差的有效对比信息方法，用于在密集检索中无需训练即可对候选负样本源进行排序。该方法利用冻结的目标编码器嵌入构建加权残差信息矩阵，包含目标一致性、语义局部性、词汇残差性和对数行列式多样性目标。在MS MARCO负样本源上，ECI_sem在非混合源中对LLM负样本排名最高，混合源中对Dense+LLM排名最高，与最强的BEIR迁移结果匹配，且消融实验显示稳定性和对目标编码器家族的依赖。
Motivation: 现有密集检索硬负样本源的选择通常仅在微调和下游评估后才能决定，缺乏前期评估标准。
Method: 提出ECI_sem，一种训练免费的语义残差方法，通过构建加权残差信息矩阵（包含目标一致性、语义局部性、词汇残差性和对数行列式多样性）来对候选负样本源排序。
Result: 在MS MARCO负样本源上，ECI_sem在非混合源中排名LLM负样本最高，混合源中排名Dense+LLM最高，与最强的BEIR迁移结果一致；消融实验显示该方法依赖目标编码器家族，且对样本大小、温度、tokenizer和IDF语料库扰动稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ECI_sem是一种无需训练即可评估硬负样本源的方法，其排序与下游评估一致，并给出了局部线性化的理论链接，但实证研究以下游评估为最终测试。

papers.title: TailLoR: Protecting Principal Components in Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient finetuning methods based on spectral decomposition have enabled progress in Continual Learning. In this paper we introduce TailLoR, which utilizes the singular bases U and V of the pre-trained weights as a fixed reference frame to learn a low-rank update applied to the singular value matrix. A soft spectral penalty discourages updates aligned with dominant singular directions, reducing interference while routing fine-grained adaptation into the highly flexible, long-tail spectral coordinates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TailLoR，一种基于谱分解的参数高效持续学习方法。该方法利用预训练权重的奇异基U和V作为固定参考框架，对奇异值矩阵学习低秩更新，并通过软谱惩罚抑制与主导奇异方向对齐的更新，从而减少干扰并将细粒度适应路由到高度灵活的长尾谱坐标。
Motivation: 参数高效微调方法在持续学习中取得进展，但现有方法在主方向上的更新可能导致灾难性遗忘。需要一种方法在保留预训练知识的同时适应新任务。
Method: TailLoR使用预训练权重的奇异值分解（SVD）得到的U和V作为固定基，仅更新奇异值矩阵S。引入软谱惩罚，对与较大奇异值对应的方向施加更大的惩罚，从而保护主成分，鼓励在新任务中利用长尾奇异方向进行适应。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法在持续学习场景下能有效减少干扰并提高适应能力。
Conclusion: TailLoR通过保护预训练模型的主成分，同时利用长尾谱坐标进行参数高效适应，为持续学习提供了一种新的基于谱分解的微调策略。

papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract_en: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions. Existing methods inject this knowledge as long inputs (retrieved through RAG or dependency analysis) or through per-repository fine-tuning and LoRA -- costly at repository scale and brittle to evolving codebases. We introduce Code2LoRA, a hypernetwork framework that generates repository-specific LoRA adapters, effectively injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead. Code2LoRA supports two usage scenarios: Code2LoRA-Static converts a single repository snapshot into an adapter, suitable for comprehension of stable codebases; while Code2LoRA-Evo maintains an adapter backed by a GRU hidden state updated per code diff, suitable for active development of evolving codebases. To evaluate Code2LoRA against parameter-efficient fine-tuning baselines, we build RepoPeftBench, a benchmark of 604 Python repositories with two tracks: a static track with 40K training and 12K test assertion-completion tasks, and an evolution track with 215K commit-derived training and 87K commit-derived test tasks. On the static track, Code2LoRA-Static achieves 63.8% cross-repo and 66.2% in-repo exact match, matching the per-repository LoRA upper bound; on the evolution track, Code2LoRA-Evo achieves 60.3% cross-repo exact match (+5.2 pp over a single shared LoRA). Code2LoRA's code can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/code2lora-6857; the model checkpoints and RepoPeftBench datasets can be found at https://huggingface.co/code2lora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Code2LoRA，一个超网络框架，用于生成仓库特定的LoRA适配器，以向代码语言模型注入仓库级知识。该框架支持静态和演化两种场景，并通过构建包含604个Python仓库的RepoPeftBench基准进行评估。静态场景下，Code2LoRA-Static达到63.8%跨仓库和66.2%仓库内精确匹配；演化场景下，Code2LoRA-Evo达到60.3%跨仓库精确匹配，比单一共享LoRA提升5.2个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法需要长上下文输入（如RAG或依赖分析）或进行每个仓库的微调/LoRA，这在仓库规模大且代码演化的情况下成本高昂且脆弱。
Method: Code2LoRA使用超网络生成每个仓库的LoRA适配器，无推理时token开销。静态场景（Code2LoRA-Static）将单个仓库快照转换为适配器；演化场景（Code2LoRA-Evo）通过GRU隐藏状态按代码差异更新适配器。
Result: 在RepoPeftBench基准上，静态跟踪精确匹配：跨仓库63.8%，仓库内66.2%；演化跟踪跨仓库精确匹配60.3%，比单一共享LoRA提高5.2个百分点。
Conclusion: Code2LoRA有效注入仓库知识，零推理token开销，适用于稳定和演化代码库。

papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of each predicted action already governs how fast the robot moves, opening a direct route to controllable execution speed. We turn this observation into TempoVLA, a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition. TempoVLA combines two coupled components. (1) A data-side Variable-Speed Trajectory Augmentation (VSTA) that re-times demonstration to any target speed by merging or splitting actions while preserving its motion semantics. (2) A model-side conditioning mechanism that feeds the speed to the policy. Statistics show that VSTA reaches the requested speed with negligible motion error. Experiments in simulation and on real-world tasks demonstrate that TempoVLA achieves flexible speed control in both directions, while VSTA additionally boosts the default $1\times$ performance via better data utilization. Furthermore, by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TempoVLA 提出一种速度可控的视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA)，通过数据增强和模型条件机制实现机器人执行速度的灵活调节。该方法基于观测：预测动作的幅度本身决定了机器人移动速度，因此通过显式速度条件控制执行速度。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型只能从训练演示中继承单一固定速度，加速方法（如模型压缩、KV-cache 复用）仅将策略从一个固定速度移至另一个，且对减速几乎未探索。
Method: 提出两个耦合组件：1) 数据侧的可变速度轨迹增强 (VSTA)，通过合并或分割动作将演示重定时至任意目标速度，同时保持运动语义；2) 模型侧的条件机制，将速度输入策略网络。
Result: 实验表明 VSTA 以可忽略的运动误差达到请求速度。仿真和真实任务显示 TempoVLA 实现双向灵活速度控制，VSTA 还通过更好的数据利用提升了默认 1× 速度性能。与大多模态模型协作时，实现动态速度控制：低风险阶段加速，高风险阶段减速。
Conclusion: TempoVLA 通过数据增强和条件机制实现了简单有效的速度可控 VLA，并展示了动态速度控制的潜力。

papers.title: Regret Minimization with Adaptive Opponents in Repeated Games
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study regret minimization in repeated games with \emph{adaptive} opponents who can respond based on histories of play. The standard metric of \emph{external regret} in online learning is known to fail to capture such adaptivity. To account for players' counterfactual reasoning, we introduce {\tt Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret)}, a game-theoretic metric that measures the difference between the \emph{realized} and the \emph{best-in-hindsight} accumulated utility when all players can \emph{respond} to the history of play. Compared to existing regret notions in this setting, ours is native to repeated game playing, enabling stronger comparators and opponents with fewer constraints, while maintaining the possibility of finding better equilibria when all players minimize it. We first identify necessary conditions for obtaining {\tt RP-Regret} sublinear in time, on the variation of the player's comparator strategies in the regret definition and on the memories of both the comparator and opponents' strategies. We then study additional conditions and provable algorithms to minimize {\tt RP-Regret}, which is by definition \emph{non-convex} in the strategy space. To address this challenge, we propose three algorithms: (i) one based on an optimization oracle, as assumed in some prior work in online non-convex learning; (ii) one that minimizes a convex and \emph{linearized} surrogate of {\tt RP-Regret} at each iteration; (iii) one that directly minimizes {\tt RP-Regret} when opponents change strategies slowly. Furthermore, when all players can run algorithms to minimize the {\tt RP-Regret} (or its linearized variant), certain subgame perfect equilibria of the repeated game can be learned. We also provide experiments showing that minimizing our regret notions can lead to more cooperative solutions with higher utility in games such as Stag-Hunt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在重复博弈中与自适应对手进行遗憾最小化的问题，提出了新的博弈论指标"重复策略遗憾"（RP-Regret），并给出了亚线性时间的必要条件以及三种最小化算法，证明了所有玩家最小化RP-Regret时可以学习子博弈完美均衡。
Motivation: 现有外部遗憾指标无法捕捉自适应对手的响应行为，需要新的指标来体现玩家基于历史的反事实推理。
Method: 提出RP-Regret指标，并设计三种算法：基于优化oracle的算法、最小化凸线性化代理的算法、以及对手缓慢变化时直接最小化RP-Regret的算法。
Result: 通过实验表明最小化新遗憾指标可以在Stag-Hunt等博弈中获得更高效用的合作解。
Conclusion: 所有玩家最小化RP-Regret（或其线性化变体）时可以学习重复博弈的某些子博弈完美均衡。

papers.title: PAR3D: A Unified 3D-MLLM with Part-Aware Representation for Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D multimodal large language models (3D-MLLMs) have enabled unified solutions for 3D scene understanding tasks, including visual question answering, captioning, and referring segmentation. However, existing 3D-MLLMs remain largely object-centric, limiting their ability to model fine-grained part structures that are essential for embodied interaction with 3D environments. In this work, we present PAR3D, a unified part-aware 3D-MLLM framework that enables models to understand, reason about, and ground both objects and their parts in 3D scenes. To enable training and evaluation of part-aware 3D scene understanding, we introduce ScenePart, a synthetic 3D scene dataset with part-level annotations and language instructions. We further develop Part-Aware 3D Representation Learning to enrich 3D visual representations with fine-grained part-level semantics, and propose Hierarchical Segmentation Query Generation to ground part targets via hierarchical object-part queries. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves part-level question answering and referring segmentation, while also achieving strong performance across object-level vision-language tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAR3D，一个统一的部件感知3D多模态大语言模型（3D-MLLM）框架，能够理解、推理和定位3D场景中的对象及其部件。为支持训练和评估，作者引入了合成3D场景数据集ScenePart，带有部件级标注和语言指令。通过部件感知3D表示学习和层次化分割查询生成，该方法在部件级问答和指代分割任务上取得显著提升，同时不损失对象级性能。
Motivation: 现有3D-MLLM主要关注对象级理解，缺乏对细粒度部件结构的建模能力，这限制了在3D环境中的具身交互应用。
Method: 提出PAR3D框架，包含三个核心：合成数据集ScenePart（部件级标注与语言指令）、部件感知3D表示学习（丰富3D视觉表示中的细粒度部件语义）、层次化分割查询生成（通过对象-部件层次查询定位部件目标）。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在部件级问答和指代分割任务上取得显著改进，同时在对象级视觉语言任务上保持强性能。
Conclusion: 部件感知表示有助于提升3D场景理解中的细粒度推理和定位能力，为具身交互提供了更丰富的视觉基础。

papers.title: Operation-Guided Progressive Human-to-AI Text Transformation Benchmark for Multi-Granularity AI-Text Detection
papers.abstract_en: As AI writing assistants become increasingly integrated into real-world drafting and revision workflows, many documents are no longer purely human-written or AI-generated, but instead result from progressive human-AI co-editing. However, existing AI-text detection benchmarks largely focus on final outputs and provide limited understanding of how AI authorship signals emerge, accumulate, or disappear throughout the revision process. We introduce OpAI-Bench, an operation-guided benchmark for studying progressive human-to-AI text transformation across document, sentence, token, and span granularities. Starting from human-written documents, OpAI-Bench constructs nine sequentially revised versions for each sample under predefined AI coverage levels and five representative AI edit operations, covering four domains while preserving complete authorship provenance at multiple granularities. The benchmark supports comprehensive evaluation with 8 document-level detectors, 7 sentence-level detectors, and 2 fine-grained token/span-level detectors. Experiments reveal that AI-text detectability is governed not only by the proportion of AI-edited content, but also by edit operation, domain, and cumulative revision history. Interestingly, we notice that mixed-authorship intermediate versions are often harder to detect than both fully human and heavily AI-edited endpoints, exposing non-monotonic detection patterns missed by existing benchmarks. OpAI-Bench provides a controlled testbed for analyzing whether, when, and how AI-assisted writing becomes detectable under realistic progressive editing scenarios. Our code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/OpAI-Bench.

TL;DR: OpAI-Bench是一个操作引导的渐进式人机文本转换基准，用于多粒度AI文本检测。它从纯人工撰写文档出发，通过九种AI编辑操作和多个覆盖率水平构建渐进修订版本，覆盖文档、句子、token和span四个粒度，并保留完整的作者身份溯源。实验发现AI文本的可检测性不仅取决于AI编辑比例，还受编辑操作、领域和累积修订历史影响，且混合作者身份的中间版本往往比纯人工或重度AI编辑的端点更难检测。
Motivation: 现有AI文本检测基准主要关注最终输出，缺乏对编辑过程中AI作者身份信号如何出现、累积或消失的理解。
Method: 提出OpAI-Bench基准，从人工撰写文档出发，构建九种渐进修订版本，包括五种代表性AI编辑操作和多种AI覆盖率水平，支持文档、句子、token和span四个粒度的检测评估。
Result: 实验显示AI文本可检测性受AI编辑比例、编辑操作、领域和累积修订历史共同影响；混合作者身份的中间版本比纯人工或重度AI编辑端点更难检测，暴露出非单调检测模式。
Conclusion: OpAI-Bench为研究渐进式人机合著文本的检测提供了可控测试平台，揭示了现有基准忽视的非单调检测模式。

papers.title: DNQ: Deep Nash Q-Network for Partially Observable n-Player Games
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world competitive systems require multiple decision-makers to act simultaneously under shared constraints, limited information, and repeated interaction, as in auctions, resource allocation, and security competition. We study multi-turn simultaneous bidding as a controlled testbed for such problems and propose DNQ, a solver-in-the-loop equilibrium supervision framework for training bidding agents. DNQ alternates between trajectory collection, critic-based payoff estimation, equilibrium computation, and policy imitation. At each visited state, a shared critic predicts either pairwise payoff matrices or an exact N-player payoff tensor, an external solver computes equilibrium strategies, and the agents are trained by minimizing the KL divergence between their masked policies and the solver-derived equilibrium targets. We focus on a scalable pairwise formulation that greatly reduces equilibrium-solving cost and training time compared with the exact formulation, while the shared critic amortizes payoff learning across agents and states. Experiments compare the pairwise and exact variants using critic loss, policy entropy, bidding resource usage, and training cost, showing that the pairwise method scales to larger numbers of agents, whereas the exact method becomes computationally impractical as the joint game grows. These results illustrate the trade-off between strategic fidelity and scalability in repeated competitive environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出DNQ框架，用于训练多轮同时竞拍中的智能体，通过求解器在环的均衡监督，交替轨迹收集、基于评论家的收益估计、均衡计算和策略模仿。关注可扩展的成对表述，降低均衡求解成本，实验比较成对与精确变体的权衡。
Motivation: 许多现实竞争系统需要多个决策者在共享约束、有限信息和重复交互下同时行动，如拍卖、资源分配和安全竞争，现有方法在可扩展性和战略保真度之间面临权衡。
Method: 提出DNQ，在访问每个状态时，共享评论家预测成对收益矩阵或精确n人收益张量，外部求解器计算均衡策略，智能体通过最小化掩码策略与求解器导出的均衡目标之间的KL散度进行训练。
Result: 实验表明成对方法能扩展到更多智能体，而精确方法在联合博弈增长时计算上不切实际，展示了战略保真度与可扩展性之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 论文强调了成对表述在降低均衡求解成本和训练时间方面的优势，同时共享评论家跨智能体和状态摊销收益学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. We propose Supervised Memory Training (SMT), a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$. SMT acquires these memory labels by training a Transformer-based encoder on a predictive state objective--retaining only information from the past necessary to predict the future. By decoupling what to remember from how to update memory, SMT enables time-parallel RNN training with a stable $O(1)$ length gradient path between any two tokens--without ever unrolling the RNN. We find that SMT outperforms BPTT when pretraining various RNN architectures on tasks like language modeling and pixel sequence modeling. SMT enables nonlinear RNNs to better capture long-range dependencies and train in parallel, potentially unlocking the scaling of models that build temporal abstractions of past experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出监督记忆训练（SMT），一种无需循环信用传播的非线性RNN预训练方法。SMT通过将RNN训练转化为一步记忆转换标签上的监督学习，并利用Transformer编码器获取记忆标签，从而实现时间并行训练和稳定的O(1)梯度路径。实验表明，SMT在语言建模和像素序列建模任务上优于传统的BPTT方法。
Motivation: 标准BPTT在训练RNN时存在时间顺序限制导致的并行性差和长序列梯度消失/爆炸问题，限制了RNN对长距离依赖的捕捉能力。
Method: 提出SMT方法：使用Transformer编码器基于预测状态目标学习记忆标签，将RNN训练简化为对一步记忆转换的监督学习，完全避免循环信用传播。
Result: SMT在语言建模和像素序列建模任务上优于BPTT，能够使非线性RNN更好地捕捉长距离依赖并实现并行训练。
Conclusion: SMT通过解耦记忆内容与更新方式，为RNN的并行训练和长序列建模提供了新思路，有望推动构建时间抽象模型的扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Complexity-Balanced Diffusion Splitting
papers.abstract_en: Standard continuous-time generative models rely on monolithic architectures that must navigate vastly different signal regimes, from isotropic noise to intricate data distributions. While scaling model capacity improves performance, deploying a massive network uniformly across the entire generative timeline is inherently inefficient. In this work, we propose Complexity-Balanced Splitting (CBS), a principled framework for temporal capacity allocation that distributes the generative workload across multiple specialized sub-networks. Grounded in function approximation theory and de Boor's equidistribution principle, CBS partitions the diffusion timeline into segments of equal approximation burden, allocating more representational capacity to regions where the generative dynamics are more difficult to model. To estimate this local complexity, we introduce two complementary and tractable monitor functions: a spatial measure based on the flow's Dirichlet energy, and a geometric measure based on the acceleration of the sampling trajectories. Using a lightweight auxiliary model to estimate these complexity profiles, our approach eliminates the need for heuristic temporal splits or computationally expensive search procedures. Extensive evaluation across multiple architectures (SiT, JiT, and UNet) and datasets demonstrates that CBS consistently improves synthesis quality without increasing per-step inference cost. In particular, CBS improves FID by ~35% on SiT-XL with CFG relative to naive temporal partitioning. Project page is available at https://noamissachar.github.io/CBS/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出复杂度平衡分割（CBS），一种用于扩散模型的时间容量分配框架，通过将生成时间线划分为等近似负担的片段，并将更多表示能力分配给生成动态更困难的区域，从而提升合成质量。基于函数逼近理论和 de Boor 等分布原理，引入两种可计算的监控函数（Dirichlet 能量和采样轨迹加速度）来估计局部复杂度。在多种架构（SiT, JiT, UNet）和数据集上，CBS 在不增加每步推理成本的情况下持续改进合成质量，例如在 SiT-XL with CFG 上比朴素时间分割提升 FID 约 35%。
Motivation: 标准连续时间生成模型使用单一架构处理从各向同性噪声到复杂数据分布的不同信号状态，统一分配模型容量导致效率低下。论文旨在设计一种原则性框架来动态分配时间上的表示能力。
Method: 提出基于函数逼近理论和 de Boor 等分布原理的 CBS 框架，利用 Dirichlet 能量和采样轨迹加速度作为互补的复杂度度量，通过轻量辅助模型估计复杂度剖面，指导扩散时间线的非均匀分割和子网络分配。
Result: 在多个架构和数据集上，CBS 不增加每步推理成本即持续改进 FID 等指标；在 SiT-XL with CFG 上相比朴素时间分割提升 FID 约 35%。
Conclusion: CBS 提供了一种无需启发式分割或昂贵搜索的容量分配方法，显著提升扩散模型合成质量，且与现有架构兼容。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning capabilities, their spatial reasoning abilities remain largely constrained to the observed images and text-oriented chain-of-thought. They often struggle to infer unobserved layouts, maintain cross-view consistency, and reason from alternative viewpoints when only limited egocentric observations are available. In this work, we study this problem as thinking with imagination, where a VLM actively acquires imagined visual evidence by interacting with a world simulator during reasoning. We propose Astra, an agentic spatial reasoning framework that empowers VLMs with action-conditioned visual imagination. Specifically, Astra couples Astra-VL, an RL-trained VLM policy, with Astra-WM, a Bagel-based world simulator that generates novel-view observations from context images and natural-language camera motions. To provide reliable imagined evidence, Astra-WM is trained with view consistency tuning to improve pose and content consistency across views. In the RL stage, we propose a world-simulator-in-the-loop two-phase RL curriculum to stabilize tool-use exploration and advance the model's ability to invoke the simulator only when imagined observations improve over direct answering. Experiments demonstrate that both the world simulator and the agentic policy are necessary: Astra-WM improves simulator-augmented Gemini-3-Flash on MMSI-Bench from 45.1 to 49.5, while Astra-VL improves the Qwen3-VL backbone from 29.8 to 38.8 on MMSI-Bench and from 36.8 to 42.7 on MindCube. These results show that imagined observations can provide useful spatial evidence, but effective world-model-augmented reasoning requires learning when, where, and how to imagine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Astra框架，通过强化学习训练的VLM策略（Astra-VL）与基于Bagel的世界模拟器（Astra-WM）协同，使VLM能在推理中主动想象未观察到的视角。该方法通过视图一致性训练提升生成图像的质量，并通过两阶段RL课程学习优化模拟器调用时机。实验表明，想象观测能提供空间证据，但需要学习何时、何地、如何想象。
Motivation: 现有VLM的空间推理能力局限于观测图像和文本链式思维，难以推断未观察布局、保持跨视角一致性或从替代视角推理。
Method: 提出Astra框架，包含RL训练的VLM策略Astra-VL和基于Bagel的世界模拟器Astra-WM，后者从上下文图像和自然语言相机运动生成新视角观测。Astra-WM通过视图一致性训练提升姿态和内容一致性。RL阶段采用世界模拟器在环的两阶段课程学习。
Result: Astra-WM在MMSI-Bench上将模拟器增强的Gemini-3-Flash从45.1提升到49.5；Astra-VL将Qwen3-VL骨干从29.8提升到38.8（MMSI-Bench），从36.8提升到42.7（MindCube）。
Conclusion: 想象观测能提供有用的空间证据，但有效的世界模型增强推理需要学习何时、何地、如何想象。

papers.title: RREDCoT: Segment-Level Reward Redistribution for Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in reasoning language models have been driven by Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. Most often, these rely on the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm or modifications thereof to steer the models to produce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. The final answer can only be verified, and the reward assigned, after the CoT trace is complete, making it a delayed reward problem. GRPO and its modifications correspond to Monte Carlo methods in standard RL, which are known to suffer from high variance. A possible solution to this problem is the redistribution of rewards through credit assignment, where segments of the CoT trace that are important for arriving at the desirable solution are emphasized by assigning a higher reward. While Monte Carlo sampling can be used to provide an unbiased estimate of intermediate state values, its computational overhead makes it unsuitable for train-time credit assignment in long contexts at high granularity. We introduce RREDCoT (Reward REDistribution for Chain of Thoughts), which utilizes the model itself to approximate the optimal reward redistribution without additional generation. We investigate the advantages of our method compared to MC sampling and several attribution methods. We further analyze several aspects relevant to the construction of the redistribution such as segmentation of CoT traces and state value estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推理语言模型中链式推理（CoT）的延迟奖励问题，提出RREDCoT方法，利用模型自身近似最优奖励分配，避免蒙特卡洛采样的高计算开销。实验表明该方法相比MC采样和多种归因方法具有优势，并分析了分段和状态值估计等关键因素。
Motivation: 现有GRPO等强化学习方法在CoT场景中存在延迟奖励和高方差问题，蒙特卡洛采样虽能提供无偏估计但计算成本过高，不适合训练时的高粒度信用分配。
Method: RREDCoT利用模型自身来近似最优奖励分配，无需额外生成，通过对CoT轨迹分段并重新分配奖励来强调对正确解答重要的推理步骤。
Result: 作者比较了该方法与MC采样及多种归因方法的优劣，并分析了分段策略和状态值估计方法对奖励分配效果的影响。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种高效且低方差的奖励分配方法，可提升推理模型的RL微调效率。

papers.title: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel. At each step, they predict tentative tokens for every masked position, committing the confident predictions to the output and discarding the unconfident ones. We show that the discarded tokens are in fact a useful lookahead signal for retrieval-augmented generation: even low-confidence tokens often surface salient entities early in the denoising trajectory, enabling retrieval of stronger evidence before the output is finalized. We exploit this through Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI), a dynamic RAG framework that uses these lookahead tokens to guide retrieval during denoising. SARDI is training-free, retriever-agnostic, and applicable to any reasoning-capable discrete diffusion language model. Across five multi-hop QA benchmarks, SARDI outperforms current training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to $8\times$ higher throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了SARDI，一个针对离散扩散语言模型的动态检索增强生成框架，利用去噪过程中低置信度预测的标记作为前瞻信号来引导检索。该框架无需训练，与检索器无关，适用于任何有推理能力的离散扩散模型。在多跳问答基准上，SARDI以高达8倍吞吐量超越了当前无训练扩散和自回归检索基线。
Motivation: 现有的扩散语言模型在去噪过程中会丢弃低置信度预测的标记，但这些标记往往包含早期出现的实体信号，可用于检索增强生成。本文旨在利用这些被丢弃的标记来改进检索质量。
Method: 提出Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI)，一种动态RAG框架，在去噪过程中使用前瞻标记(lookahead tokens)来指导检索。该方法无需训练，与检索器无关。
Result: 在五个多跳问答基准上，SARDI以高达8倍吞吐量超越了当前无训练扩散和自回归检索基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SARDI能够利用去噪过程中的前瞻信号提升检索增强生成的效果，并且具有高效性。

papers.title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks such as scientific discovery and machine learning engineering (MLE), where sustained self-evolution becomes a key capability. However, existing MLE agents suffer from inter-branch information isolation, memoryless search, and lack of hierarchical control, which together hinder long-horizon optimization. We present MLEvolve, an LLM-based self-evolving multi-agent framework for end-to-end machine learning algorithm discovery. By extending tree search to Progressive MCGS, MLEvolve enables cross-branch information flow through graph-based reference edges and gradually shifts the search from broad exploration to focused exploitation with an entropy-inspired progressive schedule. To allow the agent to evolve with accumulated experience, we introduce Retrospective Memory, which combines a cold-start domain knowledge base with a dynamic global memory for task-specific experience retrieval and reuse. For stable long-horizon iteration, we further decouple strategic planning from code generation with adaptive coding modes. Evaluation on MLE-Bench shows that MLEvolve achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple dimensions including average medal rate and valid submission rate under a 12-hour budget (half the standard runtime). Moreover, MLEvolve also outperforms specialized algorithm discovery methods including AlphaEvolve on mathematical algorithm optimization tasks, demonstrating strong cross-domain generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/InternScience/MLEvolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MLEvolve，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自演化多智能体框架，用于端到端机器学习算法发现。通过渐进式MCGS树搜索、图基参考边、熵启发渐进式调度、回顾记忆（Retrospective Memory）以及解耦策略规划与代码生成的自适应编码模式，MLEvolve在MLE-Bench上实现多项指标的最优性能，并在数学算法优化任务上超越AlphaEvolve，展现跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有机器学习工程（MLE）智能体存在分支间信息隔离、无记忆搜索、缺乏层次控制等问题，难以支持长时间跨度的自我演化。
Method: 扩展树搜索为渐进式MCGS，通过图基参考边实现跨分支信息流动，并采用熵启发渐进式调度从广域探索转向聚焦利用；引入回顾记忆，结合冷启动领域知识库和动态全局记忆以检索复用经验；解耦策略规划与代码生成，采用自适应编码模式。
Result: 在MLE-Bench上，12小时预算（标准一半时间）内平均奖牌率和有效提交率等指标达最先进水平；在数学算法优化任务上优于AlphaEvolve。
Conclusion: MLEvolve证明了LLM驱动的自演化多智能体框架在算法发现中的有效性，但未探讨其在特定领域（如气象）的应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PC Layer: Polynomial Weight Preconditioning for Improving LLM Pre-Training
papers.abstract_en: We propose a preconditioning (PC) layer, a weight parameterization via polynomial preconditioner that ensures stable weight conditioning throughout LLM training. The PC module reshapes the singular-value spectrum of weight matrices via low-degree polynomial preconditioning. After training, the preconditioned weights can be merged back into the original architecture, incurring no inference overhead. We demonstrate the advantage of the proposed PC layer over standard transformers in Llama-1B pre-training, for both the AdamW and Muon optimizers. Theoretically, we justify this spectrum-control principle by proving that uniformly bounding each layer's singular values ensures geometric convergence of gradient descent to global minima, for certain deep linear networks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Empath-aln/PC-layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 PC 层 (preconditioning layer) 的权重参数化方法，通过低阶多项式预条件子重塑权重矩阵的奇异值谱，确保 LLM 训练过程中权重条件稳定。在 Llama-1B 预训练任务上，该方法在使用 AdamW 和 Muon 优化器时均优于标准 Transformer，且训练后可将预条件权重合并回原架构，无额外推理开销。理论分析证明，对特定深度线性网络，均匀限制每层奇异值可保证梯度下降全局收敛。
Motivation: LLM 预训练中权重矩阵的条件数可能恶化，影响训练稳定性和收敛速度，现有方法缺乏直接控制权重谱的通用手段。
Method: 在每层权重前插入一个低阶多项式预条件子模块，通过优化预条件参数来动态调节权重矩阵的奇异值分布，训练后通过矩阵合并消除额外模块。
Result: 在 Llama-1B 规模上，PC 层配合 AdamW/Muon 优化器均取得优于标准 Transformer 的训练损失下降和下游任务性能；理论上证明了均匀谱约束对深度线性网络的全局收敛性。
Conclusion: PC 层提供了一种轻量、可合并的权重谱调控方法，在 LLM 预训练中具有通用性且不增加推理成本，为理解深度网络训练动力学提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How abundant are good interpolators?
papers.abstract_en: Let $S$ be the set of unit norm linear classifiers $θ\in \mathbb{R}^d$ which correctly classify every point of a labeled dataset $(X_i,y_i)_{i=1}^n$, $X_i \in \mathbb{R}^d$, $y_i \in \{-1,+1\}$, with a possibly negative margin $κ$ fixed in advance. Under two natural data-generating distributions of the $(X,y)$ pairs -- a Gaussian mixture model and a logistic model with Gaussian features -- and in the proportional regime $n/d \to α$ with small enough $α$, we establish a large deviation principle on the event that a point $θ$ chosen uniformly at random from $S$ achieves a given generalization error, with high probability over the choice of the data. The associated large deviation rate function is deterministic and describes the proportion, at the exponential scale in $d$, of interpolating classifiers having a given desired performance. As a consequence, we establish the following concentration phenomenon: all but an exponentially small fraction of interpolating classifiers have approximately the same generalization performance given by the unique maximizer of this rate function. We numerically compare this maximizer to the performance of empirical risk minimization by gradient descent and to the performance of a natural linear program, both finding a point in $S$, and deduce that in the overparametrized regime of small $α$, these efficient procedures outperform the vast majority of interpolators, pointing to their nontrivial benign overfitting in this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在高斯混合模型和逻辑回归模型下，研究均匀随机选取的插值分类器的泛化误差分布。在比例极限n/d→α且α足够小时，建立了一个大偏差原理：几乎所有插值分类器都具有几乎相同的泛化性能，其由率函数的最大值给出。数值比较表明，梯度下降和线性规划等高效算法找到的插值器优于绝大多数随机插值器，揭示了过参数化下的良性过拟合。
Motivation: 理解过参数化模型中插值分类器的质量分布，以及为什么某些算法找到的插值器泛化性能优于随机选择的插值器。
Method: 在两种数据生成分布（高斯混合模型和逻辑模型）下，建立插值分类器集合上的大偏差原理，推导出泛化误差的指数率函数。
Result: 所有插值分类器的泛化性能几乎相同，由率函数最大值给出；梯度下降和线性规划等算法找到的插值器性能优于几乎所有的随机插值器。
Conclusion: 在过参数化小α下，高效的优化算法实现了非平凡的良性过拟合，优于绝大多数插值分类器。

papers.title: Goedel-Architect: Streamlining Formal Theorem Proving with Blueprint Generation and Refinement
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Goedel-Architect, an agentic framework for formal theorem proving in Lean 4 centered on blueprint generation and refinement. A blueprint is a dependency graph of definitions and lemmas that builds up to the main theorem. First, Goedel-Architect generates a blueprint of formally stated definitions and lemmas, along with declared dependencies. This blueprint is optionally guided by a natural language proof. Then, a tool-equipped Lean prover component closes each open lemma node in parallel using relevant dependencies. Failed lemmas in turn drive refinement of the global blueprint. This strategy contrasts with other mainstream approaches which use recursive lemma decomposition, and can inefficiently loop on dead-end strategies. Using the open-weight DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B-A13B) as the backbone, Goedel-Architect attains 99.2% pass@1 on MiniF2F-test and 75.6% pass@1 on PutnamBench. With an optional natural-language proof seeding the initial blueprint on the harder problems, we additionally close the remaining two MiniF2F-test problems (reaching 100%), lift PutnamBench to 88.8% (597/672), and solve 4/6 on IMO 2025, 11/12 on Putnam 2025, and 3/6 on USAMO 2026. This represents state-of-the-art performance for an open-source pipeline at a price point up to 500x less than comparable open-source pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Goedel-Architect，一个基于蓝图生成和细化的形式化定理证明框架，使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash作为骨干，在MiniF2F和PutnamBench上取得领先结果，且成本显著低于同类开源管线。
Motivation: 现有形式化定理证明方法常采用递归引理分解，可能陷入死循环；本文旨在通过全局蓝图生成与并行证明提升效率和成功率。
Method: 提出蓝图（定义和引理的依赖图）生成与细化框架：先生成形式化的蓝图（可借助自然语言证明引导），然后Lean证明器并行关闭每个开放引理，失败引理驱动蓝图全局细化。
Result: 在MiniF2F-test上达到99.2% pass@1（通过自然语言引导可达100%），PutnamBench上75.6% pass@1（引导后88.8%），并在IMO 2025等竞赛题上取得高解决率；成本比同类开源管线低至1/500。
Conclusion: 该框架代表了开源形式化证明管线的最先进性能，且计算成本大幅降低。

papers.title: You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference in modern LLMs is increasingly constrained by decoding efficiency, especially in reasoning-heavy settings where models generate long intermediate chains of thought. Existing sparse attention methods often face a practical efficiency-quality trade-off. Structured block sparse methods typically provide stronger acceleration but incur noticeable quality loss, while token sparse methods are usually more accurate yet deliver limited end-to-end speedup because top-k routing over the full cache remains expensive. In this work, we propose cross-layer sparse attention (CLSA), which is built on top of KV-sharing architectures such as YOCO. The core idea is to share not only the KV cache across cross-decoder layers, but also the routing index. A single indexer computes token-level top-k selection once and reuses the resulting index across layers, thereby preserving the fine-grained selectivity of token sparse attention while amortizing the routing overhead. The resulting architecture improves all major inference bottlenecks jointly, including pre-filling, KV-cache storage, and long-context decoding. Experiments across short-context and long-context benchmarks show that CLSA is both accurate and efficient, achieving up to 7.6x decoding speedup and 17.1x overall throughput improvement at 128K context. These results suggest a more complete architectural solution for long-context LLMs that jointly advances model quality and inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Benchmark Everything Everywhere All at Once
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks are fundamental for evaluating and advancing LLMs and MLLMs by providing standardized and explicit measures of performance. However, their construction is labor-intensive and hard to reuse, raising concerns about sustainability and scalability. Moreover, existing benchmarks often quickly reach performance saturation after their release, resulting in insufficient discrimination among state-of-the-art models. To address these challenges, we introduce Benchmark Agent, a fully autonomous agentic system designed for benchmark building. Our framework orchestrates the complete benchmark construction pipeline, from user query analysis and subtask design to data annotation and quality control. To assess Benchmark Agent, we implement it to produce 15 representative benchmarks, spanning diverse evaluation scenarios, including text understanding, multimodal understanding, and domain-specific reasoning. Extensive experiments, including human evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge assessment, and consistency checks, demonstrate Benchmark Agent can generate high-quality benchmark samples with minimal human involvement. More importantly, through continual evaluation, we observe several insightful findings, including that current models struggle with certain domain-specific reasoning tasks. We believe that rapidly evolving benchmarks can contribute significantly to the research community. The preview and code will be publicly available at the demo page and code repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Benchmark Agent，一个全自动的基准构建系统，能够从用户查询分析到数据标注和质量控制自动完成基准构建。系统生成了15个覆盖文本理解、多模态理解和领域特定推理的代表性基准。实验表明，Benchmark Agent 能以极少量人工参与生成高质量基准样本，并揭示当前模型在领域特定推理任务上存在困难。
Motivation: 现有基准构建劳动密集、难以复用，且发布后快速饱和，无法有效区分先进模型。因此需要自动化的、可持续的基准构建方法。
Method: 提出 Benchmark Agent，一个全自主智能体系统，自动化整个基准构建流程，包括用户查询分析、子任务设计、数据标注和质量控制。
Result: 系统成功构建15个覆盖多种场景的基准，通过人工评估、LLM-as-a-judge和一致性检查验证了高质量。持续评估发现当前模型在领域特定推理上表现不足。
Conclusion: 自动且快速演进的基准对研究社区有重要价值，Benchmark Agent 展示了减少人工参与、保持基准质量与时效性的可行路径。

papers.title: Will the Agent Recuse Itself? Measuring LLM-Agent Compliance with In-Band Access-Deny Signals
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous LLM agents increasingly hold real credentials and operate infrastructure without a human in the loop, operators have no standard way to tell an agent that a resource is off-limits. Access controls either let the agent in (it has valid credentials) or hard-fail it (indistinguishable from any other client). We propose a third mode: a lightweight, published in-band deny signal -- the Recuse Signal -- that a server emits over a protocol's existing channels (an SSH banner, a PostgreSQL NOTICE) asking a connecting automated agent to voluntarily withdraw. This is a cooperative governance control, the robots.txt analogue for live access; it is explicitly not a security boundary. Its value is entirely empirical and, to our knowledge, unmeasured: do compliant LLM agents actually honor such a signal? We define the signal as an open mini-standard, implement two zero- or low-footprint adapters (an SSH banner/PAM hook and a PostgreSQL wire-protocol proxy), deploy them on a live production host, and run a controlled experiment in which fresh agents are given a benign operations task and observed for recusal. In a pilot (SSH; OpenAI GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini; and Claude Code as a deployed agent), the signal cleanly induces recusal -- 100% recusal when present versus 100% task completion in a no-signal control -- and, revealingly, behaves as a cooperative rather than absolute signal: an explicit operator-authorization framing flips the most capable model to proceed, while other agents continue to defer to the on-host policy. We release the standard, adapters, and experiment harness for reproduction.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Code, specification, and experiment harness: https://github.com/mthamil107/Recuse
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一种轻量级、公开的带内拒绝信号（Recuse Signal），通过协议现有通道（如SSH banner、PostgreSQL NOTICE）告知自主LLM代理资源不可用，并自愿退出。在SSH场景实验中，该信号实现100%回避率，且代理行为受操作员授权影响。该信号是合作治理控制，类似于robots.txt，不构成安全边界。
Motivation: 当LLM代理持有真实凭证且无人干预时，运营商无法标准地告知代理资源禁止访问，现有访问控制要么允许（有凭证）要么硬拒绝（无法区分其他客户端）。
Method: 定义Recuse Signal作为开放微型标准，实现SSH banner/PAM钩子和PostgreSQL wire-protocol代理，在生产主机上部署并运行控制实验，观察代理在给定任务下是否回避。
Result: 在SSH实验中（OpenAI GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Claude Code），信号存在时100%回避，无信号时100%完成任务；操作员明确授权时最强模型会继续执行，其他模型则遵守策略。
Conclusion: 该信号作为合作治理控制，其效用是经验性的，需要进一步测量；论文发布标准、适配器和实验工具以促进复现。

papers.title: Event Detection for Parameter-to-KPI Dependency Learning for AI-RAN
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation wireless networks are expected to rely on multiple concurrent AI-driven control functions that optimize different network objectives simultaneously, particularly in AI-integrated and open radio access network architectures such as AI Radio Access Network (AI-RAN) and Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). When these functions interact, they can interfere with one another in ways that are difficult to detect from raw network data alone. A key missing piece for managing such interactions is a reliable, interpretable dependency structure that captures which control parameters are actively influencing which network performance outcomes at any given time. This paper focuses on the event-detection step needed to support such dependency learning by converting noisy continuous telemetry into binary indicators of parameter activity and KPI response. The central difficulty is that not every fluctuation in the data reflects a genuine control interaction, so the method must distinguish real parameter-outcome relationships from background variation. Because real AI-RAN traffic traces with known parameter-KPI ground truth are difficult to obtain, we introduce a synthetic closed-loop traffic generator with planted latent dependencies. We use this controlled telemetry to evaluate a machine-learning-based dependency recovery pipeline that formulates the conversion of continuous traces into binary event indicators as a significance-detection problem. Experimental evaluation shows that the proposed pipeline reliably recovers the latent dependency structure from noisy continuous traces when the signal is sufficiently separated from background variation, while highlighting threshold calibration as the key factor controlling event-detection quality. These results constitute a foundational step toward interpretable dependency learning for adaptive AI-RAN control systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI-RAN网络中多个AI控制函数相互干扰的问题，提出一种事件检测方法，将连续遥测数据转换为二值化事件指示器，以支持参数与KPI之间的依赖学习。采用合成闭环轨迹生成器模拟潜在依赖关系，并通过显著性检测管道恢复依赖结构。实验表明，当信号与背景噪声分离充分时，该管道能可靠恢复潜在依赖结构，阈值校准是关键因素。
Motivation: 无线网络中多个AI控制函数同时运行时可能相互干扰，现有方法难以从原始数据中直接检测这种交互。缺乏可解释的依赖结构来捕捉控制参数对网络性能指标的影响，因此需要可靠的事件检测步骤。
Method: 提出一个基于显著性检测的机器学习管道，将噪声连续遥测数据转换为二值化事件指示器（参数活动和KPI响应），并引入合成闭环轨迹生成器（含已知潜在依赖）作为评估基准。
Result: 实验证明，当信号与背景噪声充分分离时，该管道能可靠恢复潜在依赖结构，并指出阈值校准是影响事件检测质量的关键因素。
Conclusion: 该工作为自适应AI-RAN控制系统的可解释依赖学习奠定了基础，但阈值校准仍需进一步关注。

papers.title: In-Context Multiple Instance Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data yields a model that can solve new tasks from a handful of labeled bags. At inference time, classification happens in a single forward pass and requires no gradient updates. We propose and investigate different synthetic data generators for bag-structured data and find that they capture complementary inductive biases. A model pretrained on a mixture of these generators inherits their per-task strengths and achieves the best average performance across twelve MIL benchmarks, outperforming supervised baselines that require task-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于上下文学习的多实例学习（MIL）方法，通过预训练感知器架构的上下文学习器在合成数据上，使得模型能从少量标记包中解决新任务，推理时单次前向传播无需梯度更新。作者研究了多种合成数据生成器，发现它们提供互补的归纳偏差，混合预训练模型在12个MIL基准上平均性能最佳，超越需要任务特定训练的有监督基线。
Motivation: 现有MIL算法在低标签场景下表现不佳，灵活模型易过拟合而刚性模型难以适应任务，需要一种能从少量标签包中快速泛化的方法。
Method: 采用感知器（Perceiver）架构作为上下文学习器，在合成多实例数据上预训练；提出多种合成数据生成器以捕获不同归纳偏差，并在推理时通过单次前向传播完成分类。
Result: 在12个MIL基准数据集上，混合生成器预训练的模型取得平均最佳性能，优于需要任务特定训练的有监督基线。
Conclusion: 上下文学习结合合成数据预训练能有效解决MIL中的低标签问题，合成生成器的多样性有助于提升泛化能力。

papers.title: Vortex: Efficient and Programmable Sparse Attention Serving for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention is becoming increasingly important for serving large language models (LLMs) as generation lengths continue to grow. However, deploying and evaluating new sparse attention algorithms at scale remains highly engineering-intensive, slowing both human researchers and AI agents in exploring the sparse attention design. To address this challenge, we present Vortex, a system that combines a Python-embedded frontend language atop a page-centric tensor abstraction for expressing a broad range of sparse attention algorithms, with an efficient backend tightly integrated into modern LLM serving stacks. Vortex enables rapid prototyping, deployment, and evaluation of sparse attention algorithms, effectively translating their theoretical efficiency gains into real-world throughput improvements. As a result, Vortex substantially accelerates the design and iteration of sparse attention algorithms. First, AI agents use Vortex to automatically generate and refine diverse algorithms, the best reaching up to $3.46\times$ higher throughput than full attention while preserving accuracy. Second, Vortex extends sparse attention to emerging architectures and very large models that are otherwise hard to experiment with, reaching up to $4.7\times$ higher throughput on the MLA-based GLM-4.7-Flash and $1.37\times$ on the 229B-parameter MiniMax-M2.7 on NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Vortex系统，结合Python嵌入式前端语言和以页为中心的张量抽象，支持多种稀疏注意力算法的快速原型设计、部署和评估。后端紧密集成到现代LLM服务栈中，能将理论效率转化为实际吞吐量提升。实验表明，AI Agent使用Vortex自动生成和优化算法，最高可实现比全注意力高3.46倍的吞吐量；在MLA-based GLM-4.7-Flash上达到4.7倍，在229B参数的MiniMax-M2.7上达到1.37倍。
Motivation: 稀疏注意力在大语言模型长序列生成中日益重要，但大规模部署和评估新算法工程成本高，阻碍了研究人员和AI Agent的探索。
Method: Vortex系统提供Python嵌入式前端语言和以页为中心的张量抽象，支持广泛稀疏注意力算法的表达，并通过高效后端集成到现代LLM服务栈中，支持自动算法生成与优化。
Result: AI Agent使用Vortex自动生成的算法最高可达全注意力3.46倍吞吐量；在MLA-based GLM-4.7-Flash上达到4.7倍，在229B参数MiniMax-M2.7上达到1.37倍（NVIDIA B200 GPU）。
Conclusion: Vortex显著加速了稀疏注意力算法的设计与迭代，并扩展了其在新型架构和超大模型上的应用，展示了实际吞吐量提升。摘要未提及局限。

summary_sections.method: Vortex系统提供Python嵌入式前端语言和以页为中心的张量抽象，支持广泛稀疏注意力算法的表达，并通过高效后端集成到现代LLM服务栈中，支持自动算法生成与优化。
summary_sections.result: AI Agent使用Vortex自动生成的算法最高可达全注意力3.46倍吞吐量；在MLA-based GLM-4.7-Flash上达到4.7倍，在229B参数MiniMax-M2.7上达到1.37倍（NVIDIA B200 GPU）。
summary_sections.conclusion: Vortex显著加速了稀疏注意力算法的设计与迭代，并扩展了其在新型架构和超大模型上的应用，展示了实际吞吐量提升。摘要未提及局限。

papers.title: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks requiring sustained reasoning over extended interaction histories. Realizing this at scale requires agents to persistently store, retrieve, and update their own memory across sessions. A rich ecosystem of agent memory systems has emerged spanning flat retrieval, LLM-mediated extraction, consolidating fact stores, and agentic control flows. Yet, their system-level behavior remains uncharacterized. We present the first systems characterization of agent memory. First, we introduce a system-oriented taxonomy classifying agent memory systems along four axes. Second, we build a phase-aware profiling harness attributing cost to construction, retrieval, and generation. Third, we characterize ten representative systems across two benchmark suites, uncovering how design choices shift cost across the write and read paths. Finally, we derive 10 system recommendations covering construction scheduling, capability floors, amortization via query volume, freshness-latency tradeoffs, and fleet-scale management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对LLM代理内存系统进行系统级表征，提出面向系统的分类法、阶段感知分析框架，并通过对10个代表性系统的基准测试，揭示了设计选择如何影响读写路径的成本，最终给出10条系统建议。
Motivation: 长时间跨度的代理任务需要持续存储、检索和更新内存，但现有代理内存系统的系统级行为尚未被表征。
Method: 引入系统导向的分类法（四轴），构建阶段感知的分析框架，对10个代表性系统在两个基准套件上进行表征。
Result: 揭示了设计选择如何影响写入和读取路径的成本，并推导出10条系统建议，涵盖构建调度、能力下限、查询量摊销、新鲜度-延迟权衡及集群规模管理。
Conclusion: 代理内存系统的设计选择显著影响性能，建议的优化方向可指导未来系统构建。
Relevance: 0
