papers.title: Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Effective Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for mechanistic interpretability in large language models, yet their formulation assigns each latent feature a single decoder direction, implicitly assuming features to be one-dimensional. We show that this assumption mismatches with the multi-dimensional structure of model features, provably inducing feature splitting through two distinct mechanisms. Geometrically, reconstructing a feature of intrinsic dimension $d_i \ge 2$ to error $\varepsilon$ with single-direction decoders forces a number of atoms that is exponential in $d_i$. From an end-to-end optimization perspective, this splitting is not merely possible but actively preferred. We prove that there exists a continuous path from the true $d_i$-dimensional basis to a strictly lower risk of the $\ell_1$-regularized SAE objective, whose descent directions drive any trained dictionary into that exponential regime. A single coherent feature is therefore fragmented across many near-collinear latents, producing spurious multiplicity and obscuring the intrinsic geometry. Motivated by this, we introduce Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA), which replace single-vector decoders with learned decoder subspaces, enforce block sparsity via Top-$s$ group gating, and adapt each group's effective rank with a nuclear-norm regularizer. We then show that once the block size satisfies $r \ge d_i$, a single group not only can represent the entire feature slice but is the global minimizer of the SASA objective. This consolidation yields a sample complexity polynomial in $d_i$ rather than exponential -- a decisive advantage given that every training activation costs an LLM forward pass. Empirically, on GPT-2 and Mistral-7B, SASA reduces feature splitting and absorption, improves monosemanticity and interpretability, and matches or exceeds standard SAEs while training on roughly half the token budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出稀疏自编码器（SAE）将每个潜在特征假设为一维，与LLM特征的多维结构不匹配，导致特征分裂。作者提出子空间感知稀疏自编码器（SASA），用学习到的子空间代替单向量解码器，结合块稀疏和核范数正则化，理论上证明了当块大小足够时单个组即可编码完整特征，样本复杂度从指数降为多项式。在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上，SASA减少了特征分裂和吸收，提高了单义性和可解释性，且训练令牌预算减半。
Motivation: 现有SAE假设特征是一维的，但LLM中特征本质是多维的，导致特征分裂：一个连贯特征被分割成多个几乎共线的潜在变量，产生虚假多重性，阻碍机械可解释性的准确性。
Method: 提出Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders（SASA），用学习到的解码器子空间代替单向量解码器；采用Top-s组门控强制块稀疏；通过核范数正则化自适应调整每组有效秩。理论证明当块大小r ≥ d_i时，单个组能够编码整个特征切片，且样本复杂度关于d_i为多项式而非指数。
Result: 在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上，SASA显著减少了特征分裂和吸收，提高了特征的单义性和可解释性，同时在大约一半的令牌预算下达到或超过标准SAE的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SASA通过显式建模特征的多维结构，为LLM的机械可解释性提供了更高效、更准确的稀疏字典学习方法。

papers.title: Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values
papers.abstract_en: Asymptotic e-values are emerging as a powerful alternative to asymptotic p-values, particularly in post-hoc inference and multiple testing, where significance levels may be data-dependent. Existing asymptotic e-values, however, suffer from the ``missing factor,'' a scaling inefficiency resulting in overly conservative inference. Drawing on the framework of near-optimal concentration inequalities developed by Bentkus in the 2000s, we introduce Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values and prove that they successfully eliminate the missing factor. We also demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that Bentkus-type e-values consistently deliver sharper inference than existing alternatives, leading to tighter post-hoc confidence intervals and higher rejection rates in multiple testing procedures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Bentkus型渐近e值，利用Bentkus在2000年代发展的近最优集中不等式，成功消除了现有渐近e值中的“缺失因子”缩放低效问题。理论和实验均表明，新方法能产生更紧凑的后验置信区间和更高的多重检验拒绝率，适用于事后推断和多重检验中显著性水平依赖于数据的情景。
Motivation: 现有渐近e值存在“缺失因子”缩放低效问题，导致推断过于保守，需要一种更高效的渐近e值以提升统计推断的精确性。
Method: 引入Bentkus型渐近e值，基于近最优集中不等式构建，旨在消除原有渐近e值中的缩放低效问题。
Result: 理论和实验证明Bentkus型渐近e值相比现有方法能实现更紧凑的后验置信区间和更高的多重检验拒绝率。
Conclusion: Bentkus型渐近e值成功解决渐近e值的缺失因子问题，为事后推断和多重检验提供更高效的统计工具。

papers.title: Efficient Mean Curvature Computation on High-Dimensional Data Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Estimating local mean curvature at each point of a high-dimensional dataset is a key ingredient of geometry-aware machine learning algorithms, such as the Mean Curvature Boundary Points (MCBP) method. The naive implementation of this computation, based on a local shape operator approximated from k-nearest neighbor patches, involves an explicit construction of a matrix $H$ whose trace form yields an $O(m^4)$ cost per point, rendering the approach intractable for datasets with more than a few dozen features. This paper introduces two complementary contributions that together reduce this cost by several orders of magnitude. The first contribution is an exact algebraic identity. This identity, derived from the orthogonality of the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix and the cyclicity of the trace operator, eliminates $H$ entirely and reduces the per-point cost to $O(m^2)$ after the eigendecomposition. The second contribution addresses the remaining $O(m^3)$ bottleneck of the full eigendecomposition. Since the local covariance matrix has rank at most $k-1 \ll m$, we replace it with a truncated SVD of the $k \times m$ centered data matrix, an $O(k^2 m)$ operation, and derive an analytical approximation for the contribution of the null-space eigenvectors based on the expected value of their outer product under the Haar measure. The resulting estimator has total cost $O(k^2 m + k m p^2)$, where $p = k-1$. Experiments on real-world datasets confirm speedups of 50 to 300 times relative to the original implementation, with negligible loss when the fast estimator is used to replace the original version. By providing a scalable and data-driven estimate of local curvature, the proposed method establishes curvature as a practical geometric feature for a broad range of machine learning tasks, from classical to modern deep learning pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维数据集上局部平均曲率计算的计算瓶颈，提出两个互补的改进：一是通过代数恒等式将每点复杂度从O(m^4)降至O(m^2)（m为特征数）；二是用截断SVD替代完整特征分解，并基于Haar分布近似零空间贡献，将总复杂度降至O(k^2 m + k m p^2)（k为近邻数，p=k-1）。实验表明在真实数据集上加速50-300倍且精度损失可忽略。
Motivation: 高维数据流形上的平均曲率计算是几何感知机器学习（如MCBP方法）的关键，但朴素实现每点需O(m^4)时间，无法处理超过数十维的数据集。
Method: 利用协方差矩阵特征向量正交性和迹循环性推导精确代数恒等式，消除显式构建矩阵H，将每点复杂度降至O(m^2)；再用截断SVD计算局部协方差（秩≤k-1），并基于Haar分布期望近似零空间特征向量外积，避免完整特征分解。
Result: 在真实数据集上，相比原始实现获得50-300倍加速，且用快速估计器替换原始版本后精度损失可忽略。
Conclusion: 本文使曲率成为机器学习中实用的几何特征，适用于从传统方法到现代深度学习流水线的广泛任务。

papers.title: PAMF: Prior-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Incomplete Time Series Data
papers.abstract_en: In healthcare, multimodal time series tasks often operate on incomplete observations in practice, for example when ECG segments are lost because electrodes detach or an entire respiratory channel is unavailable during overnight monitoring. Such missingness typically appears in two structurally distinct patterns: within-modality missing, where values are absent within an otherwise observed modality, and modality-level missing, where an entire modality is unavailable. Existing methods typically represent unobserved data implicitly through masks or missing embeddings, without learning instance-specific missing information, and most are designed for only one missingness pattern. A natural approach is to explicitly estimate the missing data; however, existing imputation methods treat missingness uniformly despite their different structural priors, and the imputation process is often isolated from downstream tasks, preventing downstream tasks from guiding imputation toward more informative representations. To address these limitations, we present PAMF, a multimodal time-series framework that explicitly handles different missingness patterns while coupling imputation with downstream prediction through prior-aware flow matching and weight sharing. Specifically, the method initializes the flow-matching source state with type-specific priors to distinguish two missing types. It further connects imputation and classification through architecturally matched encoders with weight sharing, transferring task-relevant representations into the imputation process. Experiments on multiple multimodal healthcare time-series benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves the strongest overall downstream performance across diverse datasets and missing settings compared with existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAMF框架，专为医疗多模态时间序列中的两种缺失模式（模态内缺失和模态级缺失）设计。它通过先验感知流匹配（prior-aware flow matching）显式估计缺失数据，并将插补与下游预测通过权重共享耦合。在多个医疗多模态时间序列基准上，该方法在不同缺失设置下取得了最优的下游性能。
Motivation: 现有方法对缺失数据的处理多为隐式（掩码或缺失嵌入），缺乏实例特异性，且只针对一种缺失模式。插补方法则忽视不同的结构先验，且插补与下游任务割裂。
Method: 提出PAMF，使用类型特定的先验初始化流匹配源状态以区分两种缺失类型，并通过架构匹配的编码器权重共享连接插补和分类，使插补过程获得任务相关表示。
Result: 在多个多模态医疗时间序列基准上，PAMF在不同缺失设置下均取得最优下游性能。
Conclusion: 显式建模不同缺失模式并耦合插补与预测可有效提升多模态时间序列任务的鲁棒性。

papers.title: DragOn: A Benchmark and Dataset for Drag-Based GUI Interactions
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents - vision-based models that control desktops, web browsers, and mobile devices through graphical user interfaces - promise to automate a wide range of digital tasks. While million-scale datasets have enabled substantial progress on click-grounding, drag grounding (e.g. drag-and-drop, swipe, highlight) data remains an order of magnitude smaller and current models fall short on complex drag-based interactions. We introduce DragOn, a drag grounding benchmark and training dataset covering four domains: text highlighting, cell selection, element resizing and slider manipulation. The dataset comprises 286K training screenshots and 3.5M training tasks, plus a 2000-example held-out evaluation suite. We evaluate proprietary (GPT, Claude) and open-weight (Qwen, Kimi, Holo) models, as well as a Qwen VLM fine-tuned on our training data. Results suggest that our dataset could improve performance of state-of-the-art models on downstream computer-use tasks.

papers.title: Learning What to Forget: Improving LLM Unlearning via Learned Token-Level Importance
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model while preserving its general capabilities. For autoregressive language models, not all tokens in a forget sample are equally relevant to forgetting. Existing approaches either ignore this heterogeneity or rely on auxiliary models, heuristics, or external annotations to estimate each token's relevance for forgetting. We instead characterize it through the interaction with the retain objective: a token is forget-specific to the extent that minimizing the forget loss on that token does not conflict with retain optimality. We formalize this perspective as a joint optimization problem over the model parameters and the token weights and show that, under a natural separation condition, the resulting objective recovers the oracle forget-specific token support. Motivated by this formulation, we introduce Alternating Token-Weighted Unlearning (ATWU), a lightweight framework that jointly learns token forget-specificity and model parameters during unlearning using a simple linear scorer over the hidden states, without external token level supervision. Across TOFU and RWKU, ATWU achieves state of the art forget-retain trade-offs, outperforming sample-level methods, probability-based token weighting heuristics, and auxiliary-model-based approaches. Moreover, the learned scores align substantially better with ground truth forget-specific spans, indicating that ATWU identifies semantically meaningful token level forgetting signals. Overall, our results suggest that retain conflict provides an effective criterion for identifying what language models should forget, enabling unsupervised learning of token level forget-specificity directly from model representations with minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的LLM机器遗忘方法，通过考虑token级别的遗忘重要性，基于遗忘目标与保留目标的冲突来学习token权重，无需外部标注，实现更好的遗忘-保留权衡。
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法忽略不同token对遗忘目标的贡献差异，或依赖辅助模型/启发式，缺乏原则性方法。本文旨在自动识别每个token的遗忘特异性。
Method: 提出交替token加权遗忘（ATWU）框架，联合学习token权重和模型参数，通过一个线性评分器基于隐藏状态打分，优化目标是遗忘损失与保留损失权衡。
Result: 在TOFU和RWKU基准上，ATWU取得最先进的遗忘-保留权衡，优于样本级方法和各种加权启发式；学习到的token重要性与真实遗忘跨度高度一致。
Conclusion: 保留冲突可以作为有效的遗忘准则，实现无监督的token级遗忘特异性学习，计算开销低。

papers.title: Quantum enhanced rare event discovery and sampling
papers.abstract_en: Financial crashes, cascading failures in infrastructure, and critical errors in AI systems are frequently triggered by events that occur with extremely small probability. Efficiently discovering and sampling events with probability below a threshold is therefore of critical interest. Yet this task is highly non-trivial using existing classical or quantum methods. Being rare, such events require an immense sampling overhead to collect sufficient data samples. Moreover, because the rare events are not known in advance, they cannot be flagged for amplification using standard techniques. Here, we introduce a quantum algorithm for rare-event discovery and sampling without first learning which events are rare. The algorithm achieves the optimal quantum scaling with the rarity threshold. We further demonstrate that this can achieve a quadratic speedup for heavy-tailed systems whose tail has nonvanishing total mass, and translates into a robust polynomial speedup for stationary stochastic processes, with the exponent determined by its entropy-rate structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种量子算法，用于在无需预先了解稀有事件的情况下发现和采样概率极低的事件，并实现了与稀有阈值相关的最优量子缩放。该算法在尾部非零总质量的厚尾系统中可实现二次加速，在平稳随机过程中可转化为稳健的多项式加速，其指数由熵率结构决定。
Motivation: 稀有事件（如金融崩溃、基础设施级联故障、AI系统关键错误）的发生概率极低，但影响巨大。经典和现有量子方法在采样这些未知稀有事件时需要巨大开销，且无法通过标准技术预先标记它们进行放大。
Method: 提出一种量子算法，无需预先学习哪些事件是稀有的，直接实现稀有事件的发现和采样。该算法达到与稀有阈值相关的最优量子缩放，并利用量子振幅放大等技术实现加速。
Result: 对于尾部非零总质量的厚尾系统，实现二次加速；对于平稳随机过程，实现稳健的多项式加速，加速指数由系统的熵率结构决定。
Conclusion: 该量子算法为稀有事件发现和采样提供了理论上的最优量子加速，并适用于多种现实场景，但需要进一步实验验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LLM Self-Recognition: Steering and Retrieving Activation Signatures
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in interpretability suggest that large language models (LLMs) implicitly encode signals in their generated text that enable self-recognition of their outputs. We demonstrate that this capability is reliable, even in low-entropy scenarios, and that it can be amplified through targeted intervention. By steering the internal residual stream during generation with a random sparse vector, we create a detectable fingerprint that enables attribution of a given text to a specific LLM. This signal is recoverable from the activations of an LLM used as a detector, achieving over 98% accuracy across multiple detection settings while preserving the quality of generated text. As AI-generated content proliferates, this approach offers a practical alternative to traditional detectors by leveraging the model's natural representation structure for attribution rather than embedding a signal externally. Our contributions include: (i) establishing reliable self-recognition capabilities in LLMs, (ii) a simple steering mechanism enabling multi-LLM identification with no quality degradation, (iii) demonstrating that activation spaces contain exploitable structure for encoding signals without semantic interference.
papers.comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明大型语言模型（LLM）在生成文本中隐含编码了可自我识别的信号，并可通过随机稀疏向量干预残差流创建可检测指纹。该方法利用检测LLM的激活空间，在多个检测设置中实现超过98%的准确率，且不降低生成文本质量。
Motivation: AI生成内容泛滥，传统检测器存在局限，需要利用模型自然表示结构而非外部嵌入信号进行归因。
Method: 通过在生成过程中向内部残差流注入随机稀疏向量，创建可归因的指纹；利用检测LLM的激活空间恢复该信号。
Result: 在多种检测设置下归因准确率超过98%，且生成文本质量无退化。
Conclusion: 激活空间存在可被利用的结构来编码信号而不产生语义干扰，为归因提供了实用替代方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DAS-PINNs for high-dimensional partial differential equations: extending deep adaptive sampling to spacetime domains
papers.abstract_en: Time-dependent high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) with spatially localised and dynamically evolving solutions pose a fundamental challenge for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), as uniform collocation sampling becomes increasingly ineffective in high-dimensional spatiotemporal domains. In this work, a deep adaptive sampling framework for PINNs is extended to the time-dependent setting by treating space and time as a unified domain without any explicit time marching. A normalising flow neural network model effectively learns the distribution induced by the PDE residual and generates new collocation points concentrated in regions where the solution is most difficult to learn. Unlike conventional adaptive strategies that require explicit time stepping or moving meshes, high-residual regions are automatically identified and tracked across both space and time, driven purely by the PDE residual distribution. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is assessed on a range of benchmark problems, from sharp and moving features in two spatial dimensions to localised structures in up to eight spatial dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间依赖高维PDEs中PINN均匀采样低效的问题，将深度自适应采样框架（DAS-PINNs）扩展到时空统一域，使用正规化流模型根据PDE残差分布自适应生成配点。在二维到八维的基准问题上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 时间依赖高维PDE的解常具有空间局部和动态演化特征，均匀配点采样在高维时空域中越来越低效，是现有PINNs的瓶颈。
Method: 将时空视为统一域，不显式时间推进；用正规化流神经网络学习PDE残差分布，自动生成新配点集中在高残差区域。
Result: 在包括二维中的尖锐移动特征到八维中局部结构的一系列基准问题上验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法能够自动识别和追踪时空中的高残差区域，完全由PDE残差分布驱动，无需时间步进或移动网格。

papers.title: Wall Shear Stress Reconstruction from Concentration: Differentiable Physics and Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Wall shear stress (WSS) governs near-wall transport dynamics and is a key hemodynamic indicator in cardiovascular flows, yet remains difficult to infer accurately due to the need for precise computation of near-wall velocity gradients. Passive scalar fields, such as concentration or temperature, are advected by the same underlying velocity field and have the potential to uncover hidden flow physics metrics such as WSS. In this work, we demonstrate such reconstruction from spatially limited passive scalar observations using two fundamentally different inverse frameworks: a differentiable physics framework based on discrete adjoint, PDE-constrained optimization, which enforces the governing equations as hard constraints, and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), which treat them as soft constraints. Benchmark problems include a 2D canonical backward-facing step (2D-BFS) and a 3D patient-specific stenotic coronary artery. For the 2D-BFS case, evaluated under three measurement scenarios (near-wall, far-field, and combined), PINN achieves high accuracy when near-wall data are available but fails when restricted to far-field measurements, whereas the differentiable physics approach recovers accurate WSS across all scenarios. In the 3D patient-specific case, the differentiable physics framework outperforms PINNs, yielding accurate WSS reconstruction. These results establish that measurement location and inverse formulation jointly determine reconstruction fidelity in scalar-based near-wall flow inference. The proposed framework opens a path toward estimation of near-wall hemodynamics from scalar transport data, with broader applicability to fluid flow problems where passive scalars can be observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从被动标量（如浓度）观测中重建壁剪切应力（WSS）的两种逆问题框架：基于离散伴随的PDE约束优化的可微物理方法（硬约束）和物理信息神经网络（PINNs，软约束）。在2D后向台阶流和3D患者特定狭窄冠状动脉案例中，可微物理框架在所有测量场景下均能准确重建WSS，而PINNs仅在近壁数据可用时有效。结果表明测量位置和逆问题公式共同决定基于标量的近壁流推理的重建保真度。
Motivation: 壁剪切应力是心血管血流的关键血流动力学指标，但精确计算近壁速度梯度困难。被动标量场受相同速度场平流，有望揭示WSS等隐藏流动物理量，但缺乏从标量观测中高效重建WSS的可靠方法。
Method: 采用两种逆问题框架：(1) 可微物理框架，基于离散伴随的PDE约束优化，将控制方程作为硬约束；(2) 物理信息神经网络（PINNs），将控制方程作为软约束。通过标量浓度观测反演速度场并计算WSS。
Result: 在2D后向台阶流中，PINN在近壁数据下精确但远场数据下失效，可微物理框架在所有测量场景（近壁、远场、组合）下恢复准确WSS。在3D患者特异性狭窄冠状动脉案例中，可微物理框架性能优于PINNs，实现准确的WSS重建。
Conclusion: 测量位置与逆问题公式联合决定标量基近壁流推理的重建保真度，可微物理方法更鲁棒。该框架为从标量运输数据估计近壁血流动力学开辟了路径，可推广至被动标量可观测的流体问题。

papers.title: AIS-Based Vessel Trajectory Prediction Using Memory-Augmented Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Accurate vessel trajectory prediction is essential for safe and efficient maritime operations, enabling collision avoidance and supporting route optimization. Although memory-augmented neural networks have recently shown strong performance in pedestrian and road-vehicle trajectory prediction by selectively retrieving relevant information from an external memory, their potential for vessel trajectory prediction remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical investigation of memory-based trajectory prediction using Automatic Identification System (AIS) data. Experiments on data from the Gulf of Mexico and the New York Bight demonstrate consistent and substantial performance gains over a range of deep learning baselines that do not incorporate an external memory.

papers.title: RhymeFlow: Training-Free Acceleration for Video Generation with Asynchronous Denoising Flow Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models based on Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved remarkable performance in video synthesis, yet they suffer from high inference latency and computational costs due to the quadratic complexity of 3D attention. Existing acceleration methods primarily reduce computational complexity within each individual denoising steps through techniques such as sparse attention and KV-caching. However, they rigidly adhere to the inherent constraint of the standard diffusion pipeline: every frame in the target video sequence must be subjected to a complete, dense denoising process across all diffusion timesteps. We observe that due to the corresponding contents and motions among adjacent frames, when keyframes with critical semantic transitions are anchored, the intermediate states of others often follow more predictable trajectories, which indicates that such uniform, dense denoising process is inherently redundant for natural video data. To this end, we introduce \textbf{RhymeFlow}, a training-free framework that decouples the denoising trajectories of different frames. Specifically, we first identify a sparse set of pivotal key frames that dominate the latent semantic evolution. Then, only these keyframes undergo dense, step-by-step denoising to ensure structural integrity, while non-keyframes progressively skip denoising steps to minimize computational cost. Since skipped intermediate states of non-keyframes break the temporal coherence in keyframe denoising steps, leading to visual degradation, we further introduce a latent trajectory projection module, which enables keyframes to interact with a complete and temporally consistent sequence representation. Extensive experiments on current DiT-based video generation models demonstrate our method outperforms existing baselines with higher inference speed and better visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RhymeFlow是一种无需训练的加速框架，用于基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的视频生成。它通过异步去噪流调度，仅对关键帧进行密集去噪，非关键帧跳过步骤，并引入潜在轨迹投影模块维持时序一致性。在多个DiT模型上，该方法在提高推理速度的同时保持了更好的视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有DiT视频生成模型推理延迟高、计算成本大，因为3D注意力的二次复杂度。标准扩散管线要求所有帧在所有步骤进行完整密集去噪，但视频中相邻帧内容相关，此过程存在冗余。
Method: 提出RhymeFlow，识别语义变化关键帧并对其密集去噪；非关键帧逐步跳过去噪步骤。为补偿跳步导致的时序断裂，设计潜在轨迹投影模块，使关键帧与完整时序表示交互。
Result: 在基于DiT的视频生成模型上，该方法优于现有基线，推理速度更快且视觉质量更高。
Conclusion: RhymeFlow通过去耦帧的去噪轨迹，以训练无关方式加速视频生成，保持了结构完整性和视觉质量。

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction
papers.abstract_en: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensional discrete spaces, we introduce a Jacobian-free mechanism that directly corrects the clean prediction logits, facilitating stable and effective guidance. Our method accommodates both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions. Extensive experiments across DNA, protein sequence, and molecular generation tasks demonstrate that GILC achieves state-of-the-art performance without additional training, frequently outperforming fine-tuning approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度信息logit校正（GILC）框架，通过复用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理来高效估计引导信号，无需额外训练即实现离散扩散模型的可控生成。该方法采用无雅可比机制直接校正干净预测logits，支持可微与不可微奖励函数。在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上，GILC达到当前最优性能，且常优于微调方法。
Motivation: 离散扩散模型的可控生成面临高计算开销或需要重新训练的问题，现有方法难以兼顾效率与效果。
Method: 提出GILC，利用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理估计引导信号，并通过无雅可比机制直接校正干净预测logits，避免高维离散空间的梯度不稳定。
Result: 在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上，GILC实现当前最优性能，且无需额外训练，经常超越微调方法。
Conclusion: GILC是一种即插即用的引导框架，无需重新训练即可有效控制离散扩散模型生成，适用于多种非可微奖励函数。

papers.title: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn Large Language Model (LLM) serving is critical for consistent user experiences, yet the linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache imposes significant pressure on GPU memory and bandwidth. Non-uniform KV compression effectively preserves more information by considering the individual importance of each KV cache. However, such KV cache heterogeneity introduces various systemic challenges - including memory fragmentation, scheduling complexities, and diminished kernel utilization - which collectively lead to significant inefficiencies in existing LLM serving systems. To overcome these challenges, we present Tangram, a novel serving system designed to make Non-uniform KV caches practical. Tangram addresses systemic inefficiencies through three core techniques: (1) Deterministic Budget Allocation assigns a static memory footprint to each head based on its intrinsic pattern, entirely eliminating dynamic scheduling overhead and prefill stalls; (2) Head Group Page clusters attention heads with similar retention demands and manages them with independent, vectorized page tables, thereby maximizing physical memory reclamation; and (3) Ahead-of-Time (AOT) Load Balancing leverages static budget profiles to ensure uniform GPU utilization without runtime overhead. Experimental results show that Tangram improves throughput by up to 2.6x compared to existing baselines, while fully preserving model accuracy. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aiha-lab/TANGRAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Tangram，一个专为非均匀KV缓存设计的高效多轮LLM服务系统。通过确定性预算分配、头组页和提前负载均衡三项技术，解决非均匀KV缓存带来的内存碎片、调度复杂性和内核利用率下降等问题。实验表明，在完全保持模型精度的前提下，吞吐量提升高达2.6倍。
Motivation: 多轮LLM服务中KV缓存线性增长造成GPU内存和带宽压力，非均匀压缩虽能保留更多信息，但引入系统级效率挑战，如内存碎片、调度开销和内核利用率降低。
Method: Tangram通过三项核心技术使非均匀KV缓存实用：1) 确定性预算分配，基于每头内在模式分配静态内存，消除动态调度和预填充停顿；2) 头组页，将具有相似保留需求的头聚类并用独立向量化页表管理，最大化物理内存回收；3) 提前负载均衡，利用静态预算配置确保均匀GPU利用率。
Result: 与现有基线相比，Tangram在完全保持模型精度的前提下，吞吐量提升高达2.6倍。
Conclusion: Tangram证明了通过系统级设计使非均匀KV缓存成为多轮LLM服务的高效选择，解决了内存碎片和调度复杂性等关键问题。

papers.title: Multi-ResNets for Subspace Preconditioning in Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose MResOpt, a staged residual neural network architecture for constrained optimization problems. Our architecture fits within predict-complete-correct pipelines and decomposes constraint satisfaction by priority through intermediate re-completion and stage-aware losses. The framework enables domain-informed ordered constraint satisfaction which allows the network to utilize ordinal structure when present. Under an idealized infinite-width regime, we show that our design behaves as sequential Gaussian Process regression. On synthetic QP, QCQP, and SOCP benchmarks, the staged architecture improves high-priority constraint satisfaction across convex and non-convex settings. On line-flow-constrained AC optimal power flow, we introduce a physics-motivated constraint ordering and show that MResOpt supports a learned division of labor that keeps iterates on the equality manifold, achieving substantially lower high-priority violation than reprojected baselines while remaining computationally efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MResOpt，一种用于约束优化问题的多阶段残差神经网络架构，遵循“预测-补全-校正”流程，通过中间重补全和阶段感知损失实现按优先级分解约束满足。在理想化无限宽条件下，该设计等价于序列高斯过程回归。在合成 QP、QCQP、SOCP 基准以及线流约束交流最优潮流问题上，MResOpt 在凸和非凸设定下均改善了高优先级约束满足，且相比重投影基线具有更低的违规和计算效率。
Motivation: 约束优化中不同约束具有不同优先级，现有方法难以在保持计算效率的同时按序满足约束，尤其在高非线性问题如交流最优潮流中。
Method: 提出 MResOpt 多阶段残差神经网络，每个阶段对应一个优先级，通过中间补全和阶段损失强制约束次序；无限宽理论下等价于序贯高斯过程回归。
Result: 合成 QP/QCQP/SOCP 基准上，高优先级约束违规显著降低；在线流约束 AC OPF 上，物理启发的约束排序使迭代处于等流形，高优先级违规远低于重投影基线，且保持计算高效。
Conclusion: MResOpt 提供了一种可扩展的、领域知识驱动的约束满足框架，尤其适用于具有自然顺序的约束优化问题。

papers.title: Reactive Flux Matching: Mechanism Discovery and Adaptive Sampling of Rare Events
papers.abstract_en: Path sampling methods generate ensembles of reactive trajectories connecting metastable states, but extracting mechanistic insight from these data remains nontrivial. We introduce Flux Matching, a framework that learns two complementary objects directly from reactive trajectory data: a current velocity $u(z)$, whose streamlines trace the dominant reaction pathways, and a scalar potential $h(z)$, obtained from a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of the reactive current, that serves as a data-driven reaction coordinate. Both minimize quadratic functionals over the reactive path ensemble, analogous to the flow matching loss in generative modeling, and require no knowledge of the underlying dynamics or stationary distribution. Unlike committor-based methods, $u$ and $h$ remain well-defined under projection onto non-Markovian collective variables, and their level sets in turn provide adaptive interfaces for improved sampling with enhanced sampling methods. Flux Matching is validated through the generation of current velocity trajectories and rate constant calculations on molecular systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Flux Matching 框架，从稀有事件反应轨迹数据中学习两个互补对象：电流速度 u(z)（流线显示主反应路径）和标量势 h(z)（作为数据驱动的反应坐标）。该方法基于反应路径系综的二次型泛函最小化，类似于生成模型中的流匹配损失，无需知道底层动力学或稳态分布。与基于 committor 的方法不同，u 和 h 在投影到非马尔可夫集体变量上时仍然定义良好，其水平集可为增强采样方法提供自适应界面。
Motivation: 路径采样方法可以生成连接亚稳态的反应轨迹，但从中提取机制性洞察仍然困难。现有方法如 committor 函数在投影到非马尔可夫变量时可能失效，且反应路径分析缺乏统一框架。
Method: 引入 Flux Matching 框架，通过最小化反应路径系综上的二次型泛函，同时学习电流速度 u(z) 和标量势 h(z)。u 的流线揭示主导反应路径，h 来自反应电流的加权 Helmholtz-Hodge 分解，作为反应坐标。该方法无需动力学或稳态分布的先验知识。
Result: 摘要报告在分子系统上验证了 Flux Matching，生成了电流速度轨迹并计算了速率常数，证明了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: Flux Matching 提供了一种无需 committor 的反应路径分析工具，适用于非马尔可夫投影，并能与增强采样方法结合进行自适应采样。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在分子系统上验证了 Flux Matching，生成了电流速度轨迹并计算了速率常数，证明了方法的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: Flux Matching 提供了一种无需 committor 的反应路径分析工具，适用于非马尔可夫投影，并能与增强采样方法结合进行自适应采样。

papers.title: Towards One-to-Many Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Grounding (TG) aims to localize video segments corresponding to a textual query. Prior research predominantly focuses on single-segment retrieval. Real-world scenarios, however, often require localizing multiple disjoint segments for a single query -- a setting we term One-to-Many Temporal Grounding (OMTG). Previous state-of-the-art MLLMs, optimized for one-to-one settings, struggle in this context, often yielding near-zero scores due to a lack of event cardinality perception. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic solution with three key contributions. First, we establish the first comprehensive OMTG benchmark, introducing Count Accuracy (C-Acc) and Effective Temporal F1 (EtF1) as evaluation metrics. Second, we curate a high-quality OMTG dataset comprising 56k samples through a sophisticated construction pipeline. Third, we develop novel temporal and caption reward functions specifically designed for OMTG. In particular, the caption reward leverages Chain-of-Thought reasoning over dense video captions to explicitly guide policy optimization toward both preciseness and completeness. Extensive experiments show our model achieves a new state-of-the-art EtF1 of 43.65\% on OMTG Bench, outperforming Gemini 2.5 Pro and Seed-1.8 by 15.85\% and 15.61\%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对从单个文本查询定位视频中多个不连续片段的任务（One-to-Many Temporal Grounding, OMTG），指出现有多模态大模型（MLLMs）因缺乏事件基数感知而表现差。作者构建了首个OMTG基准和包含56k样本的数据集，提出专门设计的时序和字幕奖励函数，其中字幕奖励利用密集视频字幕的链式推理指导策略优化。实验表明，模型在OMTG Bench上达到43.65%的EtF1，超过Gemini 2.5 Pro和Seed-1.8约15个百分点。
Motivation: 现有时间定位研究多聚焦于单片段检索，但实际应用常需为单个查询定位多个不连续片段（OMTG）。当前最优的MLLMs在OMTG上几乎零分，缺乏事件基数感知。
Method: 建立首个OMTG基准，提出计数准确率（C-Acc）和有效时间F1（EtF1）指标；通过精心构建流程整理56k样本的OMTG数据集；开发针对OMTG的时序和字幕奖励函数，其中字幕奖励利用密集视频字幕的链式推理显式指导策略优化，兼顾精确性和完整性。
Result: 模型在OMTG Bench上达到43.65%的EtF1，比Gemini 2.5 Pro高15.85个百分点，比Seed-1.8高15.61个百分点。
Conclusion: 本文系统解决了OMTG问题，提供了基准、数据集和专用的奖励设计，展示了显著性能提升。

papers.title: PAC-Bayesian Adversarially Robust Generalization for Message Passing Graph Neural Networks: A Sensitivity Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Whilst the vulnerability of graph neural networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks poses a critical threat to graph representation learning, the understanding of the robust generalization behavior remains a fundamental challenge in the adversarial setting. Recently, PAC-Bayesian margin-based generalization analysis substantially advances this line of research by providing a flexible and data-dependent analytical framework. However, existing robust analyses often rely on isotropic Gaussian posteriors and control weight perturbations in the full parameter space, which limits the ability to capture heterogeneous parameter sensitivity yet hinges on hidden-width-dependent complexity terms, resulting in not-tight-enough generalization bounds. In this paper, we extend a recently proposed sensitivity-aware PAC-Bayesian framework from deep neural networks to message passing GNNs (MPGNNs) and derive a tighter robust generalization bound in the adversarial setting. Specifically, we first quantify how sensitive the perturbations across different parameter blocks are to the network outputs by deriving the output Jacobians with respect to the weight parameters. Exploiting the fact that these Jacobian matrices have rank at most $K$ in $K$-class graph classification, we then construct Jacobian-aligned sensitivity matrices and use anisotropic Gaussian posteriors with optimized covariances to upper bound the KL divergence in a tight way. Notably, by refining the spectral-norm dependence on the learned weights and reducing the leading dimension factor from hidden-width-dependent terms to the number of classes $K$, our analysis yields much tighter robust generalization guarantees for MPGNNs, thereby guiding their designs to enhance adversarial robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对消息传递图神经网络（MPGNN）的对抗鲁棒泛化问题，将一种基于灵敏度的PAC-Bayesian分析框架从深度神经网络扩展到MPGNN，并推导出更紧的鲁棒泛化界。通过利用输出雅可比矩阵的低秩性质（秩不超过类别数K），构造对齐的灵敏度矩阵，并使用各向异性高斯后验来紧凑地约束KL散度，从而得到依赖于类别数K而非隐藏层宽度的泛化界。
Motivation: 现有PAC-Bayesian对抗鲁棒泛化分析通常假设各向同性高斯后验并在全参数空间控制权重扰动，无法捕捉参数异质性灵敏度，且依赖隐藏层宽度相关的复杂度项，导致泛化界不够紧。
Method: 通过推导MPGNN输出相对于不同参数块权重的雅可比矩阵，利用其秩至多为K（K类图分类）的性质，构造雅可比对齐的灵敏度矩阵；然后采用各向异性高斯后验，其协方差基于灵敏度矩阵优化，从而更紧地约束KL散度项。
Result: 得到的鲁棒泛化界在谱范数依赖上更精细，且主导维度因子从隐藏层宽度项降至类别数K，因此比现有界更紧。
Conclusion: 该分析为MPGNN提供了更紧的对抗鲁棒泛化保证，可指导模型设计以增强对抗鲁棒性。

papers.title: Synthetic Data Generation and Vision-based Wrinkle and Keypoint Detection for Bimanual Cloth Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation of textiles remains challenging because continuous deformation and self-occlusions hinder the robust visual perception required to estimate the cloth's state. To address the lack of annotated real-world data, we developed a Blender-based synthetic pipeline exporting auto-annotated keypoints, and combined manually labeled renders with real-world data to train a wrinkle detector. We present a perception framework integrating a CNN for permutation-invariant keypoint detection and a YOLOv8-OpenCV pipeline to extract grasping points from structural wrinkles. A proposed bimanual algorithm uses this system to stretch fully folded garments via wrinkles, transitioning to keypoint-based ironing once corners emerge. The keypoint model achieves a Mean Position Error (MPE) of 1.7615 pixels. The perception system transfers to physical fabrics without fine-tuning, outperforming baselines that fail in high-occlusion states or yield false positives on severe folds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Blender的合成数据生成管线，用于双手机器人布料操作中的视觉感知。通过自动标注关键点并训练CNN进行置换不变关键点检测，结合YOLOv8-OpenCV管线提取褶皱抓取点，实现将折叠衣物展开并转入基于关键点的熨烫操作。关键点模型平均位置误差为1.7615像素，感知系统可直接迁移到真实布料。
Motivation: 布料操作的连续变形和自遮挡导致鲁棒视觉感知困难，且缺乏标注的真实世界数据。
Method: 开发Blender合成管线生成自动标注的关键点数据，结合手动标注的渲染图和真实数据训练褶皱检测器。提出集成CNN（置换不变关键点检测）和YOLOv8-OpenCV（从结构褶皱中提取抓取点）的感知框架，以及基于褶皱的双臂算法。
Result: 关键点模型平均位置误差（MPE）为1.7615像素。感知系统无需微调即可迁移到真实布料，在高遮挡状态下优于基线方法，减少严重折叠上的误检。
Conclusion: 合成数据与迁移学习结合可以有效解决布料操作中的视觉感知问题，双臂算法成功实现从褶皱展开到关键点熨烫的过渡。

papers.title: Discrete Causal Representations from Heterogeneous Domains: A Bayesian Approach with Social Survey Applications
papers.abstract_en: Causal representation learning aims to infer the high-level latent causal concepts that give rise to observed low-level measurements. This is particularly relevant for heterogeneous data from different environments or domains since distribution shifts often arise through sparse, localized changes in some of the underlying causal mechanisms, while other parts of the generative process remain unchanged. Whereas identifiability of causal representations has been studied extensively, practical uncertainty-aware methods and real-world use cases remain less explored. In this work, we propose a Bayesian approach to learning causal representations from multi-environment data, focusing on the case of discrete causal concepts and unknown multi-node soft interventions. To this end, we translate causal assumptions and interpretability desiderata into suitable priors and parametric choices within a hierarchical model. We then devise an inference scheme based on sequential Monte Carlo sampling to approximate the resulting multimodal posterior. We showcase our approach through case studies on social survey data, where latent causal concepts correspond to cultural values or political opinions, measurements to survey responses, and environments to different countries or states. Our model infers meaningful high-level concepts and plausible causal relations among them, demonstrating its utility for learning causal representations of complex real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯方法，从多环境数据中学习离散因果表示，假设未知多节点软干预。通过序贯蒙特卡洛采样近似后验，并在社会调查数据（如文化价值观、政治观点）上展示效果。
Motivation: 因果表示学习的可识别性已被广泛研究，但实用且具有不确定性的方法及真实世界应用仍较少探索。
Method: 将因果假设和可解释性需求转化为层次模型中的先验和参数选择，并基于序贯蒙特卡洛采样设计推理方案以近似多模态后验。
Result: 在社会调查数据案例研究中，模型推断出有意义的潜在概念及其因果关系的合理结构。
Conclusion: 展示了所提方法在复杂真实世界数据中学习因果表示的实用性，但方法限于离散因果概念和已知环境。

papers.title: LLMs Can Leak Training Data But Do They Want To? A Propensity-Aware Evaluation of Memorization in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can reproduce training data, but existing memorization evaluations mostly measure whether models can be forced to do so, rather than whether they do so under ordinary use. We introduce PropMe, a propensity-aware framework for memorization evaluation that contrasts prefix-based capability attacks with non-adversarial evaluations. We propose a metric transformation that, applied to existing functions, allows to create propensity metrics. We further introduce SimpleTrace, a lightweight tracing pipeline built on infini-gram that deterministically attributes model generations to large-scale training corpora and computes verbatim, near-verbatim, and propensity-transformed memorization metrics. Evaluating two fully-open models: Comma and DFM Decoder on two datasets: Common Pile and Dynaword in two languages, we find a consistent gap between capability and propensity: prefix attacks elicit substantially stronger memorization signals than generic or dataset-specific prompts, while propensity scores remain low overall. Thus, the models can reveal training data when directly elicited, but rarely do so in more common non-adversarial settings. We also find that DFM Decoder, which is continually pre-trained from Comma, exhibits reduced memorization and memorization propensity for Common Pile, confirming that memorization capability can decrease when later training emphasizes partially different data. Our results suggest, and we encourage, that memorization audits should report both worst-case extractability and ordinary leakage propensity in order to have a more comprehensive view of this phenomenon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种倾向感知框架PropMe，用于评估大语言模型在非对抗性设置下泄露训练数据的倾向性，并与基于前缀的能力攻击进行对比。作者引入SimpleTrace工具链，在Comma和DFM Decoder两个开源模型上评估，发现模型在直接攻击下能泄露数据，但在普通使用中倾向性很低。
Motivation: 现有记忆化评估大多测量模型能否被强制泄露数据，而非在普通使用中是否会自发泄露，缺乏对真实部署风险的衡量。
Method: 提出PropMe框架，包含前缀攻击和普通提示的对比，并引入metric transformation将现有记忆化指标转换为倾向性指标。同时开发SimpleTrace，基于infini-gram对生成文本进行确定性溯源，计算逐字、近逐字及倾向性转换后的记忆化指标。
Result: 在Comma和DFM Decoder两个模型上，前缀攻击显著增强记忆化信号，而普通提示下倾向性分数普遍较低。DFM Decoder（从Comma继续预训练）在Common Pile上的记忆化能力和倾向性均降低。
Conclusion: 建议记忆化审计应同时报告最坏情况下的可提取性和普通泄漏倾向性，以获得更全面的视图。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: A Temporal Conditional Estimation for Multimodal Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TS-FMs) aim to learn generalizable temporal representations that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks. In real-world multimodal settings, time series are frequently affected by temporal misalignment and partial modality missingness, where different modalities are observed at heterogeneous time scales or are partially absent. Existing approaches typically rely on naive imputation or masking strategies, which fail to account for cross-modal dependencies and often lead to misaligned or degraded representations. We propose TRACE, a conditional estimation paradigm for multimodal time series foundation model pipelines under missingness and irregular sampling, allowing incomplete target modalities to be systematically inferred from available auxiliary modalities. We evaluate TRACE on diverse multimodal benchmarks spanning healthcare and affective computing, including the MIMIC-IV clinical dataset and the CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI benchmarks for multimodal sentiment analysis. Across a range of downstream prediction tasks and missing-modality settings, TRACE consistently outperforms prior multimodal fusion approaches, demonstrating improved robustness to severe modality missingness and more reliable cross-modal representations.
papers.comment: 5 figures and 5 tables in the main paper, plus appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE，一种针对多模态时间序列在缺失和不规则采样情况下的条件估计范式，旨在学习通用的时间序列表示。在MIMIC-IV、CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI等医疗和情感计算基准上的实验表明，TRACE在严重模态缺失下比现有融合方法更鲁棒，表示更可靠。
Motivation: 现实多模态时间序列中常存在时间错位和模态部分缺失，现有方法依赖简单插补或掩码，忽略跨模态依赖，导致表示退化和错位。
Method: 提出条件估计范式TRACE，利用可用辅助模态系统推断不完整目标模态，处理缺失和不规则采样，结合多模态时间序列基础模型管道。
Result: 在MIMIC-IV、CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI等基准上的下游预测任务和缺失模态设置下，TRACE持续优于先前的多模态融合方法，对严重模态缺失具有更强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: TRACE通过条件估计有效利用辅助模态信息，提升了多模态时间序列基础模型在缺失场景下的表示质量和鲁棒性。

papers.title: ToolChoiceConfusion: Causal Minimal Tool Filtering for Reliable LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on external tools, but larger tool menus can reduce reliability and efficiency by increasing wrong-tool calls, premature actions, and token cost. Existing tool-selection methods often optimize semantic relevance, exposing tools whose names or descriptions match the user request. We argue that relevance is insufficient: a tool may be related to the task while still being unnecessary or premature at the current step. We propose Causal Minimal Tool Filtering (CMTF), a training-free method that selects tools by causal sufficiency. CMTF uses lightweight precondition-effect contracts to expose only the minimal next-step tool frontier needed to advance from the current state toward the user goal. Across multi-step tool-use tasks, we compare CMTF with all-tools exposure, keyword retrieval, state-aware filtering, and causal-path ablations, measuring task success, wrong-tool calls, premature actions, tool exposure, and token cost. In the main benchmark with 102 tasks, 100 tools, four LLM backends, and 2448 task-method-model runs, CMTF matches the strongest causal baseline in aggregate success while reducing visible tools from 100 to one per step and reducing token usage by about 90% relative to all-tools exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果最小工具过滤（CMTF），一种无需训练的工具选择方法，通过因果充分性（而非语义相关性）为LLM代理选择下一步工具。在102个任务、100个工具的基准测试中，CMTF将可见工具从100个减少到每步1个，token使用减少约90%，同时保持任务成功率的竞争力。
Motivation: 现有工具选择方法基于语义相关性，但相关工具可能不必要或过早，导致错误工具调用、过早行动和token浪费。
Method: 提出CMTF，利用轻量级前提-效果契约，仅暴露从当前状态到用户目标所需的最小下一步工具前沿（causal sufficiency）。
Result: 在102任务、100工具、4种LLM后端、2448次运行中，CMTF匹配最强因果基线的总体成功率，同时将可见工具从100降至每步1个，token使用减少约90%。
Conclusion: 因果充分性而非语义相关性更适用于多步工具任务中的工具过滤，能显著降低工具暴露和token成本。

papers.title: Geodesic Flow Matching on a Riemannian Degradation Manifold for Blind Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Blind image restoration requires recovering clean images from observations corrupted by unknown and potentially mixed degradations. While recent deterministic flow-based methods model restoration as transport processes that map degraded images to clean ones, they typically rely on Euclidean interpolation, implicitly assuming linear degradation geometry. In this paper, we explicitly model degradations as points on a low-dimensional Riemannian manifold and formulate restoration as geodesic transport on the joint image-manifold space. Using a geodesic flow matching objective, we learn intrinsic transport dynamics that respect the curvature of degradation space. This framework generalizes linear flow matching, provides a principled treatment of mixed degradations as geodesic compositions, and yields a clean theoretical interpretation for generalization beyond observed degradations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对盲图像恢复问题，将退化建模为低维黎曼流形上的点，并在联合图像-流形空间上学习测地线传输，提出测地线流匹配目标，以尊重退化空间的曲率。该方法推广了线性流匹配，能自然处理混合退化，并提供清晰的泛化理论解释。
Motivation: 现有基于流的确定性方法通常依赖欧几里得插值，隐含假设线性退化几何，难以处理未知且混合的退化。
Method: 将退化显式建模为低维黎曼流形上的点，将恢复问题重构为联合图像-流形空间上的测地线传输，并使用测地线流匹配目标学习内在传输动力学。
Result: 该方法推广了线性流匹配，为混合退化提供测地线组合的理论处理，并给出超出观测退化泛化的干净理论解释。
Conclusion: 本文提出的测地线流匹配框架为盲图像恢复提供了更原则性的处理方式，能泛化到未见过的退化，但未报告具体数值实验。

papers.title: Adapting Diffusion Language Models for Lossless Pixel-Level Image Transmission
papers.abstract_en: Lossless pixel-level image transmission is a fundamental regime beyond semantic communications, because exact recovery requires both accurate symbol probability modeling and reliable delivery over noisy channels. This paper proposes DDM-SSCC, a discrete-diffusion-model-based separate source-channel coding framework for lossless image transmission. Different from raster-order autoregressive coding, the proposed source codec adapts a diffusion language model to pixel-token restoration and performs synchronized reverse arithmetic coding under bidirectional attention, allowing multiple masked tokens to be coded within one reverse denoising step. This progressive restoration process also yields a more favorable source representation for noisy transmission, since newly restored tokens can serve as bidirectional context in subsequent denoising steps. To bridge the gap between generation-oriented masked denoising and lossless arithmetic coding, we further introduce a Halton-guided denoising order, a mask-ratio-aware cosine schedule, and a lightweight temperature calibration module. These designs respectively improve spatial coverage, adapt the denoising pace to context reliability, and calibrate the probability tables used by arithmetic coding. Experiments on CIFAR10, DIV2K-LR-X4, and Kodak over additive white Gaussian noise and Rayleigh fading channels show that DDM-SSCC achieves better exact-recovery performance than representative lossless and semantic communication baselines, while ablation studies verify the effectiveness of the proposed denoising order, schedule, and calibration modules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DDM-SSCC，一种基于离散扩散模型的无损图像传输框架，通过将扩散语言模型应用于像素令牌恢复并结合同步反向算术编码，实现了比现有基线更好的精确恢复性能。实验在CIFAR10、DIV2K-LR-X4和Kodak数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 无损像素级图像传输需要精确的符号概率建模和可靠的噪声信道传输，现有方法在模型设计和编码效率上存在不足。
Method: 提出离散扩散模型框架，包括Halton引导去噪顺序、掩码率感知余弦调度和轻量级温度校准模块，用于改进无损算术编码与扩散模型的结合。
Result: 在CIFAR10、DIV2K-LR-X4和Kodak数据集上，针对AWGN和Rayleigh衰落信道，DDM-SSCC实现了更好的精确恢复性能，优于对比的无损和语义通信基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的去噪顺序、调度和校准模块有效，扩散模型在无损图像传输任务中具有潜力。

papers.title: Your GFlowNet Secretly Learns an Optimal Transport Plan
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are a framework for sampling structured objects via stochastic trajectories in a directed graph. In this work, we establish a theoretical connection between non-acyclic GFlowNets and optimal transport (OT). We show that fixing the initial flow distribution in a minimum-flow GFlowNet reduces its objective to a Kantorovich OT problem with graph-induced shortest path costs. At the optimum, the learned GFlowNet policy therefore encodes an optimal transport plan from the source distribution to the target distribution: we show that sampling trajectories from the minimum-flow GFlowNet recovers the corresponding optimal coupling. Our formulation enables applying the GFlowNet learning framework to OT problems on large graphs via edge flows and neural parameterization. Experiments confirm agreement with exact OT solvers and demonstrate that GFlowNets can learn high-quality transport plans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在非有向无环图（non-acyclic）的生成流网络（GFlowNets）与最优传输（optimal transport, OT）之间建立了理论联系。通过固定最小流GFlowNet中的初始流分布，其目标函数退化为以图诱导最短路径为代价的Kantorovich最优传输问题。实验表明，该方法能够学习高质量的最优传输计划。
Motivation: 现有GFlowNet理论主要针对有向无环图，非有向无环图情况下的最优行为尚不明确。本文旨在揭示非有向无环图GFlowNet与最优传输问题的内在联系，从而将GFlowNet框架扩展至大规模图上的最优传输问题。
Method: 提出最小流GFlowNet（minimum-flow GFlowNet）形式，通过固定初始流分布并将其目标函数转化为Kantorovich最优传输问题，使得学习到的GFlowNet策略编码最优传输计划。采用边流（edge flows）和神经网络参数化来处理大规模图。
Result: 实验表明，该方法与精确的最优传输求解器结果一致，且能够学习高质量的最优传输计划。
Conclusion: 本文建立了GFlowNet与最优传输之间的理论等价性，为在大规模图上使用GFlowNet求解最优传输问题提供了可行路径，但实际应用效果可能受限于图规模和神经网络的表达能力。

papers.title: DAST: A VLM-LLM Framework for Cross-Interface Anomaly Detection in O-RAN
papers.abstract_en: O-RAN enables a disaggregated baseband stack with programmable functions that communicate over standardized open interfaces. The same openness that enables multi-vendor composition also expands the attack surface across logically decoupled tiers that make up the compute continuum. Among these threats, Denial-of-Service and performance-degradation attacks, which account for the majority of catalogued O-RAN threats, are particularly difficult to detect. Traditional Time-Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD) methods fail in this new regime where labelled baselines are scarce, threats evolve faster than detectors can be retrained, and the high-dimensional multivariate telemetry overwhelms monolithic inference models. To address these challenges, we present DAST, a zero-shot multi-agent framework for cross-interface anomaly detection in O-RAN that chains a three-stage VLM $\rightarrow$ LLM $\rightarrow$ VLM pipeline. DAST converts multivariate KPI streams into visual representations, scores textual per-interface descriptions against O-RAN domain knowledge, and verifies suspects on high-resolution heatmaps to output the problematic interfaces, the anomalous time intervals, an indicative O-RAN WG11-aligned operational impact rating and the decision rationale. We evaluate DAST on real network traces collected from an O-RAN testbed under representative performance degradation scenarios, achieving 0.910 F1-Score and 0.843 Accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art TSAD baselines.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAST，一个零样本多智能体框架，用于O-RAN跨接口异常检测，采用VLM→LLM→VLM三级流水线，将多变量KPI转化为视觉表示，并对实际网络轨迹进行测试，F1分数0.910，精度0.843，优于现有TSAD基线。
Motivation: O-RAN的开放性增加了攻击面，尤其是DoS和性能退化攻击难以检测。传统TSAD方法存在标记数据稀缺、威胁进化快、高维遥测难以处理等问题。
Method: DAST框架通过VLM将多变量KPI流转换为视觉表示，LLM根据O-RAN领域知识对每个接口的描述进行评分，最后VLM在高分辨率热图上验证嫌疑人，输出问题接口、异常时间区间、操作影响评级和决策理由。
Result: 在真实网络轨迹上，DAST在代表性性能退化场景下达到0.910 F1分数和0.843准确率，优于最新TSAD基线。
Conclusion: DAST在O-RAN性能退化检测上表现优异，但零样本能力在更多攻击类型和动态环境下的泛化性仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: OneReason Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation models in the OneRec family have been widely deployed in many real-world services, such as short-video, live-streaming, advertising, and e-commerce. However, these generative models can only benefit from the scaling advantage, while their reasoning ability is hard to activate, since we cannot construct meaningful Chain-of-Thought (CoT) sequences consisting of itemic tokens only. Inspired by the success of the reasoning-style ``think before answer'' paradigm in the LLM field, we conduct preliminary studies (i.e., OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec) to explore reasoning capability in generative recommendation. Nevertheless, we notice an unexpected phenomenon: the thinking mode does not show advantages over the non-thinking mode. Drawing insights from recent findings on CoT robustness in multi-modal language models, we argue that effective reasoning in recommendation rests on two factors: perception, the ability to ground itemic tokens in their underlying language semantics, and cognition, the ability to reorganize a user's behavior sequence into coherent latent interest points. We therefore propose OneReason, which includes: (1) strong itemic token perception in pre-training, (2) a three-level cognition-enhanced CoT format for recommendation tasks in SFT, and (3) a specialize-then-unify training recipe in RL to enhance the thinking ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是OneRec系列生成式推荐模型的推理能力研究报告。摘要指出，尽管OneRec模型已广泛部署，但其推理能力难以激活，因为无法仅用物品token构造有意义的思维链。受LLM中'先思考后回答'范式的启发，作者进行了初步研究（OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec），但发现思考模式并未优于非思考模式。基于多模态语言模型中CoT鲁棒性的最新发现，作者提出有效推荐推理依赖于感知（将物品token映射到语言语义）和认知（将用户行为序列重组为潜在兴趣点）两个因素，并由此提出OneReason方法，包括预训练中强大的物品token感知、SFT中的三级认知增强CoT格式，以及RL中的先专业化后统一的训练策略。
Motivation: 现有的生成式推荐模型（OneRec系列）虽然具有规模优势，但缺乏推理能力，因为无法仅使用物品token构建有意义的思维链（CoT）序列。初步研究发现思考模式并未展现出优势。
Method: 提出OneReason方法，包含三个关键组件：(1) 预训练阶段增强物品token的语义感知能力；(2) 在监督微调（SFT）中采用三级认知增强的CoT格式；(3) 在强化学习（RL）阶段采用先专业化后统一的训练策略以提升思考能力。

papers.title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
papers.abstract_en: As the input length of large language model (LLM) serving continues to grow, the KV cache has become a dominant bottleneck in AI infrastructure. It limits GPU memory capacity, serving concurrency, cache reuse, and distributed scalability. Several important problems, including position-independent KV cache, prefix KV cache compression, hot/cold KV cache separation, and distributed KV cache management, all depend on how the KV cache is represented and managed. However, existing serving systems largely rely on a monolithic KV cache abstraction, where the KV cache is treated as a homogeneous sequence of token-level memory blocks and managed with similar policies across attention heads and serving scenarios. We observe that KV cache utility is highly structured across KV heads: different heads exhibit different functional roles, attention distances, and runtime importance. Therefore, a full KV cache is not always necessary for every head, token range, or serving scenario. We present RedKnot, a head-aware KV cache management system for LLM serving. RedKnot breaks the conventional monolithic KV cache abstraction by decomposing the KV cache along KV heads, whose importance and effective attention ranges vary significantly across serving scenarios. This head-level decomposition turns the KV cache from a monolithic tensor abstraction into a structured memory object, enabling RedKnot to uniformly support position-independent KV reuse, prefix KV compression, hot/cold KV separation, and distributed KV placement while preserving output fidelity and improving resource efficiency, without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning. RedKnot establishes a new foundation for AI infrastructure by transforming the KV cache from a monolithic, passive runtime artifact into a dynamic, model-aware runtime substrate for scalable LLM serving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RedKnot 是一种面向大语言模型长上下文服务的头部感知 (head-aware) KV 缓存管理系统。它通过沿 KV 头部解耦传统的单一KV缓存抽象，利用不同注意力头在功能角色、注意力距离和运行时重要性上的差异，统一支持位置无关的KV重用、前缀KV压缩、热/冷KV分离和分布式KV放置，无需模型重训练或微调，在保持输出保真度的同时提升资源效率。
Motivation: 现有LLM服务系统将KV缓存视为同质的token级内存块序列，忽略了不同注意力头之间的结构化差异，导致在长上下文场景下GPU内存受限、并发低、缓存重用效率差。
Method: 将KV缓存按KV头部进行分解，形成结构化内存对象，基于每个头的重要性与有效注意力范围，分别采取不同的缓存策略，并设计SegPagedAttention机制支持高效管理。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在保持输出保真度的前提下提升了资源效率，支持多种KV缓存优化技术。
Conclusion: RedKnot 将KV缓存从被动的运行时工件转变为动态、模型感知的运行时基板，为可扩展的LLM服务奠定新基础。

papers.title: RadiusFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling on CPUs and GPUs via Spherical Voxel Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Point clouds are a primary sensory representation for robotic perception, underpinning LiDAR-based autonomous driving, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and navigation. Within these pipelines, Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) is the most well-known downsampling operator, as its uniform coverage preserves the geometric structure on which downstream perception relies. However, the large time complexity of classical FPS scales poorly with the million-point-per-second rates of modern 3D sensors, making it a dominant latency bottleneck that conflicts with the real-time and limited onboard compute budgets of robotic systems. Therefore, we propose RadiusFPS, an FPS acceleration framework based on spherical voxel pruning that preserves the standard FPS update rule under the same initialization and tie-breaking policy. By indexing the point cloud with spherical voxels, RadiusFPS derives a conservative geometric bound that prunes redundant distance computations in each iteration, complemented by a coordinate-wise point-skip test that removes residual updates. We further introduce RadiusFPS-G, a warp-level GPU implementation that fuses voxel selection, pruning, and distance update into memory-coalesced kernels, eliminating costly global-memory round-trips. On indoor (S3DIS, ScanNet) and outdoor LiDAR (SemanticKITTI) benchmarks, RadiusFPS-G attains up to 2.5x speedup over GPU-based FPS and matches or exceeds QuickFPS among the evaluated methods while using roughly half its GPU memory, with comparable segmentation accuracy. When coupled with the learning-based FastPoint sampler, the resulting pipeline achieves the fastest End-to-End inference among all evaluated configurations. These properties make high-quality FPS-style sampling practical for latency- and memory-constrained robotic vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RadiusFPS，一种基于球形体素剪枝的FPS加速框架，在CPU和GPU上均能高效运行。通过球形体素索引和保守几何边界剪枝冗余距离计算，实现了2.5倍加速并减少了GPU内存使用。在室内和室外LiDAR基准上验证了效果。
Motivation: 经典FPS的时间复杂度高，难以满足现代3D传感器百万点每秒的实时处理需求，成为机器人感知管道的延迟瓶颈。
Method: 提出RadiusFPS框架，使用球形体素索引点云，推导保守几何边界以剪枝每轮冗余距离计算，并辅以坐标级点跳转测试。GPU实现RadiusFPS-G采用warp级融合核，消除全局内存往返。
Result: 在S3DIS、ScanNet和SemanticKITTI基准上，RadiusFPS-G比GPU FPS加速高达2.5倍，内存使用约为QuickFPS的一半，且分割精度相当。与FastPoint结合时，端到端推理最快。
Conclusion: RadiusFPS使得高质量FPS风格采样在延迟和内存受限的机器人视觉中变得实用。

papers.title: Closing the Loop on Latent Reasoning via Test-Time Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Recent work moves intermediate reasoning from natural-language traces into latent or cache-level representations to reduce token overhead and avoid a discrete communication bottleneck. However, this shift also removes a key advantage of textual reasoning: intermediate states are no longer inspectable, making it difficult to determine whether a latent state still preserves the constraints of the original query. As a result, latent reasoning typically operates in an open loop, where a latent state is produced and consumed without an input-anchored fidelity check. We propose ReLAT (Reconstruction-Guided Latent Reasoning At Test Time), a self-supervised test-time training method that closes this loop using the query itself as the reference. Our key observation is that if a latent state faithfully represents a query, the query should be recoverable from it; if the query cannot be recovered, the latent state has lost task-relevant information. ReLAT operationalizes this principle by constructing a differentiable Question -> Latent Thought -> Question cycle and optimizing query reconstruction loss through the latent thought before answer generation. This anchors opaque latent computation to the problem specification it is supposed to represent. Across mathematical reasoning, knowledge QA, and code generation benchmarks on the Qwen family, ReLAT consistently improves over single-model inference, text-based collaboration, open-loop latent collaboration, and alternative test-time training objectives. On Qwen3-8B, ReLAT raises AIME 2024 accuracy from 56.7% to 73.3%, a 16.6-point gain over the strongest open-loop latent baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLAT，一种基于重建指导的测试时潜推理方法，通过构建 Question→Latent Thought→Question 的可微循环并用查询重建损失来确保潜状态保留原始信息，从而闭合潜推理的开环问题。在数学推理、知识问答和代码生成任务上，ReLAT 在 Qwen 系列模型上均取得一致提升，例如将 Qwen3-8B 在 AIME 2024 上的准确率从 56.7% 提升至 73.3%。
Motivation: 潜推理虽减少 token 开销并避免离散通信瓶颈，但中间状态不可检查，无法保证潜状态保留原始查询约束，导致开环操作。论文旨在通过测试时自监督重建来闭合此环路。
Method: 提出 ReLAT，一种自监督测试时训练方法，构建可微的 Question→Latent Thought→Question 重建循环，优化查询重建损失，将潜计算锚定到问题规格。
Result: 在数学推理、知识 QA 和代码生成基准上，ReLAT 一致优于单模型推理、文本合作、开环潜合作及其他测试时训练目标。使用 Qwen3-8B 时，AIME 2024 准确率从 56.7% 提升 16.6 个百分点至 73.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过自监督重建损失闭合潜推理循环能显著提升性能，使潜状态更好地保留查询信息。

papers.title: GRAMformer: Any-Order Modality Interactions via Volumetric Multimodal Cross-Attention
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based multimodal models rely on attention mechanisms to integrate information across heterogeneous modalities. Despite their success, existing multimodal attention formulations compute their scores through collections of pairwise dot-product interactions or by concatenating all the modalities into the keys, even when multiple modalities should be jointly involved. As a consequence, current approaches either incur quadratic complexity in the number of modalities or fail to explicitly model interactions that depend on the joint configuration of multiple representations. In this work, we introduce the Volumetric Multimodal cross-Attention (VMA), a novel cross-attention mechanism in which attention scores are defined as a function of the joint geometry of a query and multiple modality-specific keys. VMA computes the volume spanned by query and key vectors across multiple modalities, capturing joint multimodal dependencies beyond pairwise similarity, enabling native modeling of any-order modality interactions. We integrate VMA into our novel multimodal transformer architecture, named GRAMformer, explicitly designed to integrate any number of modalities. We evaluate the proposed model on multimodal learning tasks, demonstrating improved effectiveness and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Volumetric Multimodal cross-Attention (VMA)，一种新的交叉注意力机制，通过计算查询和多个模态键向量的体积来建模任意阶的多模态交互，并集成到 GRAMformer 架构中，实验表明在多模态学习任务上有效且高效。
Motivation: 现有跨模态注意力机制要么在模态数量上呈二次复杂度，要么无法显式建模多个表示联合配置下的交互，缺乏对任意阶多模态依赖的原生建模。
Method: 定义注意力分数为查询向量与多个模态键向量所张成的体积函数，从而捕捉超出两两相似度的联合模态依赖，并集成到面向任意数量模态的 Transformer 架构 GRAMformer 中。
Result: 在多模态学习任务上验证了改进的有效性和效率，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: VMA 能够原生建模任意阶模态交互，为多模态 Transformer 提供更灵活的注意力机制，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: MPCoT: Reward-Guided Multi-Path Latent Reasoning for Test-Time Scalable Vision-Language-Action
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remain brittle in long-horizon and high-uncertainty control, where one-pass action decoding provides limited inference-time deliberation. Explicit chain-of-thought can increase reasoning depth, but introduces token latency and an indirect text-to-action interface. We propose MPCoT, a reward-guided multi-path latent reasoning framework that initializes $M$ hypotheses, refines them for K weight-tied steps, and softly aggregates them before action decoding. A training-only path-preference objective evaluates candidate action branches with expert-action consistency, world-model/VLM-based progress, and success feedback to align the latent path scorer with downstream execution quality. MPCoT preserves the original 8-step action interface, generates zero reasoning tokens, and exposes configurable inference controls (K,M). Under matched protocols on LIBERO and CALVIN, MPCoT improves long-horizon performance, with ablations confirming depth-width effects, confidence-weighted aggregation, and reward-guided path supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MPCoT，一种用于视觉-语言-动作策略的奖励引导多路径潜在推理框架，在长时域高不确定性控制任务中，通过初始化多个假设、迭代细化并软聚合，无需生成推理token即可提升性能。在LIBERO和CALVIN基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有VLA策略在长时域和高不确定性控制中脆弱，单次动作解码缺乏推理时间思维，显式链式思维增加延迟且文本到动作接口间接。
Method: 提出奖励引导的多路径潜在推理：初始化M个假设，进行K步权重共享的细化，软聚合后解码动作；训练时使用路径偏好目标，结合专家动作一致性、世界模型/VLM进展和成功反馈来训练潜在路径评分器。
Result: 在LIBERO和CALVIN上，MPCoT提升了长时域性能，消融实验证实深度-宽度效应、置信度加权聚合和奖励引导路径监督的有效性。
Conclusion: MPCoT保留了原始8步动作接口，零推理token，并具有可配置的推理控制参数(K,M)，为VLA提供了可扩展的测试时推理方法。

papers.title: Benchmarking Open-Source Layout Detection Models for Data Snapshot Extraction from Institutional Documents
papers.abstract_en: Institutional documents contain substantial amounts of operational and analytical information embedded within figures and tables. Current approaches for extracting visual content from documents are largely built around generic document layout analysis, where figures and tables are treated as uniformly relevant document objects rather than semantically meaningful analytical artifacts. In this work, we introduce a benchmark dataset and evaluation framework for \textit{data snapshot extraction}, the task of identifying and localizing semantically meaningful visual artifacts within institutional documents. The benchmark spans humanitarian reports, World Bank policy research working papers, and project appraisal documents, and includes annotations for figures and tables that contain reusable analytical information. Using this dataset, we benchmarked multiple open-source layout detection models and evaluated both detection performance and spatial extraction quality. Our results show that current models struggle to generalize to operational institutional documents despite strong performance on conventional academic benchmarks. Common failure modes include confusion between analytical and non-analytical content, fragmentation of composite analytical artifacts, and incomplete extraction of contextual information required for interpretation. These findings highlight a persistent gap between generic document layout analysis and operationally useful data snapshot extraction. We release the source PDFs, annotation dataset, metadata, and source code to support future research in operational document intelligence. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4data/data-snapshot and the source code is available at https://github.com/worldbank/ai4data/tree/main/experimental/data-snapshot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于机构文档中数据快照提取（data snapshot extraction）的基准数据集和评估框架，涵盖人道主义报告、世界银行政策研究论文等项目文件。作者对多种开源布局检测模型进行了基准测试，发现当前模型难以泛化到实际机构文档，尽管在常规学术基准上表现良好。常见失败模式包括分析性与非分析性内容的混淆、复合分析性文物的碎片化以及解释所需上下文信息的不完全提取。
Motivation: 现有文档布局分析方法将图表视为通用文档对象，而非语义上有意义的分析性工件，导致在机构文档中提取可用分析信息时效果不佳。
Method: 构建包含标注图表的数据集，并定义数据快照提取任务；对多个开源布局检测模型进行检测性能和空间提取质量的评估。
Result: 当前模型在操作性的机构文档上泛化能力差，存在内容混淆、碎片化及上下文缺失等问题。
Conclusion: 通用文档布局分析与实用数据快照提取之间仍存在差距，本文公开了数据集和代码以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TOKI: A Bitemporal Operator Algebra for Contradiction Resolution in LLM-Agent Persistent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory for an LLM agent is a write-heavy substrate: every belief update is a versioned write, and a new claim may contradict a stored one. Production systems use four resolution heuristics (last-writer-wins, evidence-weighted merge, await-confirmation, per-rule policy), yet none declares the isolation level it assumes or the write-time anomalies it admits. We show that contradiction resolution is write-time concurrency control and make the missing contract explicit. TOKI types the four heuristics as one family of bitemporal operators over a dual-row schema, each with an isolation precondition and a provenance annotation that preserves the losing fact in an audit row. Four soundness theorems close the contract across isolation, schema, and provenance, lift the guarantees to operator pipelines, and extend the fold operators to n-ary conflict sets. A tightness companion proves that, within the relational schedule model, keyed logging of the adjudicating judge is necessary for replay consistency, which every audited baseline omits. A verdict matrix over eight systems localizes the gap: every baseline that keeps a language-model judge on the write path admits at least one of three write-time anomalies (replay inconsistency, belief-drift skew, audit erasure); a content-addressed engine-layer comparator avoids them only by removing the judge, and TOKI alone excludes all three while keeping it. On its one natural-workload slice the audit-row defence moves LoCoMo by 0.86, and ablating the typed memory layer removes 0.49 accuracy on 1,444 answerable LoCoMo questions; the cross-system comparison stays underpowered and claims no superiority. The contribution is the contract: a write-time correctness specification, proved sound across isolation, schema, and provenance, pinning the guarantee every production heuristic assumes but no deployed system makes explicit.
papers.comment: 43 pages including full appendices (proofs, protocols, and reproducibility ledger). Code, data, and reproducibility artifact: https://github.com/ZenAlexa/toki-bitemporal-memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TOKI，一种双时态算子代数，用于LLM代理持久内存中的矛盾消解。它将四种生产级冲突解决启发式方法统一为双时态算子，并提供了隔离性、模式和数据谱系的完备性定理，明确了每个生产级启发式方法所假设但未显式声明的保证。在LoCoMo数据集上验证了审计行防御的有效性，并证明了TOKI在保留语言模型法官的同时排除了所有三种写时异常。
Motivation: 现有生产系统使用四种矛盾消解启发式方法，但没有声明其假设的隔离级别或接受的写时异常，导致写时并发控制不明确，缺乏可验证的保证。
Method: TOKI将四种启发式方法类型化为双时态算子族，采用双行模式（dual-row schema），每个算子具有隔离前提条件和数据谱系注释，保留失败事实于审计行。提供了四个完备性定理，并扩展了折叠算子以处理n元冲突集，证明了键控日志记录对回放一致性的必要性。
Result: 在LoCoMo数据集的一个自然工作负载切片上，审计行防御使准确率提升0.86；去除类型化内存层后，在1444个可回答问题上准确率下降0.49。跨系统比较显示，所有保留语言模型法官的基线都存在至少一种写时异常，而TOKI在保留法官的同时排除了所有三种异常。
Conclusion: 论文的贡献在于提供了一个写时正确性规范，并在隔离性、模式和数据谱系上证明了完备性，明确了每个生产级启发式方法所假设但未显式声明的保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling
papers.abstract_en: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the \texttt{softmax} temperature $T$ and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic $T_c$ with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below $T_c$. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near $T_c$. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, contributed to PAI 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统计场框架，将LLM生成的token嵌入视为一维链上的连续自旋变量。通过定义磁化率和序参量，观察softmax温度T变化时，在特征Tc附近出现尖锐的磁化率峰、序参量快速变化以及语义方向坍缩。内在维度估计在Tc附近达到最小。结果在多种模型规模（Qwen3 0.6B-32B）和提示类别上稳健。现象类似于连续相变，但自回归生成的非平衡性质需进一步研究。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏从统计物理角度理解LLM输出集体统计结构的定量工具。
Method: 基于统计物理的框架，将token嵌入视为自旋变量，定义磁化率（connected two-point correlator）和序参量（ensemble-averaged embedding field），通过改变softmax温度T观察临界行为。
Result: 在特征温度Tc附近观察到磁化率峰、序参量快速变化、语义方向坍缩；内在维度估计在Tc处最小。结果在0.6B到32B的Qwen3模型上一致。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了探测LLM输出集体统计结构的定量工具，提示解码策略与临界现象之间存在联系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tracing the Oracle: Improving Diffusion Timestep Scheduling for 3D CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models demonstrate impressive potential in solving highly ill-posed 3D computed tomography (CT) inverse problems, while the inference process suffers from significant computational overhead. Furthermore, existing uniform timestep schedules fail to capture the non-uniform evolution of the reverse conditional diffusion stochastic differential equation, thereby introducing substantial truncation errors. To overcome this limitation, we propose Tracing the Oracle (TrO), a plug-and-play framework for improved timestep scheduling. Specifically, we treat densely sampled numerical integration trajectories on a few samples as the reference oracle. The optimized schedule is extracted by leveraging dynamic programming to globally minimize the cumulative error between the few-step approximation and the oracle. This mechanism precisely allocates the limited sampling steps to critical evolution stages that are highly susceptible to truncation errors. Our extensive experiments on the AAPM dataset across multiple 3D CT reconstruction tasks demonstrate that, when combined with the state-of-the-art 3D CT reconstruction method DDS, our optimized timesteps significantly improve reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency compared to existing heuristic schedules, especially under a strict budget of no more than 10 sampling steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D CT重建中扩散模型推理计算量大且均匀时间步调度导致截断误差的问题，提出Tracing the Oracle (TrO)框架，通过动态规划从密集采样的参考轨迹中提取最优时间步调度。在AAPM数据集上的实验表明，与最新方法DDS结合，在不超过10个采样步的预算下显著提升重建保真度和计算效率。
Motivation: 现有均匀时间步调度无法捕捉逆条件扩散SDE的非均匀演化，引入较大截断误差；同时扩散模型推理计算开销大。需要更优的调度策略。
Method: 提出TrO框架，是一个即插即用的模块。首先对少量样本使用密集采样的数值积分轨迹作为参考oracle；然后通过动态规划在全局最小化少步近似与oracle之间的累积误差来提取优化调度，从而将有限采样步精确分配到关键演化阶段。
Result: 在AAPM数据集上的多任务3D CT重建实验中，与最新方法DDS结合，优化后的时间步调度在不超过10个采样步的严格预算下显著提高了重建保真度和计算效率，优于现有启发式调度。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过动态规划从参考oracle中提取优化调度可以显著减少截断误差，提升扩散模型在3D CT逆问题中的性能，尤其在小样本步数场景下。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Design a Reliable LLM-Integrated Interface for Mortality Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Mortality forecasting plays an important role in actuarial and policy decision-making, but its implementation remains technically complex and inaccessible to non-expert users. This project proposes a reliable large language model (LLM)-integrated interface that improves usability while maintaining statistical power. The LLM is designed as a constrained orchestration layer that translates natural-language inputs into structured configurations for a deterministic forecasting pipeline. A three-phase methodology is employed to ensure accuracy, usability, and transparency. First, a baseline pipeline is implemented using the CoMoMo package, reproducing established mortality forecasting results. Second, the pipeline is extended to generate multi-step forecasts using rolling-origin evaluation and mean squared error (MSE). Third, a prototype interface uses a local LLM to handle users' forecasting requests in plain language. The system demonstrates that LLMs can enhance accessibility without compromising reproducibility, transparency, or actuarial validity in high-stakes analytical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成大语言模型（LLM）的死亡率预测接口，旨在提升非专家用户的可访问性，同时保持统计效力。LLM作为约束编排层，将自然语言输入转化为确定性预测管道的结构化配置。系统使用CoMoMo包实现基线管道，通过滚动原点评估和均方误差进行多步预测，并利用本地LLM处理用户的自然语言请求。
Motivation: 死亡率预测在精算和政策决策中重要，但技术复杂，非专家用户难以使用。现有接口缺乏易用性，需要一种既保持统计精度又提升可访问性的解决方案。
Method: 采用三阶段方法：1）使用CoMoMo包实现基线死亡率预测管道；2）扩展管道以滚动原点评估和均方误差生成多步预测；3）设计原型接口，集成本地LLM处理自然语言请求，将用户输入转化为结构化配置。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但指出该系统在保持可重复性、透明性和精算有效性的前提下，提升了死亡率预测的可访问性。
Conclusion: LLM可以增强高分析性工作流的可访问性，而不牺牲统计严谨性，适用于死亡率预测等高风险场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Anchor PCA
papers.abstract_en: Principal component analysis (PCA) is one of the most widely used unsupervised dimension reduction techniques. We study PCA for data from multiple related domains. Since principal components generally differ across domains, one way to obtain a shared low-rank embedding is to perform PCA on the pooled data. However, this approach can focus on spurious directions that exhibit high variation in only a few domains. To find a robust embedding that still explains most variance in unseen but similar domains, we propose instead to focus on shared directions of variation. To this end, we introduce Anchor PCA which trades off overall explained variance with agreement between the shared and domain-specific low-rank embeddings. Anchor PCA amounts to PCA on a modified target matrix and thus can be solved efficiently. Moreover, we show that Anchor PCA recovers a maximal invariant subspace and admits a minimax reconstruction interpretation under bounded domain-specific covariance inflations. On simulated and real-world gas sensor data with temporal drift, we demonstrate, respectively, that Anchor PCA recovers the maximally invariant subspace and yields embeddings that explain more variance on unseen domains than the pooling baseline and a worst-case alternative. Taken together, these findings establish Anchor PCA as a promising approach to robust unsupervised dimension reduction from multi-domain data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Anchor PCA，一种针对多领域数据的鲁棒无监督降维方法。它通过权衡总体解释方差与共享和领域特定低秩嵌入之间的一致性，从而找到在未见过的相似领域上仍然有效的共享变异方向。该方法等价于在修改后的目标矩阵上进行PCA，计算高效，并能恢复最大不变子空间。在模拟数据和具有时间漂移的真实气体传感器数据上，Anchor PCA比池化基线和最坏情况替代方法在未见领域上解释了更多方差。
Motivation: 标准PCA在合并多领域数据时可能关注仅在少数领域高变异的虚假方向，导致嵌入对未见过的相似领域缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 提出Anchor PCA，通过优化一个同时考虑总体解释方差和共享嵌入与领域特定嵌入一致性的目标，等价于对修改后的目标矩阵进行PCA，可高效求解。
Result: 在模拟数据和具有时间漂移的气体传感器数据上，Anchor PCA比池化基线和最坏情况替代方法在未见领域上解释了更多方差。
Conclusion: Anchor PCA是一种有前景的鲁棒无监督降维方法，适用于多领域数据。

papers.title: SAM-Flow: Source-Anchored Masked Flow for Training-Free Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Training-free image editing has recently attracted increasing attention due to its ability to modify real images using powerful pre-trained diffusion and flow-matching models without additional training. However, existing inversion-based and differential-flow-based methods usually perform global latent transport, which inevitably propagates editing effects to non-target regions and leads to background leakage. To address this problem, we propose SAM-Flow, a source-anchored masked flow framework for localized training-free image editing. Instead of updating the whole latent representation, SAM-Flow first uses a scout image and token-grounded attention maps to localize the editable semantic regions. It then applies differential velocity updates only within these regions, while anchoring the remaining areas to the source-image latent trajectory. To further improve spatial stability and boundary naturalness, we introduce a time-varying source-anchored projection mechanism with dynamic soft masks, transition regions, and temporal mask accumulation. The proposed method is plug-and-play and can be integrated with mainstream flow-matching backbones such as Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX without any fine-tuning. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that SAM-Flow achieves accurate semantic editing while significantly improving background preservation, providing a simple and general localized editing paradigm for training-free image editing. Code is available at: https://github.com/chwbob/Sam-Flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAM-Flow，一种基于源锚定掩码流的无训练图像编辑方法。该方法通过侦察图像和 token 注意力图定位可编辑语义区域，仅在这些区域进行差分速度更新，其余区域锚定到源图像潜变量轨迹，从而防止背景泄漏。引入时变源锚定投影机制（动态软掩码、过渡区域、时序掩码累积）提升空间稳定性和边界自然性。无需微调，可集成至 Stable Diffusion 3 和 FLUX 等主流流匹配骨干。实验表明编辑准确且背景保持显著改善。
Motivation: 现有无训练图像编辑方法（基于反演或差分流）通常进行全局潜变量传输，导致编辑效果不可避免地扩散到非目标区域，造成背景泄漏。
Method: 提出源锚定掩码流框架：先用侦察图像和 token 级注意力图定位可编辑语义区域；然后只在区域内应用差分速度更新，其余区域锚定到源图像潜变量轨迹；并引入时变源锚定投影机制，包含动态软掩码、过渡区域和时序掩码累积以提升稳定性。
Result: 摘要报告，定性和定量实验表明 SAM-Flow 实现了精确的语义编辑，并显著改善了背景保持。
Conclusion: 提供了一种简单通用的局部编辑范式，无需训练即可与主流流匹配模型集成，在保持背景的同时实现精准编辑。
