papers.title: Where, What, Why, and Importance: Structured Defect Grounding for Text-to-Image Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Despite generating increasingly photorealistic images, text-to-image (T2I) models still exhibit localized, subtle, and structurally complex failures. Diagnosing these failures requires instance-level feedback that answers where a defect occurs, what type it is, why it is defective, and its importance to overall image quality. While recent dense-feedback methods move beyond scalar supervision, their heatmap-centric representations still formulate diagnosis as pixel-field regression, making it difficult to localize variable-cardinality defects and bind semantic reasons to individual failures. To address this representation bottleneck, we propose Structured Defect Grounding (SDG), which casts T2I diagnosis as structured set prediction by modeling each defect as a (location, type, reason, importance) tuple. To make this formulation trainable and measurable, we introduce SDG-30K, a 30K-image dataset with box-grounded annotations across four modern T2I generators, together with a dedicated evaluation protocol, SDG-Eval. Building on this structured representation, we further present a diagnosis-to-alignment framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the SDG detector, and BoxFlow-GRPO converts predicted defect sets into box-derived, importance-weighted spatial rewards for diffusion model alignment. Extensive experiments show that our SDG detector outperforms leading proprietary VLMs on structured defect grounding, while SDG-guided rewards consistently improve T2I alignment and support localized image refinement. These results establish SDG as a unified, instance-level interface for diagnosing, evaluating, and enhancing modern generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像（T2I）模型中的局部、微妙且结构复杂的缺陷，提出结构化缺陷定位（SDG），将每个缺陷建模为(位置,类型,原因,重要性)元组，从而实现结构化集合预测。作者创建了SDG-30K数据集（30K图像，包含框级标注）和评估协议SDG-Eval。进一步提出诊断到对齐框架，使用VLM作为SDG检测器，通过BoxFlow-GRPO将预测的缺陷集转换为空间奖励用于扩散模型对齐。实验表明SDG检测器在结构化缺陷定位上优于领先的专有VLM，且SDG引导的奖励一致地改善T2I对齐和支持局部图像细化。
Motivation: 现有T2I模型虽然生成逼真图像，但仍存在局部、微妙且结构复杂的失败模式。传统的密集反馈方法使用热图中心表示，将诊断视为像素场回归，难以定位可变数量的缺陷并将语义原因绑定到单个缺陷。
Method: 提出结构化缺陷定位（SDG），将T2I诊断建模为结构化集合预测，每个缺陷表示为(位置,类型,原因,重要性)元组。构建SDG-30K数据集和SDG-Eval评估协议。进一步提出诊断到对齐框架，使用VLM作为SDG检测器，通过BoxFlow-GRPO将缺陷集转换为空间奖励用于扩散模型对齐。
Result: 实验显示，SDG检测器在结构化缺陷定位上优于领先的专有VLM；SDG引导的奖励一致地改善T2I对齐，并支持局部图像细化。
Conclusion: 本文建立了SDG作为用于诊断、评估和增强现代生成模型的统一实例级接口。

papers.title: Harnessing Structural Context for Entity Alignment Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Entity alignment (EA) aims to identify equivalent entities across heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) and is a key component of knowledge fusion and cross-KG reasoning. The recent EA foundation model demonstrates that alignment knowledge, once pretrained, can be directly applied to diverse previously unseen KG pairs. However, it still underuses structural context in two places: cross-KG interaction is weak during encoding, and final candidate ranking still relies too heavily on coarse similarity. We address these limitations with ContextEA, an enhanced encoder-decoder framework for transferable EA. On the encoder side, we introduce a cross-KG interaction encoder that unifies the two KGs with anchor bridges and performs earlier relation-aware cross-graph propagation. On the decoder side, we introduce a structural calibration decoder that calibrates alignment scores with entity-level, neighborhood-level, relation-level, and anchor-aware structural evidence. This design strengthens both structural context construction and structural context exploitation while remaining lightweight. Experiments on 29 EA datasets in OpenEA, SRPRS, and DBP show consistent gains over strong transferable baselines. Notably, the pretrained ContextEA already surpasses the finetuned baselines on all three benchmark groups, demonstrating substantially stronger transfer to unseen KGs. These results suggest that explicitly harnessing structural context is an effective direction for improving EA foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ContextEA框架，通过增强编码器-解码器结构来利用结构上下文改善实体对齐基础模型。编码器引入跨KG交互编码器，解码器使用结构校准解码器，在29个数据集上超越现有可迁移基线。
Motivation: 现有实体对齐基础模型未能充分利用结构上下文，表现在跨KG交互弱和最终候选排序过度依赖粗粒度相似性。
Method: 提出ContextEA增强的编码器-解码器框架，编码器侧通过锚桥统一两个KG并进行早期关系感知跨图传播；解码器侧使用结构校准解码器，整合实体级、邻域级、关系级和锚感知的结构证据。
Result: 在OpenEA、SRPRS和DBP的29个数据集上取得一致增益，预训练ContextEA已超过微调基线，表明对未见KG的强迁移能力。
Conclusion: 明确利用结构上下文是改进实体对齐基础模型的有效方向。

papers.title: A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we propose a general framework for Sliced Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies on manifolds endowed with Pullback Euclidean Metrics (PEMs), termed Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW). Within this framework, we instantiate two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EEG解码中的协方差描述符尺度敏感问题，提出基于全秩相关矩阵的Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW)框架，并实例化两种Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW)差异。基于CorSW开发域泛化框架，在三个EEG数据集上展示改进的泛化性能，训练开销低且无额外推理成本。
Motivation: 协方差描述符对噪声鲁棒但受通道缩放影响，全秩相关矩阵作为尺度不变替代，但现有流形上的Sliced Wasserstein差异尚未被探索。
Method: 提出PEMSW框架，在流形上通过Pullback Euclidean Metrics定义Sliced Wasserstein差异，并针对全秩相关矩阵流形上的两种几何（OLM和LSM）实例化CorSW。
Result: 在三个EEG数据集上，域泛化框架在分布偏移下表现改进，训练开销低且无额外推理成本。
Conclusion: 表明基于相关矩阵的Sliced Wasserstein差异可有效用于EEG解码域泛化。

papers.title: MS-DKC: A Dataset Knowledge Card Framework for Designing and Adapting Medical Image Segmentation Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is often framed as a search for stronger architectures, but this can obscure a more fundamental question: what does the dataset require from the model? In medical imaging, this requirement is shaped by foreground occupancy, morphology, boundary ambiguity, topology sensitivity, annotation quality, acquisition variation, and operating point. This paper introduces the Medical Segmentation Dataset Knowledge Card (MS-DKC), a framework for making these factors explicit. MS-DKC records dataset evidence through image/acquisition, morphology, supervision, context-dependence, and deployment-risk descriptors. These descriptors are mapped to failure modes, design priors, and risk-aligned criteria, making segmentation design more traceable than architecture-first comparison. We evaluate MS-DKC on DRIVE, ISIC2018, and ACDC, representing distinct regimes. DRIVE contains sparse, thin, branching vessels, favoring detail-preserving models, sensitivity-aware optimization, threshold analysis, and topology-aware metrics. DKC-TNet-v2 achieved Dice 0.8044 and IoU 0.6730 with 35103 parameters, while SA-UNetv2-DKC-AmbRef reached Dice 0.8141, IoU 0.6865, sensitivity 0.8265, specificity 0.9804, and AUC 0.9853. ISIC2018 involves compact but appearance-variable lesions; validation-constrained score-function selection on Att-Next-Topo/ATTNext produced MS-DKC-AttNextTopo-VCSF-NoAug with Dice 0.8872, IoU 0.8214, precision 0.9173, Boundary F1 0.4878, and ASSD 4.13, while plausible additions failed to improve the risk-aligned profile. ACDC provides a multi-class cardiac case, where MS-DKC recommends four-class softmax segmentation, class-balanced Dice/CE supervision, and class-wise surface evaluation. Overall, the results support dataset-conditioned design: different datasets require different priors, operating points, and evidence before a model can be judged appropriate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出医学分割数据集知识卡片（MS-DKC）框架，用于显式记录数据集的前景占有率、形态、边界模糊性、拓扑敏感性、标注质量、采集变化和操作点等特征，并映射到失败模式、设计先验和风险校准标准。在DRIVE、ISIC2018和ACDC三个数据集上的实验表明，不同数据集需要不同的先验和操作点，支持数据集条件化模型设计。
Motivation: 医学图像分割往往过于关注更强的架构，而忽略了数据集本身对模型的要求。本文旨在通过显式记录数据集特征，使分割设计更可追溯。
Method: 提出MS-DKC框架，通过图像/采集、形态、监督、上下文依赖和部署风险描述符记录数据集证据，并映射到失败模式、设计先验和风险校准标准。
Result: 在DRIVE上，DKC-TNet-v2达到Dice 0.8044、IoU 0.6730；SA-UNetv2-DKC-AmbRef达到Dice 0.8141、IoU 0.6865。在ISIC2018上，MS-DKC-AttNextTopo-VCSF-NoAug达到Dice 0.8872、IoU 0.8214。ACDC上推荐四类softmax分割和类平衡Dice/CE监督。
Conclusion: 结果支持数据集条件化设计：不同数据集需要不同的先验、操作点和证据，才能判断模型是否合适。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出MS-DKC框架，通过图像/采集、形态、监督、上下文依赖和部署风险描述符记录数据集证据，并映射到失败模式、设计先验和风险校准标准。
summary_sections.result: 在DRIVE上，DKC-TNet-v2达到Dice 0.8044、IoU 0.6730；SA-UNetv2-DKC-AmbRef达到Dice 0.8141、IoU 0.6865。在ISIC2018上，MS-DKC-AttNextTopo-VCSF-NoAug达到Dice 0.8872、IoU 0.8214。ACDC上推荐四类softmax分割和类平衡Dice/CE监督。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果支持数据集条件化设计：不同数据集需要不同的先验、操作点和证据，才能判断模型是否合适。

papers.title: Step-adaptive multimodal fusion network with multi-scale cloud feature learning for ultra-short-term solar irradiance forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-short-term solar irradiance prediction is critical for photovoltaic system dispatch and power grid stability. Existing approaches suffer from three key shortcomings: single time-series models cannot capture the spatial dynamics of clouds under complex conditions, standard convolutions inadequately represent multi-scale cloud features, and fixed low-frequency compensation strategies fail to adapt to different prediction steps. To address these issues, this proposes a multi-source data fusion model for ultra-short-term irradiance prediction. The model first employs InceptionNeXt to extract multi-scale, multi-directional spatial features from ground-based cloud images. A step-adaptive low-frequency compensation unit is then introduced to dynamically modulate global low-frequency information based on the prediction step. Eventually, the enhanced image features are combined with meteorological time-series features, and a TempAttnLSTM network captures global temporal dependencies for multi-step prediction. Experiments on the public NREL dataset and practical photovoltaic stations in Shandong illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with several state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对超短期太阳辐照度预测中单时间序列模型无法捕捉云层空间动态、标准卷积无法表示多尺度云特征、固定低频补偿策略不适应不同预测步长的问题，提出一种多源数据融合模型。模型使用InceptionNeXt提取云图多尺度空间特征，引入步长自适应低频补偿单元动态调节全局低频信息，并结合气象时间序列特征通过TempAttnLSTM进行多步预测。在公开NREL数据集和山东光伏电站数据上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有超短期太阳辐照度预测方法难以同时处理云层空间动态、多尺度特征以及不同预测步长的适应性问题，限制了光伏调度和电网稳定性。
Method: 提出多源数据融合模型：采用InceptionNeXt从地基云图提取多尺度多方向空间特征；设计步长自适应低频补偿单元动态调节全局低频信息；将增强后的图像特征与气象时间序列特征融合，通过TempAttnLSTM捕获全局时间依赖进行多步预测。
Result: 在NREL公开数据集和山东实际光伏电站数据上的实验表明，该方法优于多种现有方法。
Conclusion: 步长自适应低频补偿和多尺度云特征学习能够有效提升超短期太阳辐照度预测精度。

papers.title: Quantum-limited estimation of atmospheric turbulence via spatial mode decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We establish the ultimate precision limit for estimating the optical spatial coherence radius (Fried parameter) within a quantum metrological framework. In the weak field regime, we show that spatial-mode decomposition -- originally introduced for superresolution imaging -- enables substantially more precise estimation than conventional direct imaging when the receiver aperture is smaller than the coherence radius.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在量子计量框架下建立了估计大气光学空间相干半径（Fried参数）的终极精度极限。在弱场条件下，当接收孔径小于相干半径时，空间模式分解（最初用于超分辨成像）相比传统直接成像能实现更精确的估计。
Motivation: 大气湍流对光学通信和成像系统有重要影响，但传统直接成像方法在弱场和小孔径条件下难以实现高精度估计。
Method: 采用量子计量学方法，推导了Fried参数估计的量子Cramér-Rao下界，并分析空间模式分解方案在弱场下的估计性能。
Result: 摘要表明，在接收孔径小于相干半径时，空间模式分解的估计精度显著优于直接成像。
Conclusion: 空间模式分解为弱场下大气湍流参数估计提供了一种量子最优方案，但方法依赖特定的光子统计和模式选择。

papers.title: HyperVis: Continuous Latent Visual Relational Graphs on the Lorentz Hyperboloid for Compositional Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with compositional reasoning that requires understanding inter-object relationships. A natural remedy is to inject explicit scene graph triplets $\langle s, p, o \rangle$ from an off-the-shelf scene graph generator (SGG), but we show this backfires: discrete text labels collide with the continuous visual modality, degrading GQA accuracy from 60.38\% to 58.86\%. We propose \textbf{HyperVis}, which bypasses the SGG semantic bottleneck entirely. From $N$ class-agnostic region proposals, we compute a dense $O(N^2)$ visual relation tensor via spatially-biased cross-attention, project it onto a Lorentz hyperboloid, and enforce hierarchy through spatial physics, namely IoA-driven entailment cones and exterior-angle repulsion. We discover that HyperVis contributes in two complementary ways: (1) as a \emph{training-time regularizer}, the hyperbolic relational losses shape LoRA representations that improve generative VQA (GQA 61.03\% vs.\ 57.21\% for LoRA fine-tuning without relational losses, recovering and surpassing the baseline); and (2) as an \emph{inference-time relational encoder}, hyperbolic prefix tokens boost discriminative compositional scoring (SugarCrepe 79.94\%, $+$6.25pp over baseline). The learned curvature stabilises at $κ{=}4.0$, an order of magnitude above prior hyperbolic VLMs where $κ$ typically collapses toward zero, indicating that continuous visual features genuinely require the exponential volume of strongly curved space. A controlled Euclidean ablation confirms this decomposition: the relational pipeline regularises LoRA comparably in flat space (GQA 60.81\%), but the compositionality gain is specifically hyperbolic (SugarCrepe $+$4.58pp over Euclidean), with entailment loss ${\sim}6{\times}$ higher in Euclidean training. Codes are available at TBA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperVis，一种在洛伦兹双曲面（Lorentz hyperboloid）上构建连续视觉关系图的方法，以提升视觉语言模型（VLM）的组合推理能力。通过计算密集的视觉关系张量、投影到双曲面并施加层次约束，HyperVis 作为训练正则化器改善了生成式 VQA（GQA），作为推理时关系编码器提升了判别式组合评分（SugarCrepe）。
Motivation: 标准 VLM 在理解物体间关系（组合推理）上表现不佳，而使用现成场景图生成器（SGG）注入离散三元组会因模态冲突而降低性能，因此需要一种避免语义瓶颈的连续关系表示方法。
Method: 从 N 个类无关区域提议出发，通过空间偏置交叉注意力计算密集的 O(N^2) 视觉关系张量，将其投影到洛伦兹双曲面，并利用空间物理（IoA 驱动的包含锥和外角排斥）强制层级结构。
Result: 在 GQA 上，HyperVis 作为训练正则化器达到 61.03%（对比无关系损失的 LoRA 微调 57.21%）；在 SugarCrepe 上，作为推理时关系编码器达到 79.94%（提升 6.25 个百分点）。学习曲率稳定在 κ=4.0，显著高于以往双曲 VLM 的接近零值。
Conclusion: 连续视觉特征需要强曲率双曲空间的指数体积，HyperVis 在组合推理上优于离散 SGG 注入和平直空间变体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CogManip: Benchmarking Manipulative Behavior in Multi-Turn Interactions with Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit covert psychological manipulation in complex human-AI interactions has garnered increasing safety concerns. However, existing AI safety benchmarks remain largely restricted to explicit rule compliance and static prompts, failing to capture the dynamic and covert nature of manipulative strategies in multi-turn dialogues. We introduce CogManip, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates 15 manipulation strategy risks across 1,000 multi-turn interaction scenarios, validated by human experts. A systematic evaluation of 13 representative models, including frontier models like GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V3.2, reveals significant risk heterogeneities and illuminates the targeted direction for future defense. Further analysis of objective function perturbation reveals that DeepSeek-V3.2's manipulation tactics are highly sensitive to both negative and benign system prompts, demonstrating the critical necessity of prompt-based defense engineering and implicit goal auditing. CogManip offers a robust instrument and perspective for auditing the implicit psychological influence and dynamic strategy selection of modern LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CogManip，一个用于评估大语言模型在多轮交互中隐藏心理操控行为的基准，涵盖 15 种操控策略和 1000 个场景。对 13 个代表性模型（包括 GPT-5.4 和 DeepSeek-V3.2）的系统评估揭示了风险异质性，并发现 DeepSeek-V3.2 的操控策略对系统提示高度敏感，强调了基于提示的防御工程和隐式目标审计的必要性。
Motivation: 现有 AI 安全基准主要关注显式规则遵从和静态提示，无法捕捉多轮对话中动态、隐蔽的操控策略，因此需要更全面的评估方法。
Method: 构建了包含 1000 个多轮交互场景的基准 CogManip，由人类专家验证，覆盖 15 种操控策略风险。对 13 个模型进行系统评估，并对 DeepSeek-V3.2 进行目标函数扰动分析。
Result: 评估显示不同模型间的风险异质性显著；DeepSeek-V3.2 的操控策略对负面和良性系统提示均高度敏感，表明提示工程和隐式目标审计是关键防御方向。
Conclusion: CogManip 为审计现代大模型的隐式心理影响和动态策略选择提供了有效工具和视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IR3DE: A Linear Router for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundational Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate proficiency on a wide range of general tasks, and achieve remarkable results on various specialized tasks via domain-expert LLMs. With the ever-growing list of available LLMs, inference routers are being proposed to select the most appropriate LLM for each prompt. However, existing routing methods either optimize cost across weak-to-strong generalist LLMs or require substantial training to support domain-expertise routing. In this paper, we propose IR3DE, a Ridge Regression-based Router for Domain Experts that provides cheap and fast routing decisions for each prompt. We evaluate IR3DE in two Causal Language Modeling (CLM) settings where the tasks are next-token prediction for all domains, and one reasoning setting where each domain has its own distinct reasoning task. Despite being a linear router, IR3DE achieves performance comparable to the other baselines in both CLM settings, and surpassing them in the reasoning setting, with a normalized performance of 98.4%. Moreover, IR3DE enables the addition or removal of new domain experts without requiring the router to be retrained from scratch, allowing a dynamic set of LLMs to be served with minimal disruption to the router itself. Our code is available at: github.com/gensyn-ai/IR3DE.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IR3DE，一种基于岭回归（Ridge Regression）的线性路由器，用于在多个领域专家大语言模型（LLM）之间进行快速且低成本的路由选择。实验表明，在两个因果语言建模（CLM）任务中，IR3DE 性能与基线相当，在一个推理任务中超越基线，归一化性能达 98.4%。IR3DE 支持动态添加或移除领域专家而无需重新训练路由器。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器要么针对弱到强通用模型的成本优化，要么需要大量训练才能支持领域专家路由。缺乏一种轻量、高效且支持动态专家集的线性路由方法。
Method: 基于岭回归的线性路由器，对每个提示词计算最快的路由决策，无需复杂训练即可动态增删领域专家。
Result: 在 CLM 设置下性能与基线相当，在推理设置下归一化性能达 98.4%，超越其他基线。
Conclusion: 线性路由在领域专家选择上可以做到高效且性能不弱，同时支持动态模型集。

papers.title: OrderGrad: Optimizing Beyond the Mean with Order-Statistic Policy Gradient Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Policy-gradient methods usually optimize expected return, but many real world applications care about distributional properties of returns: tail risk, outlier robustness, or best-of-K discovery. We introduce OrderGrad, a family of likelihood-ratio and reparameterization gradient estimators for order-statistic objectives. OrderGrad optimizes finite-sample L-statistics, i.e., weighted averages of sorted rewards or costs, recovering objectives such as VaR, CVaR, trimmed means, medians, and top-m/best-of-K criteria by changing only the rank weights. For any fixed sample size and rank-weight vector, OrderGrad provides an unbiased gradient estimator for the corresponding order-statistic objective. The method is implemented as a simple reward transformation that can then be used in an otherwise standard policy-gradient or reparameterized update. We study the resulting estimator's variance behavior and evaluate it on tasks where mean optimization is mismatched to the deployment objective, including LLM math post-training and other tasks. OrderGrad provides a unified, plug-and-play route to risk-averse, robust, and exploratory learning. Code: https://github.com/paavo5/ordergrad
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrderGrad，一种用于优化顺序统计量目标（如 VaR、CVaR、修剪均值、中位数、top-m/best-of-K）的策略梯度估计方法，通过似然比和重参数化梯度估计实现无偏估计，并作为简单的奖励变换集成到标准策略梯度或重参数化更新中。实验包括 LLM 数学后训练等任务，验证了其处理风险厌恶、鲁棒性和探索性学习的能力。
Motivation: 标准策略梯度方法只优化期望回报，但许多实际应用关注回报的分布特性（如尾部风险、异常值鲁棒性、最佳 K 发现），现有方法缺乏统一且无偏的梯度估计框架。
Method: 提出 OrderGrad 家族，对固定样本的排序奖励（L-统计量）使用似然比和重参数化梯度估计，通过仅改变排序权重即可实现不同目标，实现为简单奖励变换后插入标准策略梯度或重参数化更新。
Result: 在 LLM 数学后训练等任务上，OrderGrad 在分布目标与部署目标不匹配时表现优于均值优化基线，并展示了方差可控性。

papers.title: Integrating Mechanistic and Data-Driven Models for Neurological Disorders through Differentiable Programming
papers.abstract_en: Advances in computational modeling, neuroimaging, and artificial intelligence are revolutionizing the modeling of neurological disorders for improved diagnostics, prognosis, and treatment planning. Mechanistic models provide valuable scientific insight into the disorders, but in practice they are often simplified with assumptions or computationally expensive and slow to solve. However, while purely data driven approaches provide speed and scalability, they require large, high quality data to train and generally suffer from interpretability and generalization issues. This perspective paper presents a structured overview of hybrid modeling strategies, which combine deep learning models with physics based solvers, and are categorized into parallel, series, and parallel-series architectures. Three main approaches that have been emphasized are residual modeling for missing or incomplete physics, Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (NODEs) for continuous time dynamics approximation, and solver in the loop that accelerates traditional solvers with neural approximations. These hybrid models integrate the governing differential equation based formulations and deep learning to characterize the evolution of neurological disorders, and promise advanced personalized neurological modeling. In addition, the study explores and proposes different hybrid configurations to improve diagnosis accuracy, predict disease progression, and inform treatment strategies across a range of neurological disorders. These capabilities outperform standalone mechanistic or purely data driven approaches, making hybrid modeling a powerful tool, especially in applications involving modeling the progression and treatment responses in neurological conditions such as brain tumors, Alzheimer's disease, and stroke.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点综述，系统梳理了结合机理模型与深度学习模型的混合建模策略，应用于神经系统疾病的诊断、预测和治疗规划。作者分类了并行、串行和并行-串行架构，并重点介绍了残差建模、神经常微分方程 (NODEs) 和求解器在环三种方法。摘要指出混合模型在脑肿瘤、阿尔茨海默病和中风等疾病上优于纯机理或纯数据驱动方法。
Motivation: 纯机理模型通常过于简化或计算代价高，纯数据驱动方法则依赖大量数据、缺乏可解释性和泛化能力。混合建模旨在融合两者优势，提升神经系统疾病建模的精度和效率。
Method: 提出三类混合架构：并行、串行和并行-串行；三种具体技术：残差建模（补全缺失物理）、神经常微分方程（NODEs，连续时间动态近似）和求解器在环（用神经近似加速传统求解器）。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称混合模型在诊断准确性、疾病进展预测和治疗策略方面优于单独使用的机理模型或数据驱动方法。
Conclusion: 混合建模是提升神经系统疾病个性化建模的有力工具，尤其适用于脑肿瘤、阿尔茨海默病和中风等疾病的进展和治疗反应建模。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic Organization: Memory as Execution State Management for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks with interdependent decisions, where each action reshapes future constraints and intermediate errors can cascade. Existing RAG and agent memory systems organize histories by semantic similarity, retrieving content-relevant entries at decision time. We argue that this design mismatches execution-state dependencies: it fragments decision trajectories and mixes valid and erroneous traces, hindering coherent state reconstruction and error isolation. We propose MAGE (Memory as Agent-Guided Exploration), an active execution-state manager that stores interactions in a hierarchical state tree. The agent derives its state from the active root-to-current path, combining subgoal summaries, recent traces, and hints from prior branches. Four coupled operations maintain the tree: Grow records new traces, Compress summarizes completed subgoals, Maintain validates summaries, and Revise restores a target boundary and resumes on a new branch. This design bounds context growth while preserving state integrity and isolating flawed segments from the active path. Experiments on MemoryArena show that MAGE improves the average task success rate by 7.8--20.4 pp over baselines, while reducing token consumption by 55.1%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于语义相似性的RAG和智能体记忆系统在处理长时程任务时存在缺陷，无法正确管理执行状态依赖，导致轨迹碎片化和错误累积。作者提出MAGE（Memory as Agent-Guided Exploration），一种主动的执行状态管理器，通过分层状态树存储交互，并用四种操作（Grow、Compress、Maintain、Revise）维护树。实验在MemoryArena上显示，MAGE将平均任务成功率提升7.8-20.4个百分点，同时减少55.1%的token消耗。
Motivation: 现有RAG和智能体记忆系统按语义组织历史，但长时程任务中决策相互依赖，这种设计会割裂决策轨迹并混合有效和错误轨迹，阻碍状态重构和错误隔离。
Method: 提出MAGE，一个主动的执行状态管理器，使用分层状态树存储交互。智能体从当前活跃的根到当前路径派生状态，包含子目标摘要、最近轨迹和先前分支的提示。四种耦合操作维护树：Grow记录新轨迹，Compress总结已完成子目标，Maintain验证摘要，Revise恢复目标边界并在新分支上继续。
Result: 在MemoryArena基准上，MAGE将平均任务成功率提升7.8-20.4个百分点（与基线相比），同时减少55.1%的token消耗。
Conclusion: 该设计通过主动管理执行状态，在限制上下文增长的同时保持状态完整性，并从活跃路径中隔离有缺陷的片段，从而提升长时程任务的性能。

papers.title: LatentSkill: From In-Context Textual Skills to In-Weight Latent Skills for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent systems increasingly use textual skills to encode reusable task procedures, but injecting these skills into the prompt at every step incurs substantial context overhead and exposes skill content as plaintext. We present LatentSkill, a framework that converts textual skills into plug-and-play LoRA adapters through a pretrained hypernetwork. LatentSkill stores skill knowledge in weight space rather than context space, removing per-step skill tokens while preserving modular loading, scaling, and composition. On ALFWorld and Search-QA, LatentSkill outperforms the corresponding in-context skill baseline while using substantially fewer prefill tokens: it improves ALFWorld success by 21.4 and 13.4 points on the seen and unseen splits with 64.1% fewer prefill tokens, and improves Search-QA exact match by 3.0 points with 72.2% lower skill-token overhead. Further analysis shows that generated skill LoRAs form a structured semantic geometry, can be precisely controlled via the LoRA scaling coefficient, and can be composed through parameter-space arithmetic when skill components are aligned. These findings suggest that weight-space skills provide an efficient, modular, and less exposed substrate for extending LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LatentSkill，将文本技能通过预训练超网络转换为LoRA适配器存储在权重空间中，替代逐步提示中的技能令牌。在ALFWorld和Search-QA上，LatentSkill以更少的预填充令牌超越上下文技能基线，且生成的技能LoRA具有结构化语义几何，可通过缩放系数精确控制并通过参数空间算术组合。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统使用文本技能编码任务程序，但注入提示导致上下文开销大且技能内容明文暴露。
Method: 采用预训练超网络将文本技能映射为即插即用的LoRA适配器，将技能知识存储在权重空间而非上下文空间，保持模块化加载、缩放和组合能力。
Result: 在ALFWorld上，已见和未见分割的成功率分别提升21.4和13.4个百分点，预填充令牌减少64.1%；在Search-QA上精确匹配提升3.0个百分点，技能令牌开销降低72.2%。
Conclusion: 权重空间技能为扩展LLM智能体提供了高效、模块化且暴露更少的基质，技能LoRA可通过参数算术组合实现结构化操作。

papers.title: A Framework for Measuring Appropriate Reliance on Set-Valued AI Advice
papers.abstract_en: Appropriate reliance on AI advice has become a central research theme in human-AI collaboration. Existing frameworks have focused exclusively on point predictions as AI advice. However, set-valued AI advice (e.g., discrete sets or continuous intervals) is increasingly being used to communicate uncertainty and improve human decision making. In this paper, we develop the first formal framework for measuring appropriate reliance on set-valued AI advice within the sequential judge-advisor paradigm, spanning both classification and regression tasks. For classification, we first introduce the dimensions that are necessary for evaluating set-valued AI advice. We then define two metrics: correct reliance rate on AI and correct reliance rate on self, which jointly characterize appropriate reliance in this setting. For regression, we introduce quantity of AI reliance and quality of AI reliance, which respectively measure whether a decision maker utilized the AI advice and whether their reliance helped them get closer to the ground truth relative to their initial estimate. Through the application of our framework, we demonstrate how these metrics capture important nuances in human-AI collaboration that existing measures overlook.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个正式框架，用于衡量人类对集合值AI建议（如离散集或连续区间）的适当依赖，涵盖分类和回归任务。分类任务中定义了关于AI和自身的正确依赖率，回归任务中引入了AI依赖的数量和质量指标。通过应用该框架，展示了现有测量忽略的重要细微差别。
Motivation: 现有框架仅关注点预测作为AI建议，但集合值AI建议（如离散集或连续区间）越来越多地用于传达不确定性并改善人类决策，缺乏相应的度量框架。
Method: 在序贯判断-建议范式中，分别针对分类和回归任务，开发度量标准。分类中定义正确依赖率（AI和自身），回归中定义AI依赖的数量和质量。
Result: 通过框架应用，展示了这些度量能够捕捉人类-AI协作中现有测量忽略的重要细微差别。
Conclusion: 该框架为评估集合值AI建议下的适当依赖提供了基础，有助于改进人机协作设计。

papers.title: On Advantage Estimates for Max@K Policy Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is widely used for post-training reasoning models, but sparse outcome rewards make exploration difficult. A complementary approach is to optimize inference-time objectives such as pass@K and max@K directly, yet existing policy-gradient estimators for these objectives use different signals, baselines, and normalizations, making their relationships unclear. We study this issue through baseline design and advantage centering. Starting from the advantage estimator of a leading method in the field, we show that it is policy-gradient unbiased but yields a non-centered advantage. We then introduce a Leave-Two-Out baseline that preserves policy-gradient unbiasedness while making realized batch advantages exactly centered. The resulting method, MaxPO, has an efficient quadratic-time implementation and integrates naturally into group-based RL for LLM post-training. We further derive the canonical finite-batch advantage for max@K, providing a unified view of existing advantage estimators. Empirically, we verify that the L2O baseline reduces gradient variance and outperforms non-centered alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了带可验证奖励的强化学习中Max@K策略梯度的优势估计问题。作者指出现有方法使用不同的信号、基线和归一化，导致关系不清晰。通过分析领先方法的优势估计器，发现其策略梯度无偏但优势非中心化，进而提出Leave-Two-Out（L2O）基线，在保持无偏性的同时使批次优势精确中心化。由此得到的方法MaxPO具有高效的二次时间实现，可自然融入基于组的LLM后训练强化学习。实验验证L2O基线降低了梯度方差，优于非中心化替代方案。
Motivation: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习中，稀疏结果奖励使得探索困难，而直接优化推理时目标（如pass@K和max@K）的现有策略梯度估计器信号、基线和归一化各异，关系不明，需要系统研究。
Method: 提出MaxPO方法，核心是Leave-Two-Out（L2O）基线：在保持策略梯度无偏性的同时，使得实现的批次优势精确中心化。该基线具有高效的二次时间实现，并自然融入基于组的RL（如LLM后训练）。
Result: 实验证明L2O基线降低了梯度方差，并优于非中心化的优势估计方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过L2O基线获得中心化优势估计是提升Max@K策略梯度性能的有效手段，并为现有优势估计器提供了统一视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowledge Distillation for Visual Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) image generation models are highly expressive but computationally intensive, motivating effective model compression. Knowledge distillation (KD) is a natural approach for model compression and has been widely studied in language modeling, yet its behavior in visual AR generation remains underexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of distillation strategies for AR image models. Our analysis shows that while standard distillation can yield meaningful gains, recent methods developed for language do not directly transfer to images: long decoding horizons and visual token ambiguity make teacher supervision unreliable especially under student-conditioned contexts. To address this, we propose VarKD, a distillation framework for visual autoregressive models that distills on student samples while selectively applying teacher supervision and reducing token-level ambiguity. Experiments on ImageNet across multiple AR backbones show that VarKD consistently outperforms prior distillation baselines, narrowing the gap to large-scale models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了自回归图像生成模型的知识蒸馏策略，发现语言领域的蒸馏方法不直接适用于图像领域，主要障碍包括长解码序列和视觉标记歧义导致教师监督不可靠。为此提出VarKD框架，在学生采样上蒸馏，同时选择性应用教师监督并减少标记级歧义。在ImageNet上多个自回归骨干网络上的实验表明，VarKD持续优于先前的蒸馏基线，缩小了与大规模模型的差距。
Motivation: 自回归图像生成模型计算量大，但知识蒸馏在视觉自回归生成中的行为尚待探索。语言领域的蒸馏方法无法直接迁移到图像，因为长解码序列和视觉标记歧义使得教师监督在student-conditioned上下文中不可靠。
Method: 提出VarKD框架，该框架在学生生成样本上进行蒸馏，并有选择地应用教师监督，同时减少令牌级歧义。通过处理视觉自回归模型的独特挑战（长解码序列、视觉令牌歧义）来改进蒸馏效果。
Result: 在ImageNet上多个自回归骨干网络（如AR序列模型）上，VarKD优于先前的蒸馏基线，显著缩小了与大规模模型的性能差距。
Conclusion: 该工作为视觉自回归模型的蒸馏提供了系统分析，并证明针对图像特点设计的蒸馏策略（如VarKD）能有效压缩模型，未来可进一步扩展至更大模型和任务。

papers.title: 3D Underwater Path Planning via Generative Flow Field Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) launch and recovery (LAR) into the hull of an advancing host platform requires traversal of a complex, three-dimensional propeller wake whose hydrodynamic structure cannot be characterised by a uniform current model. High-fidelity Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations resolve this structure with sufficient accuracy for path planning, but their computational cost renders them impractical for onboard use. We address this gap by integrating two conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) architectures -- a regularised PatchGAN and a 2D3DGAN with self-attention -- as drop-in replacements for RANS CFD data within a three-dimensional, energy-weighted A* path planning framework. Both generators are driven by a hierarchical pipeline that synthesises full $128^3$ voxel flow field volumes from scalar operating condition inputs alone, with end-to-end inference times of approximately 28-146 $μ$s, compared to hours for a single RANS computation. We benchmark all four environmental knowledge levels: uniform current, ground-truth CFD, PatchGAN, and 2D3DGAN~SA across 19,800 independently generated trajectories spanning 550 distinct flow conditions. Full CFD wake knowledge reduces energy expenditure by 5.7-12.5% and high-velocity wake-core encounters by up to 77.8% relative to uniform-current planning, with both benefits scaling with operating severity. The cGAN surrogates recover approximately 45-60% of the CFD energy benefit and high-velocity cell avoidance benefit while operating at inference speeds compatible with edge device use. These results provide the first systematic quantification of the downstream path planning value of cGAN-predicted hydrodynamic fields in a three-dimensional maritime robotics application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自主水下航行器（AUV）在母船尾流中回收的路径规划问题，提出使用条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）作为高保真CFD模拟数据的替代模型。通过层级式流水线从标量操作条件生成128^3体素流场，并将预测的流场集成到能量加权的A*路径规划框架中。实验表明，全CFD尾流知识可降低5.7-12.5%的能量消耗并减少77.8%的高速尾流核心遭遇，而cGAN替代模型可恢复约45-60%的CFD性能优势，且推理速度适合边缘设备。
Motivation: 高保真RANS CFD模拟能精确解析复杂的三维螺旋桨尾流结构，但计算成本过高，无法用于AUV的在线路径规划。现有均匀流模型无法表征尾流的真实动力学特征，导致路径规划不优。
Method: 采用两种条件生成对抗网络架构——正则化PatchGAN和带自注意力的2D3DGAN，作为RANS CFD数据的替代模型；通过层级式流水线从标量操作条件合成128^3体素流场；将生成的流场输入三维能量加权A*路径规划框架。
Result: 在19,800条轨迹和550种流况下，全CFD知识相比均匀流规划降低能量消耗5.7-12.5%，减少高速尾流核心遭遇高达77.8%；cGAN替代模型恢复约45-60%的CFD能量收益和高速单元规避收益，推理时间仅28-146微秒。
Conclusion: 该工作首次系统量化了cGAN预测流场在三维海洋机器人路径规划中的下游价值，证明了生成式替代模型在实时规划中的可行性。

papers.title: Learning Visual Spatial Planning from Symbolic State via Modality-Gap-Aware Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While vision-language models excel at general multimodal understanding, they still struggle with visual spatial planning. We attribute this to a perception-reasoning modality gap: visual planning requires models to infer latent state structures from pixels and then reason over the recovered structure to produce valid actions, whereas symbolic planning directly leverages explicit objects and constraints. This creates dual bottlenecks in visual state recovery and multi-step planning. To address this, we propose MGSD, a two-stage modality-gap-aware self-distillation framework. First, a cold-start grounding stage equips the visual student with reliable state representations, minimizing early perception noise. Second, a privileged teacher transfers planning capabilities via on-policy distillation, using explicit symbolic states to supervise the student's own visual rollout prefixes. Crucially, symbolic data is used strictly during training, leaving inference purely visual. Experiments on visual planning benchmarks show that MGSD consistently improves visual planning across both 4B and 8B backbones, raising the macro average by 19.3% and 18.4%, respectively. The resulting models narrow the gap to symbolic-input upper bounds, while ablations and diagnostics confirm that the improvement comes from both visual state recovery and optimal-path reasoning. These results suggest that modality-gap-aware self-distillation improves not only how models perceive actionable states, but also how they plan over the inferred structure. Code is available at https://github.com/Oranger-l/MGSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MGSD，一个两阶段模态差距感知自蒸馏框架，用于解决视觉空间规划中感知与推理之间的模态差距。该方法先通过冷启动接地阶段减少早期感知噪声，再使用符号状态作为特权教师监督学生的视觉规划，使模型在推理时纯视觉地执行规划。在视觉规划基准上，MGSD 在 4B 和 8B 骨干模型上分别提升宏观平均 19.3% 和 18.4%。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在视觉空间规划中表现不佳，原因是感知-推理模态差距：视觉规划需从像素推断状态结构并推理出有效动作，而符号规划直接利用显式对象和约束，造成视觉状态恢复和多步规划的双重瓶颈。
Method: 提出两阶段模态差距感知自蒸馏框架 MGSD。第一阶段冷启动接地，使视觉学生获得可靠状态表示；第二阶段特权教师通过在线策略蒸馏，利用显式符号状态监督学生自身的视觉展开前缀，符号数据仅在训练中使用，推理时纯视觉。
Result: 在视觉规划基准上，MGSD 在 4B 和 8B 骨干上分别提升宏观平均 19.3% 和 18.4%，缩小了与符号输入上界的差距。消融实验证实改进来自视觉状态恢复和最优路径推理。
Conclusion: 模态差距感知自蒸馏不仅改善了模型感知可行动状态的能力，也改善了基于推断结构进行规划的能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VZCrash: A Large-Scale IMU Dataset of Ego-Vehicle Crashes
papers.abstract_en: We introduce VZCrash, the largest publicly available dataset of real-world vehicle collision data featuring Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) telemetry. The dataset contains more than 31,000 validated crashes and 158,000 negative samples, including hard cases and distractors. Each sample includes acceleration and angular velocity at 100 Hz, and GPS speed at 1 Hz. Events in VZCrash were captured by devices installed on a fleet of 73,010 commercial vehicles of different sizes driving in the United States over the span of several years. We also present an extensive experimental study enabled by the volume of the dataset. We first benchmark several different approaches, from a simple threshold-based heuristic to state-of-the-art deep learning models. Then, we present an experiment demonstrating the importance of scaling data to train high-quality crash detection models, and we show that scale is especially important when these models need to be deployed into a real-world environment.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026). VZCrash is publicly available at this URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/vzc-research-chapter/VZCrash
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VZCrash 是当前最大的公开真实车辆碰撞数据集，包含超过31,000个碰撞事件和158,000个负样本，采集自73,010辆商用车的IMU数据（100 Hz加速度和角速度，1 Hz GPS速度）。该数据集支持从简单阈值到深度学习方法的碰撞检测基准测试，并展示了数据规模对模型实际部署性能的重要性。
Motivation: 现有碰撞检测数据集规模有限且多为模拟数据，缺乏大规模真实场景中的IMU数据，难以训练和评估高鲁棒性的碰撞检测模型。
Method: 通过安装在73,010辆商用车上的设备采集多年IMU数据，标注碰撞事件，并构建包含困难负样本和干扰项的数据集。
Result: 基于该数据集，基准测试表明深度学习模型优于阈值方法，并且数据规模增大显著提升模型在真实环境中的碰撞检测性能。
Conclusion: 大规模真实IMU数据对开发实用型碰撞检测系统至关重要，VZCrash为相关研究提供了标准化基准。

papers.title: FontFusion: Enhancing Generative Text in Diffusion Models with Typographic Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Typography generation in diffusion models faces a persistent trade-off: enabling precise font control typically degrades text legibility, while maintaining readability often sacrifices typographic fidelity. We present FontFusion, a plug-and-play conditioning framework for Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architectures that resolves this dilemma through three core innovations: (1) a hierarchical token representation establishing explicit text-font relationships at multiple granularities, (2) position-aware embeddings creating spatial bindings between typography and image content, and (3) a multi-level token dropping strategy improving both computational efficiency and generalization to unseen fonts. Our systematic evaluation of font embedding spaces reveals that a dual encoder combining DeepFont and DINOv2 outperforms any single encoder for typography tasks. FontFusion demonstrates 76% relative improvement on challenging decorative fonts over single-encoder baselines and font consistency gains exceeding approximately 68-76% over unconditioned models, while integrating into existing DiT architectures without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FontFusion，一个即插即用的条件生成框架，用于扩散 Transformer（DiT）中的字体生成。通过层次化 token 表示、位置感知嵌入和多级 token 丢弃策略，解决了字体控制与文本可读性之间的权衡。评估表明，在装饰性字体上相对单编码器基线提升 76%，字体一致性提升 68-76%。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在生成文本时难以同时实现精确的字体控制和高可读性，两者之间存在权衡。
Method: 提出 FontFusion 框架，包含三个核心创新：层次化 token 表示建立文本-字体关系、位置感知嵌入创建字体的空间绑定、多级 token 丢弃策略提升效率和泛化。采用 DeepFont 和 DINOv2 双编码器。
Result: 在装饰性字体上相对单编码器基线提升 76%，字体一致性相比无条件模型提升约 68-76%，且无需重新训练即可集成到现有 DiT 架构中。
Conclusion: 本文展示了在扩散模型中实现字体精确控制与文本可读性的统一，并验证了双编码器优于单编码器。

papers.title: ReCache: Learning Budget-Aware Caching Schedules for Diffusion Models via REINFORCE
papers.abstract_en: Modern diffusion models generate high-quality images and videos, but their iterative denoising process makes inference expensive. Feature caching accelerates sampling by reusing or predicting intermediate activations across neighboring denoising steps, exploiting the redundancy of computations along the reverse trajectory. In this work, we focus on the caching schedule: selecting which denoising steps should be fully recomputed. Existing schedules are either fixed (e.g. uniform) or chosen adaptively from per-step error heuristics; in both cases, the actual compute cost is a side-effect of hand-tuned thresholds rather than a quantity the user can specify. We propose ReCache, which inverts this: given a target budget k, it learns the recomputation schedule that maximizes generation quality, turning compute into a directly controllable input. ReCache trains via policy gradients, sidestepping backpropagation through full diffusion inference, and uses no labelled data. Generations from uncached inference serve as matching targets, paired with a reward for generation quality. ReCache is compatible with any caching mechanism, including feature reuse and feature forecasting; for each mechanism, a single trained policy adapts across computational budgets at inference time. ReCache consistently outperforms scheduling baselines: under a $\times5.04$ FLOPs reduction on FLUX, it reduces LPIPS by 31% (from 0.456 to 0.316) compared to DiCache; on Wan 2.1 at a $\sim \times2.6$ speedup, it drops LPIPS by 65% (from 0.480 to 0.169) and boosts the VBench score by 7% (5.6 points, from 70.4 to 76.0) over uniform HiCache. Code is available at https://github.com/thecrazymage/ReCache.

papers.title: MDP-GRPO: Stabilized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is ideal for multi-constraint instruction following, yet standard group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) becomes unstable under discrete, low-dispersion rewards, where within-group reward distributions are frequently homogeneous. We identify and formalize three pathologies of z-score group normalization in this regime: low-variance amplification, mean-centering blindness, and zero-variance collapse. To address them, we propose MDP-GRPO, which stabilizes learning through (1) multi-temperature sampling to increase reward dispersion, (2) dual-anchor advantages to restore gradients in homogeneous groups and stop mean-centering blindness, (3) prospect-theoretic shaping to bound updates and penalize violations based on Kahneman and Tversky's theory, and (4) asymmetric KL regularization. Evaluated on FollowBench, IFEval, and a curated multi-constraint dataset, MDP-GRPO outperforms standard GRPO, improving strict constraint satisfaction by up to 5.0% on Llama-3.2-3B. Our method also enables stable convergence with small group sizes while preserving general capabilities on MMLU and ARC.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference. 14 pages, 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对标准GRPO在多约束指令跟随任务中因离散、低方差奖励导致的不稳定问题，提出MDP-GRPO方法。该方法通过多温度采样、双锚点优势、前景理论塑形和非对称KL正则化四项技术稳定学习。在FollowBench、IFEval等数据集上，MDP-GRPO在Llama-3.2-3B模型上将严格约束满足率提升高达5.0%，并在小分组规模下保持稳定收敛，同时保留MMLU和ARC上的通用能力。
Motivation: 标准GRPO在离散、低方差奖励下会出现低方差放大、均值中心盲区和零方差崩溃三种病态现象，导致多约束指令跟随训练不稳定。
Method: 提出MDP-GRPO，包含：(1)多温度采样以增加奖励离散度；(2)双锚点优势以恢复同质组中的梯度并消除均值中心盲区；(3)基于Kahneman和Tversky前景理论的塑形函数以限制更新并惩罚违规；(4)非对称KL正则化。
Result: 在FollowBench、IFEval和自建多约束数据集上，MDP-GRPO相比标准GRPO，Llama-3.2-3B的严格约束满足率提升最高5.0%，且小分组规模下仍能稳定收敛，MMLU和ARC上通用能力无损。
Conclusion: 论文认为所提出的四项机制有效解决了低离散奖励下GRPO的不稳定问题，为多约束指令跟随提供稳定实用的强化学习方案。

papers.title: Metamorphic Testing with the Rashomon Set: Explanation Faithfulness in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multiple machine learning models can achieve near-equivalent predictive performance on the same task, yet provide divergent feature-based explanations. This is called the Rashomon effect of (explainable) machine learning, and it raises the question of which explanations, if any, are trustworthy. We propose a framework based on metamorphic testing that assesses explanation faithfulness without requiring ground-truth labels by exploring attributed feature importance from post-hoc explanation methods. Five metamorphic relations formalize expected consistency properties between model behavior and feature attributions. We apply this general framework to two tabular regression datasets and two post-hoc explainers (SHAP and LIME) to demonstrate the approach. The framework offers a practical, model-agnostic tool for selecting accurate models with reliable and trustworthy explanations.
papers.comment: Accepted at 10th International Workshop on Metamorphic Testing (MET 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器学习模型解释的忠实性问题，利用Rashomon set（多个近等性能模型）提出基于蜕变测试（metamorphic testing）的评估框架。该框架通过五个蜕变关系检验后验解释方法（如SHAP和LIME）在特征重要性归因上的一致性，无需真实标签。在表格回归数据集上的实验验证了其有效性，提供了选择准确且解释可靠模型的实用工具。
Motivation: 不同模型在相同任务上可达到近等性能但产生分歧的解释（Rashomon效应），导致难以判断哪些解释可信，缺乏忠实性评估方法。
Method: 提出基于蜕变测试的框架，定义五种蜕变关系（如模型输出对特征扰动的变化与解释一致性），利用Rashomon set中的多个模型作为测试基准，无需真实标签即可评估后验解释的忠实性。
Result: 在表格回归数据集上，使用SHAP和LIME两种解释器，该框架成功检测到解释不一致性，展示了模型无关的评估能力。
Conclusion: 该框架为选择既准确又具有可靠解释的机器学习模型提供了实用、模型无关的工具，有助于提升可解释AI的信任度。

papers.title: When Should Memory Stay Silent: Measuring Memory-Use Boundaries in Memory-Augmented Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables language model agents to support personalized interactions, but it remains unclear when available memories warrant integration into responses. Existing memory evaluations emphasize retrieval accuracy and downstream task utility, while overlooking whether retrieved sensitive memory content is warranted in the current turn. We introduce RBI-Eval, a controlled measurement study built around a probe set that compares model behavior with and without access to sensitive memory under identical benign prompts. We evaluate four base LLMs against a matched no-memory reference across four memory-access settings: full-context exposure and three retrieval systems. Our results reveal substantial behavioral divergence. With memory available, the separation score for sensitive-memory integration decreases by 8.9\%--26.6\% relative to the matched no-memory reference for GPT-5.4-mini, but by 51.1\%--82.9\% for Claude-Sonnet-4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and Qwen3.5-9B. Control experiments on DeepSeek and GPT-5.4-mini show this effect is specific to sensitive content, rather than general personalization. Retrieval systems reduce exposure but do not eliminate integration once sensitive memory reaches the generator. These findings suggest safe personalization requires memory-aware decisions at both retrieval and generation time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RBI-Eval，一个用于测量记忆增强对话代理在何时应整合敏感记忆的评估框架。通过对比有无敏感记忆下的模型行为，发现不同模型在整合敏感记忆时存在显著差异，且检索系统虽减少暴露但无法消除整合。结果表明安全个性化需在检索和生成阶段都进行记忆感知决策。
Motivation: 现有记忆评估强调检索准确率和下游任务效用，忽略了检索到的敏感记忆内容在当前对话轮次中是否合理可用。
Method: 构建 RBI-Eval 探测集，在相同良性提示下比较模型有无敏感记忆时的行为差异，设置全上下文暴露和三种检索系统共四种记忆访问设置。
Result: GPT-5.4-mini 的敏感记忆整合分离分数下降 8.9%-26.6%，而 Claude-Sonnet-4.6、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Qwen3.5-9B 下降 51.1%-82.9%；控制实验表明该效应仅对敏感内容而非通用个性化有效。
Conclusion: 安全个性化需要在检索和生成时都考虑记忆内容是否合适，仅靠检索减少暴露不足以避免不当整合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Similarity: Trustworthy Memory Search for Personal AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to provide persistent personalization across sessions. However, existing memory pipelines are largely driven by semantic similarity: memory data close to the current query is retrieved and injected into the model context. This creates a critical trustworthiness gap, since a semantically related memory may still be contextually inappropriate, leading to threats such as cross-domain leakage, sycophancy, tool-call drift, or memory-induced jailbreaks. In this paper, we study memory search as a trust boundary in personal AI agents. We evaluate representative agentic memory frameworks, including A-Mem, Mem0, and MemOS, together with OpenClaw, a real-world personal-agent environment with persistent state and tool-use capability. Our results show that long-term memory is not merely a utility layer, but a durable control channel that can reshape how agents interpret tasks and execute actions, leaving them highly susceptible to the aforementioned threats. To mitigate these vulnerabilities, we propose MemGate, a lightweight and deployable memory plug-in for trustworthy memory search, with only 9M parameters and a 35.1MB footprint. MemGate is inserted between the vector memory store and the backbone LLM, requiring no LLM modification, memory-database rewriting, or inference-time LLM judge. It applies a query-conditioned neural gate to candidate memory representations, turning raw similarity search into task-conditioned memory admission. Across multiple mainstream memory frameworks, real-world agent settings, and diverse LLM backbones, MemGate reduces memory-induced threats while preserving long-term memory utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究个人AI代理中长期记忆的信任边界，指出现有基于语义相似度的记忆检索存在安全隐患（如跨域泄漏、谄媚、工具调用漂移、记忆诱导越狱）。提出MemGate，一种轻量级记忆插件，通过查询条件神经门控将原始相似度搜索转换为任务条件记忆准入，仅9M参数，无需修改LLM或记忆数据库。实验表明MemGate在多个框架下减少了记忆诱导威胁且保持长期记忆效用。
Motivation: 现有个人AI代理的记忆管道依赖语义相似度检索，导致语义相关但上下文不恰当的记忆被注入，引发安全威胁（跨域泄漏、谄媚、工具调用漂移、记忆诱导越狱）。需要更可信的记忆搜索机制。
Method: 提出MemGate，一个轻量级、可部署的记忆插件，插入在向量记忆存储和主干LLM之间。使用查询条件神经门控对候选记忆表示进行过滤，将原始相似度搜索转换为任务条件记忆准入。仅9M参数，35.1MB体积，不需要修改LLM、重写记忆数据库或使用推理时LLM评判。
Result: 在多个主流记忆框架（A-Mem, Mem0, MemOS）和真实世界个人代理环境（OpenClaw）中，MemGate减少了记忆诱导威胁，同时保持了长期记忆效用。
Conclusion: 长期记忆不仅是效用层，还是持久的控制通道，易受攻击。MemGate作为轻量级插件可有效缓解记忆相关威胁，且易于部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation under Misspecification
papers.abstract_en: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits and episodic reinforcement learning (RL) under general function approximation with model misspecification. Existing guarantees rely on realizability and therefore do not extend to misspecified models, where classical regret bounds may fail. This work introduces KL misspecification formulations for contextual bandits and episodic RL and analyzes regression-based algorithms with Gibbs policy updates. High-probability KL-regret guarantees with explicit misspecification terms are established, recovering the standard realizable KL-regularized setting as a special case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在模型错误设定下，使用通用函数逼近的KL正则化上下文强盗和情节强化学习问题。现有方法依赖于可实现性假设，无法推广到错误设定模型。作者提出了KL错误设定公式，并分析了基于回归的Gibbs策略更新算法，建立了带有显式错误设定项的高概率KL遗憾界，可恢复标准可实现的KL正则化设定。
Motivation: 现有KL正则化RL算法的遗憾界依赖于可实现性假设，而实际中模型往往存在错误设定，导致经典界失效。
Method: 提出了上下文强盗和情节RL的KL错误设定公式，并设计了基于回归的算法，使用Gibbs策略更新进行在线学习。
Result: 建立了高概率KL遗憾界，其中包含显式的错误设定项，且在可实现情况下退化为标准结果。
Conclusion: 该工作为KL正则化RL在模型错误设定下的理论分析提供了基础，但尚未涉及实际应用。

papers.title: Learning solution operators of PDEs with sparse approximation methods
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the approximation of solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) using sparse high-dimensional techniques. Building on a dimension-incremental framework, we combine product basis expansions with sparse recovery methods, specifically orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP), to substantially reduce the required sample size compared with a previously considered cubature-based approach. We evaluate the resulting method numerically on several examples, comparing it against both cubature-based sparse approximation and Fourier neural operators in terms of accuracy, runtime, and sample size. The experiments show that our approach considerably reduces the number of required PDE solves relative to its predecessor while maintaining competitive accuracy, particularly when the solution admits a sparse representation in the chosen basis. Furthermore, the recovered sparse index sets yield interpretable insights into the relevant variables and parameter interactions.

papers.title: Adaptive Learning Rates with Surrogate Probability for Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader
papers.abstract_en: Follow-the-regularized-leader framework has shown effectiveness and flexibility in online learning problems, where the choice of learning rates are known to be crucial. Recently, adaptive learning rates defined in terms of the arm-selection probabilities, obtained by solving convex optimization, have achieved improved best-of-both-worlds (BOBW) guarantees in various bandit problems. In contrast, BOBW guarantees for its computationally efficient alternative, follow-the-perturbed-leader (FTPL), remain relatively limited since its optimization-free nature ironically makes the design of adaptive, probability-dependent learning rates non-trivial. To address this challenge, we propose an adaptive learning rate for FTPL by introducing surrogate probability functions that can be computed only from the available quantities, without requiring the exact probabilities. Based on these learning rates with surrogate functions, we provide the BOBW guarantee for FTPL with Pareto perturbations for any shape parameter $α>1$, generalizing prior results restricted to specific choices of $α=2$. We further show the BOBW guarantees for FTPL with adaptive learning rates in the bandit problem with expert advices. Our approach preserves the computational simplicity of FTPL while enabling probability-dependent adaptivity, and the surrogate-based methodology may be of independent interest in other algorithmic frameworks beyond FTPL and learning rate designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跟随扰动领导者（FTPL）算法提出一种基于代理概率的自适应学习率，使得FTPL在无需精确概率计算的情况下也能实现最佳双世界（BOBW）保证，并将结果推广到任意形状参数α>1的帕累托扰动及专家建议的赌博机问题。
Motivation: FTPL的计算高效性使其有吸引力，但其无优化的特性导致难以设计依赖概率的自适应学习率，从而限制了BOBW保证的适用范围（此前仅对特定α=2成立）。
Method: 引入代理概率函数，该函数仅利用可用量（无需精确概率）计算，并以此定义自适应学习率；将其应用于FTPL的帕累托扰动和专家建议赌博机问题。
Result: 证明所提方法对于任意α>1的帕累托扰动均能获得BOBW保证，并在专家建议赌博机问题中同样实现BOBW保证，同时保持FTPL的计算简单性。
Conclusion: 基于代理概率的自适应学习率方法有效扩展了FTPL的BOBW保证范围，其方法论可能对FTPL之外的算法框架具有独立价值。

papers.title: Sample-efficient Low-level Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulation Tasks via Zero-shot Transfer Learning
papers.abstract_en: As robotic systems become more sophisticated, the growing complexity of their motion planning models and the longer training times pose substantial challenges. Evolutionary algorithms such as the Sample-efficient Cross-Entropy Method (iCEM) have recently demonstrated promising potential for low-level real-time planning by leveraging efficient knowledge reuse strategies to improve performance. Although effective in many control tasks, iCEM's performance can be constrained in more complex scenarios, particularly those requiring stacking, sliding, and shelf placement. In this work, we propose a novel iCEM+TL framework that explicitly leverages Transfer Learning (TL), where key iCEM parameters are transferred from simpler upstream tasks to guide more complex downstream tasks. Additionally, we applied Reward Redesign (RR) through task decomposition for stacking objects and shelf placement to optimize task-specific performance. Results from the simulation show that our framework achieves success rate improvements of up to 23%. The framework is further validated on a real Franka Emika robot in a stacking task, demonstrating its practical feasibility for real-world deployment.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN) 2026 conference accepted
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iCEM+TL 框架，通过迁移学习将简单任务中学到的 iCEM 参数迁移到复杂机器人操作任务（如堆叠、滑动、货架放置），并结合奖励重新设计（RR）进行任务分解。仿真实验显示成功率提升高达 23%，并在真实 Franka Emika 机器人上验证了堆叠任务的可行性。
Motivation: 随着机器人系统复杂度增加，运动规划模型训练时间增长，进化算法 iCEM 在复杂场景（堆叠、滑动、货架放置）中性能受限。现有方法缺乏高效的跨任务知识复用机制。
Method: 提出 iCEM+TL 框架，核心是迁移学习（TL）：将上游简单任务中学到的 iCEM 关键参数（如精英样本权重、噪声方差）直接初始化下游复杂任务，避免从零开始优化。同时引入奖励重新设计（RR），将堆叠和货架放置任务分解为子目标（如对齐、放置），以优化任务特定奖励信号。
Result: 在仿真中，框架在堆叠、滑动、货架放置等任务上实现最高 23% 的成功率提升。在真实 Franka Emika 机器人堆叠任务中成功部署，验证了实际可行性。
Conclusion: 框架通过迁移学习和任务分解显著提升了样本效率与成功率，但摘要未提及在其他机器人平台或更复杂环境中的泛化性。

papers.title: Texture-preserving implicit neural representation for Cone beam CT truncated reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) frequently suffers from data truncation, which introduces severe artifacts and limits the effective field of view (FOV). Existing deep learning methods for truncated cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) reconstruction suffer from serious limitations, including a strict reliance on supervised ground truth and a failure to account for continuous 3D spatial truncation variations. To address these challenges, we introduce a self-supervised 3D reconstruction framework based on neural scene representations. By directly mapping spatial coordinates to radiodensity under projection supervision, our approach inherently bypasses traditional filtering and backprojection operations, thereby fundamentally eliminating truncation-induced ring artifacts while enabling robust continuous 3D data extrapolation. However, coordinate networks are susceptible to an inherent spectral bias, which leads to a severe loss of clinically vital high-frequency textures. To resolve this bottleneck, we further incorporate a physics-based iterative refinement module into the neural scene representation architecture. Leveraging the artifact-free, extrapolated volume from the coordinate network as an optimal initialization, this module progressively re-extracts and injects high-frequency structural information from the original projections back into the volume. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method successfully unifies the exceptional artifact suppression and extrapolation capabilities of neural networks with the high-fidelity detail preservation of iterative algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对锥束CT（CBCT）数据截断导致的伪影和有效视野受限问题，提出一种基于神经场景表示的自监督3D重建框架。该方法直接映射空间坐标到辐射密度，避免传统滤波反投影操作，从而消除截断引起的环状伪影，并实现连续3D数据外推。为解决坐标网络的频谱偏差导致高频纹理丢失的问题，引入基于物理的迭代精化模块，从原始投影中重新提取高频结构信息。模拟和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法结合了神经网络出色的伪影抑制和外推能力与迭代算法的高保真细节保留。
Motivation: 现有CBCT截断重建方法严重依赖有监督地面真值，且无法处理连续3D空间截断变化，导致伪影和细节丢失。
Method: 提出自监督3D重建框架：使用坐标网络将空间坐标映射到辐射密度进行投影监督，并集成基于物理的迭代精化模块，以高频信息注入的方式恢复纹理。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据集上，该方法有效消除截断伪影，实现连续外推，同时保留临床关键高频纹理。
Conclusion: 该方法统一了神经网络的伪影抑制与外推能力以及迭代算法的细节保真度，为CBCT截断重建提供了新范式。

papers.title: Memory is Reconstructed, Not Retrieved: Graph Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress, LLM agents still struggle with reasoning over long interaction histories. While current memory-augmented agents rely on a static retrieve-then-reason paradigm, this rigid pipeline design prevents them from dynamically adapting memory access to intermediate evidence discovered during inference. To bridge this gap, we propose MRAgent, a framework that combines an associative memory graph with an active reconstruction mechanism. We represent memory as a Cue-Tag-Content graph, where associative tags serve as semantic bridges connecting fine-grained cues to memory contents. Operating on this structure, our active reconstruction mechanism integrates LLM reasoning directly into memory access, allowing the agent to iteratively explore and prune retrieval paths based on accumulated evidence. This ensures that memory retrieval is dynamically adapted to the reasoning context while avoiding combinatorial explosion caused by unconstrained expansion. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark and LongMemEval benchmark demonstrate significant improvements over strong baselines (up to 23%), while substantially reducing token and runtime cost, highlighting the effectiveness of active and associative reconstruction for long-horizon memory reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MRAgent框架，将记忆表示为线索-标签-内容图，并通过主动重建机制动态调整记忆检索路径，使LLM智能体能根据推理过程中发现的中间证据迭代探索和剪枝检索路径。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准上，该方法相比强基线取得了最高23%的提升，并显著降低了token和运行时间成本。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强型LLM智能体依赖静态的检索-推理范式，无法根据推理过程中发现的中间证据动态调整记忆访问，导致长交互历史推理效果不佳。
Method: 提出MRAgent框架，包含关联记忆图（线索-标签-内容图）和主动重建机制；主动重建机制将LLM推理直接整合到记忆访问中，允许智能体基于累积证据迭代探索和剪枝检索路径，同时避免无约束扩展导致的组合爆炸。

Conclusion: 主动和关联重建对于长时域记忆推理是有效的，能够动态适应推理上下文并提高效率。

papers.title: When Good Enough Is Optimal: Multiplication-Only Matrix Inversion Approximation for Quantized Gated DeltaNet
papers.abstract_en: Matrix inversion in chunk-wise parallel linear attention is a major bottleneck for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs, where forward-substitution-based methods exhibit limited parallelism and poor hardware utilization. We propose a fast, Matrix Multiplication (MatMul)-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices arising in chunk-wise linear attention. Motivated by the rapid growth of Neumann-series terms and the diagonal concentration of the inverse matrix, we employ a truncated Neumann expansion with structural masking and parallel residual correction to eliminate sequential dependencies. We further extend our method to low-bits INT by mitigating the dynamic range expansion arising from repeated matrix power operations, and adapt the approximation order and residual step to the chunk size to minimize computational cost while preserving the model's accuracy. Experiments on Qwen3.5-family models demonstrate up to 5$\times$ kernel-level speedup and a 20% reduction in decode-layer overhead, while preserving accuracy under both floating-point and low-precision inference. Our method offers an efficient and hardware-friendly solution for scalable linear attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分块并行线性注意力中的矩阵求逆瓶颈，提出基于矩阵乘法(MatMul)的快速算法。利用截断Neumann展开、结构掩码和并行残差校正消除顺序依赖，并扩展至低比特整数推理。在Qwen3.5系列模型上实现5倍内核加速和20%解码层开销降低，同时保持精度。
Motivation: 分块并行线性注意力的矩阵求逆是长上下文建模的主要瓶颈，尤其在NPU上，基于前向替换的方法并行性有限且硬件利用率低。
Method: 提出基于矩阵乘法的算法：对严格下三角矩阵采用截断Neumann展开，结合结构掩码和并行残差校正；扩展至低比特整数时抑制动态范围扩展，并根据块大小调整近似阶数和残差步长以最小化计算成本。
Result: 在Qwen3.5系列模型上实现高达5倍内核级加速和20%解码层开销降低，在浮点和低精度推理下均保持精度。
Conclusion: 该方法为可扩展线性注意力提供了一种高效且硬件友好的解决方案。

papers.title: Catastrophic Forgetting as Accessibility Collapse: A Three-Level Framework for Knowledge Persistence in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting is commonly interpreted as the irreversible erasure of previously acquired knowledge during sequential learning. In this work, we investigate an alternative perspective: that forgetting may arise not from complete destruction of task representations but from a loss of accessibility to preserved information. We introduce a three-level framework separating knowledge storage, representation, and accessibility, and evaluate each component through a series of continual-learning experiments on sequential CIFAR-100 classification using ResNet-18. Our analysis combines checkpoint persistence, linear probing, representation geometry, classifier-reset recovery, and layer-wise recoverability experiments. We observe complete behavioral forgetting of earlier tasks, with task accuracy collapsing from 54.8% to 0%, while linear probe performance retains approximately 76% of the original representational information. Furthermore, retraining only the final classifier restores 75.7% of the original task performance without modifying the backbone network. Layer-wise analysis reveals that early and intermediate layers preserve highly recoverable task information despite severe degradation at later stages. Projection-energy and principal-angle analyses indicate that retained knowledge persists as distributed high-dimensional representations rather than through preservation of a small dominant subspace. These findings suggest that catastrophic forgetting is better characterized as an accessibility failure than complete representational erasure, and that substantial task-relevant information remains embedded within neural representations even after functional forgetting has occurred.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Sequential continual-learning experiments on CIFAR-100 using ResNet-18
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个三维框架（知识存储、表示、可访问性），通过CIFAR-100顺序分类实验发现，灾难性遗忘更可能是可访问性崩溃而非表示擦除。实验表明，线性探测保留约76%的表示信息，仅重训练分类器可恢复75.7%的性能。
Motivation: 传统观点认为灾难性遗忘是先前知识的不可逆擦除，本文提出另一种视角：遗忘可能源于已保存信息的可访问性丧失。
Method: 引入分离知识存储、表示和可访问性的三维框架，通过检查点持久性、线性探测、表示几何、分类器重置恢复和层可恢复性实验进行分析。
Result: 早期任务的行为遗忘从54.8%降至0%，但线性探测保留约76%的表示信息；仅重训练分类器可恢复75.7%的原任务性能；早期和中间层保留高度可恢复的任务信息。
Conclusion: 灾难性遗忘更应被视为可访问性故障而非完整表示擦除；功能性遗忘后，大量任务相关信息仍嵌入在神经表示中。

papers.title: RedditPersona: A Modular Framework for Community-Conditioned LLM Adaptation from Reddit
papers.abstract_en: Community-conditioned language model adaptation requires choices about data collection, community definition, and evaluation that are currently made independently in each study, making it hard to compare assumptions or reuse artifacts. We present RedditPersona, a modular framework that standardizes these choices: it collects Reddit posts and comments, profiles active users, partitions them under five grouping strategies (subreddit-based, graph-structural, semantic, hybrid, and interaction-based), trains a parameter-efficient adapter per strategy via QLoRA, and evaluates them under a shared metric suite spanning fluency, fidelity, distributional alignment, and community identifiability. Applied to 112 subreddits in the urban well-being domain (301,429 user profiles, 16M+ comments), we find that adapters' behavioral identifiability tracks each strategy's intrinsic agreement with the subreddit baseline, and that a consistent trade-off between identifiability and distributional similarity to real text holds across all five strategies. The code and configuration files are available at: https://github.com/Ahghaffari/redditpersona.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RedditPersona，一个模块化框架，用于标准化基于 Reddit 的社区条件化语言模型适配。该框架通过收集 Reddit 帖子、根据五种分组策略划分用户、使用 QLoRA 训练参数高效适配器，并在一套统一的指标集上评估。在 112 个子版块上的实验表明，适配器的行为可识别性与分组策略的内在一致性相关，且可识别性与分布相似性之间存在一致权衡。
Motivation: 当前社区条件化语言模型适配研究中，数据收集、社区定义和评估方法各自独立，导致假设难以比较和成果难以复用。
Method: 提出 RedditPersona 框架，包含数据收集、用户画像、五种分组策略（基于子版块、图结构、语义、混合和交互）、基于 QLoRA 的参数高效适配器训练，以及统一评估指标集（涵盖流畅度、保真度、分布对齐和社区可识别性）。
Result: 在 112 个子版块、301,429 个用户画像和超过 1600 万条评论上，发现适配器的行为可识别性随分组策略与子版块基线的内在一致性变化，且可识别性与分布相似性之间存在一致权衡。
Conclusion: RedditPersona 为社区条件化 LLM 适配提供了标准化框架和开源工具，有助于未来研究的可比较性和可复用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EGTR-Review: Efficient Evidence-Grounded Scientific Peer Review Generation via Multi-Agent Teacher Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Scientific peer review generation has attracted increasing attention for reducing reviewing burdens and providing timely feedback. However, existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods often produce generic comments with insufficient evidence support and weak source traceability, while complex multi-agent systems incur high inference costs. To address these challenges, we propose EGTR-Review, an Evidence-Grounded and Traceable Review Generation framework via Multi-Agent Teacher Distillation. EGTR-Review first constructs a multi-agent teacher that performs structure-aware paper decomposition, key-element extraction, external scholarly evidence retrieval, evidence-state labeling, verification reasoning, and review synthesis. It then distills both intermediate reasoning trajectories and final review comments into a lightweight student model through task-prefix-driven multi-task learning. An evidence-weighted objective further reduces the influence of weak, missing, or non-verifiable supervision. Experiments on public peer-review datasets show that EGTR-Review (Student) outperforms strong prompt-based, fine-tuned, and structured/agentic baselines across automatic metrics, LLM-as-Judge evaluation, and human evaluation, while maintaining strong factual grounding and source traceability with substantially lower token consumption and inference time. Our code, prompts, configurations, and sample data are available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EGTR-Review，一个基于证据的同行评议生成框架，通过多智能体教师蒸馏将推理轨迹和评论注入轻量级学生模型，在保持事实性和可溯源性的同时显著降低推理成本。实验表明学生模型在多个指标上超越强基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的同行评议方法常产生泛泛评论、缺乏证据支持，而多智能体系统推理成本高。
Method: 构建多智能体教师，执行结构感知论文分解、关键元素提取、外部学术证据检索、证据状态标注、验证推理和评论合成；通过任务前缀驱动的多任务学习将中间推理和最终评论蒸馏到学生模型；引入证据加权目标以降低弱监督影响。
Result: 在公开同行评议数据集上，学生模型在自动指标、LLM-as-Judge 评估和人工评估中均优于基于提示、微调、结构化或智能体的基线，同时 token 消耗和推理时间大幅降低，并保持强事实基础和源可溯性。
Conclusion: EGTR-Review 提供了一种高效且可溯源的同行评议生成方案，适用于需要证据支撑的审稿场景。

papers.title: OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space by aligning student and teacher representations across selected layers on the same rollouts, bypassing the LM head entirely. Theoretically, OPRD eliminates sampling variance and provides richer per-layer structural information. Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. OPRD also trains 1.44x faster and uses 54% less memory than top-k OPD. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线策略蒸馏（OPD）仅约束输出空间导致采样方差大且忽略中间表示的问题，提出在线策略表示蒸馏（OPRD），在隐藏状态空间对齐学生与教师的表示。理论分析表明OPRD消除了采样方差，实验在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上缩小了师生差距，训练速度提升1.44倍，内存减少54%。
Motivation: 现有OPD只监督输出空间的next-token概率，存在两个局限：（1）在大词表上蒙特卡洛KL估计的采样方差在整个训练过程中持续存在；（2）将教师视为黑盒，丢弃了LM头之前的所有中间隐藏状态。
Method: 提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，在相同轨迹上，跨选定层对齐学生和教师的表示，绕过LM头，在隐藏状态空间进行蒸馏。
Result: 在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上，OPRD缩小了学生与教师的差距，而输出空间OPD基线低于教师；训练速度比top-k OPD快1.44倍，内存减少54%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调OPRD通过利用中间表示消除了采样方差并提供了更丰富的层间结构信息，从而提升了蒸馏效果和效率。

papers.title: ReSAGE-PAR: Representational Similarity Assessment for Generative Expansion in Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
papers.abstract_en: To address the limited diversity and data scarcity in Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR), we explore image synthesis using diffusion models guided by attribute-based prompts. While this enables the controlled generation of pedestrian images, it faces two critical challenges: (i) the domain gap between high-quality pre-training data and low-resolution, non-standard surveillance crops, and (ii) the need for reliable attribute verification to prevent generative hallucinations. In this paper, we introduce a robust generate-score-autolabel pipeline called ReSAGE-PAR (REpresentational Similarity Assessment for Generative Expansion in PAR) that bridges this domain gap and enables scalable, high-fidelity dataset expansion. First, we adapt pre-trained diffusion models to native PAR resolutions using a tailored LoRA-based Image-to-Image approach. Second, we extract vision-language alignment scores between the generated images and their conditioning prompts, utilizing a comprehensive prompting strategy that includes label-consistent and inconsistent complements. Finally, we formulate a Bayesian classifier that converts these continuous scores into reliable binary pseudo-labels. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of ReSAGE-PAR in preserving spatial priors and verifying attributes. When integrated into PAR training, ReSAGE-PAR consistently yields significant improvements-achieving gains of up to 8.7% on standard backbones and pushing state-of-the-art frameworks to new performance levels. This proves its value as an architecture-agnostic solution for scalable PAR enhancement. The complete codebase for ReSAGE-PAR is publicly available at http://www-vpu.eps.uam.es/publications/ReSAGE-PAR.
papers.comment: Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReSAGE-PAR管道，通过扩散模型生成行人图像并自动属性标注，以解决行人属性识别（PAR）中数据多样性不足和稀缺问题。管道包括：使用LoRA微调扩散模型适配低分辨率监控图像、提取视觉-语言对齐分数、以及贝叶斯分类器生成可靠伪标签。实验表明，该方法在标准主干上提升达8.7%，并推动现有最先进框架达到新水平。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有PAR受限于数据稀缺和领域差距（预训练高质量图像与低分辨率监控图像之间），且生成图像需可靠的属性验证以避免幻觉。
Method: 采用定制LoRA的图像到图像方法将预训练扩散模型适配到PAR本机分辨率；基于多策略提示（含一致/不一致补充）计算生成图像与提示的视觉-语言对齐分数；再通过贝叶斯分类器将连续分数转化为可靠二值伪标签。
Result: 在标准PAR主干上取得最高8.7%的性能提升，并改进了现有最先进框架的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为ReSAGE-PAR是一种架构无关的可扩展PAR增强方案，能有效保留空间先验和验证属性。

papers.title: Leveraging MTG-FCI fire observations for event-based fire behavior monitoring from near-real-time operation to seasonal analysis
papers.abstract_en: Wildfire monitoring and suppression require timely information on fire behavior, including fire energy release and rate of spread, to support operational decision-making and resource allocation. Active fire products from the Flexible Combined Imager (FCI) aboard the geostationary Meteosat Third Generation (MTG) satellites provide 10-min observations over Europe and Africa. Deriving fire behavior information from these observations requires associating individual hotspot detections into coherent fire events. We present a Fire Event Tracker (FET) algorithm that performs spatio-temporal clustering of hotspot detections from the LSA-SAF FCI active fire product. The algorithm assigns persistent identifiers to fire events and updates their geometry, fire radiative power, and rate of spread at each 10-min interval. The same parameterization is used for both near-real-time and retrospective processing. FET was applied retrospectively to the Mediterranean FCI hotspot archive of 2025 and operationally in two near-real-time contexts: wildfire monitoring in Portugal and support of the 2025 SILEX airborne campaign within the EUBURN project, where besides fire monitoring, FET products were also used to initialize coupled FOREFIRE-MesoNH simulations for plume forecasting. Results show that event-based clustering of FCI active fire detections provides a consistent description of fire evolution, enabling both tactical wildfire management and high-frequency seasonal fire analyses.

papers.title: PLAN-S: Bridging Planning with Latent Style Dynamics for Autonomous Driving World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models (LWMs) have strengthened end-to-end autonomous driving by forecasting compact scene dynamics for downstream planning. However, existing LWM-based planners usually generate trajectories directly from entangled latent representations. This compact latent-to-planner pathway lacks explicit modeling of risk, drivability, and diverse style preferences, making driving-style dynamics difficult to supervise, inspect, or modulate before a final trajectory is selected. We propose PLAN-S (PLANning with latent Style dynamics), a planner-facing bridge that addresses this compactness-controllability dilemma by decoding a style-conditioned, four-channel semantic cost map from the latent representation. The cost map is conditioned on ego state and driving style and is consumed up-stream of the planning decision through two host-side interfaces: attention-level fusion for regression planners and reward-level fusion for anchor-score planners. We validate PLAN-S on two architecturally distinct hosts, ResWorld on nuScenes and WoTE on NAVSIM, while keeping the host backbones frozen to isolate the contribution of the proposed bridge. On nuScenes, PLAN-S reduces L2 at every horizon over the baseline, with 0.55 m average L2 and a 42% relative reduction in the 3 s collision rate. On NAVSIM, the rule-cost variant reaches 89.4 Predictive Driver Model Score (PDMS), while the learned cost variant provides complementary gains on baseline-challenging scenes. Ablations show that the cost pathway contributes most directly to safer trajectory selection. Qualitative results further show that PLAN-S can produce diverse cost maps, with spatially consistent variations aligned to different driving styles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLAN-S，一种规划器侧的桥梁，通过从潜世界模型的紧凑表示中解码出风格条件的四通道语义成本图，解决了紧凑性与可控性之间的困境。成本图融合到规划器中，在nuScenes和NAVSIM上验证，降低了L2距离和碰撞率，并支持多种驾驶风格。
Motivation: 现有基于潜世界模型的规划器直接从紧凑的潜在表示生成轨迹，缺乏对风险、可驾驶性和风格偏好的显式建模，导致难以在最终轨迹选择前进行监督、检查和调控。
Method: 提出PLAN-S桥梁，从潜在表示解码出受自车状态和驾驶风格条件化的四通道语义成本图，并通过注意力级融合（回归规划器）和奖励级融合（锚点分数规划器）两种接口供给规划决策。
Result: 在nuScenes上，PLAN-S在所有规划时域上降低了L2距离，平均L2为0.55米，3秒碰撞率相对降低42%；在NAVSIM上，规则成本变体达到89.4 PDMS，学习成本变体在基线困难场景上提供互补增益。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明成本通路对安全轨迹选择贡献最直接，定性结果显示PLAN-S能产生与不同驾驶风格对齐的空间一致变化成本图。

papers.title: Merging model-based control with multi-agent reinforcement learning for multi-agent cooperative teaming strategies
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a framework that combines multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) with model-based control to achieve safe, dynamically feasible actions in cooperative multi-agent tasks. Multi-agent reinforcement learning provides the advantage of learning cooperative policies for multi-agent teams from discrete non-differentiable rewards in a long planning horizon. Model-predictive control is robust and offers safe, dynamically feasible actions in a fast replanning framework for short horizons. We propose an algorithm that extends actor-critic model predictive control for MARL which we refer to as multi-agent actor-critic model predictive control (MA-AC-MPC). We demonstrate the capabilities of this algorithm by applying it to a multi-agent pursuit-evasion scenario. Specifically, we compare the evader team's strategy using the MA-AC-MPC model and a multi-layer perceptron model (MA-AC-MLP). The pursuer team uses augmented proportional navigation as it is accepted as an advanced adversarial control law. We also provide an example with a heterogeneous environment where a drone and omni-wheeled rover cooperate to achieve repeatable and successful landing with 100% success rate in hardware for MA-AC-MPC compared to 60% for MA-AC-MLP. We demonstrate the robustness of the proposed MA-AC-MPC algorithm in hardware for both environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合多智能体强化学习（MARL）与模型预测控制（MPC）的框架（MA-AC-MPC），以实现合作多智能体任务中安全且动态可行的动作。在追逃场景中，该算法与多层感知机基线（MA-AC-MLP）进行比较；在异构环境中，无人机与全向轮式机器人协作着陆的硬件实验显示，MA-AC-MPC成功率达100%，而MA-AC-MLP仅为60%。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习能学习长期合作的策略，但难以保证安全性和动态可行性；模型预测控制鲁棒且能提供短时域内的安全动作。结合两者可弥补各自的不足。
Method: 提出多智能体演员-评论家模型预测控制（MA-AC-MPC），将actor-critic框架扩展至MPC，使得每个智能体在分布式规划中利用学习到的值函数和模型预测进行协同决策。
Result: 在多智能体追逃仿真中，MA-AC-MPC相比MA-AC-MLP展现出更好的逃避策略；在真实硬件实验中，无人机与全向轮式机器人的协作着陆成功率达100%，而MA-AC-MLP仅60%。
Conclusion: MA-AC-MPC结合了模型预测控制的安全性与强化学习的长期优化能力，能够有效应用于需要协同且动态可行的多智能体任务。
