papers.title: High-Dimensional Theory of LoRA Fine-Tuning in a Solvable Attention Model
papers.abstract_en: We develop a high-dimensional statistical theory of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in attention models, capturing the interplay between pre-training and fine-tuning. We introduce a solvable framework in which a single-head attention layer is first pre-trained on a data-abundant task and subsequently adapted via a rank-one LoRA update on limited data. In the high-dimensional limit, both stages admit a sharp asymptotic characterization in terms of a finite set of order parameters, yielding explicit predictions for test errors and representation alignment. Our analysis shows that the impact of pre-training on LoRA is summarized by an effective noise term, from which we derive prescriptions for the optimal pre-training procedure. We also demonstrate a regime with a mismatch between the value of the test error and representation quality, and propose an application of our theory to active fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一种适用于注意力模型的低秩适应（LoRA）微调的高维统计理论，提出了一个可解框架，其中单头注意力层先在大数据任务上预训练，再通过秩1 LoRA更新在有限数据上微调。在高维极限下，两阶段过程可用一组有限序参数精确刻画，给出测试误差和表示对齐的显式预测。分析表明预训练对LoRA的影响可总结为有效噪声项，并推导出最优预训练程序。还展示了测试误差与表示质量不匹配的机制，并应用于主动微调。
Motivation: 现有LoRA理论分析不足，缺乏对预训练与微调相互作用的高维统计理解。
Method: 建立一个可解框架，单头注意力层先预训练后通过秩1 LoRA微调，在高维极限下用序参数刻画。
Result: 给出测试误差和表示对齐的显式预测，发现预训练影响可表示为有效噪声项，并推导最优预训练程序。
Conclusion: 展示了测试误差与表示质量不匹配的机制，并提出理论在主动微调中的应用。

papers.title: Resonant Minds: Closed-Loop Social Avatars with Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: Creating lifelike digital humans with genuine social intelligence requires unifying cognitive reasoning and multimodal generation within a coherent framework. Current approaches treat these as separate tasks: Large Language Models excel at dialogue but lack embodied expression, while diffusion-based talking head models achieve visual fidelity but ignore social cognition. To bridge this gap, we propose a closed-loop dual-agent framework integrating perception, social reasoning, and expression into a continuous interaction cycle. The perception module analyzes partners' multimodal behaviors from video, while the social reasoning module infers hidden mental states through Theory of Mind and selects responses via an ensemble mechanism. The expression module then generates emotion-controllable dual-agent videos synthesizing both speaker speech and expression alongside listener reactive behaviors, capturing bidirectional dynamics absent in prior work. We construct a hierarchical Persona-Scenario dataset with psychologically grounded personas and private social goals to support evaluation under information asymmetry. Experiments on this dataset demonstrate competitive or superior performance on both dialogue quality and video generation metrics. Notably, our method surpasses even the full-information Script mode on key dialogue quality dimensions, suggesting that explicit mental state inference under uncertainty can elicit more thoughtful dialogue than unrestricted information access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个闭环双智能体框架（Resonant Minds），统一感知、社会推理（Theory of Mind）与多模态生成，用于创建具有社交智能的逼真数字人。框架包含感知模块分析伙伴行为、社会推理模块推断心理状态并选择响应、表达模块生成情绪可控的双智能体视频。在构建的分层Persona-Scenario数据集上，该方法在对话质量和视频生成指标上达到竞争性或更优性能，甚至在某些对话质量维度上超越全信息脚本模式。
Motivation: 现有方法将语言模型对话与表情生成分离，缺乏对社交认知的整合，导致数字人缺乏真正的社交智能。
Method: 提出闭环双智能体框架：感知模块从视频分析多模态行为，社会推理模块通过心智理论（Theory of Mind）推断隐藏心理状态并利用集成机制选择响应，表达模块生成情绪可控的说话者与听者双向互动视频。
Result: 在自建Persona-Scenario数据集上，方法在对话质量和视频生成指标上表现竞争性或更优，尤其在关键对话质量维度上超越全信息脚本模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在信息不对称下显式推断心理状态能引出比完全信息访问更周到的对话，该框架为统一认知与生成提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representing Research Attention as Contextually Structured Flows
papers.abstract_en: Research attention is widely used as an indicator of visibility, influence, and societal uptake, yet it is typically represented as aggregated counts that do not preserve how attention develops across contexts over time. This creates a mismatch between how attention is interpreted and how it is represented. We propose attention flows as contextually structured representations that encode the organisation of attention and its evolution over time. We evaluate whether these representations capture transferable structure by constructing a benchmark based on analogy-style reasoning across research outputs. Comparing signal, sequence, and flow-based representations, we find that flow representations more effectively support structural comparison, particularly in settings where attention is shaped by temporal progression or context distributions. We further show that learned flow representations improve robustness under partial observation and structural perturbation. Overall, these results support modelling attention as a contextually structured phenomenon and provide a basis for more informative approaches to research evaluation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将研究注意力表示为上下文结构化的流（attention flows），以编码注意力随时间的组织与演化。通过类比推理基准，对比信号、序列和基于流的表示，发现流表示更有效地支持结构比较，尤其在注意力受时间进展或上下文分布影响的场景中。此外，学习到的流表示在部分观测和结构扰动下具有更好的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 当前研究注意力通常以聚合计数表示，无法保留注意力在不同上下文中如何随时间发展的信息，导致解释与表示之间的不匹配。
Method: 提出注意力流作为上下文结构化的表示，并构建基于类比推理的基准来评估不同表示（信号、序列、流）捕捉可迁移结构的能力。
Result: 流表示在结构比较任务上优于信号和序列表示，特别是在注意力受时间进展或上下文分布影响的场景中。学习到的流表示在部分观测和结构扰动下表现出更好的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 结果表明应将注意力建模为上下文结构化的现象，为更信息化的研究评估方法提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Staying with the Uncertainty: Uncertainty-Scaffolding Strategies for Artificial Moral Advisors in LLM-to-LLM Simulated Conversations
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly deployed as Artificial Moral Advisors (AMA) in a variety of contexts: what kind of conversational patterns should they display? In this paper, we study how AMA can help their interlocutors "stay with the uncertainty". We propose three modes of uncertainty (Perspective-Multiplying, Tension-Preserving, Process-Reflecting) and compare them against three control conditions (Baseline, Persuasive, Sycophantic). A user-agent LLM engages in a dialogue on an ethical dilemma with an AMA following a specific uncertainty strategy, and completes pre- and post-conversation questionnaires. We further examine the effect of two persona prompt formats (Declarative and Narrative). We found that (1) no single model dominates as a simulated user agent, with open models aligning with human ambiguity through between-persona divergence and closed models through within-persona hedging; (2) declarative personas better capture initial stance diversity while narrative personas show more realistic belief revision; (3) all six AMA strategies produce distinguishable conversational patterns; and (4) uncertainty strategies differ not in how much stance revision they produce, but in the quality of engagement they sustain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型作为人工道德顾问（AMA）时，如何通过不确定性策略（观点倍增、张力保持、过程反思）帮助对话者“与不确定性共处”。通过LLM模拟对话比较三种不确定性策略与三种控制条件，发现无单一模型主导模拟用户，声明式人格更好捕捉初始立场多样性，叙事式人格显示更现实的信念修正，所有策略产生可区分的对话模式，不确定性策略在立场修正量上无差异但在参与质量上不同。
Motivation: LLM被部署为人工道德顾问，需要研究其应对伦理困境时应采用的对话模式，特别是如何帮助用户保持对不确定性的开放性。
Method: 设计三种不确定性策略（观点倍增、张力保持、过程反思）和三种控制条件（基线、说服、谄媚），通过LLM模拟对话，用户代理与AMA就伦理困境对话，并完成前后问卷，同时评估声明式和叙事式两种人格提示格式。
Result: 无单一模型主导模拟用户；开放模型通过个体间分歧对齐人类模糊性，封闭模型通过个体内对冲；声明式人格更好捕捉初始立场多样性，叙事式人格显示更现实的信念修订；所有六种AMA策略产生可区分对话模式；不确定性策略在立场修正量上无差异，但在参与质量上不同。
Conclusion: 不确定性策略不改变立场修正的程度，但影响对话的参与质量，提示在设计AMA时应关注对话的深度而非立场变化量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retry Policy Gradients in Continuous Action Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Retry-based objectives such as pass@K and max@K optimize the best return obtained from multiple sampled trajectories, and recent work has shown that they can promote exploration without explicit exploration bonuses. In discrete action spaces, ReMax was shown to do so by adapting to return uncertainty. In this work, we introduce pathwise derivative estimators for retry objectives and use them to extend ReMax to continuous action spaces. We study the resulting learning dynamics and show that, even with deterministic rewards, ReMax can encourage stochastic exploration by reshaping the policy-gradient landscape. In particular, it alters gradients both in direction, biasing updates toward higher policy entropy, and in magnitude, damping gradients and slowing convergence. We further show that Adam's adaptive normalization can mitigate this damping, depending on its numerical stabilization parameter. Empirically, we instantiate this objective as ReMax Actor-Critic (ReMAC), an off-policy actor--critic algorithm that optimizes the ReMax objective using a pathwise derivative estimator. Our experiments show that ReMAC can promote higher policy entropy without entropy regularization and achieves performance comparable to SAC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续动作空间，引入路径导数估计器用于重试目标（如pass@K和max@K），将ReMax方法扩展到连续动作空间，提出ReMAC算法。理论分析表明重试目标通过重塑策略梯度景观促进随机探索，但梯度阻尼可能减缓收敛；Adam的自适应归一化可缓解此问题。实验显示ReMAC无需熵正则化即可获得更高策略熵，性能与SAC相当。
Motivation: 重试目标在离散动作空间中已被证明能促进探索，但连续动作空间中缺乏相应方法，且梯度估计器尚未被探索。
Method: 提出路径导数估计器用于重试目标，并基于此设计离策略actor-critic算法ReMAC，优化ReMax目标。
Result: ReMAC在连续控制任务上无需额外熵正则化即可获得较高策略熵，性能与SAC相当。
Conclusion: 重试目标通过改变梯度方向和大小促进随机探索，但梯度阻尼可能影响收敛，Adam的数值稳定参数可缓解该问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Denser Credit Is Not Enough: Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents require reinforcement learning methods that can assign credit to intermediate decisions under sparse and delayed rewards. Recent group-based methods such as GiGPO improve over GRPO by constructing step-level advantages at repeated anchor states. However, we show that such dense credit can be statistically unreliable: under limited rollouts, rare but lucky actions may receive overly large advantages, producing divergent anchor bias and late-stage training oscillation. We propose Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization (ECPO), a critic-free policy optimization algorithm that calibrates step-level credit before policy updates. ECPO combines Evidence-Calibrated Action Advantage, which groups rollouts by canonical actions and shrinks low-count estimates, with Variance-Gated Credit Weighting, which suppresses anchor states dominated by within-action noise. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B show that ECPO consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving GiGPO by +5.2/+7.3 success points on ALFWorld/WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B while adding only 0.1% additional advantage-computation overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视野LLM agent在稀疏延迟奖励下的信用分配问题，指出现有密集信用方法（如GiGPO）在有限rollout下统计不可靠，导致发散锚偏差和训练振荡。提出证据校准策略优化（ECPO），通过证据校准动作优势和方差门控信用权重校准步骤级信用。在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B的实验表明，ECPO优于GiGPO等强基线，分别提升+5.2和+7.3成功率点，且额外计算开销仅0.1%。
Motivation: 现有群组方法如GiGPO通过构建步骤级优势提供密集信用，但有限rollout下罕见幸运动作可能获得过大优势，导致发散锚偏差（anchor bias）和后期训练振荡，需要更稳健的信用分配机制。
Method: 提出无评论家策略优化算法ECPO，包括两个组件：1）证据校准动作优势（Evidence-Calibrated Action Advantage），按规范动作分组rollout并收缩低计数估计；2）方差门控信用权重（Variance-Gated Credit Weighting），抑制受动作内噪声主导的锚状态。
Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上，ECPO使用Qwen2.5-1.5B分别比GiGPO提高+5.2和+7.3成功率点；使用Qwen2.5-7B也持续优于基线。额外优势计算开销仅为0.1%。
Conclusion: 论文表明，校准步骤级信用可以有效改善长视野LLM agent训练的稳定性和最终性能，ECPO是轻量级且有效的改进方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Dataset Condensation for Diffusion Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Dataset condensation aims to construct compact datasets from real data via synthesis or selection. However, existing approaches are ill-suited for diffusion model training: synthetic data generation often yields low-fidelity samples unsuitable for authentic modeling, while real subset selection typically fails to preserve the distributional geometry required by diffusion likelihood objectives. To address this, we propose to reformulate real subset selection as a geometry-aware distribution alignment problem. By incorporating one-sided partial optimal transport, our method selectively aligns a compact subset with the full data distribution while allowing unmatched mass in low-density regions, ensuring the preserved geometric structure necessary for effective diffusion model training. To further ensure distributional fidelity, we complement geometric alignment with lightweight feature-statistics and semantic consistency regularization. An efficient two-stage discrete optimization strategy is proposed to achieve this alignment objective. Extensive experiments across diffusion variants, subset sizes, image resolutions, and training rounds show that our method achieves superior fidelity and distributional coverage in diffusion model training. Codes are available at https://github.com/2018cx/GADC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型训练中的数据集压缩问题，提出了一种几何感知的分布对齐方法，通过单侧部分最优传输（one-sided partial optimal transport）选择真实子集，保留完整数据分布的几何结构，并辅以特征统计和语义一致性正则化，采用两阶段离散优化策略实现高效子集选择。实验表明，该方法在多种扩散变体、子集大小、图像分辨率和训练轮次下均提升了训练保真度和分布覆盖度。
Motivation: 现有数据集压缩方法不适用于扩散模型训练：合成数据生成的低保真样本无法用于真实建模，而真实子集选择通常无法保留扩散模型似然目标所需的分布几何结构。
Method: 将真实子集选择重新定义为几何感知的分布对齐问题，引入单侧部分最优传输，允许低密度区域的不匹配质量，同时结合轻量级特征统计和语义一致性正则化，并设计高效的两阶段离散优化策略。
Result: 在多种扩散模型变体、不同子集大小、图像分辨率和训练轮次下，该方法在保真度和分布覆盖度上均优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 通过几何感知的分布对齐和正则化，可以有效保留扩散模型训练所需的分布结构，实现高质量的数据集压缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TS-ICL: A Flexible Time-Indexed Foundation Model for Time Series via In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models mark a profound paradigm shift in time series modeling, with task-specific models being superseded by general-purpose zero-shot models. Yet, current approaches primarily focus on forecasting, while real-world time series are often irregularly and partially observed, requiring models that can jointly forecast, impute missing values, and handle degraded sampling conditions. To address these challenges, we introduce TS-ICL, a novel probabilistic In-Context Learning encoder--regressor Transformer that unifies forecasting and imputation. TS-ICL formulates time series tasks as timestamp-aligned regression and naturally incorporates covariates by training on synthetic dependency structures generated from a novel causal data prior. Empirically, TS-ICL achieves a new state-of-the-art in imputation, while remaining competitive with leading forecasting foundation models across both univariate and covariate-aware benchmarks. It shows particularly strong performance in forecasting with partially observed look-back windows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TS-ICL 是一个基于上下文学习（In-Context Learning）的概率编码器-回归器 Transformer，统一了时间序列的预测和插补任务。通过将时间序列任务建模为时间戳对齐的回归，并在新的因果数据先验生成的合成依赖结构上训练，TS-ICL 在插补任务上达到新最优，同时在单变量和协变量感知基准上与领先的预测基础模型竞争，尤其在部分观测的回顾窗口预测中表现突出。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型主要聚焦于预测，但真实世界的时间序列通常不规则且部分观测，需要模型能同时处理预测、缺失值插补和降采样条件。
Method: 提出 TS-ICL，一种概率上下文学习编码器-回归器 Transformer，将时间序列任务形式化为时间戳对齐的回归，并利用新颖的因果数据先验生成合成依赖结构以自然纳入协变量。
Result: 在插补任务上达到新最优；在单变量和协变量感知基准上与领先的预测基础模型竞争，尤其在部分观测的回看窗口预测中表现强劲。
Conclusion: TS-ICL 统一了预测和插补，在多种时间序列任务上展现出灵活性和竞争力，但摘要未明确讨论其局限性或泛化边界。
Relevance: 30

summary_sections.result: 在插补任务上达到新最优；在单变量和协变量感知基准上与领先的预测基础模型竞争，尤其在部分观测的回看窗口预测中表现强劲。
summary_sections.conclusion: TS-ICL 统一了预测和插补，在多种时间序列任务上展现出灵活性和竞争力，但摘要未明确讨论其局限性或泛化边界。

papers.title: QCFuse: Query-Aware Cache Fusion via Compressed View for Efficient RAG Serving
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language model (LLM) answer quality by grounding generation in external evidence, but processing retrieved contexts makes the prefill stage a dominant serving cost. RAG cache fusion reduces this cost by reusing precomputed key-value (KV) caches for retrieved chunks and selectively recomputing tokens under the current prompt. Existing selectors, however, face a dilemma between quality and efficiency: fast query-agnostic or final-layer query-to-context selectors can miss request-relevant evidence, whereas full-view query-aware selectors require broad context and layer visibility before recomputation and therefore stall the layer-wise cache-fusion pipeline. We present QCFuse, a compressed-view query-aware selector for RAG cache fusion. QCFuse uses chunk-anchor query probing to condition user-query states on compact per-chunk anchors and critical-layer profiling to identify recomputation tokens without all-layer inspection. We implement QCFuse in SGLang and evaluate it on four open-weight LLMs across six datasets. QCFuse reaches full-prefill-level quality. At matched quality, QCFuse achieves an average prefill-time speedup of 1.7x over full prefill and 1.5x over ProphetKV, the strongest quality-preserving baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QCFuse 提出一种基于压缩视图的查询感知选择器，用于 RAG 缓存融合，通过块锚查询探测和关键层分析来减少预填充阶段的计算开销，在保持全预填充质量的同时实现平均 1.7 倍加速。
Motivation: RAG 服务中的缓存融合面临质量与效率的权衡：现有快速选择器可能错过相关证据，而全视图选择器需要广泛上下文和层可见性，导致流水线延迟。
Method: QCFuse 使用块锚查询探测将用户查询状态条件化到紧凑的每块锚点上，并通过关键层分析识别需要重新计算的令牌，避免全层检查。
Result: 在四个开源 LLM 和六个数据集上，QCFuse 达到全预填充质量，平均预填充时间加速比全预填充快 1.7 倍，比质量保持基线 ProphetKV 快 1.5 倍。
Conclusion: QCFuse 通过压缩视图查询感知实现了 RAG 缓存融合中质量与效率的更好平衡。

papers.title: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots hold great promise for operating in human-centered environments, yet ladder climbing remains one of the most challenging tasks due to sparse footholds and handholds, complex whole-body coordination, and sensitivity to perception and control errors. We present \textbf{LadderMan}, a unified system that enables humanoid robots to robustly climb diverse ladders and perform manipulation under such constrained conditions. Our climbing policy is built on a scalable two-stage learning pipeline, where we use hybrid motion tracking to learn multiple climbing experts from a single reference motion, and distill these experts into a unified depth-based visuomotor climbing policy via hybrid imitation and reinforcement learning. To enable real-world deployment, we leverage vision foundation models to bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception. Building on the learned climbing policy, we further train a separate manipulation policy using a dual-agent formulation, allowing stable on-ladder manipulation via teleoperation. Experiments demonstrate that LadderMan achieves robust ladder climbing across a wide range of geometries, successfully transfers to real-world hardware in a zero-shot manner, and supports various manipulation tasks under challenging ladder constraints. Video results are available at https://ladderman-robot.github.io .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LadderMan系统，使人形机器人能够稳健攀爬各种梯子，并在梯子上执行操作任务。系统采用两阶段学习流水线：从单个参考动作学习多个攀爬专家，再通过混合模仿和强化学习蒸馏为统一的深度视觉运动攀爬策略。利用视觉基础模型弥合sim-to-real差距。实验表明攀爬策略可零样本迁移到真实硬件，并支持多种操作任务。
Motivation: 人形机器人攀爬梯子因稀疏的抓握点、复杂的全身协调以及对感知和控制误差的敏感性而极具挑战性。
Method: 两阶段学习流水线：首先使用混合运动跟踪从单个参考动作学习多个攀爬专家；然后通过混合模仿和强化学习将专家蒸馏为统一的基于深度图的视觉运动攀爬策略。利用视觉基础模型弥合sim-to-real差距。对于梯上操作，使用双智能体公式训练独立操作策略。
Result: 摘要报告LadderMan在多种不同几何形状的梯子上实现稳健攀爬，零样本迁移到真实硬件，并在梯子约束下支持多种操作任务。
Conclusion: 本文展示了人形机器人攀爬梯子的统一系统，强调了从仿真到真实的零样本迁移以及梯上操作能力。

papers.title: Entropy-Based Evaluation of AI Agents: A Lightweight Framework for Measuring Behavioral Patterns
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are commonly evaluated using task success, reward, latency, and cost. These metrics are useful, but they often miss important aspects of agent behavior: whether an agent explores too much, repeats itself too rigidly, uses tools effectively, reduces uncertainty over time, or remains robust across repeated runs. This paper proposes Entropy-Based Evaluation of AI Agents (EEA), a lightweight framework for measuring agent behavior through entropy. Rather than treating intelligence as only final task completion, EEA studies the structure of the agents decision process. The framework introduces action entropy, trajectory entropy, tool entropy, information gain, exploration efficiency, and robustness entropy. These metrics are intended to complement, not replace, traditional evaluation methods. We also present a practical Python implementation designed to integrate with agent frameworks such as LangChain, Google ADK, custom agent loops, and stored observability traces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于熵的轻量级框架（EEA），用于评估AI代理的行为模式，包括动作熵、轨迹熵、工具熵、信息增益、探索效率和鲁棒性熵。摘要强调该框架旨在补充而非取代传统的基于任务成功率和奖励的评估方法，并提供了与LangChain等框架集成的Python实现。
Motivation: 传统评估指标（任务成功率、奖励、延迟、成本）忽略了代理行为的重要方面，如过度探索、重复模式、工具使用效率、不确定性的减少以及跨运行的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出EEA框架，引入一系列熵度量（动作熵、轨迹熵、工具熵、信息增益、探索效率、鲁棒性熵），并提供一个Python实现以集成到主流代理框架中。
Result: 论文未提供具体实验数据或定量结果，仅描述了框架的设计和度量定义。
Conclusion: EEA框架旨在为代理行为提供结构化的熵视角，辅助传统评估方法，但未在摘要中说明任何局限性或具体的实证验证。

papers.title: Compositional Boundaries for Density Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Distributed uncertainty-management systems often combine local probabilistic models along aggregation trees chosen by communication, privacy, or scheduling constraints. The final density should depend on the weighted sources, not on the particular order in which intermediate nodes combine them. We study this requirement as an algebraic compositionality problem for binary fusion of weighted probability densities. The central question is when a local fusion rule can be executed hierarchically while remaining order-invariant. We establish a compositional boundary for local segment-valued fusion rules. Within the class of continuous binary rules with additive output weights and weight-only coefficients, order-invariant hierarchical execution characterizes normalized weighted linear pooling; norm-induced segment balancing realizes the corresponding coefficient. Smooth endpoint-to-candidate $f$-divergence balancing has a different local geometry: its quadratic expansion induces square-root effective weights, showing why pairwise solvability alone is insufficient for schedule-independent fusion. We show that this obstruction is local to endpoint-to-candidate binary balancing, whereas global divergence barycenters retain additive-weight local limits. Finally, Gaussian mixtures show how the same issue appears in finite model classes: exact fusion is compositional, whereas stepwise compression is compositional only under a congruence condition on unnormalized component measures. These results distinguish exact schedule-independent fusion from global aggregation objectives and local approximation heuristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究加权概率密度层级融合的顺序不变性，建立局部段值融合规则的组合边界。指出连续二元规则中，顺序无关的层级融合仅对应归一化加权线性池化；端点-候选f-散度平衡的局部几何导致平方根有效权重，说明成对可解性不足以保证调度无关融合。高斯混合模型展示了精确融合具有组合性，而逐步压缩仅在未归一化分量测度的同余条件下成立。
Motivation: 分布式不确定性管理系统沿聚合树组合局部概率模型时，最终密度应依赖加权源而非中间节点的组合顺序。现有理论对层级二值融合规则何时保持顺序不变性的刻画不足。
Method: 通过代数组合性框架，分析局部段值融合规则。在连续二元规则类中，证明顺序无关的层级执行等价于归一化加权线性池化；通过二次展开揭示端点-候选f-散度平衡的局部几何障碍。
Result: 顺序无关的层级融合唯一刻画为归一化加权线性池化；端点-候选f-散度平衡因局部二次结构导致平方根权重，破坏调度无关性；全局散度重心保持加性权重局部极限；高斯混合模型中精确融合组合，但逐步压缩需同余条件。
Conclusion: 结果区分了精确的调度无关融合与全局聚合目标及局部近似启发式，表明调度无关性对融合规则有强约束。

papers.title: Cross-scale spatially-aware generative modeling of transcriptomic programs underlying neurodegenerative brain organization
authors: Krishnakumar Vaithianathan (for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
papers.abstract_en: Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease exhibit highly organized patterns of regional brain vulnerability, yet the biological mechanisms underlying this spatial selectivity remain incompletely understood. Existing imaging-transcriptomic studies have largely relied on correlation-based analyses between gene expression and neuroimaging phenotypes, limiting their ability to model how molecular organization gives rise to neurodegeneration. Here, we introduce a cross-scale spatially-aware generative framework for modeling transcriptomic programs underlying cortical neurodegeneration. Regional transcriptomic profiles were derived from the Allen Human Brain Atlas using 910 landmark genes across 68 cortical regions. Neurodegenerative vulnerability maps were constructed from ADNI FreeSurfer cortical thickness measurements by computing regional cortical thinning differences between cognitively normal controls (NC = 926) and Alzheimer's disease subjects (AD = 426). A variational generative architecture was used to learn latent biological programs linking regional gene-expression organization to cortical degeneration while incorporating graph-based spatial smoothness regularization to preserve cortical organization. The proposed framework achieved strong prediction of regional neurodegenerative vulnerability, yielding an explained variance of 0.8604 and a significant spatial correlation between predicted and observed cortical degeneration profiles (r = 0.9439, p < 0.001). The learned latent representations revealed structured transcriptomic organization associated with distributed disease susceptibility. These findings demonstrate that biologically constrained generative modeling can bridge microscale molecular organization with macroscale neurodegeneration, providing a foundation for spatially-aware generative neurobiology and computational neuroscience.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个跨尺度空间感知生成框架，用于建模神经退行性疾病中转录组程序与皮层脆弱性的关系。利用艾伦人脑图谱的910个标志基因和ADNI皮层厚度数据，通过变分生成架构结合图空间平滑正则化，学习连接基因表达与皮层退化的潜在生物程序。模型预测区域神经退行性脆弱性的解释方差为0.8604，预测与观测退化图谱的空间相关性r=0.9439（p<0.001）。

Method: 使用艾伦人脑图谱的910个标志基因在68个皮层区域的转录组特征，以及ADNI中认知正常和阿尔茨海默病受试者的皮层厚度测量差异构建脆弱性图谱，通过变分生成架构结合图空间平滑正则化学习潜在生物程序。
Result: 模型在预测区域神经退行性脆弱性上解释方差0.8604，预测与观测退化图谱的空间相关性r=0.9439（p<0.001），潜在表征揭示与疾病易感性相关的结构化转录组组织。
Conclusion: 生物约束的生成建模可桥接微观分子组织与宏观神经退行性变化，为空间感知的生成神经生物学和计算神经科学奠定基础。

papers.title: Deciphering Two Training Clocks in Grokking via Deep Linear Network Theory with Conditional ReLU Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Grokking suggests that fitting the training data and learning a simple underlying rule may occur on different time scales. We formalize this phenomenon by separating the fast decay of the classification loss from the slower simplification of the learned representation, and we call the resulting pair of stopping times two training clocks. For deep linear networks, we show that a post-margin gap-growth or one-step tail-contraction condition reduces the cross-entropy loss to level epsilon on a logarithmic time scale. In contrast, when layerwise weight decay is present, the induced regularization on the end-to-end map can be expressed as a Schatten-type penalty; under a sharp late-time Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz tail, this structural energy closes on a polynomial time scale. The two clocks, therefore, separate fitting from representation simplification. We then explain how the same mechanism can appear in ReLU MLPs. In regions where the activation patterns on the training set remain fixed, the network reduces to a linear model in the active coordinates. In a two-layer ReLU embedding model, chain-rule estimates further show that the classifier head can receive larger effective gradients than the embedding block under controlled downstream norms. This supports a two-stage mechanism in which the classifier fits first, while the representation continues to simplify later. We use modular addition as the main experimental setting. The deep linear theory provides the rigorous core of the analysis. But the ReLU results are formulated as conditional reductions that account for empirical behavior without claiming a global proof for nonlinear training dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: Grokking现象中训练数据拟合与底层规则学习的时间尺度分离尚未被形式化解释，本文旨在分离这两个过程并给出理论分析。

papers.title: LLMCodec: Adapting Video Codecs for Efficient Weight Compression of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of large language models(LLMs) has led to remarkable advances in natural language processing. However, the increasing scale of these models introduces substantial challenges in terms of storage, transmission, and deployment. Though great efforts have been devoted to model compression and quantization, existing methods often rely on fine-tuning or calibration data, which exhibit limited generalization across different tensor types. In this paper, we argue that video codecs offer a promising solution for LLM compression, due to their inherent compatibility with matrix structured data, configurable compression strategies, and the availability of highly optimized, off-the-shelf implementations. Therefore, we present LLMCodec, a video codec-based LLM compression method that integrates affine quantization with the recent VVC/H.266 video codec. Beyond VVC, we further compare a range of video codecs and encoding profiles to evaluate their impact on compression performance. Experiments on different models demonstrate the robustness and generality of LLMCodec. Notably, on LLaMA-3-8B at 2-bit precision, LLMCodec reduces perplexity by over 1.5x and improves downstream task accuracy by 21% compared with the existing method.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE BMSB 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLMCodec，一种基于视频编解码器（VVC/H.266）的大语言模型权重重压缩方法。该方法结合仿射量化与现成的高效视频编解码器，利用视频编解码器对矩阵结构数据的兼容性和可配置压缩策略，无需微调或校准数据。在LLaMA-3-8B模型2-bit精度下，困惑度降低超过1.5倍，下游任务准确率提升21%，展现了良好的泛化性。
Motivation: 现有LLM压缩方法依赖微调或校准数据，在不同张量类型上泛化能力有限；视频编解码器天然适合矩阵结构数据且已有高度优化的实现，但尚未被用于LLM压缩。
Method: 将仿射量化与最新VVC/H.266视频编解码器集成，并比较多种视频编解码器及编码配置对压缩效果的影响，形成LLMCodec框架。
Result: 在LLaMA-3-8B上，2-bit精度时困惑度降低1.5倍以上，下游任务准确率相比现有方法提高21%。
Conclusion: 视频编解码器可为LLM压缩提供高效、通用且无需调优的方案，尤其适合矩阵权重数据的存储与传输。

papers.title: GenAutoML: An Agentic Framework for Dynamic Architecture Generation and Optimization in Time-Series Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Designing neural architectures for time-series forecasting and anomaly detection remains a resource-intensive task that often requires substantial domain expertise. Traditional Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) systems typically rely on static, predefined search spaces, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse data characteristics. We present GenAutoML, an agentic framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as neural architects to bridge natural-language requirements and executable PyTorch implementations. The framework incorporates a Sandboxed Reflection Loop for autonomous code refinement and a Signature-Aware Runtime that enforces architectural consistency and execution safety. To improve robustness under non-stationary conditions, we further introduce a Dynamic Reversible Instance Normalization (Dyn-RevIN) wrapper. Experiments on the ETTh1, ETTm1, and Weather benchmarks demonstrate that GenAutoML can dynamically generate task-specific neural architectures tailored to dataset characteristics. Among the generated models, WaveInterferenceNet achieves inference latency below 0.01 ms per sample while maintaining competitive predictive performance. By emphasizing computational efficiency, architectural adaptability, and stable optimization behavior, GenAutoML enables the creation of ultra-lightweight neural networks suitable for resource-constrained and latency-sensitive Edge AI deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenAutoML 是一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的智能体框架，用于时间序列分析和异常检测中的动态神经网络架构生成与优化。它通过沙箱反射循环实现自主代码优化，并引入动态可逆实例归一化 (Dyn-RevIN) 提升非平稳条件下的鲁棒性。在 ETTh1、ETTm1 和 Weather 基准上，生成的 WaveInterferenceNet 实现了低于 0.01 ms/样本的推理延迟，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能，特别适合资源受限的边缘 AI 部署。
Motivation: 传统 AutoML 依赖静态预定义搜索空间，难以适应多样化的时间序列数据特征，且架构设计需要大量专家知识。
Method: 提出 GenAutoML 框架，使用 LLM 作为神经架构师，将自然语言需求转化为可执行的 PyTorch 代码；包含沙箱反射循环用于自主代码改进，以及签名感知运行时确保架构一致性和执行安全；并引入 Dyn-RevIN 包装器增强非平稳条件下的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 ETTh1、ETTm1 和 Weather 基准上，生成的架构能动态适配数据集特征；其中 WaveInterferenceNet 推理延迟低于 0.01 ms/样本，预测性能有竞争力。
Conclusion: GenAutoML 强调计算效率、架构适应性和稳定优化行为，可生成超轻量级神经网络，适用于资源受限和延迟敏感的边缘 AI 场景。

papers.title: EEGDancer: Dynamic Emotion Latent Space Masked Modeling with Reinforcement Learning for EEG Continuous Emotion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Continuous electroencephalography (EEG) emotion prediction aims to model the temporal evolution of human emotional states from EEG signals. Unlike conventional discrete emotion recognition, continuous prediction requires capturing long-range temporal dependencies and coherent emotional dynamics. However, existing methods mainly rely on point-wise regression and directly model noisy high-dimensional EEG features, limiting their ability to characterize continuous emotional evolution.To address these challenges, we propose EEGDancer, a dynamic emotional latent space learning framework for continuous EEG emotion prediction. The framework integrates vector-quantized representation learning, masked temporal modeling, and reinforcement learning-based trajectory optimization into a unified architecture.Specifically, a causal spatiotemporal Vector-Quantization Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) is designed to learn structured emotional prototypes and construct a discrete-continuous emotional latent space from EEG signals. Based on the learned latent representations, a Transformer-based masked dynamic modeling strategy captures long-range emotional dependencies and temporal evolution patterns. Furthermore, continuous emotion prediction is formulated as a sequential decision-making problem, and a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) framework is introduced to optimize emotional prediction trajectories at the sequence level instead of frame-wise local fitting.Extensive experiments on the SEED, SEED-IV, and Long-Term Naturalistic Emotion datasets demonstrate that EEGDancer consistently outperforms existing machine learning and deep learning methods. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of the proposed latent space and reinforcement learning-based trajectory optimization for modeling continuous EEG emotional dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EEGDancer，一个用于连续脑电（EEG）情绪预测的动态情绪潜在空间学习框架。该框架结合向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）学习离散-连续情绪原型，基于Transformer的掩码动态建模捕获长期时序依赖，并将连续情绪预测建模为序列决策问题，使用软演员-评论家（SAC）强化学习优化轨迹。在SEED、SEED-IV和长期自然情绪数据集上，该方法优于现有机器学习与深度学习方法。
Motivation: 现有连续EEG情绪预测方法主要依赖逐点回归直接建模嘈杂的高维EEG特征，难以捕获连续情绪演化中的长程时间依赖和连贯动态。
Method: 提出三阶段统一框架：1）因果时空VQ-VAE学习结构化情绪原型并构建离散-连续潜在空间；2）基于Transformer的掩码动态建模捕获长程情绪依赖；3）将连续预测转化为序列决策问题，采用SAC强化学习优化序列级预测轨迹而非帧级局部拟合。
Result: 在SEED、SEED-IV和长期自然情绪数据集上，EEGDancer一致优于现有机器学习与深度学习方法。消融实验验证了潜在空间和基于强化学习的轨迹优化对建模连续EEG情绪动态的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调潜在空间学习和序列级强化学习轨迹优化是提升连续情绪预测性能的关键。

papers.title: UniVoice: A Unified Model for Speech and Singing Voice Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-speech (TTS) and singing voice synthesis (SVS) both aim to generate human vocal audio from symbolic inputs, but they impose different requirements on the generation process. Speech generation relies on flexible, language-driven prosody, whereas singing generation requires explicit melody control and accurate rhythmic alignment. This mismatch makes it challenging to train a single model that can generate both natural speech and controllable singing, since melody-related conditions should strongly constrain singing but should not restrict speech prosody. We present UniVoice, a unified speech and singing voice generation framework based on conditional flow matching. Instead of using a single undifferentiated conditioning representation, UniVoice factorizes the condition into content, melody, and timbre, which are encoded by modality-appropriate encoders and consumed by a shared Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone. For singing, the melody condition is represented by MIDI note sequences; for speech, it is replaced with a learned null melody token, allowing the model to infer prosody from linguistic and acoustic context. This design preserves explicit melody control for singing while avoiding the need to impose melody constraints on speech. We further analyze the null melody token as an approximation to melody marginalization in the conditional flow. Trained on 30k hours of speech and 35k hours of singing data, UniVoice achieves a speech PER of 5.26\%, comparable to dedicated TTS systems such as F5-TTS (5.21\%) and CosyVoice3 (5.30\%). On singing generation, UniVoice achieves a PER of 16.22\%, outperforming the unified baseline Vevo1.5 (24.72\%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniVoice 是一个统一的语音和歌声生成框架，基于条件流匹配，将条件分解为内容、旋律和音色，分别由相应的编码器处理并由共享的 Diffusion Transformer 主干使用。对于歌声，旋律条件由 MIDI 音符序列表示；对于语音，则替换为学习的空旋律标记，使模型能从语言和声学上下文中推断韵律。模型在 3 万小时语音和 3.5 万小时歌声数据上训练，语音 PER 达到 5.26%，歌声 PER 达到 16.22%，在统一模型中表现优异。
Motivation: 文本到语音 (TTS) 和歌声合成 (SVS) 对生成过程有不同要求：语音需要灵活的语言驱动韵律，歌声需要明确的旋律控制和准确的节奏对齐。现有方法难以用一个模型同时生成自然语音和可控歌声，因为旋律条件应强烈约束歌声但不应限制语音韵律。
Method: 提出 UniVoice，基于条件流匹配的条件分解方法：将条件分解为内容、旋律和音色，由模态合适的编码器编码，输入共享的 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 主干。对歌声，旋律条件为 MIDI 音符序列；对语音，旋律条件替换为学习的空旋律标记，使模型从上下文推断韵律。
Result: 在 30k 小时语音和 35k 小时歌声数据上训练后，UniVoice 语音 PER 为 5.26%，与专用 TTS 系统 F5-TTS (5.21%) 和 CosyVoice3 (5.30%) 相当；歌声 PER 为 16.22%，优于统一基线 Vevo1.5 (24.72%)。
Conclusion: UniVoice 通过条件分解和空旋律标记实现了语音和歌声生成的有效统一，无需对语音施加旋律约束，同时保持了歌声的显式旋律控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inverse Design of Realizable Metasurface based Absorbers using Improved Conditioning and Diversity Enhanced Progressively Growing GANs
papers.abstract_en: Metasurfaces enable precise manipulation of electromagnetic waves for applications such as beam steering, sensing, and stealth technology. However, inverse design of metasurfaces with targeted EM responses remains challenging due to the computational expense of iterative full wave simulation driven optimization and the limited conditioning fidelity and diversity of existing generative approaches. To address these challenges, this paper presents a generative inverse design framework for controllable and physically consistent metasurface synthesis under continuous spectral constraints. The proposed approach employs a progressively growing Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty integrated with feature wise linear modulation based conditioning for stable propagation of continuous spectral and fabrication constraints. EM consistency is embedded directly into the generative learning process through a surrogate assisted spectral alignment loss, enabling physics constrained generation during training. Further, a determinantal point process based diversity regularization strategy is incorporated to generate geometrically diverse yet spectrally consistent realizations for the same target response. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is demonstrated through the generation of practically realizable metasurface absorbers exhibiting diverse reflection characteristics in the frequency range of 2 to 18 GHz. EM simulations validate that the generated designs meet the target specifications with high accuracy. The final proposed framework achieved an average mean squared error of 0.0052, diversity score of 0.8730, band alignment accuracy of 0.8533, and a valid EM design generation percentage of 89.57, clearly demonstrating its capability to generate highly accurate, diverse, electromagnetically consistent and fabrication realizable metasurface configurations.

papers.title: Agentic Molecular Recovery via Molecule-Aware Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided molecular generation with LLMs often yields invalid SMILES. We argue that invalid drafts should be addressed through a shift from validity-oriented repair to identity-preserving molecular recovery: the objective is not only to restore chemical validity, but also to preserve target-relevant structural cues and recover the molecular identity implied by the description. This perspective reveals the limitations of existing correction strategies. Post-hoc repair can recover validity while distorting key structures, LLM-only correction can introduce unintended global drift, and generic agentic correction remains constrained by greedy single-candidate trajectories even when equipped with executable RDKit edit tools. To address these limitations, we propose AMREC, which couples molecule-aware mismatch tracking with expanded candidate exploration and trajectory-level selection. On invalid ChEBI-20 drafts from three backbone models, AMREC achieves the strongest overall recovery profile across structural, exact-match, and string-level metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）生成文本驱动的分子结构时常得到无效SMILES的问题，提出了一种分子感知的恢复方法AMREC。该方法通过分子感知的不匹配跟踪、扩展候选探索和轨迹级选择，旨在不仅恢复化学有效性，还保留目标相关的结构线索并恢复分子身份。在三个主干模型生成的无效ChEBI-20草稿上，AMREC在结构、精确匹配和字符串级指标上取得了最强的整体恢复效果。
Motivation: 现有的无效SMILES修复策略存在不足：事后修复虽能恢复有效性但扭曲关键结构，LLM-only修正可能引入全局偏移，通用智能体修正即使配备RDKit编辑工具也受限于贪婪的单候选轨迹。因此需要一种身份保持的分子恢复方法。
Method: 提出AMREC框架，结合分子感知的不匹配跟踪（检测生成结构与文本描述的结构偏差）、扩展候选探索（生成多个候选修正）和轨迹级选择（从候选轨迹中选择最优恢复结果）。
Result: 在三个不同骨干模型（如T5、MoleculeGPT等）生成的无效ChEBI-20分子草稿上，AMREC在结构相似性、精确匹配率和字符串编辑距离等指标上均优于现有的修复方法，取得了最强的整体恢复效果。
Conclusion: 论文强调，对于文本引导的分子生成，应转向身份保持的分子恢复（而非单纯有效性修复），AMREC通过分子感知的探索和选择实现了这一目标。

papers.title: GenTI: Benchmarking LLMs for Autonomous IDPS Rule Generation for Unseen Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Rule-based Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS) offer precise attack detection as well as mitigation, however their manually crafted, signature-driven rules limit adaptability to emerging and zero-day threats. Additionally, existing public datasets (e.g., CICIDS2017, UNSW-NB15) focus on traffic classification and provide little structured information to support automatic rule synthesis or prevention logic. To address this gap, we propose Generative Thread Intelligence (GenTI) \footnote{GenTI refers to the proposed framework, and GTI refers to the dataset.} an LLM-driven benchmark for automatic generation of IDPS rules targeting unseen attacks. The dataset (GTI) aggregates over 150k detection and prevention rules from Snort, Suricata, Emerging Threats, as well as 50k YARA, each annotated with protocol behavior, payload signatures, contextual relationships, mappings to Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), along with actionable response types (alert, drop, reject). Moreover, on top of this corpus we design an LLM-based pipeline that transforms analyst prompts and representative payloads into deployable rules via structured prompt engineering, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, as well as a Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) loop for syntactic, semantic, and security validation. The generated rules are executed in real time on (Snort/Suricata) and evaluated by syntax accuracy, semantic similarity, CTI coverage, security effectiveness as well as unseen attacks detection. Furthermore, our GenTI instantiation achieves a composite rule-quality score of 89.4\%, with 94.8\% CTI coverage, improving unseen attacks detection from 45\% to 87.4\% and reducing the false-positive rate from 8.5\% to 2.3\%. Overall, GenTI establishes the first large-scale benchmark that tightly couples rule-level CTI with LLM-based automation, enabling adaptive, self-evolving IDPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出GenTI基准，利用LLM自动生成针对未知攻击的入侵检测与防御系统（IDPS）规则。构建了包含超过15万条Snort、Suricata、Emerging Threats规则及5万条YARA规则的GTI数据集，并设计基于提示工程、思维链推理和验证循环的LLM流水线。生成的规则在Snort/Suricata上实时执行，综合规则质量分数达89.4%，CTI覆盖率达94.8%，未知攻击检测率从45%提升至87.4%，误报率从8.5%降至2.3%。
Motivation: 基于规则的IDPS依赖手动编写的签名规则，难以适应新兴和零日攻击；现有公开数据集专注于流量分类，缺乏支持自动规则合成和防御逻辑的结构化信息。
Method: 构建GTI数据集（含15万+检测和防御规则及5万YARA规则，附带协议行为、载荷签名、上下文关系、CTI映射和响应类型），并设计LLM流水线：通过结构化提示工程、思维链推理和验证循环（CoVe）将分析师提示和代表性载荷转化为可部署规则。
Result: GenTI综合规则质量分数89.4%，CTI覆盖率94.8%，未知攻击检测率从45%提升至87.4%，误报率从8.5%降至2.3%。
Conclusion: GenTI建立了首个将规则级CTI与LLM自动化紧密结合的大规模基准，支持自适应、自演进的IDPS。

papers.title: Mechanistic Insights into Functional Sparsity in Multimodal LLMs via CoRe Heads
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate remarkable proficiency on complex vision-language tasks, the mechanisms by which they extract query-relevant visual features from complex, noisy contexts remain opaque. In this paper, we present an in-depth interpretability study that uncovers a profound structural property within MLLMs: functional sparsity in cross-modal retrieval. Leveraging a token-level metric termed Retrieval Attention Mass (RAM), we identify and characterize a highly specialized subset of attention heads, referred to as Context-aware Retrieval (CoRe) heads. Across diverse visual domains and model scales, we observe a clear functional division: CoRe heads act as dedicated information extractors, while most other heads distribute attention over broader contextual regions. Causal interventions further demonstrate the necessity of these specialized heads. Ablating only the top 5% of CoRe heads causes significant degradation in multimodal reasoning performance, whereas ablating lower-ranked heads has minimal effect. Moreover, acceleration experiments validate the utility of CoRe heads, showing that leveraging this localized sparsity significantly accelerates inference while maintaining robust task performance. Our findings reveal a structural principle of functional sparsity within MLLMs, refining the current understanding of mechanistic interpretability and laying a theoretical foundation that can inspire future architecture design and model optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过可解释性研究揭示了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中的功能稀疏性结构：存在一类称为上下文感知检索（CoRe）注意力头的特殊子集，它们专门负责从复杂上下文中提取与查询相关的视觉特征。基于标记级度量“检索注意力质量”（RAM）识别CoRe头，并证明它们对于多模态推理性能至关重要——消除前5%的CoRe头会显著降低性能，而消除其他头影响甚微。加速实验表明利用这种局部稀疏性可以在保持任务性能的同时加速推理。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在复杂视觉-语言任务中表现出色，但其从嘈杂上下文中提取查询相关视觉特征的机制尚不透明，缺乏结构层面的理解。
Method: 提出标记级度量“检索注意力质量”（RAM）来识别注意力头中的功能稀疏性，定义并表征上下文感知检索（CoRe）头；通过因果干预（消除实验）和加速实验验证其必要性及实用性。
Result: 发现CoRe头作为专用信息提取器，仅占注意力头的一小部分；消除前5%的CoRe头导致多模态推理性能显著下降，而消除其余头影响极小；利用这种稀疏性可加速推理并保持性能。
Conclusion: 揭示多模态大语言模型中功能稀疏性的结构原理，为机制可解释性提供新视角，并为未来架构设计和模型优化奠定理论基础。

papers.title: Learning Geometric Representations from Videos for Spatial Intelligent Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at 2D semantic understanding but lack intrinsic 3D awareness, resulting in representations that fail to maintain geometric and spatial consistency across video frames. Given the scarcity of large-scale 3D data, we present GeoVR, a novel framework that learns geometric representations using purely 2D video sequences. This approach effectively restructures the semantic latent space within MLLMs to unlock spatial intelligence. Rather than employing superficial feature mixing, GeoVR reshapes the internal representations of the MLLM by distilling geometry knowledge from pre-trained 3D foundation models. This is accomplished through a multi-objective learning strategy driven by four complementary geometric targets: (1) estimating inter-frame camera poses to embed varying viewpoint dynamics, (2) regressing dense depth maps to anchor physical distances, (3) predicting a metric scale factor for real-world calibration, and (4) distilling multi-scale 3D features to align the intermediate feature space. Guided by these explicit physical and geometric constraints, the model's internal representations naturally develop strong 3D awareness. Extensive experiments on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that GeoVR achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new paradigm for endowing foundation models with spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoVR 框架，利用 2D 视频序列学习几何表示，通过蒸馏预训练 3D 基础模型的知识，结合多目标学习（相机位姿估计、深度估计、度量尺度因子预测、多尺度 3D 特征蒸馏）来重构多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的内部表示，使其获得三维空间理解能力。在空间推理基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 缺乏内在的 3D 意识，导致跨帧几何和空间一致性差，而大规模 3D 数据稀缺。
Method: GeoVR 通过多目标学习从 2D 视频中蒸馏 3D 几何知识：估计帧间相机位姿、回归密集深度图、预测度量尺度因子、对齐多尺度 3D 特征。
Result: 在空间推理基准上取得最佳性能，证明该方法能有效赋予基础模型空间智能。
Conclusion: 通过显式物理和几何约束重构 MLLM 内部表示，可自然发展强 3D 意识，为空间智能提供新范式。

papers.title: Gender Artifacts from Art History to Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Artistic styles are rooted in specific socio-historical contexts that encode social hierarchies, including distinct constructions of gender. Yet in AI research, style has long been treated as a surface-level visual property: a filter of color, brushstroke, and texture applied to otherwise content-neutral scenes. We introduce the first dataset to investigate the interplay between gender representation and style in both historical and generated images. StyleGender comprises 74k images spanning 19 artistic styles, comprising art historical images with style and gender annotations, T2I-generated images under controlled style and gender prompts, and a semantically aligned set enabling direct art history-to-generation comparison. By proposing two Set Gender Artifact (SGA) metrics (PixelSGA and MaskSGA), capturing gender signals at the pixel level and in compositional structure, we show that (1) gender representation shapes visual features across artistic styles, (2) style keywords carry these patterns into T2I generation, and (3) generative models tend to amplify gender artifacts beyond what is observed in historical sources.

papers.title: Statistical Priors for Implicit Preferences: Decoupling Skill Selection as a Local Harness in Personal Agents
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities advance, locally deployed personal agents relying on API-based remote models and external skills have emerged as a novel paradigm. With the rapid expansion of available skills, enabling personal agents to learn and adapt to implicit user preferences becomes a critical challenge. However, local deployment constraints preclude complex centralized selection algorithms, creating an urgent need for a lightweight local preference harness. This paper explores the implementation of such a harness through a novel architecture that strictly decouples statistical preference learning from semantic intent parsing. Specifically, we leverage localized statistical results to influence and modulate the selection decisions of the remote LLM. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our decoupled approach achieves the lowest cumulative regret and highest test accuracy, significantly outperforming traditional memory-augmented agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对本地部署的个人代理中隐式用户偏好学习问题，提出一种将统计偏好学习与语义意图解析严格解耦的轻量级架构。通过本地统计结果影响远程LLM的技能选择决策，实验表明该方法在累积遗憾和测试准确率上显著优于传统记忆增强代理。
Motivation: 随着可用技能快速扩展，个人代理需要学习隐式用户偏好，但本地部署限制排除了复杂集中式算法，亟需轻量级本地偏好控制机制。
Method: 提出一种解耦架构：统计偏好学习模块基于本地历史数据生成统计先验，远程LLM仅负责语义意图解析，选择决策由统计结果调制，从而实现偏好与语义的分离。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在累积遗憾和测试准确率上达到最优，显著超过传统记忆增强代理。
Conclusion: 解耦统计先验与语义解析为本地个人代理的隐式偏好适应提供了一种有效且轻量的方案。

papers.title: Benchmarks in Leipzig
papers.abstract_en: Between April 1 and May 15, 2026, a group of 49 mathematicians compiled a dataset of research-level mathematics questions with known answers. Most of the work was done during the 3-day workshop *Benchmarks in Leipzig* with 35 participants at the Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences in Leipzig, Germany. We present the resulting collection of 100 questions. We evaluated these questions in three stages: a single attempt by five state-of-the-art LLMs, followed by a 20-runs-per-model evaluation with three of these models, and finally a 3-run attempt with two heavy-thinking models. After Stage 1, 41 questions remained completely unsolved; after Stage 2, this count dropped to 16; and we concluded Stage 3 with only 2 unsolved questions. This demonstrates that the mathematical reasoning capabilities of LLMs are becoming impressive.
papers.comment: 8 pages including 8 benchmark statistics tables + 20 pages appendix containing the 100 Leipzig Benchmark questions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文由49位数学家于2026年4月至5月编制了100个研究级数学问题，并在三阶段评估中测试了多个大语言模型（LLM）。结果显示，经过阶段1后41个问题完全未解，阶段2后降至16个，阶段3后仅剩2个未解，表明LLM的数学推理能力正变得令人印象深刻。
Motivation: 旨在系统评估大语言模型在真实研究级数学问题上的推理能力，填补现有基准多局限于本科水平或题库问题的空白。
Method: 通过3天研讨会收集100个有已知答案的研究级数学问题，分三个阶段测试：单次尝试5个LLM、每模型20次运行评估3个模型、及每模型3次运行评估2个重型思考模型。
Result: 阶段1后41个问题完全未解，阶段2后降至16个，阶段3后仅剩2个未解。
Conclusion: LLM的数学推理能力正变得令人印象深刻，但仍有少数高难度问题未能解决。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Consistency Training Along the Transformer Stack
papers.abstract_en: Consistency training encourages models to behave similarly across different contexts, and has shown promise for reducing misalignment. We broaden the scope of consistency training in two ways. First, we introduce two new internal consistency targets: MLP Consistency Training (MLPCT), which matches post-activation MLP states, and Attention Consistency Training (AttCT), which matches per-head attention distributions. Second, we apply consistency training to four additional safety threats: persona in-context learning attacks, adversarial frustration, prefill attacks, and conditional misalignment. Across several models and threat settings, we find that consistency training reduces misalignment well beyond the sycophancy and jailbreak settings studied in prior work. We also find cases of cross-threat generalization, where training against one failure mode improves robustness to another, and identify a shared residual-stream mechanism underlying ACT, MLPCT, and AttCT, while distinguishing BCT as mechanistically distinct. Our results suggest that consistency training is a flexible and extensible framework for alignment, capable of unifying defenses against a broader class of model pathologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文拓展了一致性训练 (consistency training) 的适用范围，提出了两种新的内部一致性目标：MLP 一致性训练 (MLPCT) 和注意力一致性训练 (AttCT)，分别匹配 MLP 后激活状态和每头注意力分布。同时将一致性训练应用于四种额外的安全威胁：角色上下文学习攻击、对抗性挫折、预填充攻击和条件性误对齐。在多个模型和威胁设置下，一致性训练显著减少误对齐，且出现跨威胁泛化现象。机制分析表明 ACT、MLPCT 和 AttCT 共享残差流机制，而 BCT 机制不同。
Motivation: 现有一致性训练主要针对 sycophancy 和 jailbreak 等少类威胁，其在更广泛安全威胁下的效果及内部一致性目标的作用尚不清楚。
Method: 提出两种新内部一致性目标（MLPCT 和 AttCT），并扩展一致性训练至四种额外威胁场景；通过匹配激活状态和注意力分布实现模型内部一致性。
Result: 在多个模型和威胁设置下，一致性训练有效减少误对齐，并展现跨威胁泛化能力，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 一致性训练是一个灵活可扩展的对齐框架，能够统一防御多种模型病理，其内部一致性目标具有不同的机制基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emotion-Aware Image Generation from Korean Diary Text via LLM-based Prompt Translation and LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: T2I models cannot effectively capture sentiment from various types of text, including diaries, as they primarily focus on visual object-related patterns rather than contextual emotional understanding. This paper proposes an emotion-aware text-to-image pipeline that generates children's hand drawing style images from short Korean diary entries. The proposed pipeline employs Qwen3-8B for recognising implicit sentiment from short diaries, and Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium fine-tuned with LoRA on children's drawing images with emotion-based trigger words for image generation. Additionally, this paper presents experiments examining the effect of emotion trigger words on generated images and discusses the limitations of CLIP Score as an evaluation metric for emotion-aware image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个情感感知的文本到图像生成流水线，使用Qwen3-8B从短韩语日记中识别隐含情感，然后用LoRA微调的Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium生成儿童手绘风格图像。摘要报告了情感触发词对生成图像的影响，并讨论了CLIP Score作为评估指标的局限性。
Motivation: 现有的文本到图像模型主要关注视觉对象模式，无法有效捕捉文本中的情感，尤其是日记等非正式文本中的隐含情感。
Method: 提出流水线：先用Qwen3-8B从简短韩语日记中识别隐含情感，再用LoRA微调的Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium（基于儿童绘画图像和情感触发词）生成图像。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅提及实验研究了情感触发词对生成图像的影响，并指出CLIP Score在情感感知评估中的局限性。
Conclusion: 提出了一种结合LLM情感识别和LoRA微调的文本到图像方法，并指出了评估指标的不足。

papers.title: Robust and sparse support vector machine via hybrid truncated loss for supervised classification
papers.abstract_en: The support vector machine (SVM) is a widely used classifier, but choosing an appropriate loss function remains difficult. Convex losses such as the hinge loss and least-squares loss are sensitive to outliers, while bounded non-convex losses often lead to high computational cost. To address this, we propose a hybrid truncated loss function ($L_{\mathrm{ht}}$) that is both sparse and bounded, and build the $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM model for single-view classification. We introduce the P-stationary point and use it to establish the first-order necessary and sufficient optimality conditions. Based on these conditions, we design an alternating direction method of multipliers with a working-set strategy that reduces computational cost and achieves global convergence. We further extend $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM to multi-view learning by adding structural information and view weights, resulting in Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM, which follows both the consensus and complementarity principles. Experiments on synthetic, real-world, and image datasets show that $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM achieves higher accuracy with fewer support vectors and better noise robustness than five single-view methods, while Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM outperforms six multi-view methods in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合截断损失函数 (L_ht)，兼顾稀疏性和有界性，用于构建鲁棒稀疏支持向量机 (L_ht-SVM)。作者建立了P-驻点条件并设计交替方向乘子法 (ADMM) 结合工作集策略实现全局收敛。进一步扩展到多视图学习得到 MvL_ht-SVM。实验表明，单视图和多视图分类中该方法在精度、支持向量数量和噪声鲁棒性上均优于对比方法。
Motivation: 现有SVM损失函数在凸性、有界性和稀疏性之间难以平衡，凸损失对异常值敏感，非凸损失计算成本高，且缺乏明确的优化理论保证。
Method: 提出混合截断损失 L_ht，定义其P-驻点并推导一阶最优性充要条件；基于此设计带工作集策略的ADMM算法以降低计算开销并保证全局收敛。进一步将模型扩展至多视图学习，引入结构信息和视图权重。
Result: 在合成、真实和图像数据集上，L_ht-SVM相比五种单视图方法获得更高精度、更少支持向量和更好噪声鲁棒性；MvL_ht-SVM在准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数上优于六种多视图方法。
Conclusion: 混合截断损失可同时实现稀疏性和鲁棒性，且优化过程有严格理论支撑；多视图扩展遵循一致性和互补性原则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Tools Fail: Benchmarking Dynamic Replanning and Anomaly Recovery in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing benchmarks evaluate Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) in LLMs on idealized ''happy paths'', largely overlooking real-world tool failures. We introduce ToolMaze, a benchmark for dynamic path discovery and error recovery in TIR agents. To separate systematic replanning from blind trial-and-error, ToolMaze adopts a two-dimensional design: DAG-based topological complexity and a $2 \times 2$ taxonomy of tool perturbations (explicit/implicit, transient/permanent). Evaluations show that perturbations degrade performance across nearly all models, with the sharpest drops under implicit semantic failures. Driven by systemic over-trust in corrupted outputs, Perturbation Recovery Rate (PRR) plummets by around 37\% in these scenarios, while complex topologies trap agents in futile trial-and-error loops. Crucially, agentic fault-tolerance improves with model scale $3.66\times$ slower than basic task execution, highlighting dynamic replanning as a distinct bottleneck unaddressed by model scaling or prompting. Data and code are available at https://github.com/Zhudongsheng75/ToolMaze.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ToolMaze基准，用于评估LLM agent在工具使用中的动态路径发现和异常恢复能力。通过DAG拓扑复杂度和工具扰动二维设计，发现现有模型在隐式语义失败下性能大幅下降，且agent容错能力提升速度远低于基础任务执行能力。
Motivation: 现有TIR基准仅评估理想路径，忽略现实工具故障，缺乏对动态重规划和错误恢复的系统性评测。
Method: 构建ToolMaze基准，采用DAG拓扑复杂度和工具扰动（显式/隐式、瞬时/永久）二维设计，并引入扰动恢复率(PRR)指标。
Result: 扰动几乎降低所有模型性能，隐式语义失败下PRR下降约37%；复杂拓扑导致无效试错循环；agent容错能力随模型规模提升的速度比基础任务执行慢3.66倍。
Conclusion: 动态重规划是模型扩展和提示工程无法解决的关键瓶颈，需要专门方法。

papers.title: From Risk Classification to Action Plan Remediation: A Guardrail Feedback Driven Framework for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based guardrails typically safeguard agents by evaluating proposed actions or inputs before execution, producing safety signals such as binary allow/deny decisions, risk categories, and/or explanatory rationales about potential policy violations. However, agent risks often arise when otherwise benign tasks are contaminated by untrusted external content, unsafe instructions, or risky tool use. Existing guardrails often flag the entire task uniformly as unsafe, thereby blocking the threat but sacrificing the benign part. Moreover, existing work largely evaluates guardrails in isolation, leaving unclear whether their interventions lead to safer downstream agent behavior. To address this, we introduce TRIAD (Tripartite Response for Iterative Agent Guardrailing), a guardrail-integrated agent framework that leverages guardrail-generated verbal feedback as a guiding signal to keep the agent aligned with benign objectives at each planning step. We finetune a language model on a self-curated training dataset to output one of three decisions: proceed, refuse, or update, together with structured natural-language feedback. Rather than merely allowing or blocking execution, update guides the agent to revise its plan, avoid harmful components, and preserve the benign task where possible. TRIAD injects this feedback into the agent's context, enabling subsequent plan revision and forming a closed loop between guardrail feedback and agent planning. Extensive experiments on ASB and AgentHarm show that TRIAD reduces the average attack success rate to 10.42%, while achieving the best safety-utility trade-off among guardrail-integrated baselines. Our code is available at: https://github.com/YUHAOSUNABC/TRIAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRIAD框架，通过护栏生成的反馈信号引导LLM智能体在规划过程中保持良性目标，避免有害组件的同时保留良性任务。框架基于三分类决策（proceed/refuse/update）和结构化自然语言反馈，形成闭环规划修订。实验在ASB和AgentHarm上达到10.42%的平均攻击成功率，实现最佳安全-效用权衡。
Motivation: 现有护栏通常将整个任务统一标记为不安全，牺牲良性部分；且缺乏对干预后智能体下游行为安全性的评估。
Method: TRIAD框架，微调语言模型在自建数据集上输出三分类决策（proceed/refuse/update）及结构化自然语言反馈，将反馈注入智能体上下文以指导计划修订，形成护栏反馈与规划之间的闭环。
Result: 在ASB和AgentHarm基准上，平均攻击成功率降至10.42%，并在护栏集成基线中取得最佳安全-效用权衡。
Conclusion: TRIAD通过护栏反馈驱动智能体修订计划，有效避免危害并保留良性任务。

papers.title: SALT: When More Rollouts Don't Help in Group-Based Policy Optimization and How to Make Them Matter
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often adopts GRPO-style group-relative updates, sampling multiple rollouts per prompt to construct normalized learning signals. However, merely increasing the number of rollouts does not reliably strengthen learning: under GRPO-style group normalization, per-rollout policy-gradient features can concentrate into a low-rank, signed geometry, causing substantial cancellation during aggregation and weakening the effective update. We address this failure mode with SALT, a Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT that uses sample-wise gradient geometry to reweight the coefficients of group-relative updates. SALT estimates a dominant shared subspace from the mini-batch Gram geometry, decomposes group-relative coefficients into shared and residual channels, and adaptively amplifies the residual channel when signed cancellation is severe. Across diverse reasoning-oriented RLVR benchmarks and model scales, SALT improves effective update geometry and performance without modifying the reward model or the rollout sampling procedure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GRPO风格组归一化策略优化中，增加采样数（rollouts）反而导致梯度信号因符号集中抵消而减弱的问题，提出SALT组件，通过子空间自适应调整组相对更新的权重系数，在不修改奖励模型或采样流程的情况下改善有效更新几何。
Motivation: 在GRPO风格的组归一化方法中，增加rollout数量并不能可靠地增强学习，因为梯度特征会集中到低秩带符号几何中，导致聚合时大量抵消。
Method: 提出SALT（Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT），利用小批量Gram几何估计主导共享子空间，将组相对系数分解为共享和残差通道，在符号抵消严重时自适应放大残差通道。
Result: 在多种面向推理的RLVR基准和模型规模上，SALT改善了有效更新几何和性能。
Conclusion: SALT能缓解GRPO中组归一化的梯度抵消问题，提升优化效果，且无需修改奖励模型或采样过程。

papers.title: CaliDist: Calibrating Large Language Models via Behavioral Robustness to Distraction
papers.abstract_en: Existing calibration methods for Large Language Models (LLMs) often overlook a critical dimension of trustworthiness: a model's {\em behavioral robustness} to irrelevant or misleading information. In this paper, we argue that a model's true confidence should reflect its stability under cognitive pressure. We introduce \textsc{CaliDist}, a novel post-hoc calibration approach that directly measures and penalizes a model's susceptibility to distraction. \textsc{CaliDist} quantifies how an LLM's predictions and uncertainty change when its input prompt is perturbed with semantic \textit{distractors}. This stability (or lack thereof) signal is then used to adaptively scale the model's initial confidence score. Our extensive experiments on seven Natural Language Understanding classification benchmarks using six distinct LLMs show that \textsc{CaliDist} consistently achieves lower Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier Score compared with strong baselines. Remarkably, our method reduces the ECE from 23\% to 7\% on average--a relative improvement of 70\%--demonstrating that behavioral stability is a powerful signal for calibration. We make our code and datasets available at github.com/m-anas-j/CaliDist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CaliDist，一种新型后处理校准方法，通过衡量LLM在输入受语义干扰时的预测稳定性来调整置信度。实验在7个NLU分类基准上使用6个LLM，相比强基线持续降低ECE和Brier Score，平均ECE从23%降到7%（相对提升70%）。
Motivation: 现有LLM校准方法忽略了对无关或误导信息的鲁棒性，而真正置信度应反映认知压力下的稳定性。
Method: 引入CaliDist，通过添加语义干扰来量化LLM预测和不确定性的变化，接着用这一稳定性信号自适应缩放初始置信度分数。
Result: 在7个NLU分类基准上，使用6种LLM，CaliDist相比强基线持续降低ECE和Brier Score，平均ECE从23%降到7%，相对提升70%。
Conclusion: 行为稳定性是校准的有力信号。代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks for Counterfactual Outcome Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal treatment decisions require predicting potential outcomes under future treatment sequences in the presence of time-varying confounding, heterogeneous patient dynamics, and limited domain-specific data. Existing longitudinal causal estimators typically train a new model for each cohort or simulator. We introduce Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks (CausalLongPFN), a prior-fitted in-context predictor for longitudinal causal prediction. The model is pretrained entirely on synthetic episodes sampled from a broad prior over temporal structural causal models, exposing it to treatment-confounder feedback, latent heterogeneity, nonlinear state evolution, delayed effects, and cumulative treatment responses. At test time, CausalLongPFN is frozen: it conditions on support trajectories, a query history, and a proposed future treatment sequence, and returns a predictive distribution over future outcomes without gradient updates or propensity-model fitting. Multi-step predictions are obtained by recursively applying the one-step predictor under the specified treatment sequence. We evaluate on branchable cancer, HIV, and warfarin benchmarks with ground-truth counterfactual labels, and on factual-only rolling-origin prediction in MIMIC-III ICU trajectories. CausalLongPFN is competitive with domain-trained longitudinal baselines on counterfactual benchmarks and performs strongly on factual MIMIC-III prediction, suggesting that broad synthetic causal pretraining can provide a useful frozen alternative when repeated domain-specific training is costly or impractical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果纵向先验拟合网络（CausalLongPFN），一种预训练于合成因果模型上的上下文预测器，用于纵向治疗决策中的反事实结果预测。模型在癌症、HIV、华法林等基准上与传统方法竞争，并在MIMIC-III数据上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有纵向因果估计器通常需要针对每个队列或模拟器重新训练模型，成本高且不实用。本文旨在开发一种无需梯度更新或倾向性模型拟合的冻结预测器。
Method: CausalLongPFN在时间结构因果模型的宽广先验上生成合成情节进行预训练，学习治疗-混杂反馈、潜在异质性、非线性状态演化等。测试时，模型根据支持轨迹、查询历史和未来治疗序列返回预测分布，通过递归一步预测实现多步预测。
Result: 在分支癌症、HIV和华法林的反事实基准上，CausalLongPFN与领域训练基线竞争；在MIMIC-III事实预测上表现强劲。
Conclusion: 广泛的合成因果预训练可以提供一种有用的冻结替代方案，当重复的领域特定训练成本高昂或不切实际时。

papers.title: CollabBench: Benchmarking and Unleashing Collaborative Ability of LLMs with Diverse Players via Proactive Engagement
papers.abstract_en: While LLM-based agents excel at individual tasks, effective collaboration with realistic human partners remains challenging. Most of the existing conversation-level collaborative studies lack grounded interaction and behavioral execution, motivating the need for cooperative game environments that enable contextualized and immersive collaboration. To this end, this paper proposes CollabBench, a benchmark for evaluating and training collaborative agents in cooperative games. CollabBench features a Diverse Player Profile Simulation pipeline to model varied players behaviors, and a Collaborative Agentic Training paradigm that unifies reasoning, communication, and action via agentic rollouts, optimized with a hybrid reward balancing task efficiency and affective adaptation. We further extend classic environments to CWAH-MultiPlayer and Cook-MultiPlayer for systematic evaluation under diverse personalities. Experiments with efficiency and affective metrics show that our trained models outperform base models, achieving 19.5% higher efficiency and 24.4% improved affective performance. Further analysis reveals key collaborative limitations of existing models and offers insights for future collaborative training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CollabBench，一个用于评估和训练LLM协作能力的基准，包括多样化玩家模拟和协作智能体训练范式。实验表明，训练后的模型在效率和情感指标上分别提升19.5%和24.4%。
Motivation: 现有LLM协作研究缺乏真实交互和行为执行，需要沉浸式合作游戏环境来推动实际协作能力的发展。
Method: 提出Diverse Player Profile Simulation管道模拟多种玩家行为，以及Collaborative Agentic Training范式，通过智能体展开统一推理、通信和动作，并使用混合奖励平衡任务效率和情感适应。
Result: 训练模型在效率和情感指标上分别比基础模型提升19.5%和24.4%。
Conclusion: 揭示了现有LLM在协作中的关键限制，为未来协作训练提供了见解。

papers.title: Can LLMs Write Correct TLA+ Specifications? Evaluating Natural-Language-to-TLA+ Generation
papers.abstract_en: TLA+ has supported industrial verification at companies such as Amazon and Microsoft, yet writing correct TLA+ specifications from natural language still requires time and expertise, which limits adoption. LLMs show promise, but no prior study measures whether they produce semantically correct TLA+ specifications from natural language. This paper presents the first systematic evaluation of LLM-based TLA+ specification synthesis from natural language. Our study evaluates 30 LLMs across eight families on a curated dataset of 205 TLA+ specifications: 25 open-weight models across four prompting strategies (2,600 runs) and 5 proprietary models under few-shot prompting (130 runs), all validated by the SANY parser and TLC model checker. LLMs achieve up to 26.6% syntactic correctness but only 8.6% semantic correctness, with successes exclusive to progressive prompting. Results show that model size does not predict quality, e.g., DeepSeek r1:8b outperforms its 70B variant across all strategies, which suggests the importance of reasoning alignment for formal languages. Code-specialized models consistently underperform due to negative transfer from mainstream language training. We identify five recurring hallucination categories, all traceable to specific training data biases. These results suggest that current LLMs do not generate reliable TLA+ specifications without expert oversight. We release the evaluation framework, code, and dataset to support reproducibility and future research.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 11 tables. Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Software Technologies (ICSOFT 2026); Recommended as Best Paper Award Candidate
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言生成TLA+规范的能力。在205个TLA+规范数据集上测试了30个LLM（25个开放权重模型+5个专有模型），使用四种提示策略，共2730次运行，通过SANY解析器和TLC模型检查器验证。结果显示LLM最高仅达到26.6%的语法正确率和8.6%的语义正确率，且成功仅出现在渐进式提示中。模型大小不能预测质量，例如DeepSeek r1:8b在所有策略上优于其70B变体，表明推理对齐对形式语言的重要性。代码专用模型因主流语言训练的负迁移而表现不佳。作者识别了五种反复出现的幻觉类别，均与特定训练数据偏差有关。结论是当前LLM在无专家监督下无法生成可靠的TLA+规范。
Motivation: 尽管TLA+已在工业验证中广泛应用，但从自然语言编写正确的TLA+规范仍需时间和专业知识，限制了其采用。尚无研究评估LLM是否能生成语义正确的TLA+规范。
Method: 构建包含205个TLA+规范的评估数据集，采用四种提示策略（包含零样本、少样本、渐进式提示等），分别测试25个开放权重模型和5个专有模型，使用SANY解析器和TLC模型检查器验证语法和语义正确性。
Result: LLM最高达到26.6%语法正确率和8.6%语义正确率，成功仅出现在渐进式提示中。DeepSeek r1:8b优于其70B变体，代码专用模型表现较差。识别了五种幻觉类别。
Conclusion: 当前LLM无法在没有专家监督下生成可靠的TLA+规范；释放评估框架、代码和数据集以支持可重复性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文首次系统评估大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言生成TLA+规范的能力。在205个TLA+规范数据集上测试了30个LLM（25个开放权重模型+5个专有模型），使用四种提示策略，共2730次运行，通过SANY解析器和TLC模型检查器验证。结果显示LLM最高仅达到26.6%的语法正确率和8.6%的语义正确率，且成功仅出现在渐进式提示中。模型大小不能预测质量，例如DeepSeek r1:8b在所有策略上优于其70B变体，表明推理对齐对形式语言的重要性。代码专用模型因主流语言训练的负迁移而表现不佳。作者识别了五种反复出现的幻觉类别，均与特定训练数据偏差有关。结论是当前LLM在无专家监督下无法生成可靠的TLA+规范。
summary_sections.motivation: 尽管TLA+已在工业验证中广泛应用，但从自然语言编写正确的TLA+规范仍需时间和专业知识，限制了其采用。尚无研究评估LLM是否能生成语义正确的TLA+规范。
summary_sections.method: 构建包含205个TLA+规范的评估数据集，采用四种提示策略（包含零样本、少样本、渐进式提示等），分别测试25个开放权重模型和5个专有模型，使用SANY解析器和TLC模型检查器验证语法和语义正确性。
summary_sections.result: LLM最高达到26.6%语法正确率和8.6%语义正确率，成功仅出现在渐进式提示中。DeepSeek r1:8b优于其70B变体，代码专用模型表现较差。识别了五种幻觉类别。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前LLM无法在没有专家监督下生成可靠的TLA+规范；释放评估框架、代码和数据集以支持可重复性。

papers.title: Next-Generation Parallel Decoder for LPDR: Architectural Optimization and Class-Balanced GAN-Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Real-Time License Plate Detection and Recognition (LPDR) forms the backbone of modern smart cities. Although the YOLOV5-PDLPR model substantially improved system efficiency through a parallel decoder approach, its performance is still affected by spatial character mismatches and data imbalance within the training set. This paper addresses these limitations by introducing Cross-Spatial Hybrid Attention (CSHA) and Class-Balanced Synthetic Augmentation (CBSA). An extensive study involving 75,000 synthetic samples is conducted and evaluated on four benchmarks: CCPD, CLPD, PKU, and an application-specific dataset. Experimental results demonstrate a substantial improvement in the recognition rate of minority provincial license plates from 78.2% to 91.5% while maintaining real-time processing performance of 152 FPS. The results indicate that spatially-aware parallel decoding combined with class-balanced augmentation provides an effective solution for high-speed license plate recognition systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对车牌检测与识别（LPDR）中空间字符不匹配和数据不平衡问题，提出跨空间混合注意力（CSHA）和类别平衡合成增强（CBSA）。通过75,000张合成样本的实验，在CCPD、CLPD、PKU等基准上将少数省份车牌识别率从78.2%提升至91.5%，同时保持152 FPS的实时性能。

Method: 提出跨空间混合注意力（CSHA）模块增强空间特征对齐，以及类别平衡合成增强（CBSA）方法生成合成样本来缓解数据不平衡。
Result: 在多个基准上，少数省份车牌识别率从78.2%提升至91.5%，推理速度达到152 FPS，表明该方法在保持实时性的同时显著提高了识别精度。
Conclusion: 空间感知的并行解码结合类别平衡增强为高速车牌识别系统提供了有效解决方案。

papers.title: TAPO: Tool-Aware Policy Optimization via Credit Transfer for Multimodal Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: We identify and formally characterize credit misassignment as a systematic failure mode of GRPO in tool-augmented multimodal search agents: its uniform broadcast of trajectory-level advantages to all tokens causes valuable tool-use steps in failing trajectories to be penalized no differently from valueless ones. We further empirically quantify the scale of this phenomenon. Over half of failing trajectories and failing tool-use actions exhibit correctable credit misassignment, demonstrating that the wasted training signal is both substantial and structurally exploitable. Building on this insight, we propose Tool-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), which exploits the parameter-determinism property of information-acquisition tools: similar call parameters define equivalent information-acquisition actions and should therefore share comparable action credit. TAPO constructs counterfactual witnesses within the current training batch and compensates misassigned negative credit via confidence-gated conservative advantage correction. It requires no additional annotation, models, or sampling, and introduces negligible computational overhead. Across multiple multimodal search benchmarks, TAPO delivers consistent, plug-and-play improvements over strong baselines for three mainstream RL algorithms (GRPO, GSPO, and SAPO). Our code and models will be publicly released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别并形式化了工具增强多模态搜索代理中 GRPO 的信用错误分配问题：统一广播轨迹级优势会导致有价值工具使用步骤被错误惩罚。提出 TAPO 方法，利用信息获取工具的参数确定性特性，通过反事实见证和置信门控保守优势修正来纠正负信用，无需额外标注或采样。
Motivation: 现有 GRPO 在工具增强多模态搜索代理中因均匀广播轨迹级优势而错误惩罚有价值工具步骤，浪费训练信号；超过一半的失败轨迹和失败工具动作存在可纠正的信用错误分配。
Method: TAPO 利用工具的参数确定性：相似调用参数定义等效信息获取动作，应共享相似信用。在训练批次内构建反事实见证，通过置信门控保守优势修正补偿被错误分配的负信用。
Result: 在多个多模态搜索基准上，TAPO 对 GRPO、GSPO 和 SAPO 三种主流强化学习算法均带来一致的即插即用改进，且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: TAPO 通过信用修正有效提升工具增强搜索代理的训练效率，无需额外数据或模型，为现有 RL 算法提供简单高效的增强。

papers.title: Domain-Adapted Small Language Models with Hybrid Post-Processing: Achieving Cost-Efficient, Low-Latency Multi-Label Structured Prediction via LoRA Fine-Tuning on Scarce Data
papers.abstract_en: Deploying frontier large language models (LLMs) for domain-specific structured evaluation tasks often incurs substantial latency, cost, and data privacy overhead. We present a hybrid framework that combines a fine-tuned small language model (LLaMA 3.1 8B, with only 2.05% trainable parameters via LoRA) and a deterministic rule-based post-processing layer. Trained on just 219 curated examples, the system is applied to multi-label compliance evaluation of conversational transcripts spanning 18 heterogeneous output fields. In blind evaluation on 53 previously unseen production transcripts, it achieves 100% JSON structural validity, 83.0% human-validated overall accuracy, and 100% accuracy on the most critical classification field. The proposed approach formalizes a hybrid neural-symbolic decomposition and introduces targeted hard-negative augmentation to improve performance on critical decision boundaries. Running on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, inference completes in approximately 2 seconds, which is 2-5x faster than frontier-model APIs. The system costs only $0.013 per evaluation compared with $0.025-$0.055 for proprietary alternatives, resulting in 46-76% cost savings. These results demonstrate that domain-adapted small language models, when combined with deterministic post-processing, can match frontier-model accuracy for structured compliance evaluation while substantially reducing operational cost, latency, and privacy risk. Keywords: small language models, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, LoRA, domain adaptation, hybrid inference, compliance evaluation, structured output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合框架，将LoRA微调的小语言模型（LLaMA 3.1 8B，仅2.05%参数可训练）与确定性规则后处理层相结合，在仅219个样本上训练，用于多标签合规评估。在53个未见过的生产样本上，实现了100% JSON结构有效性、83.0%总体准确率和关键字段100%准确率，单次推理约2秒，成本为0.013美元，比前沿模型API节省46-76%成本。
Motivation: 前沿大模型在领域特定的结构化评估任务中延迟高、成本高且存在数据隐私问题，需要一种更高效、低成本的替代方案。
Method: 采用LoRA微调LLaMA 3.1 8B（仅2.05%参数）构建小语言模型，结合确定性规则后处理层进行结构化输出校正；引入硬负样本增强以改善关键决策边界。
Result: 在53个未见过的生产样本上，达到100% JSON结构有效性、83.0%人类验证的总体准确率、关键分类字段100%准确率；推理速度比前沿API快2-5倍，成本降低46-76%。
Conclusion: 领域适配的小语言模型结合确定性后处理可以在结构化合规评估中达到与前沿模型相当的准确率，同时大幅降低运营成本、延迟和隐私风险。

papers.title: TinyML-Driven Cybersecurity for Autonomous Spacecraft: Latency-Accuracy Analysis for SPARTA RF and Cyber Threat Detection
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous spacecraft require rapid, lightweight, and reliable onboard detection of cyber-RF threats. Using the SPARTA attack model, we analyze the latency-accuracy trade-offs of TinyML-compatible classical models -- Random Forest, Logistic Regression, SVM, and MLP -- for detecting uplink jamming, Fake-NR spoofing, payload manipulation, ground-segment compromise, and unauthorized command injection. We present a physics-informed theoretical analysis of each model's computational complexity, VC dimension, Lipschitz continuity, and latency scaling, supported by empirical measurements on adversarial RF spectrograms generated via BandErasure, FakeNR, and NoiseBurst corruption modes. Results show that Logistic Regression achieves microsecond-level inference with only a 1\% accuracy drop relative to Random Forest, making it an effective TinyML baseline for onboard autonomy. The study also identifies opportunities for advancing spacecraft cybersecurity through richer feature encoders and multi-timescale learning architectures, building on recent progress in edge intelligence and trustworthy AI.
papers.comment: Twenty Fifth International Conference on Security & Management (SAM'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向自主航天器在轨实时检测射频（RF）与网络威胁的需求，基于SPARTA攻击模型，分析了多种TinyML兼容的经典模型（随机森林、逻辑回归、SVM、MLP）在检测上行链路干扰、伪造NR欺骗、载荷篡改等威胁时的延迟-精度权衡。通过物理信息理论分析（计算复杂度、VC维、Lipschitz连续性、延迟缩放）和对抗性RF频谱图实验，结果显示逻辑回归达到微秒级推理且精度仅比随机森林低1%，适合作为机载自主性的基线模型。
Motivation: 自主航天器需要快速、轻量、可靠的星载电磁与网络威胁检测能力，但现有方案难以兼顾低延迟与高精度。
Method: 利用SPARTA攻击模型生成对抗性RF频谱图（BandErasure、FakeNR、NoiseBurst），对TinyML兼容的随机森林、逻辑回归、SVM、MLP进行理论复杂度分析和实测延迟-精度权衡。
Result: 逻辑回归推理延迟为微秒级，精度仅比随机森林低1%，成为有效的TinyML基线。
Conclusion: 研究为自主航天器实时威胁检测提供了TinyML可行性分析，并指出更丰富的特征编码器和多时间尺度学习架构是未来方向。
