summary_sections.conclusion: 针对性的推理监督使紧凑模型能够生成可操作、视觉上接地的指导，并在未经过基准特定训练的情况下泛化到训练数据之外，无需大规模模型扩展。

papers.title: A Trajectory-Driven Spatio-Temporal Refinement Solution for CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3: DOST
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present our solution for the 8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence (DOST). Our method is built upon the strong baseline framework Segment Any Motion (SegAnyMo), which provides powerful mask generation and motion tracking capabilities. To further boost the segmentation performance under severe atmospheric distortions, we propose two key improvements. First, we employ a data-centric domain adaptation strategy. We significantly expand our training data by incorporating selected sequences from the DAVIS dataset alongside a subset of the DOST dataset, and apply simulated atmospheric fluctuation degradations to enhance the model's robustness against complex geometric distortions. Second, we introduce a spatio-temporal post-processing module. This refinement step effectively removes persistent boundary-connected false foregrounds and short-lived fragmented noise, while strictly preserving genuine small targets and maintaining original individual labels across frames. With these combined strategies, our proposed method ranks the 2st place in the challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CVPR 2026第8届UG2+挑战赛Track 3的动态目标分割（DOST）任务，基于SegAnyMo框架，通过数据领域自适应（扩充DAVIS和DOST数据并模拟大气波动退化）和时空后处理模块，有效去除假阳性并保持标签一致性，最终在挑战赛中取得第二名。
Motivation: 在严重大气湍流下进行动态目标分割极具挑战，现有方法在复杂几何畸变下性能不足，亟需提升鲁棒性。
Method: 基于SegAnyMo基线，采用数据驱动领域自适应（加入DAVIS子集和模拟大气退化）以及时空后处理模块，去除边界相连的假前景和短时碎片噪声，同时保留小目标和标签一致性。
Result: 在CVPR 2026 UG2+挑战赛DOST赛道中取得第二名。
Conclusion: 数据领域自适应与时空后处理相结合可显著提升大气畸变下的动态分割性能，但方法依赖于特定数据集和模拟退化。

papers.title: Industrializing Prediction-Powered Inference: The GLIDE Library for Reliable GenAI and Agentic Systems Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of agentic systems requires unbiased estimates with valid uncertainty, but standard practice navigates between costly human annotation and biased LLM-as-judge proxies. Prediction-powered inference (PPI) combines both into debiased estimates with valid confidence intervals, yet its various methods remain scattered across papers under partial implementations. We introduce GLIDE, an open-source Python library that unifies state-of-the-art PPI estimators (PPI++, Stratified PPI, Predict-Then-Debias and its stratified variants, Active Statistical Inference) and samplers (uniform, stratified, active, cost-optimal) under a scipy-style API specialized to mean estimation. GLIDE ships with a reproducible Monte Carlo validation suite, an empirically grounded decision tree for method selection, and an agentic evaluation case study showing substantial annotation savings at equivalent precision. The GLIDE package is available at this URL: https://github.com/EmertonData/glide
papers.comment: 8 pages, Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Statistical Frameworks for Uncertainty in Agentic Systems, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍GLIDE，一个开源Python库，统一了预测驱动推断（PPI）的各种估计器和采样器，用于可靠地评估生成式AI和代理系统。该库提供类似scipy的API，包含可复现的蒙特卡洛验证套件、方法选择决策树，并在代理评估案例研究中展示了在同等精度下大幅减少标注成本的效果。
Motivation: 当前代理系统的评估标准做法要么依赖昂贵的人工标注，要么使用有偏的LLM评判代理。预测驱动推断（PPI）能结合两者得到无偏估计和有效置信区间，但现有方法分散在各种论文中，实现不完整，缺乏统一工具。
Method: 提出GLIDE库，统一了PPI++、分层PPI、预测-然后去偏及其分层变体、主动统计推断等估计器，以及均匀、分层、主动、成本最优等采样器，专注于均值估计任务，并提供方法选择决策树和可复现验证套件。
Result: 在代理评估案例研究中，GLIDE在同等精度下实现了显著的标注节省。
Conclusion: GLIDE为可靠评估生成式AI和代理系统提供了统一的、易于使用的PPI工具，有助于标准化实践。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generating Graph-Like Logical Rules for Knowledge Graph Reasoning via Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Logical rules constitute a cornerstone of knowledge graph (KG) reasoning, valued for their interpretability and ability to model relational patterns. However, existing rule mining methods predominantly focus on simple chain-like rules and therefore neglect the richer relational information encoded in graph-like structures, such as cycles and branches. This limitation is further exacerbated by computational bottlenecks caused by the combinatorial explosion of the search space, which is especially challenging for graph-like rules. Meanwhile, generative approaches such as diffusion models, despite their success in other domains, cannot be directly applied to rule mining because their training objectives are not aligned with the goal of learning high-quality rules, and non-differentiable KG rule quality metrics cannot directly guide model optimization. To address these limitations, we propose GRiD, a framework that reformulates graph-like rule discovery as a discrete generative process conditioned on the target relation. GRiD employs a two-phase training strategy. First, supervised pre-training enables GRiD to capture structural priors from subgraphs sampled from the KG meta-graph. Subsequently, reinforcement learning is applied to fine-tune GRiD through policy gradient optimization guided directly by non-differentiable rule-quality metrics. Experiments on six benchmark datasets show that GRiD achieves competitive performance on KG completion tasks. Ablation studies confirm the efficiency and robustness of GRiD and further show that graph-like rules complement chain-like rules in KG completion. Our code and datasets are available in https://github.com/Haoxiang-Cheng/GRiD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRiD框架，将图样逻辑规则发现转化为离散生成过程，使用扩散模型通过两阶段训练（监督预训练+强化学习）生成复杂图样规则，用于知识图谱推理。实验在六个基准数据集上展示了竞争力。
Motivation: 现有规则挖掘方法主要关注链式规则，忽略了图样结构（如环、分支）中的丰富关系信息，且搜索空间组合爆炸，基于扩散模型的方法因训练目标不对齐而无法直接应用。
Method: 提出GRiD，将图样规则发现建模为以目标关系为条件的离散生成过程，两阶段训练：第一阶段用监督预训练从知识图谱元图子图中捕获结构先验；第二阶段用强化学习通过策略梯度优化直接由非可微规则质量指标指导。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上，GRiD在知识图谱补全任务上取得具有竞争力的性能，消融研究证实了效率和鲁棒性，并显示图样规则补充了链式规则。
Conclusion: GRiD框架通过扩散模型和强化学习有效生成了图样逻辑规则，增强了知识图谱推理能力，代码和数据已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MUSE: Benchmarking Manufacturable, Functional, and Assemblable Text-to-CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced text-driven 3D generation, yet Text-to-CAD remains far from supporting industrial product design. Existing benchmarks focus primarily on generating single-part CAD models and evaluate them using geometric similarity metrics that fail to capture functionality, manufacturability, and assemblability. To address this gap, we introduce MUSE, a Text-to-CAD benchmark focused on complex, editable boundary representation (B-Rep) assemblies. MUSE pairs practical design instances with structured Design Specifications and evaluates generated models through a three-stage protocol: code check, geometric check, and design-intent alignment. The final stage uses design-specific rubrics to assess functionality, manufacturability, and assemblability, moving beyond shape matching toward practical design quality. To enable scalable evaluation, we use a rubric-based visual language model (VLM) judge and validate its reliability through human annotation. Experiments on closed-source and open-source LLMs reveal a clear failure cascade from executable code to valid geometry and finally to engineering-ready design, with even the strongest models achieving limited success on fine-grained engineering criteria. Together, MUSE provides a realistic benchmark and evaluation framework for advancing Text-to-CAD from geometric generation toward true engineering design. Our project website, including the leaderboard, dataset, and code, is available at https://dong7313.github.io/muse-benchmark/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MUSE基准，用于评估文本生成CAD模型的功能性、可制造性和可装配性，超越了传统的几何相似性度量。通过三阶段评估协议（代码检查、几何检查、设计意图对齐），并使用基于评分标准的视觉语言模型评判。实验表明现有LLM在工程级设计标准上表现有限。
Motivation: 现有Text-to-CAD基准主要关注单零件模型几何相似性，忽略了实际工程中的功能性、可制造性和可装配性。
Method: 提出MUSE基准，包含复杂可编辑B-Rep装配体，配以结构化设计规范，通过三阶段协议评估：代码检查、几何检查、设计意图对齐，最后阶段使用设计特定评分表评估功能/制造/装配质量。采用基于评分表的VLM评判，并通过人工标注验证可靠性。
Result: 实验显示从可执行代码到有效几何再到工程级设计存在明显的失败级联，最强模型在细粒度工程标准上成功有限。
Conclusion: MUSE为Text-to-CAD从几何生成迈向真正工程设计提供了现实基准和评估框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient-Flow Optimization as Dynamic Random-Effects Inference: Testing and Early Stopping with Applications to Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-flow optimization is usually viewed as an algorithmic procedure for minimizing empirical loss, with training duration selected by validation or heuristic early-stopping rules. We develop a statistical inference framework for the gradient-flow training trajectory itself. The central object is fixed-operator squared-error gradient flow: whenever the fitted value evolves through a time-invariant positive semidefinite training operator, the trained model output at each training time is exactly equivalent to the best linear unbiased predictor, or empirical-Bayes posterior mean, under a corresponding random-effects model. Under this representation, training time becomes a variance-component parameter governing how variance is reallocated from residual noise to structured signal. This turns two basic training decisions into inferential problems. First, whether training is needed is formulated as a variance-component test for signal beyond initialization. Second, how long to train is formulated as restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimation of the training-time variance component. The resulting REML-guided early stopping rule has a spectral interpretation: it selects the training time at which optimized spectral losses become empirically decorrelated from the eigenvalues of the training operator, yielding an effective degrees-of-freedom measure for the evolving trained model. We establish asymptotic prediction optimality for fixed-design in-sample risk and, under additional kernel regularity conditions, random-design out-of-sample risk. Deep learning models in fixed-kernel gradient regimes provide canonical modern-AI instantiations of the theory. Numerical experiments and a UK Biobank proteomics application show that the proposed inferential approach attains competitive prediction accuracy while reducing the reliance on validation splits and repeated checkpoint evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将梯度流优化视为动态随机效应推断问题，将训练时间解释为方差分量参数，并通过REML估计得到早停规则，适用于固定核深度学习模型。
Motivation: 梯度流优化通常被视为最小化经验损失的算法过程，训练时长由验证或启发式早停规则决定，缺乏统计推断框架。
Method: 建立固定算子平方误差梯度流的统计推断框架，将训练输出等价为随机效应模型下的BLUP或经验贝叶斯后验均值，训练时间成为方差分量，通过方差分量检验和REML估计指导训练决策。
Result: REML早停规则具有谱解释，选择训练时间使谱损失与训练算子特征值去相关，提供有效自由度度量；渐近预测最优性在固定设计样本内风险和随机设计样本外风险下成立；数值实验和UK Biobank蛋白质组学应用表明该方法在保持预测精度的同时减少验证集依赖。
Conclusion: 该框架将训练决策转化为推断问题，减少对验证集和检查点评估的依赖，适用于固定核深度学习模型。

papers.title: PortBench: A Correlation-Aware, Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM-Driven Portfolio Management
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across diverse financial tasks, yet portfolio management (PM), a critical financial decision-making task, remains poorly benchmarked. Existing benchmarks exhibit two main gaps: they ignore cross-asset correlation structures, thereby failing to distinguish genuinely diversified portfolios from concentrated ones, and fail to evaluate the complete PM decision pipeline in real-world scenarios. We introduce PortBench, a benchmark spanning six heterogeneous asset classes over ten years. PortBench consists of two complementary layers: a static QA dataset of 6,269 correlation-based questions across seven task templates, and a dynamic five-stage allocation pipeline that mirrors the full PM decision cycle. To evaluate these layers, we introduce two dedicated metrics: a dual-layer correlation score that measures whether proposed portfolios exploit inter-class hedging and avoid intra-class concentration, and CEPS, a metric that quantifies how reasoning errors compound across pipeline stages. We further assess strategy robustness and investor alignment under three historical stress regimes and risk profiles. Evaluating ten frontier LLMs, we find that despite strong performance on static financial QA, 90\% of model-profile combinations fail to outperform a basic equal-weight allocation, and models that satisfy every procedural constraint still suffer catastrophic drawdowns under stress. Our source code is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticFinLab/portbench}{this https URL}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PortBench是一个针对LLM驱动投资组合管理的全流程基准，包含静态相关性问题数据集和动态五阶段分配流水线。评估表明，尽管LLM在静态金融问答上表现良好，但90%的模型-风险配置组合未能超越简单等权配置。
Motivation: 现有基准忽略了跨资产相关性结构，且未能评估真实场景中完整的投资组合决策流程。
Method: 提出PortBench，包含6,269个基于相关性的静态QA问题和五阶段动态分配流水线，并引入双层次相关性分数和CEPS指标。
Result: 十个前沿LLM中，90%的模型-风险配置组合未能超越等权配置，且满足所有程序约束的模型在压力情境下仍遭受灾难性回撤。
Conclusion: PortBench揭示了LLM在投资组合管理中的严重不足，强调需要更关注相关性和决策流程的评估。

summary_sections.method: 提出PortBench，包含6,269个基于相关性的静态QA问题和五阶段动态分配流水线，并引入双层次相关性分数和CEPS指标。
summary_sections.result: 十个前沿LLM中，90%的模型-风险配置组合未能超越等权配置，且满足所有程序约束的模型在压力情境下仍遭受灾难性回撤。
summary_sections.conclusion: PortBench揭示了LLM在投资组合管理中的严重不足，强调需要更关注相关性和决策流程的评估。

papers.title: ClothTransformer: Unified Latent-Space Transformers for Scalable Cloth Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Unified and scalable Transformers have recently achieved remarkable success in modeling diverse phenomena traditionally associated with computer graphics, such as 3D visual effects, rendering processes, and motion in videos. In this work, we take a step further by investigating whether modern Transformer techniques can tackle the challenging task of cloth simulation. To this end, we present ClothTransformer, a framework that reformulates cloth simulation as autoregressive sequence modeling in a learned latent space. Existing neural cloth simulators are largely specialized to single scenarios, intrinsically coupled to the mesh discretization, and lack robust collision handling. Our approach addresses these limitations through three contributions: (1) a unified Transformer architecture that handles diverse scenarios -- body-driven garments, robotic manipulation, and free-fall collisions -- under a single model and achieves approximately $4$--$9{\times}$ lower error than prior state-of-the-art methods across all scenarios; (2) a scalable latent-space formulation that compresses arbitrary-resolution meshes into a fixed-size set of latent tokens, making temporal dynamics computation independent of mesh resolution; and (3) a diverse-scenario high-fidelity penetration-free dataset of ${\sim}$493.4k frames spanning all three settings, which enables a differentiable Continuous Collision Detection (CCD) module to suppress penetration artifacts. Project Page: https://yucrazing.github.io/clothtransformer/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClothTransformer，将布料模拟重新表述为潜在空间中的自回归序列建模。框架使用统一的 Transformer 架构处理人体驱动、机器人操作和自由落体碰撞等多种场景，在单一模型下相比已有方法误差降低约 4-9 倍。通过可扩展的潜在空间表示将任意分辨率网格压缩为固定大小的潜在 token，使时间动态计算与网格分辨率解耦。同时引入可微分的连续碰撞检测模块抑制穿透伪影，并提供约 49.3 万帧的高保真无穿透数据集。
Motivation: 现有神经布料模拟器通常针对单一场景定制，与网格离散化紧密耦合，且缺乏稳健的碰撞处理能力，限制了其通用性和可扩展性。
Method: 采用自回归 Transformer 在学习的潜在空间中对布料动态进行序列建模；通过潜在编码器将任意分辨率网格压缩为固定数量的潜在 token；集成可微分的连续碰撞检测模块以在训练中自动抑制穿透。
Result: 在人体驱动、机器人操作和自由落体碰撞三类场景中，ClothTransformer 相比先前最优方法降低约 4-9 倍误差，并生成无穿透的高保真模拟结果。
Conclusion: 统一的潜在空间 Transformer 框架可有效泛化多种布料模拟场景，为计算昂贵且需专用求解器的传统方法提供可扩展的替代方案。

papers.title: Detectability in Diversity: Improved Canary Crafting for Privacy Auditing in One Run
papers.abstract_en: Privacy auditing aims to empirically assess privacy leakage in machine learning models using membership inference attacks (MIAs), and to derive lower bounds on differential privacy (DP) parameters. Recent one-run auditing methods address the high cost of standard approaches by relying on a single training run with multiple "canary" points whose inclusion or exclusion must be detected by the auditor. In this work, we study the problem of efficiently crafting canaries for one-run privacy auditing. Motivated by recent theoretical insights suggesting that interference between canaries contributes to weaker leakage estimates compared to multi-run methods, we propose to optimize canaries to be both highly detectable and minimally interfering. Our approach combines a greedy initialization based on influence functions with a bilevel optimization procedure that maximizes distinguishability while promoting diversity in embedding space, enabling the use of computationally efficient bilevel algorithms. Experiments show that our method achieves stronger privacy leakage estimates at a lower computational cost than existing canary crafting approaches.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的金丝雀构造方法，用于单次运行隐私审计。通过结合基于影响函数的贪心初始化和双层优化，最大化金丝雀的可检测性并最小化相互干扰，从而在较低计算成本下获得更强的隐私泄露估计。
Motivation: 现有单次运行审计方法中，金丝雀之间的干扰导致隐私泄露估计弱于多次运行方法，本文旨在通过优化金丝雀来弥补这一差距。
Method: 提出结合基于影响函数的贪心初始化与双层优化的方法，最大化金丝雀的可区分性并促进嵌入空间多样性，利用高效的双层算法。
Result: 实验表明该方法能在较低计算成本下获得比现有金丝雀构造方法更强的隐私泄露估计。
Conclusion: 论文强调其方法在单次运行隐私审计中更有效，通过优化金丝雀的多样性和可检测性提升了审计效果。

papers.title: Once-For-All: A Train-Once and Select-Anytime Framework for Multimodal Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal instruction tuning is the de facto recipe for adapting vision language models (VLMs), yet instruction data are highly redundant, making data selection critical for training efficiency. Existing methods derive selection signals from a specific model or dataset, so whenever the target model or candidate pool changes, the criteria must be recomputed from scratch at substantial cost. To address this, we propose OFA, a data selection framework that trains a reusable selector once and applies it to any dataset or model without recomputation. OFA clusters multimodal instructions in a frozen CLIP space, derives pseudo labels from the cluster structure, and trains a lightweight selector for only a few epochs; samples on which this selector is least confident are selected as the most informative. Once trained, the frozen selector transfers directly across datasets and model scales. The selector is trained once on LLaVA-665K and applied both to LLaVA-665K itself and, without any retraining, to the unseen Vision-Flan-186K. Selecting only 15% of the data, OFA achieves 98.3% of full data performance across 10 downstream benchmarks; on the smaller Vision-Flan-186K, the transferred selector surpasses full data training by 10.6%, confirming that the learned signal generalizes to datasets never seen during selector training. The same selected subsets benefit VLMs at both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and LLaVA-v1.5-7B without per model recomputation, decoupling selection from the target model. These results demonstrate that a single, transferable selector provides an effective and reusable solution for efficient multimodal instruction tuning.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Mingkang Dong and Hongyi Cai contributed equally to this work. Muxin Pu is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OFA框架，用于多模态指令调优中的数据选择。该框架在CLIP空间中对指令聚类，训练一个轻量级选择器，该选择器一旦训练完成即可直接迁移至不同数据集和模型，无需重新计算。实验表明，仅选择15%的数据即可达到全量数据98.3%的性能，且在未见数据集上超越全量训练10.6%。
Motivation: 多模态指令调优中数据高度冗余，现有数据选择方法对特定模型或数据集不可迁移，每次更换目标模型或候选池时需从头计算，成本高昂。
Method: 在冻结的CLIP空间中对多模态指令进行聚类，利用聚类结构生成伪标签，训练轻量级选择器（仅少量epoch），选择器置信度最低的样本作为最信息量样本。训练后的选择器可直接跨数据集和模型尺度迁移。
Result: 在LLaVA-665K上训练的选择器应用于自身和未见过的Vision-Flan-186K，仅选15%数据在10个下游基准上达到98.3%全量性能；在Vision-Flan-186K上，迁移选择器超越全量训练10.6%。同一选择子集对Qwen2.5-VL-3B和LLaVA-v1.5-7B均有效，无需针对模型重新计算。
Conclusion: 单个可迁移的选择器为高效多模态指令调优提供了可复用的解决方案，将选择与目标模型解耦。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DuoGesture: Neuro-Inspired and Biomechanically Informed Dual-Stream Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.abstract_en: Co-speech gesture generation requires both semantic expressivity and biomechanically plausible rhythmic motion. Existing holistic gesture models mix lexically grounded semantic gestures with frequent prosody-aligned beat gestures. This limits semantic grounding, speech-motion alignment, and kinematic smoothness. We propose \emph{DuoGesture}, a neuro-inspired and biomechanically informed dual-stream approach that decomposes co-speech gesture synthesis into coupled semantic and beat streams. The two streams are coordinated by a \emph{Semantic Variational Information Bottleneck}, a stochastic frame-level gate that learns when semantic gestures should override rhythmic beat motion. The semantic stream is controlled by \emph{Motion-Grounded Semantic Conditioning}, which replaces purely linguistic word embeddings with motion-language representations to provide motion-aligned semantic priors for long-tailed lexical triggers of gestures. The beat stream is further regularised by an \emph{Inertial Beat Prior}, an anthropometry-weighted arm-chain module that reduces jitter and improves rhythmic consistency without constraining semantic frames. Objective evaluations and subjective experiments show that DuoGesture outperforms strong holistic baselines, while component ablations confirm the complementary roles of semantic grounding, stochastic stream selection, and biomechanical regularisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoGesture 是一种受神经科学和生物力学启发的双流共语手势生成方法，将手势生成分解为语义流和节拍流，通过语义变分信息瓶颈协调，并引入运动接地语义条件和惯性节拍先验以提升语义表达和运动平滑性。实验表明该方法在客观和主观评估上优于强基线模型。
Motivation: 现有共语手势模型混合语义手势和节拍手势，限制了语义接地、语音-运动对齐和运动平滑性。
Method: 提出双流架构：语义流和节拍流，由随机帧级门控（语义变分信息瓶颈）协调；语义流使用运动接地语义条件替代纯语言嵌入；节拍流通过惯性节拍先验（基于人体测量学的臂链模块）减少抖动。
Result: 客观和主观实验表明 DuoGesture 优于强基线模型，消融实验验证了语义接地、随机流选择与生物力学正则化的互补作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双流分解与生物力学约束可有效提升共语手势的语义表达和运动自然度。

papers.title: AutoDFT: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous DFT Calculations
papers.abstract_en: Density functional theory (DFT) serves as the basis for computational discovery in materials science and chemistry, yet each calculation demands extensive human effort: adjusting algorithms when convergence stalls, revising plans when unexpected physics emerges, and inserting steps as intermediate results reshape the problem. Existing LLM-based agents automate only the initial planning stage, producing a full execution plan upfront and leaving all subsequent adaptation to hand-crafted rules. As a result, these workflows remain fragile, do not generalize well beyond pre-planned scenarios, and often require expert intervention when failures or unexpected intermediate results require changes to the calculation path. Here, we introduce AutoDFT, a closed-loop multi-agent framework that embeds LLM reasoning into every stage of the DFT lifecycle, where a strategic planner produces a skeletal plan of step objectives; a step planner generates numerical parameters just in time from preceding results; and a monitor-recover-reflect cycle diagnoses failures, repairs them, and revises the plan when the evidence justifies it. We demonstrate both breadth and depth: breadth on VASPBench, a purpose-built benchmark spanning 34 tasks and 9 DFT calculation types, where AutoDFT achieves 94.1% task-level success with GPT-5.2; and depth on established materials databases, where AutoDFT produces quantitatively reliable property predictions across electronic, magnetic, and energetic properties. By closing the loop between planning and execution, AutoDFT enables experimentalists without deep computational expertise to obtain reliable first-principles results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoDFT是一个闭环多智能体框架，将大语言模型（LLM）推理嵌入到密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的每个阶段。该框架包含战略规划器、步骤规划器以及监控-恢复-反思循环，使计算过程能够自适应调整。在包含34个任务和9种DFT类型的VASPBench基准上，使用GPT-5.2达到94.1%的任务级成功率，并在已知材料数据库上对电子、磁性和能量属性给出定量可靠的预测。
Motivation: 现有DFT计算需要大量人工干预，而基于LLM的智能体仅自动化初始规划阶段，后续适应依赖手工规则，导致流程脆弱、泛化性差且需要专家介入应对失败或意外中间结果。
Method: 提出闭环多智能体框架AutoDFT：战略规划器生成步骤目标的骨架计划；步骤规划器根据前序结果即时生成数值参数；监控-恢复-反思循环诊断失败、修复并修订计划。
Result: 在VASPBench基准上（34个任务、9种DFT类型）使用GPT-5.2达到94.1%任务级成功率；在已知材料数据库上获得电子、磁性和能量属性的定量可靠预测。
Conclusion: 通过闭环规划与执行，AutoDFT使缺乏深厚计算专业知识的实验人员也能获得可靠的第一性原理结果。

papers.title: Extreme Region Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for large language models faces a fundamental trade-off between sample efficiency and asymptotic performance: strictly on-policy methods discard trajectories after a single update, while off-policy reuse introduces distribution mismatch that existing trust-region techniques mitigate primarily by enforcing conservative optimization, often leaving rich training signals underutilized. To investigate this, we perform extensive off-policy updates on fixed data. Our experiments reveal that aggressive multi-step optimization brings rapid initial gains, but excessive updates cause trajectory probabilities to deviate and entropy to collapse, with performance plateauing early. Tightening KL constraints merely lowers the ceiling without resolving the degradation. This motivates Extreme Region Policy Distillation (ERPD), a two-stage framework that decouples sample efficiency from KL efficiency. The first stage performs weakly constrained off-policy optimization on fixed data to maximally extract training signals. The resulting policy provides token-level supervision. In the second stage, we distill these signals into the base policy under trust-region constraints, filtering harmful drift while preserving useful signals. The distilled policy achieves comparable or better performance with substantially smaller KL divergence, indicating that much of the first-stage divergence was spent on unnecessary drift rather than genuine improvement. Crucially, ERPD accommodates both strong and weak teachers: when aggressive optimization yields no stronger policy, even degenerate teachers provide effective supervision via alternative signal construction strategies. We validate ERPD on mathematical reasoning, showing gains for strong base models where on-policy training plateaus, and reliable improvements with weak teachers.

papers.title: Whose Alignment? Comparing LLM Process Alignment Across Diverse Organizational Decision Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Steerable pluralism requires a model to faithfully represent one specified perspective. Organizations are a natural setting for this demand, since they deploy LLMs to make decisions that must reflect their own policy. Yet, most existing work fixes that perspective at the level of individuals or demographic groups. We rely on a decision-policy capturing method to measure process alignment in organizational settings, assessing whether an LLM faithfully reproduces the organization's decision policy rather than merely reaching the same conclusions. We find heterogeneity along two axes. Across models, baseline alignment varies strongly and tracks neither pricing nor general benchmark performance. Across organizations, the structure of alignment changes. In ECHR Article 6 decisions, process alignment predicts output accuracy ($r = 0.85$, $p < .001$), and making the organization's past decision policy explicit improves poorly aligned models. In consumer credit decisions, process alignment is low overall but varies more than output accuracy, and the models resist adopting the organization's weighting of protected attributes. Because historical credit decisions encode potentially discriminatory patterns, higher alignment there is not always desirable. Process-level measurement is therefore necessary, and depending on whether the target policy is normatively desirable, the same procedure can calibrate or audit a model. Deciding which policy to align to, and whether higher alignment is feasible or desirable, makes organizational alignment a pluralistic problem in its own right.
papers.comment: Accepted to Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在组织决策中的过程对齐（process alignment）问题，即模型是否忠实再现组织的决策策略而非仅得到相同结论。通过捕捉决策策略的方法，发现不同模型和不同组织间的对齐程度存在异质性：在ECHR第6条决策中，过程对齐与输出准确性高度相关（r=0.85, p<0.001），且明确组织过去决策策略可改善对齐较差的模型；而在消费者信贷决策中，整体对齐度低但变化大，模型难以采纳组织对受保护属性的权重。论文认为过程对齐测量是必要的，且取决于目标策略是否合乎规范，同一过程可用于校准或审计模型。
Motivation: 现有对齐研究多聚焦于个体或人口群体的视角，忽略了组织作为自然场景的需求——组织需要LLM做出的决策反映其自身政策。论文旨在填补这一空白，探讨在组织背景下如何测量和评估LLM的过程对齐。
Method: 采用决策策略捕捉方法（decision-policy capturing method）来测量LLM在组织场景中的过程对齐，即评估模型是否忠实模拟组织的决策过程而非仅匹配输出结论。
Result: 发现两个维度的异质性：不同模型（基线对齐度差异大，不与价格或通用基准性能相关）和不同组织（对齐结构变化）。在ECHR第6条决策中，过程对齐与输出准确性的相关系数为0.85（p<0.001），且明确组织过去决策策略能改善对齐较差的模型；在消费者信贷决策中，整体对齐度低但变化大于输出准确性，模型难以采纳组织对受保护属性的权重。
Conclusion: 过程对齐测量对于评估LLM是否真正遵循组织政策至关重要。是否追求更高对齐取决于目标政策是否具有规范性价值，组织对齐本身是一个多元主义问题。

papers.title: JudgmentBench: Comparing Rubric and Preference Evaluation for Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Two methodologies dominate current practices of benchmarking: rubric-based scoring evaluates items against predefined criteria, whereas comparative judgment elicits pairwise preferences between outputs. Although both methodologies are widely used, the choice between them is rarely justified. We release JudgmentBench, a benchmark of 30 real-world legal tasks, paired with 1,539 rubric scores and 1,530 pairwise preference judgments collected from practicing attorneys--including at major U.S. law firms--with substantial experience. The annotations constitute the first publicly available dataset in a high-expertise domain in which both supervision signals are elicited from the same experts on the same items. Using LLM-generated outputs at three constructed quality levels, we provide an initial empirical comparison: comparative judgments recover the intended quality ordering substantially better than rubrics under both a per-task rank-correlation metric (mean Spearman's rank correlation of 0.908 vs. 0.150, estimated difference = 0.758 [0.494, 1.021]) and a per-judgment pairwise win-rate metric (0.669 vs. 0.542, estimated difference = 0.127 [0.067, 0.186]), while requiring less than half the annotation time. The patterns hold for human annotators and LLM autograders. Beyond this initial comparison, the paired structure of the dataset supports a broader research agenda on how expert judgment should be elicited, aggregated, and used as supervision in domains without verifiable ground truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布JudgmentBench，一个包含30个真实法律任务的基准数据集，并由资深律师提供了1539个评分标准和1530组成对偏好判断。实证比较表明，比较判断（comparative judgment）在恢复预期质量排序上显著优于评分标准（rubric scoring）：平均Spearman秩相关0.908 vs 0.150，成对胜率0.669 vs 0.542，且注释时间减少一半以上。该数据集为研究专家判断的收集与聚合提供了基础。
Motivation: 当前基准测试中，基于评分标准与基于比较判断两种评估方法被广泛使用，但选择依据缺乏实证支持。
Method: 构建JudgmentBench数据集，收集30个法律任务中来自资深律师的1539个评分和1530个成对偏好，并使用LLM生成三种质量水平的输出进行对比分析。
Result: 比较判断在每任务秩相关（0.908 vs 0.150）和每判断成对胜率（0.669 vs 0.542）上均显著优于评分标准，且注释时间更短。
Conclusion: 在专家评估场景中，比较判断比评分标准更高效、更准确地恢复质量排序；数据集支持进一步研究专家判断的聚合与监督学习。

papers.title: EgoAdapt: A Multi-Scene Egocentric Adaptation Method for CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA Challenge
papers.abstract_en: This technical report presents our solution, EgoAdapt (Egocentric Adaptation via Category, Calibration, and Consistency), to the CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA challenge. HD-EPIC evaluates whether a vision-language model can reason over realistic first-person kitchen videos, where the evidence for an answer may be a short hand-object interaction, a long recipe trajectory, a spatial relation to a fixture, or a subtle gaze cue. The benchmark contains 26K multiple-choice questions across seven macro-categories: recipe, ingredient, nutrition, fine-grained action, 3D perception, object motion, and gaze. We observe that the main difficulty is not only model capacity, but also the mismatch between a single generic inference recipe and the heterogeneous temporal, spatial, and semantic structure of the benchmark. Our method, EgoAdapt, introduces three inference-time components: (1) category-conditioned routing with per-category prompts, frame budgets, and sampling rates; (2) calibrated option scoring that evaluates all candidate answers with letter-token likelihoods and generation agreement instead of relying only on direct generation; and (3) test-time consistency adaptation that aggregates predictions across option permutations and verification-style prompts for ambiguous cases. This design substantially improves over the available HD-EPIC baselines.
papers.comment: Technical Report for CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA挑战赛提出EgoAdapt方法，解决第一人称厨房视频问答中单一通用推理模板与异构时空语义结构不匹配的问题。通过类别条件路由、校准选项评分和测试时一致性适应三个推理时组件，显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: HD-EPIC基准包含26K多项选择题，涵盖食谱、成分、营养、细粒度动作、3D感知、物体运动和凝视七个宏观类别，单一通用推理方法难以应对其异构的时空语义结构。
Method: EgoAdapt包含三个推理时组件：(1) 类别条件路由，为每类使用不同提示、帧预算和采样率；(2) 校准选项评分，利用字母token似然和生成一致性评估所有候选答案；(3) 测试时一致性适应，聚合不同选项排列和验证式提示下的预测。
Result: 该方法在HD-EPIC基准上显著优于可用基线。
Conclusion: 通过针对异构场景设计的推理时适应组件，有效提升了视频问答性能。

papers.title: EgoAction: Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion for the EPIC-KITCHENS Action Detection Challenge at CVPR 2026
papers.abstract_en: The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Detection challenge evaluates whether a model can localize the start and end of each action in long untrimmed egocentric videos and assign the corresponding verb--noun action label. In this report, we formulate our submission as EgoAction (Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion), a unified decoupled detection and fusion pipeline. The pipeline uses EPIC-finetuned VideoMAE-L features, trains separate noun and verb temporal detectors with causal temporal modeling, composes action hypotheses from top noun--verb pairs, and introduces a confidence-adaptive boundary fusion rule at post-processing time. The key observation is that verb and noun streams often fail differently: verb scores are sensitive to motion transitions, whereas noun scores are sensitive to hand-object visibility and object clutter. A fixed arithmetic mean of their predicted boundaries can therefore amplify localization errors when one stream degenerates. We replace this hard-coded mean with Dynamic Weighted Fusion (DWF), which normalizes the maximum noun and verb classification confidences into proposal-wise boundary weights and linearly combines the two intervals. This lightweight tensor-only operator shifts boundary authority toward the more reliable stream while preserving the decoupled action scoring mechanism. Together with sliding-window inference, top-K noun--verb action composition, and class-wise Soft-NMS, EgoAction provides a compact and reproducible system for egocentric temporal action detection.
papers.comment: Technical Report for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Detection Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoAction 系统，用于 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 动作检测挑战。系统采用解耦的动词和名词检测器，通过动态加权融合（DWF）根据分类置信度自适应组合边界预测，提高定位精度。该方法在挑战提交中取得良好性能。
Motivation: EPIC-KITCHENS-100 挑战要求精确定位动作起止并分类，但动词和名词检测器错误模式不同（动词敏感于运动过渡，名词敏感于手物可见性和物体杂乱），固定平均融合会放大定位误差。
Method: 提出 EgoAction 管线：使用 VideoMAE-L 特征，分别训练动词和名词时序检测器（因果建模），组合 top noun-verb 对；后处理引入可靠性感知的 DWF，将最大分类置信度归一化为边界权重，线性组合两个区间。
Result: 在 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 挑战上提交，DWF 相比固定均值融合减少了定位误差，提升了动作检测性能。
Conclusion: EgoAction 提供了一个紧凑可复现的 egocentric 时序动作检测系统，通过 DWF 动态赋予更可靠流更高的边界决策权重，减轻融合误差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniEgo-R$^2$: A Routed Reasoning Framework for the 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at CVPR 2026
papers.abstract_en: The 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis, CVPR 2026 evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over egocentric videos across surgery, industry, extreme sports, and animal perspective. We achieved second place in both the Source-Limited and Open-Source tracks. In this report, we formulate EgoCross as a robust cross-domain embodied video reasoning problem rather than a simple multiple-choice visual question answering task. We identify three key challenges: (C1) temporal boundary ambiguity, where critical state transitions are sparsely sampled and often occur between frames; (C2) cross-domain semantic granularity mismatch, where the same capability requires different domain-specific visual grammar; and (C3) decision instability under close options, where long multimodal reasoning can select unsupported distractors or produce malformed outputs. To address them, we propose OmniEgo-R$^2$ (Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning), a unified routed reasoning pipeline consisting of temporal-evidence normalization, domain-agnostic capability routing, structured perception--dynamics--decision reasoning, boundary-aware option verification, and defensive answer calibration. OmniEgo-R$^2$ uses the Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT checkpoints on each EgoCross domain as the visual-language backbone, and wraps them with lightweight test-time reasoning and parsing programs. Our final submissions obtain 66.35% overall accuracy in the Source-Limited track and 66.77% in the Open-Source track, ranking second in both leaderboards. The codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/OmniEgo-R2

TL;DR: 本文针对CVPR 2026首届跨域自我中心视频推理挑战赛EgoCross，提出OmniEgo-R²路由推理框架。该框架将挑战问题形式化为跨域具身视频推理，而非简单多项选择问答。通过时间证据归一化、域无关能力路由、结构化感知-动态-决策推理、边界感知选项验证和防御性答案校准五个模块，在Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT骨干上实现Source-Limited和Open-Source赛道均获第二名，准确率分别达66.35%和66.77%。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理跨域自我中心视频推理时面临时间边界模糊、跨域语义粒度不匹配和相近选项决策不稳定三大挑战，需要统一的鲁棒推理框架。
Method: 提出OmniEgo-R²路由推理流水线，包括时间证据归一化、域无关能力路由、结构化感知-动态-决策推理、边界感知选项验证和防御性答案校准五部分，使用Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT检查点作为视觉语言骨干，并辅以轻量级测试时推理和解析程序。
Result: 在Source-Limited赛道获得66.35%总体准确率，Open-Source赛道获得66.77%总体准确率，两个赛道均排名第二。
Conclusion: 本文证明通过路由推理框架可以有效应对跨域自我中心视频推理的核心挑战，所提出的方法具有通用性和可复现性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TempRet: Temporal Enhancement and Two-Stage Reranking for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Video-text retrieval has witnessed remarkable progress driven by large-scale vision-language pretraining, yet most existing approaches inherit an implicit assumption from image-text retrieval: that visual semantics can be captured frame-by-frame. This assumption overlooks the temporal dynamics of egocentric videos. The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval (MIR) challenge further raises the bar by providing soft-label relevance matrices rather than binary labels, demanding models that can resolve graded semantic correspondences across modalities. In this report, we present our solution, termed TempRet, to the CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR challenge. Our approach builds upon a CLIP-based dual-encoder backbone and introduces two key components to address the temporal and cross-modal challenges. First, a temporal transformer operates exclusively on the video side, modeling inter-frame dependencies through learnable positional encodings and multi-head self-attention over frame-level CLIP features. Second, a two-stage reranking pipeline first retrieves Top-K candidates via the dual-encoder, then refines their scores using a cross-encoder equipped with an Image-Text Matching (ITM) head. The entire system is trained with Symmetric Multi-Similarity Loss to exploit the soft-label relevance matrices provided by the challenge. Our method achieves 67.97% average mAP and 82.92% average nDCG on the EK-100 MIR benchmark, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal modeling and cross-modal refinement for egocentric video retrieval.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对第一人称视频中的多实例检索问题，提出TempRet方法，基于CLIP双编码器架构，引入时间Transformer建模帧间依赖，并通过两阶段重排序（双编码器初筛+交叉编码器精排）利用软标签相关性矩阵，在EK-100 MIR基准上达到67.97%平均mAP和82.92%平均nDCG。
Motivation: 现有视频-文本检索方法大多继承图像-文本检索的逐帧假设，忽视第一人称视频的时间动态性，且EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR挑战提供软标签相关性矩阵，要求模型解决跨模态的语义等级对应。
Method: 基于CLIP双编码器，在视频侧加入时间Transformer（可学习位置编码+多头自注意力机制），并设计两阶段重排序流水线：先双编码器检索Top-K候选，再用带图像-文本匹配头的交叉编码器精化分数，训练使用对称多相似性损失。
Result: 在EK-100 MIR基准上平均mAP 67.97%，平均nDCG 82.92%。
Conclusion: 时间建模和跨模态精化对第一人称视频检索有效，但方法仅在单一挑战基准上验证，未涉及其他视频检索场景或零样本设置。

papers.title: Class-Dependent Hybrid Data Augmentation for Multiclass Migraine Classification under Severe Class Imbalance
papers.abstract_en: We conducted a reproducibility-oriented re-evaluation of prior migraine classification studies, correcting for data leakage and metric bias. We then introduced (i) a clinically motivated aggregation of two hemiplegic subtypes following ICHD-3 §1.2.3, (ii) a class-dependent hybrid augmentation strategy that assigns generation methods based on per-class sample size, and (iii) the concept of fidelity asymmetry, motivating proportionally constrained growth as an alternative to full class balance. Experiments were performed on a dataset of 400 patients across seven migraine subtypes under a two-stage protocol, including the six-class configuration described above. Models were evaluated using stratified 5-fold cross-validation with macro-averaged F1 as the primary metric. Correcting methodological flaws reduces previously inflated performance estimates, with the corrected macro-F1 baseline standing at 0.71. The proposed framework consistently outperformed individual augmenters in macro-F1 averaged across the eight evaluated classifiers (0.862 vs. 0.836 for Gaussian Copula, 0.815 for CTGAN, and 0.801 for the no-augmentation baseline), and achieved its peak result of 0.914 with FT-Transformer under proportional augmentation. The no-augmentation FT-Transformer baseline (0.896) shows that, at the per-classifier ceiling, clinically motivated class aggregation accounts for most of the absolute improvement; the framework's principal measurable contribution is the gain in average robustness across classifiers, highlighting the dominant role of problem formulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对先前的偏头痛分类研究进行可重复性评估，纠正了数据泄露和指标偏差。提出了基于ICHD-3标准的两类半偏头痛亚型临床聚合、基于类别样本量的混合数据增强策略，以及保真度不对称概念。在400名患者七个子类型的数据集上，使用分层5折交叉验证，校正后的宏平均F1基线为0.71。所提框架在八个分类器上的平均宏平均F1达到0.862，优于单独增强器；FT-Transformer在比例增强下取得最高0.914。
Motivation: 现有的偏头痛分类研究存在方法学缺陷（数据泄露、指标偏差），且严重类别不平衡导致性能评估失真，需要更可靠的框架。
Method: 提出类别依赖的混合增强策略，根据每类样本量分配生成方法；引入临床驱动的亚型聚合（合并两种半偏头痛亚型）；提出保真度不对称概念，采用比例约束增长而非完全平衡。
Result: 校正后基线宏平均F1为0.71；所提框架在八个分类器上的平均宏平均F1为0.862，优于高斯Copula(0.836)和CTGAN(0.815)；FT-Transformer在比例增强下达到0.914。
Conclusion: 临床驱动的类别聚合贡献了大部分绝对改进，框架的主要可衡量贡献是提升跨分类器的平均鲁棒性，问题公式化占主导地位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reflex: Reinforcement Learning with Reflection Symmetry Exploitation in State-Based Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has long struggled with poor sample efficiency. One promising approach to mitigate this problem is leveraging group-invariant Markov Decision Processes ($G$-invariant MDPs). Existing works in this direction have primarily focused on image-based RL and rotational symmetry such as $\mathrm{SO(2)}$, leaving state-based RL and reflection symmetry largely underexplored. In this work, we focus on state-based continuous control tasks and exploit reflection symmetry by introducing Reflex, a paradigm that seamlessly integrates with both on-policy and off-policy RL algorithms. We formalize two types of reflection-axial reflection and bilateral reflection, and characterize their corresponding transformations. Building on a theoretical analysis of symmetry-preserving optimal value functions and policies, Reflex integrates reflection symmetry into policy learning through principled symmetry regularization mechanisms. We integrate Reflex with PPO and SAC, and evaluate it on a suite of OpenAI Gym and DeepMind Control benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance over standard baselines while improving sample efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/Reflex.
papers.comment: Some of the data in the paper contain errors and need to be confirmed for modification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reflex，一种利用反射对称性（轴向反射和双侧反射）来提升状态连续控制强化学习样本效率的方法。该方法形式化两种反射对称性及其变换，基于对称保持最优值函数和策略的理论分析，通过对称性正则化机制无缝集成到 PPO 和 SAC 算法中，在 OpenAI Gym 和 DeepMind Control 基准上展现了优于标准基线的性能和样本效率。
Motivation: 现有利用组不变性 MDP 的工作主要关注图像 RL 和旋转对称性（如 SO(2)），忽略了状态 RL 和反射对称性。
Method: 形式化轴向反射和双侧反射两种对称性及其变换，基于对称保持最优值函数和策略的理论分析，提出对称性正则化机制整合到策略学习中，并集成到 PPO 和 SAC。
Result: 在 OpenAI Gym 和 DeepMind Control 基准上，Reflex 展现了优于标准基线（PPO/SAC）的性能并提升了样本效率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明利用反射对称性可以有效提升状态连续控制 RL 的样本效率。

papers.title: The ASE-LSE Disagreement Landscape: An End-to-End Characterisation of Extremes and Structural Drivers
papers.abstract_en: Two of the most widely used methods for analysing graph data, Adjacency Spectral Embedding and Laplacian Spectral Embedding, often produce different results when applied to the same graph. Yet the structural reasons behind this disagreement remain incompletely understood. This paper provides an end-to-end account of ASE-LSE latent subspace disagreement. We first prove that the two methods produce identical latent subspaces for every embedding dimension whenever the Laplacian is a scalar multiple of the adjacency matrix, and show that this scalar relationship holds if and only if the graph is either regular or bipartite biregular. This anchor result identifies a sufficient condition for perfect agreement that pins down the floor of the disagreement spectrum and supplies the baseline for the perturbation analysis. We then prove that no maximal-disagreement graph or family of graphs exists: the disagreement is always strictly below its theoretical ceiling, and we exhibit a witness family demonstrating that no finite maximum is attainable, so the disagreement landscape has no maximiser. With both endpoints established, we derive a Regularity Departure Bound whose two terms isolate degree heterogeneity and eigengap as the primary structural factors influencing disagreement in the middle regime. Empirical validation across thousands of simulated graphs confirms the mechanisms predicted by the bound: heterogeneity pushes disagreement up, eigengap suppresses it, and their joint ratio emerges as a unified predictor of ASE-LSE disagreement, suggesting when the two embeddings can be treated as interchangeable and when they cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了邻接谱嵌入（ASE）与拉普拉斯谱嵌入（LSE）在相同图数据上产生不同潜在子空间的根本原因。作者首先证明了当图是正则或二分双正则时，两种嵌入完全一致；然后证明了不存在最大化不一致的图族；最后提出了正则性偏离界，将度异质性和特征间隙识别为影响不一致的主要结构因素。
Motivation: ASE和LSE是图数据分析中两种主流方法，但它们在相同图上的结果常常不同，而背后的结构原因尚未完全理解。
Method: 通过理论证明和扰动分析，建立ASE与LSE潜在子空间不一致的完整刻画：先确定完全一致的条件，再证明不一致无最大值的特性，最后推导正则性偏离界量化度异质性和特征间隙的影响。
Result: 理论证明：当且仅当图是正则或二分双正则时，ASE与LSE完全一致；不存在最大不一致的图族；度异质性增强不一致，特征间隙抑制不一致，两者的联合比可作为统一的预测指标。数千模拟图上的实验验证了这些机制。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了ASE与LSE不一致的完整理论图景，并给出了在实践中判断两种嵌入何时可互换的指导标准。

papers.title: Scalable Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Batch Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Conventional wisdom holds that large-batch training is fundamentally incompatible with Reinforcement Learning (RL) - beyond a modest threshold, increasing batch sizes typically yields diminishing returns or performance degradation due to the inherent non-stationarity of the data distribution. We challenge this view by observing that non-stationarity is not a fixed property of RL, but evolves throughout training: early stages exhibit rapid behavioral shifts that demand small batches for plasticity, whereas late stages approach a quasi-stationary regime where large batches enable precise convergence. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Batch Scaling (ABS), that dynamically adjusts the effective batch size according to the stability of the learning policy. Central to ABS is Behavioral Divergence, a novel metric that quantifies policy non-stationarity by measuring action-level shifts between consecutive updates, which we use to scale batch size inversely to policy volatility. Integrated with the Parallelised Q-Network (PQN) algorithm and evaluated on the ALE benchmark, ABS seamlessly reconciles early-stage plasticity with late-stage stable convergence. Strikingly, contrary to conventional wisdom, our results reveal that the combination of larger networks and larger batch sizes achieves the best performance - a scaling behavior previously thought to be unattainable in RL, now unlocked through adaptive batch control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了强化学习中大批量训练会导致性能下降的传统观点，提出自适应批量缩放（ABS）方法，根据策略稳定性动态调整批量大小。在ALE基准上结合PQN算法评估，证明大批量和大网络的组合在自适应控制下可实现最佳性能，打破了以往认为RL中不可行的缩放行为。
Motivation: 传统观点认为RL中大批量训练会导致收益递减或性能下降，根源在于数据分布的非平稳性。本文观察到非平稳性随训练阶段变化，早期需要小批量保持塑性，后期可批量增大以实现精确收敛。
Method: 提出自适应批量缩放（ABS），通过行为散度（Behavioral Divergence）量化策略的非平稳性，根据策略波动性反比调整批量大小。与并行Q网络（PQN）算法集成，在ALE基准上评估。
Result: 与常规做法相反，结合大网络和大批量在自适应批量控制下实现了最佳性能，表明此前被认为在RL中不可行的缩放行为成为可能。
Conclusion: ABS有效兼顾了早期塑性和后期稳定收敛，证明了在RL中通过动态批量控制可以解锁大规模训练的潜力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文挑战了强化学习中大批量训练会导致性能下降的传统观点，提出自适应批量缩放（ABS）方法，根据策略稳定性动态调整批量大小。在ALE基准上结合PQN算法评估，证明大批量和大网络的组合在自适应控制下可实现最佳性能，打破了以往认为RL中不可行的缩放行为。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统观点认为RL中大批量训练会导致收益递减或性能下降，根源在于数据分布的非平稳性。本文观察到非平稳性随训练阶段变化，早期需要小批量保持塑性，后期可批量增大以实现精确收敛。
summary_sections.method: 提出自适应批量缩放（ABS），通过行为散度（Behavioral Divergence）量化策略的非平稳性，根据策略波动性反比调整批量大小。与并行Q网络（PQN）算法集成，在ALE基准上评估。
summary_sections.result: 与常规做法相反，结合大网络和大批量在自适应批量控制下实现了最佳性能，表明此前被认为在RL中不可行的缩放行为成为可能。
summary_sections.conclusion: ABS有效兼顾了早期塑性和后期稳定收敛，证明了在RL中通过动态批量控制可以解锁大规模训练的潜力。

papers.title: Toto 2.0: Time Series Forecasting Enters the Scaling Era
papers.abstract_en: We show that time series foundation models scale: a single training recipe produces reliable forecast-quality improvements from 4M to 2.5B parameters. We release Toto 2.0, a family of five open-weights forecasting models trained under this recipe. The Toto 2.0 family sets a new state of the art on three forecasting benchmarks: BOOM, our observability benchmark; GIFT-Eval, the standard general-purpose benchmark; and the recent contamination-resistant TIME benchmark. This report describes our experimental results and details the design decisions behind Toto 2.0: its architecture and training recipe, training data, and the u-muP hyperparameter transfer pipeline. All five base checkpoints are released under Apache 2.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了时间序列基础模型的可扩展性：从4M到2.5B参数范围内，单一训练方案即可稳定提升预测质量。发布了Toto 2.0系列五个开源权重模型，在BOOM、GIFT-Eval和TIME三个基准上取得新SOTA。报告详细描述了架构、训练方案、数据以及u-muP超参数迁移管线。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型是否具备类似语言/视觉模型的可扩展性尚未得到系统验证，且缺乏统一的高质量开源系列。
Method: 提出统一的训练方案，涵盖架构设计、训练数据构建和u-muP超参数迁移管线，训练参数规模从4M到2.5B。
Result: Toto 2.0系列在BOOM、GIFT-Eval和TIME基准上均达到新SOTA。
Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型可以稳定扩展，开源系列可能推动该领域规模化研究。

papers.title: When Preference Labels Fall Short: Aligning Diffusion Models from Real Data
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment aims to guide generative models by learning from comparisons between preferred and non-preferred samples. In practice, most existing approaches rely on preference pairs constructed from model-generated images. Such supervision is inherently relative and can be ambiguous when both samples exhibit artifacts or limited visual quality, making it difficult to infer what constitutes a truly desirable output. In this work, we investigate whether real data can serve as an alternative source of supervision for preference alignment. We adopt a data-centric perspective and study a curation strategy that treats real images as reference points and constructs preference signals by contrasting them with generated or perturbed samples, without requiring manually annotated preference pairs. Through empirical analysis, we show that real-data-based supervision provides effective guidance for aligning diffusion models and achieves performance comparable to existing preference-based methods. Our results suggest that real data offers a practical and complementary source of supervision for preference alignment and highlight directions of label-efficient alignment strategies. Code and models are available at https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Camera Ready; Project Page: https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨在扩散模型偏好对齐中，使用真实数据替代模型生成图像作为监督信号的可行性。通过将真实图像作为参考，对比生成或扰动样本来构造偏好信号，无需人工标注。实验表明，基于真实数据的监督能达到与现有偏好方法相当的性能。
Motivation: 现有偏好对齐方法依赖模型生成图像构造偏好对，这种相对监督在两者都有瑕疵时难以明确理想输出。作者希望探索真实数据能否作为替代监督源。
Method: 采用数据中心的视角，设计一种筛选策略：以真实图像为参照，通过与生成或扰动样本对比获得偏好信号，不依赖人工标注偏好对。
Result: 基于真实数据的监督与现有偏好方法性能相当，表明真实数据可作为实用且互补的监督来源。
Conclusion: 真实数据为偏好对齐提供了一种标签高效的替代方案，并指出了进一步研究方向。

papers.title: MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MAVEN
papers.comment: [14] pages, [6] figures, [11] tables, appendix included. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAVEN，一个多智能体提示精炼框架，旨在提升单文化和跨文化文本到视频生成中的文化保真度。MAVEN将提示分解为人、动作和位置三个维度，由专门智能体并行或顺序处理。作者创建了包含243个文化提示和972个视频的基准，覆盖中国、美国和罗马尼亚三种文化。评估表明，多智能体精炼（特别是并行专业化）显著改善文化相关性，同时保持视觉质量和时间一致性。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频生成在视觉保真度上进展迅速，但在单个提示中忠实呈现多种文化的能力尚未充分探索。
Method: MAVEN多智能体框架，将提示分解为人物、动作、位置三个维度，由专门智能体并行或顺序处理，实现文化感知的提示精炼。
Result: 在243个文化提示和972个视频的基准上，结合CLIP指标、VLM-as-judge评估和视频质量度量，并行专业化方法显著提升文化相关性，同时保持视觉质量和时间一致性。
Conclusion: 论文强调多智能体提示精炼（尤其是并行专业化）能够在不牺牲视觉质量的前提下提升文本到视频生成的文化保真度。数据集和代码已开源。

papers.title: Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack)
papers.abstract_en: Neural architecture search (NAS) is a powerful approach for automating model design, but existing methods often optimize for accuracy alone or rely on proxy metrics such as bit operations (BOPs) that correlate poorly with hardware cost. This gap is particularly large for FPGA deployment, where cost is dominated by a multi-dimensional budget of lookup tables, DSPs, flip-flops, BRAM, and latency. We present the Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack), an open-source AutoML framework for hardware-aware neural architecture codesign and end-to-end FPGA deployment. SNAC-Pack runs a multi-objective global search with Optuna and NSGA-II, loading trials to a shared SQLite store that enables parallel workers across compute nodes. A hardware surrogate model outputs per-trial resource and latency estimates, avoiding the synthesis cost that would otherwise dominate the search loop. A local search stage then applies quantization-aware training (QAT) together with iterative magnitude pruning in a combined compression loop, after which the final model is synthesized to FPGA firmware via the hls4ml Python library. A YAML configuration and an optional agentic frontend let users run the pipeline on new datasets without modifying the framework. We demonstrate SNAC-Pack on jet classification at the Large Hadron Collider and superconducting qubit readout, discovering compact architectures that match or exceed strong baselines on the task metric while reducing FPGA resource utilization and, in the qubit readout case, reducing the design space exploration process from months of manual fine-tuning to hours of automated search.
papers.comment: 15 Pages, 3 Figures, AutoML (International Conference on Automated Machine Learning) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍SNAC-Pack，一个开源AutoML框架，用于硬件感知的神经架构协同设计和端到端FPGA部署。该框架使用多目标全局搜索（Optuna和NSGA-II）和硬件代理模型预测资源与延迟，避免合成开销。局部搜索阶段结合量化感知训练和迭代剪枝，最后通过hls4ml合成FPGA固件。在大型强子对撞机喷注分类和超导量子比特读出任务上展示了紧凑架构在匹配或超越任务指标的同时降低FPGA资源利用，并将设计空间探索从数月缩短至数小时。
Motivation: 现有NAS方法常仅优化精度或使用与硬件成本相关性差的代理指标（如BOPs），尤其对于FPGA部署，成本由多维预算（查找表、DSP等）决定，缺乏有效建模。
Method: 提出SNAC-Pack框架，包含：多目标全局搜索（Optuna和NSGA-II），通过共享SQLite存储支持并行工作节点；硬件代理模型预测每试次的资源和延迟；局部搜索阶段结合量化感知训练和迭代剪枝的压缩循环；最后通过hls4ml库合成FPGA固件；提供YAML配置和可选的智能体前端。
Result: 在喷注分类和超导量子比特读出任务上，发现的紧凑架构在任务度量上匹配或超越强基线，同时降低FPGA资源利用率，并将设计空间探索从数月手动微调减少到数小时自动化搜索。
Conclusion: SNAC-Pack提供了一个开源、硬件感知的神经架构协同设计框架，能够自动化端到端FPGA部署，显著加速设计空间探索。

papers.title: Towards Generalization of Block Attention via Automatic Segmentation and Block Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Block attention, which processes the input as separate blocks that cannot attend to one another, offers significant potential to improve KV cache reuse in long-context scenarios such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, its broader application is hindered by two key challenges: the difficulty of segmenting input text into meaningful, self-contained blocks, and the inefficiency of existing block fine-tuning methods that risk degrading performance. To address these, we first construct SemanticSeg, a large and diverse semantic segmentation dataset containing over 30k instances across 16 categories-including books, code, web text, and conversations with text lengths ranging from 2k to 32k. Using this dataset, we train a lightweight segmenter to automatically partition text into human-instinct-aligned blocks with controllable granularity. Second, we propose block distillation, a training framework that is more efficient than block fine-tuning, which uses a frozen full-attention teacher model to guide the block-attention student. This framework integrates three novel components: block sink tokens to mitigate information loss at block boundaries, block dropout to leverage training signals from all blocks, and token-level loss weighting to focus learning on block-attention-sensitive tokens. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that our segmenter outperforms heuristic and statistical baselines, and block distillation achieves near-full-attention performance under block attention, establishing a practical and scalable pathway for deploying block attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对块注意力（block attention）在长上下文场景（如RAG）中的泛化问题，提出自动分割和块蒸馏方法。首先构建了包含30k+实例的语义分割数据集SemanticSeg，训练轻量级分割器自动将文本划分为语义连贯的块。然后提出块蒸馏训练框架，通过冻结全注意力教师模型指导学生模型，并引入块sink token、块dropout和token级损失加权三个组件。实验表明分割器优于启发式基线，块蒸馏在多种模型和基准上接近全注意力性能。
Motivation: 块注意力在长上下文（如RAG）中可提升KV缓存复用，但面临两个挑战：难以将输入文本分割为有意义的自包含块，以及现有的块微调方法效率低且可能损害性能。
Method: 构建SemanticSeg数据集（30k+实例，16类别，文本长度2k-32k），训练轻量级分割器实现自动分割；提出块蒸馏框架，使用冻结的全注意力教师模型指导块注意力学生模型，并加入块sink token、块dropout和token级损失加权。
Result: 摘要报告分割器优于启发式和统计基线；块蒸馏在多种模型和基准上达到接近全注意力的性能。
Conclusion: 本文为部署块注意力提供了实用且可扩展的路径，解决了分割和训练效率问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning Models Don't Just Think Longer, They Move Differently
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-trained language models often spend more tokens on harder problems, but longer chains of thought do not show whether a model is merely computing for more steps or following a different internal trajectory. We study this distinction through hidden-state trajectories during chain-of-thought generation across competitive programming, mathematics, and Boolean satisfiability. Raw trajectory geometry is strongly shaped by generation length: longer generations mechanically alter path statistics, so difficulty-dependent comparisons are misleading without adjustment. After residualizing trajectory statistics on length, difficulty remains systematically coupled to corrected trajectory geometry across all domains studied. The clearest reasoning-specific separation appears in the code domain, where harder problems show more direct corrected trajectories and less heterogeneous local curvature in reasoning-trained models than in matched instruction-tuned baselines. Corrected difficulty-geometry coupling is weaker, but still present, in mathematics and Boolean satisfiability. Prompt-stage linear probes do not mirror the code-domain separation, and behavioral annotations show that stronger corrected coupling co-occurs with strategy shifts and uncertainty monitoring. Together, these findings establish length correction as a prerequisite for generation-time trajectory analysis and show that reasoning training can be associated with distinct corrected trajectory geometry, with the strength of the effect depending on the domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理训练的语言模型在链式思考生成过程中的隐藏状态轨迹。作者发现原始轨迹几何形状强烈受生成长度影响，需进行长度校正。校正后，难度与轨迹几何存在系统性耦合，尤其在编程领域，推理模型比指令微调基线表现出更直接的校正轨迹和更低的局部曲率异质性。数学和布尔可满足性问题中的耦合较弱。
Motivation: 现有研究仅关注推理模型在更难问题上生成更多token，但未区分是计算步数增加还是内部轨迹变化。本文旨在通过隐藏状态轨迹分析揭示推理训练是否导致不同的内部计算路径。
Method: 对链式思考生成过程中的隐藏状态轨迹进行几何分析，首先通过残差化校正生成长度对轨迹统计量的影响，然后分析校正后轨迹与问题难度的耦合关系，并在编程、数学和布尔可满足性三个领域进行对比。
Result: 校正后，难度与轨迹几何在所有领域均有耦合。编程领域中最明显：推理模型比指令微调基线有更直接的校正轨迹和更低的局部曲率异质性。数学和布尔可满足性问题中耦合较弱。
Conclusion: 长度校正是生成时轨迹分析的前提；推理训练可导致独特的校正轨迹几何，效应强度因领域而异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Exact Linear Attention (ELA), a mechanism that achieves linear computational complexity for Transformer attention by exploiting the exact decomposition property of kernel functions, thereby eliminating approximation error. We identify and address two key limitations of prior linear attention -- gradient explosion and token attention dilution -- by imposing kernel constraints that ensure non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability. Several kernel functions are proposed, including the Hadamard Exp Kernel, Summation Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, and Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, each tailored for specific attention behaviors. Beyond the core attention formulation, the paper presents three engineering innovations: (1) a Hyper-Link structure that replaces traditional residual connections to mitigate gradient degradation; (2) a Memory Lobe module based on bidirectional linear attention, which captures "transformation flow" across layers to implement qualitative memory and an implicit reinforcement learning paradigm; and (3) a routing-score-based bias mechanism for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to improve interpretability and semantic alignment. Experimental results demonstrate that ELA achieves up to 6x faster decoding speed and 75% reduction in KV cache memory usage compared to full attention, while maintaining comparable or superior training performance. The proposed memory module accelerates convergence and enhances generalization. Furthermore, we extend the linear attention principle to vision models, yielding YOLO-LAT, which attains up to 4.3x GPU inference speedup and 7.9x parameter reduction with competitive detection accuracy. These results underline the broad applicability of exact linear attention for scaling Transformer models to ultra-long sequences and efficient visual tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Exact Linear Attention (ELA)，通过核函数的精确分解实现线性复杂度，消除近似误差；针对梯度爆炸和token注意力稀释问题，引入非负、可区分和几何可解释的核约束；设计Hadamard Exp Kernel等核函数以及Hyper-Link、Memory Lobe、MoE路由分数偏置等工程创新。实验显示解码速度提升6倍，KV缓存减少75%，YOLO-LAT视觉模型GPU加速4.3倍、参数减少7.9倍。
Motivation: 先前线性注意力存在近似误差、梯度爆炸和token注意力稀释问题，限制了其在大模型中的应用。
Method: 利用核函数精确分解实现线性注意力，施加非负、可区分和几何可解释的核约束；提出多种核函数及Hyper-Link结构、双向线性注意力Memory Lobe模块、基于路由分数的MoE偏置。
Result: 解码速度提升6倍，KV缓存减少75%，训练性能相当或更优；YOLO-LAT视觉模型GPU加速4.3倍，参数减少7.9倍，检测精度有竞争力。
Conclusion: 精确线性注意力可有效扩展Transformer到超长序列和高效视觉任务，具有广泛适用性。

papers.title: Unified Pix Token And Word Token Generative Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Since the emergence of Vision Transformer (ViT), it has been widely used in generative language model and generative visual model. Especially in the current state-of-art open source multimodal models, ViT obtained by CLIP or SigLIP method serves as the vision encoder backbone to help them acquire visual understanding capabilities. But this method leads to limitations in visual understanding for details, such as difficulty in recognizing small text or numbers in images. To address these issues, we propose a new model to unify pix token and word token into the generative language model. The new model also features with each pix of image having its own token embedding, color folding, global conditional attention approximation and image unsupervised pretraining. We conducted image unsupervised pretraining experiments using our new model to explore its potential. The experimental results show that it has good performance even in small model and with limited training data. We believe our model also conforms to the scaling law, as long as model parameters and training data increased, its performance will continue to improve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一像素标记（pix token）和词标记（word token）的生成语言模型，旨在解决现有多模态模型（如基于CLIP/ViT的方法）在细粒度图像理解（如小文字或数字识别）上的不足。模型引入了每个像素独立嵌入、颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似及图像无监督预训练等特性。小规模模型和有限数据上的实验显示良好性能，并符合缩放定律。
Motivation: 现有基于CLIP或SigLIP的多模态模型在图像细节理解（如小文字或数字）上存在局限，需要一种更细粒度的视觉-语言统一生成模型。
Method: 提出新模型架构，统一处理像素标记和词标记，包括每个像素独立嵌入、颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似，并采用图像无监督预训练。
Result: 摘要报告小模型和有限训练数据上取得良好性能，且模型符合缩放定律（随参数和数据增加性能提升）。
Conclusion: 该模型在细粒度视觉理解上有潜力，但摘要未提及具体量化结果或与其他方法的对比，旨在探索统一像素与词标记的生成式建模。

papers.title: Quantifying Sensitivity for Tree Ensembles: A symbolic and compositional approach
papers.abstract_en: Decision tree ensembles (DTE) are a popular model for a wide range of AI classification tasks, used in multiple safety critical domains, and hence verifying properties on these models has been an active topic of study over the last decade. One such verification question is the problem of sensitivity, which asks, given a DTE, whether a small change in subset of features can lead to misclassification of the input. In this work, our focus is to build a quantitative notion of sensitivity, tailored to DTEs, by discretizing the input space of the model and enumerating the regions which are susceptible to sensitivity. We propose a novel algorithmic technique that can perform this computation efficiently, within a certified error and confidence bound. Our approach is based on encoding the problem as an algebraic decision diagram (ADD), and further splitting it into subproblems that can be solved efficiently and make the computation compositional and scalable. We evaluate the performance of our technique over benchmarks of varying size in terms of number of trees and depth, comparing it against the performance of model counters over the same problem encoding. Experimental results show that our tool XCount achieves significant speedup over other approaches and can scale well with the increasing sizes of the ensembles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对决策树集成（DTE）的敏感性验证问题，提出一种量化敏感性的新方法，通过离散化输入空间并枚举易受敏感性影响的区域。算法基于代数决策图（ADD）编码，将问题分解为可组合的子问题，从而实现高效且可扩展的计算。实验表明，工具XCount在不同规模的基准上相比其他方法（如模型计数）显著加速。
Motivation: 决策树集成在安全关键领域广泛应用，现有敏感性验证缺乏定量分析，难以评估输入特征的微小变化对分类结果的影响程度。
Method: 提出一种基于代数决策图（ADD）的量化敏感性算法，将原问题编码为ADD并递归分解为子问题，利用符号计算和组合方法在保证误差和置信界的前提下高效计算敏感性区域。
Result: 工具XCount在多个不同树数量和深度的基准上相比模型计数方法取得显著加速，且能随集成规模扩大保持良好的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 本文提供的量化敏感性方法可有效用于决策树集成的安全验证，并具备扩展到其他集成模型和验证属性的潜力。

papers.title: Scaling few-shot spoken word classification with generative meta-continual learning
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot spoken word classification has largely been developed for applications where a small number of classes is considered, and so the potential of larger-scale few-shot spoken word classification remains untapped. This paper investigates the potential of a spoken word classifier to sequentially learn to distinguish between 1000 classes when it is given only five shots per class. We demonstrate that this scaling capability exists by training a model using the Generative Meta-Continual Learning (GeMCL) algorithm and comparing it to repeatedly trained or finetuned baselines. We find that GeMCL produces exceptionally stable performance, and although it does not always outperform a repeatedly fully-finetuned HuBERT model nor a frozen HuBERT model with a repeatedly trained classifier head, it produces comparable performance to the latter while adapting 2000 times faster, having been trained less than half of the data for two orders of magnitude less time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索少样本口语单词分类扩展到1000类的可行性，使用生成式元持续学习（GeMCL）算法训练模型，仅每类5个样本。实验表明GeMCL性能稳定，与冻结HuBERT加重复训练的分类头性能相当，但适应速度快2000倍，训练数据少一半，时间少两个数量级。
Motivation: 现有少样本口语分类通常针对少量类别，大规模少样本分类的潜力尚未开发，本文旨在验证扩展到1000类的可能性。
Method: 采用生成式元持续学习（GeMCL）算法训练模型，并与重复训练或微调的HuBERT基线（完全微调、冻结HuBERT加重复训练分类头）进行比较。
Result: GeMCL产生异常稳定的性能；虽未始终优于完全微调的HuBERT，但与冻结HuBERT加重复训练分类头性能相当，但适应速度快2000倍，训练数据少于一半，耗时少两个数量级。
Conclusion: GeMCL展示了在少样本口语分类中实现大规模学习的潜力，提供了效率与性能的权衡。

papers.title: Coreset-Induced Conditional Velocity Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: We propose Coreset-Induced Conditional Velocity Flow Matching (CCVFM), a generative model that augments hierarchical rectified flow with a data-informed source distribution. Hierarchical flow matching models the full conditional velocity law in velocity space, but its inner flow is asked to transport isotropic Gaussian noise to a multimodal target velocity distribution from scratch. Our key observation is that this inner source can be replaced by a closed-form surrogate built from a coreset of the target. CCVFM first compresses the target into weighted atoms using an entropic Sinkhorn coreset and lifts them to a Gaussian mixture. The induced conditional velocity law is then a closed-form Gaussian mixture that can be sampled without a learned neural sampler. A lightweight correction flow, trained from this exact surrogate source, then refines the remaining surrogate-to-target residual rather than learning an entire noise-to-data map. We prove that the surrogate transport cost equals the target--surrogate Wasserstein gap under an explicit compression assumption, whereas the noise-source analogue has a dimension-scale lower bound. We further characterize the conditional second moment of the direct surrogate-source training target and show that its source-dependent excess is small when the surrogate conditional law is close to the true conditional velocity law in mean and covariance. Empirically, on MNIST, CIFAR-10, ImageNet-32, and CelebA-HQ, the proposed method reaches competitive few-step generation under matched architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Coreset-Induced Conditional Velocity Flow Matching (CCVFM)，一种通过数据驱动的源分布增强分层整流流 (hierarchical rectified flow) 的生成模型。CCVFM 首先用 Sinkhorn 核集 (coreset) 将目标分布压缩为加权原子，并提升为高斯混合 (Gaussian mixture)，从而得到闭式的条件速度律。然后训练一个轻量级修正流来学习核集到目标的残差，而非完整的噪声到数据映射。理论分析表明，该方法的传输代价与目标-核集 Wasserstein 差距相关，且条件二阶矩的源依赖误差较小。在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-32 和 CelebA-HQ 上，该方法在匹配架构下达到有竞争力的少步生成。
Motivation: 分层流匹配要求内层流将各向同性高斯噪声传输到多模态目标速度分布，学习难度大。本文提出用核集构建闭式代理源分布，降低学习负担。
Method: 使用熵 Sinkhorn 核集将目标压缩为加权原子，构造成高斯混合作为源分布；然后从该代理源训练轻量级修正流，学习残差映射。
Result: 在多个图像数据集上达到与匹配架构下少步生成竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 通过核集诱导的代理源可有效降低流匹配的学习复杂度，理论保证传输代价与 Wasserstein 差距相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProfiliTable: Profiling-Driven Tabular Data Processing via Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Table processing-including cleaning, transformation, augmentation, and matching-is a foundational yet error-prone stage in real-world data pipelines. While recent LLM-based approaches show promise for automating such tasks, they often struggle in practice due to ambiguous instructions, complex task structures, and the lack of structured feedback, resulting in syntactically correct but semantically flawed code. To address these challenges, we propose ProfiliTable, an autonomous multi-agent framework centered on dynamic profiling, which constructs and iteratively refines a unified execution context through interactive exploration, knowledge-augmented synthesis, and feedback-driven refinement. ProfiliTable integrates (i) a Profiler that performs ReAct-style data exploration to build semantic understanding, (ii) a Generator that retrieves curated operators to synthesize task-aware code, and (iii) an Evaluator-Summarizer loop that injects execution scores and diagnostic insights to enable closed-loop refinement. Extensive experiments on a diverse benchmark covering 18 tabular task types demonstrate that ProfiliTable consistently outperforms strong baselines, particularly in complex multi-step scenarios. These results highlight the critical role of dynamic profiling in reliably translating ambiguous user intents into robust and governance-compliant table transformations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProfiliTable 是一个基于动态分析（dynamic profiling）的多智能体框架，用于自动化表格数据处理（清洗、转换、增强、匹配）。它通过 ReAct 风格的数据探索、知识增强的代码生成和闭环反馈优化来应对模糊指令和复杂任务。在覆盖 18 种表格任务类型的基准测试上，该框架持续优于强基线，尤其在多步复杂场景中表现突出。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的自动化表格处理方法常因指令模糊、任务结构复杂和缺乏结构化反馈而产生语法正确但语义有误的代码。
Method: 提出 ProfiliTable 框架，包含三个核心组件：Profiler（执行 ReAct 风格数据探索以建立语义理解）、Generator（检索 curated 算子合成任务感知代码）、Evaluator-Summarizer（注入执行分数和诊断见解实现闭环优化）。
Result: 在 18 种表格任务类型的基准测试上，ProfiliTable 持续优于强基线，尤其在复杂多步场景中表现更优。
Conclusion: 动态分析（dynamic profiling）对于可靠地将模糊用户意图转化为鲁棒且合规的表格转换至关重要。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Macro: Enhancing Multilingual Counterfactual Explanations through Alignment-as-Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Self-generated counterfactual explanations (SCEs) are minimally modified inputs (minimality) generated by large language models (LLMs) that flip their own predictions (validity), offering a causally grounded approach to unraveling black-box LLM behavior. Yet extending them beyond English remains challenging: existing methods struggle to produce valid SCEs in non-dominant languages, and a persistent trade-off between validity and minimality undermines explanation quality. We introduce Macro, a preference alignment framework that applies Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to multilingual SCE generation, using a composite scoring function to construct preference pairs that effectively translate the trade-off into measurable preference signals. Experiments across four LLMs and seven typologically diverse languages show that Macro improves validity by 12.55\% on average over the chain-of-thought baseline without degrading minimality, while avoiding the severe minimality violations of the translation-based baseline. Compared to supervised fine-tuning, Macro achieves superior performance on both metrics, confirming that explicit preference optimization is essential for balancing this trade-off. Further analyses reveal that Macro increases cross-lingual perturbation alignment and mitigates common generation errors. Our results highlight preference optimization as a promising direction for enhancing multilingual model explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Macro 框架，利用直接偏好优化 (DPO) 提升大语言模型在多语言场景下自生成反事实解释 (SCE) 的有效性与最小性之间的平衡，实验显示在多种语言上有效性平均提升 12.55%，且不牺牲最小性。
Motivation: 现有多语言反事实解释方法在非主流语言上难以生成有效的 SCE，且有效性与最小性之间存在难以权衡的问题，影响解释质量。
Method: Macro 通过一个复合评分函数构造偏好对，将有效性与最小性的权衡转化为可测量的偏好信号，并应用 DPO 进行偏好对齐训练。
Result: 在四个大语言模型和七种跨语言实验上，Macro 相比基线链式思维方法平均提升有效性 12.55%，且不降低最小性；相比翻译基线避免了严重的最小性破坏；相比监督微调在两项指标上均更优。
Conclusion: 明确偏好优化对于平衡多语言反事实解释中有效性与最小性的权衡至关重要，该方法有助于增强多语言模型解释能力。

papers.title: LLMs for Secure Hardware Design and Related Problems: Opportunities and Challenges
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and hardware security is rapidly reshaping the semiconductor industry. While LLMs offer unprecedented capabilities in generating Register Transfer Level (RTL) code, automating testbenches, and bridging the semantic gap between high-level specifications and silicon, they simultaneously introduce severe vulnerabilities. This comprehensive review provides an in-depth analysis of the state-of-the-art in LLM-driven hardware design, organized around key advancements in EDA synthesis, hardware trust, design for security, and education. We systematically expand on the methodologies of recent breakthroughs -- from reasoning-driven synthesis and multi-agent vulnerability extraction to data contamination and adversarial machine learning (ML) evasion. We integrate general discussions on critical countermeasures, such as dynamic benchmarking to combat data memorization and aggressive red-teaming for robust security assessment. Finally, we synthesize cross-cutting lessons learned to guide future research toward secure, trustworthy, and autonomous design ecosystems.
papers.comment: Accepted for 2026 IEEE Computer Society Annual Symposium on VLSI (ISVLSI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面综述了大语言模型（LLM）在电子设计自动化（EDA）和硬件安全中的集成应用，涵盖RTL代码生成、测试台自动化、硬件信任、设计安全及教育等方面，同时分析了数据污染、对抗性机器学习规避等新漏洞，并讨论了动态基准测试和红队测试等应对措施。
Motivation: LLM在硬件设计中的潜力与安全风险并存，亟需系统性梳理现有进展与挑战，以指导未来研究。
Method: 以综述形式组织LLM驱动的硬件设计突破，从推理驱动综合、多智能体漏洞提取到对抗性ML规避，并整合关键对策讨论。
Result: 无具体实验数字，但总结了LLM在EDA合成、安全评估等方面的能力与脆弱性。
Conclusion: 强调需要动态基准测试、红队测试等机制来构建安全、可信、自主的设计生态系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fault tolerance estimation in digital circuits with visualised generative networks
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new numerical method to estimate the fault tolerance of failure modes in digital circuit structures with a generative network sampling technique. From a random input of generated bitwise configurations of ideally digitalised analog currents in the digital circuit design with classical logical gates, expected output currents are compared to the realistic signals of a numerical experiment at the discriminator part of the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to calculate the deviation from ideal digital electronic signals, including various error modes, such as missing or interchanged logical devices. From the present analysis of a representation of the GAN in terms of complex variables, it is possible to evaluate the robustness in electronic designs by differentiating the impact of failure modes associated with different classical logical elements in the circuit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的数字电路容错估计新方法。通过生成随机比特位配置并与理想信号比较，评估不同故障模式（如逻辑门缺失或互换）对电路输出偏差的影响，从而量化电路设计的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 数字电路设计中需要评估故障容错能力，但传统方法计算复杂或精度有限。本文利用生成网络采样技术，提供一种数值估计手段。
Method: 基于GAN框架：生成器产生随机数字电路电流的比特位配置，判别器将理想输出与实际数值实验信号对比，计算偏差，并引入复数变量分析来区分不同逻辑元件的故障模式影响。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明方法能够评估电路鲁棒性并区分不同逻辑元件的故障模式。
Conclusion: 该方法通过生成对抗网络和复数变量分析，为数字电路容错估计提供了新途径，可区分不同故障模式的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Attention Beats Fourier: Multi-Scale Transformers for PDE Solving on Irregular Domains
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of \emph{architecture selection} for deep learning models trained to solve partial differential equations (PDEs), asking when transformer-based architectures with learned attention outperform Fourier-domain neural operators. We introduce the \textbf{Multi-Scale Attention Transformer} (\msat{}), a deep learning architecture that encodes spatiotemporal solution histories as token sequences and trains end-to-end via a composite supervised objective with optional physics-informed regularization terms. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation against nine baselines -- including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), neural operators (FNO, DeepONet, GNOT), and state-space models (Mamba-NO) -- across five benchmark problems from the PINNacle suite, using identical train/test splits and reference data for all methods. \msat{} achieves state-of-the-art generalization on complex geometry problems ($L^2_\mathrm{rel} = 0.0101$ on Heat2D-CG, a $3.7\times$ improvement over FNO) at $34\,\mathrm{s}$ total inference vs.\ $120{,}812\,\mathrm{s}$ for Mamba-NO. Ablation studies over the physics regularization component reveal a precise inductive bias tradeoff: physics priors reduce test error on diffusion-dominated problems but degrade generalization on chaotic and recirculating-flow regimes, directly characterizing the prior misspecification boundary. Approximation error bounds as a function of domain boundary complexity $κ$ provide a theoretical basis for these empirical findings and a principled rule for architecture selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用于求解偏微分方程（PDE）的深度学习架构选择，提出了多尺度注意力Transformer（MSAT），将时空解历史编码为token序列，并通过复合监督目标训练。在五个基准问题上的综合实验表明，MSAT在复杂几何问题上达到了最先进的泛化性能（Heat2D-CG上L2_rel=0.0101，比FNO提升3.7倍），推理速度远超Mamba-NO。消融实验揭示了物理正则化的归纳偏差权衡，并通过边界复杂度κ的近似误差界为架构选择提供了理论基础。
Motivation: 现有PDE求解方法中，基于傅里叶的神经算子（如FNO）在规则域上表现良好，但在不规则域上性能受限。Transformer架构虽然灵活，但缺乏系统的比较研究。本文旨在系统比较基于注意力的Transformer与傅里叶域神经算子，并引入一种新的多尺度注意力架构。
Method: 提出多尺度注意力Transformer（MSAT），将时空解历史编码为token序列，使用多尺度注意力机制捕获不同尺度的特征，通过端到端训练，可加入物理信息正则化。
Result: 在PINNacle套件的五个基准问题上，MSAT在复杂几何问题Heat2D-CG上达到L2_rel=0.0101，比FNO提升3.7倍，推理时间34秒，而Mamba-NO需120,812秒。消融显示物理先验在扩散主导问题上有益，但在混沌和回流问题上会损害泛化。
Conclusion: 近似误差边界关于域边界复杂度κ的理论分析为架构选择提供了理论指导，并直接刻画了先验错配边界。
Relevance: 65
