papers.title: Detecting Perspective Shifts in Multi-agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Generative models augmented with external tools and update mechanisms (or \textit{agents}) have demonstrated capabilities beyond intelligent prompting of base models. As agent use proliferates, dynamic multi-agent systems have naturally emerged. Recent work has investigated the theoretical and empirical properties of low-dimensional representations of agents based on query responses at a single time point. This paper introduces the Temporal Data Kernel Perspective Space (TDKPS), which jointly embeds agents across time, and proposes several novel hypothesis tests for detecting behavioral change at the agent- and group-level in black-box multi-agent systems. We characterize the empirical properties of our proposed tests, including their sensitivity to key hyperparameters, in simulations motivated by a multi-agent system of evolving digital personas. Finally, we demonstrate via natural experiment that our proposed tests detect changes that correlate sensitively, specifically, and significantly with a real exogenous event. As far as we are aware, TDKPS is the first principled framework for monitoring behavioral dynamics in black-box multi-agent systems -- a critical capability as generative agent deployment continues to scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时态数据核视角空间（TDKPS），用于在时间维度上联合嵌入多个黑盒智能体，并设计了若干假设检验来检测智能体个体或群体层面的行为变化。通过模拟数字人格演化系统和真实自然实验验证，该方法能敏感、特异且显著地检测与真实外生事件相关的变化。据作者所知，这是首个用于监测黑盒多智能体系统行为动态的框架。
Motivation: 随着多智能体系统的广泛应用，需要一种能随时间监测智能体行为变化的方法，但现有工作仅关注单一时间点的低维表示，缺乏跨时间的联合分析和统计检验框架。
Method: 提出 Temporal Data Kernel Perspective Space (TDKPS)，将多个智能体在不同时间点的响应联合嵌入到一个核空间中，并据此构造多种假设检验（如智能体级别和群体级别的行为变化检验）。通过模拟和真实实验评估超参数敏感性。
Result: 在模拟演化数字人格系统上，检验对关键超参数敏感；在真实自然实验中，检测到的变化与实际外生事件之间具有敏感、特异且显著的关联。
Conclusion: TDKPS 是首个面向黑盒多智能体系统行为动态监测的通用框架，有助于在智能体部署规模扩大时保持系统可控性。

papers.title: Efficient Asynchronous Federated Evaluation with Strategy Similarity Awareness for Intent-Based Networking in Industrial Internet of Things
papers.abstract_en: Intent-Based Networking (IBN) offers a promising paradigm for intelligent and automated network control in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) environments by translating high-level user intents into executable network strategies. However, frequent strategy deployment and rollback are impractical due to tightly coupled workflows and high downtime costs, while node heterogeneity and privacy constraints further complicate centralized strategy evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a Federated Evaluation Enhanced Intent-Based Networking framework (FEIBN), which leverages large language models (LLMs) to translate user intents into structured strategy tuples and employs federated learning to support distributed strategy evaluation. To improve training efficiency and reduce communication overhead, we design a Strategy Similarity Aware Federated Learning mechanism (SSAFL), which selects nodes relevant to the task based on strategy similarity and resource status, and triggers asynchronous model uploads only when local updates are significant. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method improves model accuracy, accelerates convergence, and reduces communication cost compared with the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FEIBN框架，利用大语言模型将用户意图转化为结构化策略元组，并通过联邦学习实现分布式策略评估。设计的SSAFL机制基于策略相似性和资源状态选择节点，仅在本地更新显著时异步上传模型，从而减少通信开销并加速收敛。实验表明该方法在模型精度、收敛速度和通信成本上均优于基线。
Motivation: 工业物联网中频繁部署和回滚策略不切实际，节点异构性和隐私约束使得集中式策略评估困难重重。
Method: 提出FEIBN框架，结合LLM进行意图翻译与联邦学习进行分布式评估；并设计SSAFL机制，根据策略相似性与资源状态选择节点，仅在本地模型更新显著时触发异步上传。
Result: 实验显示所提方法相比基线提升了模型精度，加速了收敛，并降低了通信成本。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效解决IIoT环境中基于意图的网络策略评估难题，兼顾效率与隐私。

papers.title: Escaping the Verifier: Learning to Reason via Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Training Large Language Models (LLMs) to reason often relies on Reinforcement Learning (RL) with task-specific verifiers. However, many real-world reasoning-intensive tasks lack verifiers, despite offering abundant expert demonstrations that remain under-utilized for reasoning-focused training. We introduce RARO (Relativistic Adversarial Reasoning Optimization), which learns strong reasoning capabilities from expert demonstrations alone via Inverse Reinforcement Learning. RARO sets up an adversarial game between a policy and a relativistic critic: the policy learns to mimic expert answers, while the critic aims to identify the experts among expert-policy answer pairs. Both the policy and the critic are trained jointly and continuously via RL, and we identify the key stabilization techniques required for robust learning. Empirically, RARO significantly outperforms strong verifier-free baselines across all evaluation tasks: +13.7% accuracy on Countdown (1.5B), +8.2% accuracy on DeepMath (7B), and +19.1% win-rate on Poetry Writing (7B) against expert poems. RARO also exhibits similar robust scaling trends as RL with verifiers. These results demonstrate that RARO effectively elicits strong reasoning performance from expert demonstrations alone, enabling robust reasoning learning even when task-specific verifiers are unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RARO (Relativistic Adversarial Reasoning Optimization)，一种通过逆强化学习从专家演示中训练 LLM 推理能力的方法，无需任务特定的验证器。RARO 设置策略与相对性评论者之间的对抗博弈，策略学习模仿专家答案，评论者区分专家与策略的答案对。实验表明，RARO 在 Countdown、DeepMath 和诗歌写作任务上显著优于无验证器的基线方法，分别提升 13.7%、8.2% 和 19.1%，并展现出与带验证器的 RL 相似的稳健缩放趋势。
Motivation: 许多现实世界的推理密集型任务缺乏任务特定的验证器，但拥有丰富的专家演示数据，这些数据在基于推理的训练中未被充分利用。现有方法依赖 RL 与验证器，而本文旨在仅从专家演示中学习强推理能力。
Method: 提出 RARO，基于逆强化学习，构建策略与相对性评论者之间的对抗博弈：策略学习模仿专家答案，评论者区分专家与策略生成的答案对。两者通过 RL 联合连续训练，并引入关键稳定技术确保鲁棒学习。
Result: 在 Countdown (1.5B) 上准确率提升 13.7%，DeepMath (7B) 上准确率提升 8.2%，Poetry Writing (7B) 上胜率提升 19.1%（对抗专家诗歌）。RARO 展现出类似带验证器的 RL 的稳健缩放趋势。
Conclusion: RARO 能从专家演示中有效激发强推理性能，即使没有任务特定验证器，也能实现鲁棒的推理学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Masks Can Be Distracting: On Context Comprehension in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to Autoregressive Language Models (ARLMs), leveraging a denoising objective that, in principle, should enable more uniform context utilisation. In this work, we examine the context comprehension abilities of MDLMs and uncover two key limitations. First, despite their more global training objective and bidirectional attention mechanism, similarly to ARLMS, MDLMs exhibit a strong locality bias: performance is highly sensitive to the position of relevant information within the input, favouring local over distant context. Second, we show that appending a large number of mask tokens--required for generation--can significantly degrade context comprehension. Through systematic ablations, we find that these masks act as distractors, reducing the model's ability to process relevant information. To address this, we introduce a mask-agnostic loss function that encourages predictions to remain invariant to the number of appended masks. Fine-tuning with this objective substantially mitigates the distracting effect of masks, improving robustness of MDLMs. Overall, our findings reveal critical limitations of the current MDLM training paradigm and provide actionable insights for building diffusion-based language models with stronger context comprehension.
papers.comment: Published at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了掩蔽扩散语言模型（MDLM）的上下文理解能力，发现两个关键局限：一是与自回归模型类似，MDLM 表现出强局部偏置，优先关注邻近上下文；二是生成时附加的大量掩码令牌会干扰模型处理相关信息。作者提出掩码无关损失函数（mask-agnostic loss）进行微调，显著缓解了掩码的干扰效应，提升了模型的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 MDLM 被期望能更均匀地利用上下文，但实际中其上下文理解能力存在未被探索的缺陷，尤其是掩码令牌的干扰效应。
Method: 通过系统消融实验揭示 MDLM 的局部偏置和掩码干扰问题，并提出一种掩码无关损失函数，鼓励预测在附加掩码数量变化时保持不变，以此微调模型。
Result: 微调后的 MDLM 在多个上下文理解任务上显著减轻了掩码的干扰效果，提高了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 当前 MDLM 训练范式在上下文理解方面存在关键局限，所提方法提供了可操作的改进方向，但研究仅限于语言模型领域。

papers.title: MSTN: A Lightweight and Fast Model for General TimeSeries Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series often exhibit strong non-stationarity, complex nonlinear dynamics, and behavior expressed across multiple temporal scales, from rapid local fluctuations to slow-evolving long-range trends. However, many contemporary architectures impose rigid, fixed-scale structural priors such as patch-based tokenization, predefined receptive fields, or frozen backbone encoders - which can over-regularize temporal dynamics and limit adaptability to abrupt high-magnitude events. To handle this, we introduce the Multi-scale Temporal Network (MSTN), a hybrid neural architecture grounded in an Early Temporal Aggregation principle. MSTN integrates three complementary components: (i) a multi-scale convolutional encoder that captures fine-grained local structure; (ii) a sequence modeling module that learns long-range dependencies through either recurrent or attention-based mechanisms; and (iii) a self-gated fusion stage incorporating squeeze-excitation and a single dense layer to dynamically reweight and fuse multi-scale representations. ETA ensures downstream modules operate in O(1) time, while the encoder retains O(L^2) (Transformer) or O(L) (BiLSTM). This design enables MSTN to flexibly model temporal patterns spanning milliseconds to extended horizons, while avoiding the computational burden typically associated with long-context models. Across extensive benchmarks covering imputation, long-term forecasting, classification, and cross-dataset generalization, MSTN achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing new best results on 21 of 27 datasets, while remaining lightweight (~0.40M params for MSTN-BiLSTM and ~1.06M for MSTN-Transformer) and suitable for low-latency inference (<1 sec, often in milliseconds), resource-constrained deployment.
papers.comment: 30 pages, published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSTN是一种轻量级、快速的通用时间序列分析模型，基于早期时间聚合（Early Temporal Aggregation）原理，结合多尺度卷积编码器、序列建模模块和自门控融合阶段。在21/27个数据集上取得最先进结果，参数量小（~0.40M~1.06M），推理延迟低（<1秒，常为毫秒级）。
Motivation: 现有时间序列模型使用固定的结构先验（如基于块的标记化、预定义感受野或冻结骨干编码器），过度正则化时间动态，难以适应突变事件。
Method: 提出多尺度时间网络（MSTN），包含：(i)多尺度卷积编码器捕获细粒度局部结构；(ii)序列建模模块（Transformer或BiLSTM）学习长程依赖；(iii)自门控融合阶段（squeeze-excitation加单密集层）动态重加权融合多尺度表示。早期时间聚合原则使下游模块在O(1)时间内运行。
Result: 在插补、长期预测、分类和跨数据集泛化基准上，MSTN在27个数据集中的21个达到最佳性能。MSTN-BiLSTM参数量约0.40M，MSTN-Transformer约1.06M，推理时间<1秒（通常毫秒级）。
Conclusion: MSTN通过早期时间聚合和混合架构实现了灵活多尺度建模，同时保持轻量和低延迟，适用于资源受限部署。

summary_sections.tldr: MSTN是一种轻量级、快速的通用时间序列分析模型，基于早期时间聚合（Early Temporal Aggregation）原理，结合多尺度卷积编码器、序列建模模块和自门控融合阶段。在21/27个数据集上取得最先进结果，参数量小（~0.40M~1.06M），推理延迟低（<1秒，常为毫秒级）。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有时间序列模型使用固定的结构先验（如基于块的标记化、预定义感受野或冻结骨干编码器），过度正则化时间动态，难以适应突变事件。
summary_sections.method: 提出多尺度时间网络（MSTN），包含：(i)多尺度卷积编码器捕获细粒度局部结构；(ii)序列建模模块（Transformer或BiLSTM）学习长程依赖；(iii)自门控融合阶段（squeeze-excitation加单密集层）动态重加权融合多尺度表示。早期时间聚合原则使下游模块在O(1)时间内运行。
summary_sections.result: 在插补、长期预测、分类和跨数据集泛化基准上，MSTN在27个数据集中的21个达到最佳性能。MSTN-BiLSTM参数量约0.40M，MSTN-Transformer约1.06M，推理时间<1秒（通常毫秒级）。
summary_sections.conclusion: MSTN通过早期时间聚合和混合架构实现了灵活多尺度建模，同时保持轻量和低延迟，适用于资源受限部署。

papers.title: Harmonious Parameter Adaptation in Continual Visual Instruction Tuning for Safety-Aligned MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: While continual visual instruction tuning (CVIT) has shown promise in adapting multimodal large language models (MLLMs), existing studies predominantly focus on models without safety alignment. This critical oversight ignores the fact that real-world MLLMs inherently require such mechanisms to mitigate potential risks. In this work, we shift our focus to CVIT for safety-aligned MLLMs and observe that during continual adaptation, the model not only suffers from task forgetting but also exhibits degradation in its safety. Achieving a harmonious balance between safety and task performance remains a crucial challenge. To address this, we propose Harmonious Parameter Adaptation (HPA), a post-training framework composed of focusing-based parameter partition, harmoniously balanced parameter selection, and orthogonal parameter adjustment. Specifically, HPA partitions parameters into two types based on their focus on safety or task performance, and selects the focused ones to preserve from a balanced perspective. In addition, HPA imposes orthogonality constraints on parameter updates to further alleviate catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments on the CVIT benchmark and safety evaluation datasets demonstrate that HPA better maintains high safety and mitigates forgetting than existing baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Minato-Zackie/HPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注安全对齐的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在持续视觉指令调优（CVIT）中的问题，发现模型不仅面临任务遗忘，安全性能也会退化。为此提出调和参数适应（HPA）框架，通过聚焦参数划分、平衡选择和正交调整，在CVIT基准和安全评估数据集上优于现有基线，同时保持高安全性并缓解遗忘。
Motivation: 现有CVIT研究主要针对未做安全对齐的模型，忽略了实际MLLMs需要安全机制。在持续适应中，模型不仅遗忘任务，安全性能也会下降，缺乏在安全与任务性能间取得平衡的方法。
Method: 提出HPA后训练框架：首先根据参数对安全或任务的聚焦程度进行划分；然后从平衡角度选择需保留的聚焦参数；最后对参数更新施加正交约束，以缓解灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在CVIT基准和安全评估数据集上，HPA比现有基线在保持高安全性和缓解遗忘方面表现更优。
Conclusion: HPA能有效平衡安全对齐与任务性能，并缓解持续学习中的遗忘问题。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rotation-Parameterized Graph Fractional Fourier Transform: Definition, Properties, and Optimal Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Graph spectral representations are fundamental in graph signal processing, providing a rigorous frameworkforanalyzing graph-structured data. The graph fractional Fourier transform (GFRFT) extends the graph Fourier transform (GFT) through a fractional-order parameter, enabling flexible spectral analysis with mathematical consistency. The angular graph Fourier transform (AGFT) further introduces angular control by rotating GFT eigenvectors; however, existing constructions may fail to reduce exactly to the GFT at zero angle, weakening theoretical consistency and interpretability. To address these complementary limitations, namely the lack of rotation-based basis control in GFRFT and the defective zero-angle degeneracy of AGFT, this paper proposes the rotation-parameterized graph fractional Fourier transform (RP-GFRFT), which unifies fractional order and rotation-parameterized spectral analysis. A degeneracy preserving rotation matrix family is constructed to guarantee exact GFT reduction at zero angle. TwoRP-GFRFTvariants,I-RP-GFRFTandII-RP-GFRFT,arethenformulated, with theoretical analyses confirming their unitarity, invertibility, reduction behavior, and smooth parameter dependence. The fractional order and rotation angle are jointly optimized for adaptive graph spectral filtering. Experiments on real-world signals, images, and point clouds demonstrate that RP-GFRFT improves denoising accuracy, reconstruction quality, and feature preservation over GFRFT, AGFT, and representative filtering baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出旋转参数化图分数傅里叶变换（RP-GFRFT），统一分数阶和旋转参数化谱分析，解决现有图分数傅里叶变换缺乏旋转基控制以及角图傅里叶变换零角度退化的问题。构建了退化保持旋转矩阵族，保证零角度下精确还原为图傅里叶变换，并推导了两种变体的理论性质（酉性、可逆性、光滑参数依赖）。实验在真实信号、图像和点云数据上展示出去噪精度和重构质量的提升。
Motivation: 现有图分数傅里叶变换缺乏基于旋转的基控制，而角图傅里叶变换在零角度时不能退化为标准图傅里叶变换，理论一致性和可解释性不足。
Method: 构造一个退化保持旋转矩阵族，使变换在零角度时精确还原为图傅里叶变换；在此基础上定义两种RP-GFRFT变体，并联合优化分数阶和旋转角度以实现自适应图谱滤波。
Result: 在真实信号、图像和点云实验中，RP-GFRFT相比GFRFT、AGFT及其他代表性滤波基线，提高了去噪精度、重建质量和特征保持能力。
Conclusion: RP-GFRFT通过引入旋转参数统一了分数阶与旋转基控制，理论性质良好，并在若干应用场景中展示了优越的滤波性能。

papers.title: Facial-R1: Aligning Reasoning and Recognition for Facial Emotion Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Facial Emotion Analysis (FEA) extends traditional facial emotion recognition by incorporating explainable, fine-grained reasoning. The task integrates three subtasks: emotion recognition, facial Action Unit (AU) recognition, and AU-based emotion reasoning to model affective states jointly. While recent approaches leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and achieve promising results, they face two critical limitations: (1) hallucinated reasoning, where VLMs generate plausible but inaccurate explanations due to insufficient emotion-specific knowledge; and (2) misalignment between emotion reasoning and recognition, caused by fragmented connections between observed facial features and final labels. We propose Facial-R1, a three-stage alignment framework that effectively addresses both challenges with minimal supervision. First, we employ instruction fine-tuning to establish basic emotional reasoning capability. Second, we introduce reinforcement training guided by emotion and AU labels as reward signals, which explicitly aligns the generated reasoning process with the predicted emotion. Third, we design a data synthesis pipeline that iteratively leverages the prior stages to expand the training dataset, enabling scalable self-improvement of the model. Built upon this framework, we introduce FEA-20K, a benchmark dataset comprising 17,737 training and 1,688 test samples with fine-grained emotion analysis annotations. Extensive experiments across eight standard benchmarks demonstrate that Facial-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance in FEA, with strong generalization and robust interpretability.

TL;DR: 本文提出Facial-R1框架，通过三阶段对齐（指令微调、强化训练、数据合成）解决面部情感分析中的幻觉推理和推理与识别不对齐问题，并构建FEA-20K基准数据集，在多个标准基准上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在面部情感分析中存在幻觉推理和推理与识别不对齐的问题。
Method: 三阶段对齐框架：指令微调建立基础推理能力，强化训练以情绪和AU标签为奖励信号对齐推理与预测，数据合成流水线迭代扩展训练集。
Result: 在八个标准基准上达到最先进性能，具备强泛化性和鲁棒可解释性。
Conclusion: Facial-R1有效解决了面部情感分析中的两大关键限制，并展示了可扩展的自我改进能力。

papers.title: Selective Sinkhorn Routing for Improved Sparse Mixture of Experts
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models are scalable and computationally efficient, enabling large increases in model capacity with limited inference overhead. Existing SMoE methods often depend on auxiliary objectives, such as load-balancing loss and z-loss, or additional trainable components such as noisy gating. While these techniques encourage expert diversity, they can introduce objective misalignment, increase model complexity, or incur substantial training overhead, especially in Sinkhorn-based routing methods. In this paper, we revisit the token-to-expert assignment as an optimal transport problem. We add constraints to ensure balanced expert utilization. We show that even minimal optimal transport-based routing improves SMoE performance without requiring auxiliary balancing losses. Unlike prior approaches, our method derives gating scores directly from the transport map, leading to more balanced and effective token-to-expert assignments. Building on this insight, we introduce Selective Sinkhorn Routing (SSR), a lightweight routing mechanism that replaces complex auxiliary losses with efficient Sinkhorn-based routing while preserving flexible expert selection. Experiments on language modeling and image classification show that SSR improves training efficiency, accuracy, and robustness to input corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性Sinkhorn路由（Selective Sinkhorn Routing, SSR），一种用于稀疏混合专家（SMoE）模型的轻量级路由机制。该方法将token到专家的分配视为最优传输问题，通过添加约束确保专家平衡利用，直接从传输图导出门控分数，无需辅助平衡损失。在语言建模和图像分类任务上，SSR提升了训练效率、准确率和对输入损坏的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有SMoE方法通常依赖辅助目标（如负载平衡损失、z-loss）或额外可训练组件（如噪声门控），这些可能导致目标不对齐、模型复杂度增加或训练开销大，尤其在基于Sinkhorn的路由方法中更为突出。
Method: 将token-to-expert分配建模为最优传输问题，添加约束以保证专家平衡利用；提出SSR，一种轻量级路由机制，直接从传输图导出门控分数，替代复杂的辅助损失，同时保持灵活的专家选择。
Result: 实验表明，SSR在语言建模和图像分类任务上提升了训练效率、准确率以及对输入损坏的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: SSR通过基于最优传输的轻量级路由，有效替代了复杂的辅助损失，实现了更平衡和有效的token-专家分配，提升了SMoE性能。

papers.title: PF$Δ$: A Benchmark Dataset for Power Flow under Load, Generation, and Topology Variations
papers.abstract_en: Power flow (PF) calculations are the backbone of real-time grid operations, across workflows such as contingency analysis (where repeated PF evaluations assess grid security under outages) and topology optimization (which involves PF-based searches over combinatorially large action spaces). Running these calculations at operational timescales or across large evaluation spaces remains a major computational bottleneck. Additionally, growing uncertainty in power system operations from the integration of renewables and climate-induced extreme weather also calls for tools that can accurately and efficiently simulate a wide range of scenarios and operating conditions. Machine learning methods offer a potential speedup over traditional solvers, but their performance has not been systematically assessed on benchmarks that capture real-world variability. This paper introduces PF$Δ$, a benchmark dataset for power flow that captures diverse variations in load, generation, and topology. PF$Δ$ contains 859,800 solved power flow instances spanning six different bus system sizes, capturing three types of contingency scenarios (N , N -1, and N -2), and including close-to-infeasible cases near steady-state voltage stability limits. We evaluate traditional solvers and GNN-based methods, highlighting key areas where existing approaches struggle, and identifying open problems for future research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/pfdelta/pfdelta/tree/main and our code with data generation scripts and model implementations is at https://github.com/MOSSLab-MIT/pfdelta.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了电力潮流基准数据集PFΔ，包含859800个已求解的潮流实例，覆盖6种不同规模的母线系统、三种故障场景（N、N-1、N-2）以及接近稳态电压稳定极限的近似不可行工况。评估了传统求解器和基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法，揭示了现有方法在处理某些变化场景时的不足，并为未来研究指明了开放问题。
Motivation: 电力潮流计算是实时电网运行的关键，在考虑可再生能源和气候极端天气带来的不确定性时，需要能准确高效模拟大量场景的工具，但现有机器学习方法缺乏能反映真实变异的系统基准评估。
Method: 构建PFΔ数据集，包含负载、发电和拓扑的多样化变化，涵盖六种不同大小的母线系统，三种故障类型（N、N-1、N-2），并包含接近稳态电压稳定极限的实例。使用传统求解器和GNN方法进行性能评估。
Result: 数据集包含859800个潮流实例，覆盖六种电网规模和三种故障场景。评估结果表明传统求解器和GNN方法在某些接近不可行的复杂场景下表现不佳。
Conclusion: PFΔ提供了反映真实世界变异的基准，有助于推动电力潮流机器学习方法的系统评估和改进，数据集和代码已公开。

papers.title: On Universality of Deep Equivariant Networks
papers.abstract_en: Universality results for equivariant neural networks remain rare. Those that do exist typically hold only in restrictive settings: either they rely on regular or higher-order tensor representations, leading to impractically high-dimensional hidden spaces, or they target specialized architectures, often confined to the invariant setting. This work develops a more general account. For invariant networks, we establish a universality theorem under separation constraints, showing that the addition of a fully connected readout layer secures approximation within the class of separation-constrained continuous functions. For equivariant networks, where results are even scarcer, we demonstrate that standard separability notions are inadequate and introduce the sharper criterion of $\textit{entry-wise separability}$. We show that with sufficient depth or with the addition of appropriate readout layers, equivariant networks attain universality within the entry-wise separable regime. Together with prior results showing the failure of universality for shallow models, our findings identify depth and readout layers as a decisive mechanism for universality, additionally offering a unified perspective that subsumes and extends earlier specialized results.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度等变神经网络（equivariant neural networks）的普遍性（universality）。现有普遍性结果多局限于高阶张量表示或特定架构，且主要针对不变网络。作者对不变网络证明了在分离约束下添加全连接读出层可实现逼近；对等变网络提出逐项可分性（entry-wise separability），并证明足够深度或读出层可使网络在该区域内达到普遍性。这些结果统一并扩展了先前工作。
Motivation: 等变神经网络的普遍性结果稀少且限制性强，缺乏更一般性的理论框架。
Method: 针对不变网络，在分离约束下引入全连接读出层；针对等变网络，提出逐项可分性概念，并分析深度与读出层对普遍性的影响。
Result: 摘要报告：不变网络在分离约束下可通过全连接读出层实现逼近；等变网络在足够深度或适当读出层时，在逐项可分区域内达到普遍性。
Conclusion: 深度和读出层是实现等变网络普遍性的关键机制，文章提供了一个涵盖并扩展先前结果的统一视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Correcting Prompt Dependence in LLM Benchmarks: A Bayesian Hierarchical Model with Embedding-Space Clustering
papers.abstract_en: LLM benchmarking metrics often misstate performance and uncertainty as they rely on two assumptions that frequently do not hold in practice: (i) a sufficient number of evaluations are available for classical inference, and (ii) test prompts are independent. We propose a corrective Bayesian hierarchical model with embedding-space clustering that provides robust performance metrics in limited-data settings while correcting for prompt dependence. We apply the approach to adversarial robustness benchmarks, showing consistent recovery of clustering structure, resulting in more reliable performance metrics, with 4-73% improvements to mean absolute errors and 40-450 unit improvements to expected log posterior densities.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 1st Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks, CTB@ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM基准测试中因提示依赖性和有限数据导致性能指标不准确的问题，提出一种基于贝叶斯层次模型和嵌入空间聚类的校正方法。该方法在对抗鲁棒性基准上验证，恢复了聚类结构，平均绝对误差改进4-73%，期望对数后验密度改进40-450单位。
Motivation: 现有LLM基准测试假设评估数量足够且测试提示独立，这在实际中常不成立，导致性能指标和不确定性估计失准。
Method: 提出贝叶斯层次模型与嵌入空间聚类相结合的方法，在有限数据设定下提供鲁棒的性能指标，并校正提示之间的依赖关系。
Result: 在对抗鲁棒性基准上，该方法一致恢复聚类结构，平均绝对误差改进4-73%，期望对数后验密度改进40-450单位。
Conclusion: 该方法可提高LLM基准测试中性能指标的可靠性和鲁棒性，特别适用于有限数据和提示依赖的情况。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Equilibrium Response of Atmospheric Machine-Learning Models to Uniform Sea Surface Temperature Warming
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models for the global atmosphere that are capable of producing stable, multi-year simulations of Earth's climate have recently been developed. However, the ability of these ML models to generalize beyond the training distribution remains an open question. In this study, we evaluate the climate response of several state-of-the-art ML models (ACE2-ERA5, NeuralGCM, and cBottle) to a uniform sea surface temperature warming, a widely used benchmark for evaluating climate change. We assess each ML model's performance relative to a physics-based general circulation model (NOAA's Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory AM4) across key diagnostics, including surface air temperature, precipitation, temperature and wind profiles, and top-of-atmosphere radiation. While the ML models reproduce key aspects of the physical model response, particularly the response of precipitation, some exhibit notable departures from robust physical responses, including radiative responses and land region warming. Our results highlight the promise and current limitations of ML models for climate change applications and suggest that further improvements are needed for robust out-of-sample generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了多个全球大气机器学习模型（ACE2-ERA5, NeuralGCM, cBottle）对均匀海表温度增暖的气候响应，与基于物理的环流模型AM4对比。结果表明ML模型能复现降水响应的关键特征，但在辐射响应和陆地增暖方面存在显著偏差，凸显了ML模型在气候变化应用中的前景和当前局限。
Motivation: 机器学习气候模型能否泛化到训练分布之外尚不清楚；均匀海表温度增暖是评估气候变化响应的标准基准，用于检验ML模型的泛化能力。
Method: 采用ACE2-ERA5、NeuralGCM和cBottle等ML模型，与NOAA GFDL AM4物理模型比较，诊断地表气温、降水、温度风廓线和大气顶辐射等关键变量。
Result: ML模型能够再现物理模型对降水响应的主要特征，但在辐射响应和陆地增暖方面出现显著偏离。
Conclusion: ML模型在气候变化应用中表现出潜力，但需要进一步改进以实现稳健的分布外泛化。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: A Cartography of Open Collaboration in Open Source AI: Mapping Practices, Motivations, and Governance in 14 Open Large Language Model Projects
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of open large language models (LLMs) is fostering a vibrant ecosystem in artificial intelligence (AI). However, the methods of collaboration used to develop open LLMs, both before and after their public release, have not yet been systematically studied, limiting our understanding of how open LLM projects are initiated, organised, and governed, as well as the opportunities to further foster this ecosystem. We address this gap through an exploratory analysis of open collaboration throughout the development and reuse lifecycle of open LLMs, drawing on semi-structured interviews with the developers of 14 diverse open LLM projects. These collaborations span multiple artefact domains -- including models, data, software, evaluation, compute, and community engagement -- each enabling distinct forms of participation and involving different stakeholders that evolves across the LLM development lifecycle, shifting from concentrated, selective engagement in the early stages to broader, distributed participation after model release. The open LLM developers are motivated by a variety of social, economic, and technological motivations, ranging from democratising access to AI and promoting open science to building regional ecosystems and expanding language representation. These dynamics are coordinated through a range of governance structures, typically formal and professionalised to varying degrees, including centralised company-led efforts to decentralised grassroots initiatives. We synthesise our findings in a conceptual model of open collaboration in open LLM ecosystems, provide recommendations for practice, and conclude that openness in open source AI is not a uniform property but an emergent outcome of how collaboration is organised across interconnected artefact domains, lifecycle stages, and institutional contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对14个开放大语言模型（LLM）项目的开发者进行半结构化访谈，探索了开放LLM在开发和复用生命周期中的开放协作实践。研究发现协作跨越模型、数据、软件、评估、计算和社区参与等多个制品领域，在生命周期不同阶段呈现从集中选择性参与到广泛分布式参与的变化。动机涵盖社会、经济和技术因素，治理结构从企业集中化到草根去中心化各异。论文提出了开放LLM生态系统中开放协作的概念模型，并提供实践建议。
Motivation: 开放LLM项目数量激增，但其协作方法缺乏系统研究，限制了对项目启动、组织和治理的理解。
Method: 采用探索性分析方法，对14个不同开放LLM项目的开发者进行半结构化访谈，分析协作在开发与复用全生命周期中的表现。
Result: 协作跨越多个制品领域，在不同生命周期阶段参与模式变化；动机多样（民主化AI、开放科学、构建区域生态等）；治理结构从集中式公司主导到分散式草根倡议不等。
Conclusion: 开放源代码AI中的开放并非统一属性，而是协作在互连制品领域、生命周期阶段和制度背景中组织方式的涌现结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Laws and Spectra of Shallow Neural Networks in the Feature Learning Regime
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws underlie many of the recent advances in deep learning, yet their theoretical understanding remains largely confined to linear models. In this work, we present a systematic analysis of scaling laws for quadratic and diagonal neural networks in the feature learning regime. Leveraging connections with matrix compressed sensing and LASSO, we derive a detailed phase diagram for the scaling exponents of the excess risk as a function of sample complexity and weight decay. This analysis uncovers crossovers between distinct scaling regimes and plateau behaviors, mirroring phenomena widely reported in the empirical neural scaling literature. Furthermore, we establish a precise link between these regimes and the spectral properties of the trained network weights, which we characterize in detail. As a consequence, we provide a theoretical validation of recent empirical observations connecting the emergence of power-law tails in the weight spectrum with network generalization performance, yielding an interpretation from first principles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在特征学习区间内系统分析了二次和对角神经网络的缩放定律，利用矩阵压缩感知与LASSO的联系，推导了超风险缩放指数随样本复杂度和权重衰减的详细相图，揭示了交叉和平台行为，并建立了缩放区间与网络权重谱性质的联系，为权重谱幂律尾与泛化性能之间的经验观测提供了理论验证。
Motivation: 神经网络缩放定律的理论理解目前主要局限于线性模型，缺乏对非线性特征学习网络的理论分析。
Method: 通过将二次和对角神经网络与矩阵压缩感知及LASSO建立联系，推导超风险缩放指数随样本复杂度和权重衰减的相图，并分析训练后网络权重的谱性质。
Result: 揭示了不同缩放区间之间的交叉和平台行为，精确刻画了缩放指数与权重谱性质之间的对应关系。
Conclusion: 为神经网络缩放定律提供了基于第一性原理的理论解释，验证了权重谱幂律尾与泛化性能之间的经验联系。

papers.title: HiDe: Rethinking The Zoom-IN method in High Resolution MLLMs via Hierarchical Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in visual understanding tasks. However, their performance on high-resolution images remains suboptimal. While existing approaches often attribute this limitation to perceptual constraints and argue that MLLMs struggle to recognize small objects, leading them to use "zoom in" strategies for better detail, our analysis reveals a different cause: the main issue is not object size, but rather caused by complex background interference. We systematically analyze this "zoom in" operation through a series of decoupling experiments and propose the Hierarchical Decoupling Framework (HiDe), a training-free framework that uses Token-wise Attention Decoupling (TAD) to decouple the question tokens and identify the key information tokens, then leverages their attention weights to achieve precise alignment with the target visual regions. Subsequently, it employs Layout-Preserving Decoupling (LPD) to decouple these regions from the background and reconstructs a compact representation that preserves essential spatial layouts while eliminating background interference. HiDe sets a new SOTA on V*Bench, HRBench4K, and HRBench8K, boosting Qwen2.5-VL 7B and InternVL3 8B to SOTA (92.1% and 91.6% on V*Bench), even surpassing RL methods. After optimization, HiDe uses 75% less memory than the previous training-free approach. Code is provided in https://tennine2077.github.io/HiDe.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视高分辨率多模态大模型中“zoom-in”操作的根本原因，发现主要问题不是物体大小而是复杂背景干扰。提出训练无关的层次解耦框架（HiDe），包含Token级注意力解耦（TAD）和布局保持解耦（LPD），在V*Bench、HRBench4K和HRBench8K上达到新SOTA，Qwen2.5-VL 7B和InternVL3 8B在V*Bench上分别达92.1%和91.6%，内存使用比之前训练无关方法减少75%。
Motivation: 现有方法将高分辨率MLLM性能不佳归因于感知限制，认为模型难以识别小物体而需要放大。本文通过解耦实验发现主要问题是复杂背景干扰而非物体大小，因此需要一种无需重新训练的方法来消除背景干扰。
Method: 提出HiDe框架，包括Token-wise Attention Decoupling (TAD) 解耦问题token并识别关键信息token，利用注意力权重与目标视觉区域精确对齐；Layout-Preserving Decoupling (LPD) 将目标区域与背景解耦并重建紧凑表示，保留空间布局同时消除背景干扰。
Result: 在V*Bench、HRBench4K和HRBench8K上达到新SOTA，Qwen2.5-VL 7B和InternVL3 8B在V*Bench上分别达92.1%和91.6%，甚至超过RL方法。内存使用比之前训练无关方法减少75%。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了高分辨率MLLM中zoom-in问题的真实原因（背景干扰），并证明HiDe作为训练无关框架可有效解决，显著提升性能并降低内存消耗。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Concept-SAE: A Controllable and Invertible Concept Interface for Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Standard Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) excel at discovering a dictionary of a model's learned features, providing a powerful lens for passive feature discovery. However, this passive nature makes it difficult to systematically evaluate or analyze concepts that users explicitly care about. We introduce Concept-SAE, a framework that augments SAEs with a structured and controllable interface for probing user-defined concepts. Concept-SAE decomposes an activation subspace into two orthogonal components: Concept Tokens, which are aligned to externally specified semantics through dual supervision on both concept existence and spatial localization, and Free Tokens, which operate like standard SAEs to capture all remaining information. This hybrid disentanglement strategy ensures that Concept Tokens are faithful, spatially grounded, and cleanly separated from the residual subspace while preserving the ability of SAEs for open-ended concept discovery. We conduct extensive experiments demonstrating that Concept-SAE yields high-fidelity, well-localized, and strongly disentangled concept representations, outperforming alternatives in interface quality. Finally, we validate the utility of this conceptual interface through three diagnostic evaluations: a detection test on classifying adversarial image samples, a controllability test focusing on controlled counterfactual editing and a stability test using adversarial perturbations. Together, these results show that Concept-SAE equips SAEs with a reliable mechanism for evaluating, probing, and diagnosing user-defined concepts.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Concept-SAE，一种在稀疏自编码器（SAE）基础上增加可控、可逆概念接口的框架。通过将激活空间分解为与外部语义对齐的概念令牌（Concept Tokens）和保留剩余信息的自由令牌（Free Tokens），实现用户定义概念的忠实、空间定位和干净分离。实验表明该接口在概念表示质量上优于现有方法，并在对抗样本检测、反事实编辑和稳定性测试中验证了其实用性。
Motivation: 标准SAE只能被动发现特征，难以系统评估或分析用户明确关心的概念，缺乏对用户定义概念的可控探测能力。
Method: 将激活子空间分解为两个正交部分：概念令牌（通过双重监督对齐概念存在性和空间定位）和自由令牌（类似标准SAE捕获剩余信息），实现混合解耦策略。
Result: 概念表示具有高保真度、良好定位和强解耦性，在接口质量上优于替代方法；在对抗样本检测、控制反事实编辑和稳定性测试中表现可靠。
Conclusion: Concept-SAE为SAE提供了一种评估、探测和诊断用户定义概念的可靠机制，但当前仅针对特定概念接口，未探讨其在开放域概念发现中的局限性。

papers.title: General Synthetic-Powered Inference
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of high-quality synthetic data -- generated by advanced AI models or collected as auxiliary data from related tasks -- presents both opportunities and challenges for statistical inference. This paper introduces a GEneral Synthetic-Powered Inference (GESPI) framework that wraps around a broad class of statistical inference procedures to safely enhance sample efficiency by combining synthetic and real data. Our framework leverages high-quality synthetic data to boost statistical power, yet adaptively defaults to the standard method using only real data when synthetic data are of low quality. The error rate of our method remains below a user-specified bound without any distributional assumptions on the synthetic data, and decreases as the quality of the synthetic data improves. This flexibility enables seamless integration with conformal prediction, risk control, hypothesis testing, and multiple testing procedures, all without modifying the base inference method. We demonstrate the benefits of our method on challenging tasks with limited labeled data, including AlphaFold protein structure prediction, and comparing large reasoning models on complex math problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用合成增强推断（GESPI）框架，通过结合合成数据与真实数据安全提升样本效率。该框架自动适应合成数据质量，保证错误率低于用户指定界限，无需对合成数据做分布假设。可无缝集成到共形预测、风险控制、假设检验等多种推断过程，并在AlphaFold蛋白结构预测和复杂数学问题推理模型比较等有限标注任务上展示了优势。
Motivation: 高质量合成数据的激增为统计推断带来机会，但现有方法难以在保证错误率控制的前提下安全有效地利用合成数据提升样本效率。
Method: 提出GESPI框架，包裹广泛的统计推断程序，通过加权组合合成与真实数据，自适应根据合成数据质量切换至标准方法，确保错误率始终有界。
Result: 在AlphaFold蛋白结构预测和复杂数学问题推理模型比较等挑战性任务上验证了方法有效性，尤其适用于标注数据有限的情形。
Conclusion: GESPI框架提供了一种通用、安全的合成数据增强推断方法，无需修改基础推断算法，且不要求对合成数据做任何分布假设。

papers.title: RAG Security and Privacy: Formalizing the Threat Model and Attack Surface
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is an emerging approach in natural language processing that combines large language models (LLMs) with external document retrieval to produce more accurate and grounded responses. While RAG has shown strong potential in reducing hallucinations and improving factual consistency, it also introduces new privacy and security challenges that differ from those faced by traditional LLMs. Existing research has demonstrated that LLMs can leak sensitive information through training data memorization or adversarial prompts, and RAG systems inherit many of these vulnerabilities. At the same time, reliance of RAG on an external knowledge base opens new attack surfaces, including the potential for leaking information about the presence or content of retrieved documents, or for injecting malicious content to manipulate model behavior. Despite these risks, there is currently no formal framework that defines the threat landscape for RAG systems. In this paper, we address a critical gap in the literature by proposing, to the best of our knowledge, the first formal threat model for retrieval-RAG systems. We introduce a structured taxonomy of adversary types based on their access to model components and data, and we formally define key threat vectors such as document-level membership inference and data poisoning, which pose serious privacy and integrity risks in real-world deployments. By establishing formal definitions and attack models, our work lays the foundation for a more rigorous and principled understanding of privacy and security in RAG systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统的形式化威胁模型，基于攻击者对模型组件和数据的访问权限，建立了对手类型结构化分类法，并正式定义了文档级成员推断和数据投毒等关键威胁向量，为RAG系统的隐私与安全研究奠定理论基础。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏统一的框架来定义RAG系统面临的安全与隐私威胁，尽管已有工作揭示LLM存在记忆训练数据、对抗性提示泄露等问题，且RAG引入外部知识库后新增了文档信息泄露和恶意内容注入等攻击面，但尚无形式化模型来系统刻画这些风险。
Method: 通过对手访问权限分类（模型组件与数据），提出形式化的威胁模型，包括文档级成员推断攻击和数据投毒攻击的形式化定义，并构建攻击面结构化分类法。
Result: 论文本身不包含实验结果，主要贡献是理论框架：首次为RAG系统建立了形式化的威胁模型和攻击面分类。
Conclusion: 该工作为RAG系统的隐私与安全建立了更严谨的理论基础，有助于未来设计针对性的防御机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoT-Space: A Theoretical Framework for Internal Slow-Thinking via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling, primarily manifested through multi-step Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning via Reinforcement Learning (RL), has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, a significant theoretical gap persists: traditional token-level analysis fails to capture the macroscopic dynamics of reasoning-level scaling. To address this, we introduce CoT-Space, a novel theoretical framework that recasts the reasoning process from a discrete token-prediction task to an optimization process within a continuous, reasoning-level semantic space. By modeling the reasoning trajectory from both noise and risk perspectives and revitalizing foundational principles from classical learning theory, we demonstrate that the observed convergence to an optimal CoT length is a natural consequence of the fundamental trade-off between underfitting and overfitting. We further utilize RL as a tool to elicit and verify these results in our experiments. Our findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the internal test-time scaling via RL, offering a principled theoretical foundation to optimize reasoning trajectories in modern LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoT-Space理论框架，将大语言模型中的链式思维推理过程从离散token预测重铸为连续语义空间中的优化问题。从噪声和风险视角建模推理轨迹，证明最优CoT长度的出现是欠拟合与过拟合之间权衡的自然结果，并通过强化学习实验验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 现有test-time scaling方法缺乏理论支撑，传统token级分析无法解释推理层面的宏观动态。
Method: 构建连续语义空间，将推理轨迹建模为优化过程；引入噪声和风险视角，并借用经典学习理论中的欠拟合-过拟合权衡来解释最优长度。
Result: 理论推导表明最优CoT长度是自然出现的，且通过RL实验验证了该结论。
Conclusion: 为内部test-time scaling提供了机制性解释，为优化推理轨迹奠定了理论基础。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Scale-Adaptive Generative Flows for Multiscale Scientific Data
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative models can face numerical challenges on scientific data with multiscale Fourier spectra, often producing large errors at fine scales. We approach this problem within the flow matching and stochastic interpolants framework, through the principled design of noise distributions and interpolation schedules. Working in function space ensures that the generative model remains well defined as the resolution is refined; the Lipschitz regularity of the drift is important to both this function-space well-posedness and the integration cost at fixed resolution. The central observation is that the noise should be at least as rough as the target distribution -- measured by Fourier-spectrum decay -- in order to keep the Lipschitz constant finite. For Gaussian and near-Gaussian targets whose fine-scale structure is known, matched-spectrum noise improves numerical efficiency over standard white-noise choices. For more complex non-Gaussian targets, matched-spectrum noise may not be sufficient, and we propose scale-adaptive interpolation schedules to mitigate the terminal-time stiffness that arises when the noise is rougher than the data. Numerical experiments on synthetic Gaussian random fields and on invariant measures of the stochastic Allen--Cahn and Navier--Stokes equations illustrate the approach and demonstrate its ability to generate high-fidelity samples at lower computational cost than traditional approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科学数据中多尺度傅里叶谱导致的数值困难，在流匹配和随机插值框架下，通过设计噪声分布和插值调度来改进生成模型。在函数空间中建模以保证分辨率变化时模型定义良好，并强调漂移项的Lipschitz正则性对数值效率的影响。关键观察是噪声应至少与目标分布具有相同的光滑度（由傅里叶谱衰减衡量），并提出了尺度自适应插值方案来处理非高斯目标。数值实验在合成高斯随机场以及随机Allen-Cahn和Navier-Stokes方程的不变测度上展示了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 基于流的生成模型在处理多尺度科学数据时，常因噪声与目标分布谱不匹配而产生大误差，尤其在精细尺度上。现有方法缺乏对噪声分布和插值调置信的原则性设计。
Method: 在函数空间的流匹配/随机插值框架下，提出噪声应该与目标分布具有匹配的傅里叶谱粗糙度（matched-spectrum noise），并针对非高斯目标提出尺度自适应插值调度（scale-adaptive interpolation schedules）以缓解终端时间刚度问题。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在合成高斯随机场、随机Allen-Cahn和Navier-Stokes方程的不变测度上，以较低计算成本生成高保真样本，优于标准白噪声方法。
Conclusion: 本文强调了噪声谱匹配对生成模型数值效率的关键作用，并提供了处理多尺度科学数据的理论指导。该方法在函数空间中保证了模型随分辨率细化的良好定义。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: A Survey on Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are rapidly emerging as a powerful and promising alternative to the dominant autoregressive (AR) paradigm. By generating tokens in parallel through an iterative denoising process, DLMs possess inherent advantages in reducing inference latency and capturing bidirectional context, thereby enabling fine-grained control over the generation process. While achieving a several-fold speed-up, recent advancements have allowed DLMs to show performance comparable to their autoregressive counterparts, making them a compelling choice for various natural language processing tasks. In this survey, we provide a holistic overview of the current DLM landscape. We trace its evolution and relationship with other paradigms, such as autoregressive and masked language models, and cover both foundational principles and state-of-the-art models. Our work offers an up-to-date, comprehensive taxonomy and an in-depth analysis of current techniques, from pre-training strategies to advanced post-training methods. Another contribution of this survey is a thorough review of DLM inference strategies and optimizations, including improvements in decoding parallelism, caching mechanisms, and generation quality. We also highlight the latest approaches to multimodal extensions of DLMs and delineate their applications across various practical scenarios. Furthermore, our discussion addresses the limitations and challenges of DLMs, including efficiency, long-sequence handling, and infrastructure requirements, while outlining future research directions to sustain progress in this rapidly evolving field. Project GitHub is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/Awesome-DLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）领域的最新进展，将其视为自回归范式的重要替代方案。文章介绍了DLMs通过迭代去噪并行生成token的原理，总结了预训练策略、后训练方法、推理优化及多模态扩展，并指出了效率、长序列处理等挑战与未来方向。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型作为自回归模型的替代方案具有并行生成、低延迟和双向上下文捕捉的优势，但该领域尚缺乏系统性的综述来梳理其发展脉络、技术分类和前沿动态。
Method: 该综述采用分类学方法，从基础原理、预训练与后训练技术、推理优化（包括解码并行性、缓存机制、生成质量）、多模态扩展及应用场景等维度对现有DLM工作进行系统梳理。
Result: 摘要指出DLMs在实现数倍速度提升的同时，已达到与自回归模型可比的性能，并在多种NLP任务中展现出竞争力。
Conclusion: 综述强调了DLMs在效率、长序列处理和基础设施方面的局限性，并为未来研究指明了方向。

summary_sections.method: 该综述采用分类学方法，从基础原理、预训练与后训练技术、推理优化（包括解码并行性、缓存机制、生成质量）、多模态扩展及应用场景等维度对现有DLM工作进行系统梳理。
summary_sections.result: 摘要指出DLMs在实现数倍速度提升的同时，已达到与自回归模型可比的性能，并在多种NLP任务中展现出竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 综述强调了DLMs在效率、长序列处理和基础设施方面的局限性，并为未来研究指明了方向。

papers.title: Towards Label-Noise Resistant Learning via Optimal Brain Damage Masking
papers.abstract_en: Noisy labels are inevitable in real-world scenarios. Due to the strong capacity of deep neural networks to memorize corrupted labels, these noisy labels cause significant performance degradation. Existing noise-robust methods have mainly focused on robust loss functions and sample selection, with comparatively limited exploration of dynamic architectural adaptation. In this paper, we rethink the role of model connectivity in the presence of label noise. Intuitively, performance degradation caused by noisy labels stems from the backpropagation of noisy gradients. Since the final classifier layer acts as the primary gateway for this error propagation, directly discarding redundant connections within the classifier can structurally intercept noisy gradients at the root. Consequently, to identify these redundant connections, we leverage the seminal Optimal Brain Damage (OBD) theory from model compression, which posits that parameters causing negligible loss perturbation can be safely removed without impairing performance. Guided by this principle, we reveal that masking low-activation edges maintains the network's normal fitting capacity while effectively reducing the risk of backpropagating noisy gradients. To bridge this theoretical insight with practical training, we propose a novel Selective Edge Masking (SEM) mechanism for the widely-adopted fully connected (FC) layer to enhance model robustness against noisy labels. It can adaptively preserve only the most critical edges for information propagation while suppressing gradient errors caused by noisy labels. As a plug-and-play component, SEM can be seamlessly integrated into various noise-robust methods, including robust loss functions and sample selection. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our OBD-driven approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对标签噪声问题，从模型连接性角度出发，利用Optimal Brain Damage理论发现掩码低激活边可以保持模型拟合能力同时减少噪声梯度反向传播。据此提出Selective Edge Masking（SEM）机制，自适应地保留全连接层中的关键边，抑制噪声梯度。SEM可作为即插即用组件集成到现有鲁棒方法中，在合成和真实噪声基准上均取得优于现有方法的效果。
Motivation: 现有噪声鲁棒方法主要关注鲁棒损失函数和样本选择，对动态架构适配探索有限。作者认为性能退化源于噪声梯度通过分类层的反向传播，因此需要从结构上阻断该传播。
Method: 基于Optimal Brain Damage理论，提出Selective Edge Masking (SEM) 机制，用于全连接层。SEM通过自适应保留最关键边进行信息传播，抑制噪声标签引起的梯度误差，且可作为即插即用组件集成到各种噪声鲁棒方法中。
Result: 在合成和真实标签噪声基准上的广泛评估表明，该OBD驱动方法一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的OBD驱动的SEM方法能有效提升模型对标签噪声的鲁棒性，且具有即插即用的实用性。

papers.title: The Relative Instability of Model Comparison with Cross-validation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-validation (CV) is known to provide asymptotically exact tests and confidence intervals for model improvement but only when the model comparison is relatively stable. Surprisingly, we prove that even simple, individually stable models can generate relatively unstable comparisons, calling into question the validity of CV inference. Specifically, we show that the Lasso and its close cousin, soft-thresholding, generate relatively unstable comparisons and invalid CV inferences, even in the most favorable of learning settings and when both models are individually stable. These findings highlight the importance of verifying relative stability before deploying CV for model comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 交叉验证（CV）在模型比较中提供渐近精确的测试和置信区间，但前提是比较相对稳定。本文证明即使简单、个体稳定的模型（如Lasso和软阈值）也会产生相对不稳定的比较，从而质疑CV推断的有效性。
Motivation: 现有CV推断只有在比较相对稳定时才有效，但本文发现即使个体稳定的模型也可能导致相对不稳定，因此需要关注相对稳定性。
Method: 通过理论证明，Lasso和软阈值即使在最有利的学习设置下也会产生相对不稳定的比较和无效的CV推断。
Result: 证明了即使个体稳定的模型也可能导致相对不稳定，从而CV推断失效。
Conclusion: 强调了在部署CV进行模型比较之前验证相对稳定性的重要性。

papers.title: Learning to optimize with guarantees: a complete characterization of linearly convergent algorithms
papers.abstract_en: The design of many classical optimization algorithms is driven by the certification of linear convergence rates over classes of optimization problems. In this paper, we consider the problem of improving the average-case performance of an algorithm over a specific distribution of problem instances. While this task can be tackled by embedding trainable components into the algorithm updates, a key challenge is to preserve worst-case guarantees across the entire problem class. For classes of composite optimization problems, we show that all linearly convergent algorithms can be parametrized in terms of a baseline linearly convergent algorithm, and a set of trainable, exponentially-decaying modifications to its update rule; crucially, this parametrization excludes all-and only-the algorithms that do not converge linearly. Our results apply to improving the average-case performance of classical algorithms such as gradient descent for nonconvex, gradient-dominated functions; Nesterov's accelerated method for smooth, strongly convex functions; and projected gradient methods for optimization over polyhedral feasible sets. We illustrate how our characterization can be used for learning to optimize with linear convergence and feasibility guarantees. Numerical results showcase benefits over classical optimizers when solving ill-conditioned systems of linear equations and running a model predictive control scheme on a linear dynamical system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文刻画了所有线性收敛算法的完整参数化形式：任何线性收敛算法均可表示为一个基线线性收敛算法加上一组可训练的指数衰减修正。该参数化排除了所有非线性收敛的算法，并可用于在保持最坏情况保证的同时提升平均性能。
Motivation: 传统优化算法设计以最坏情况收敛性为目标，而实际应用中希望提升特定问题分布下的平均性能，但在保持线性收敛保证的前提下进行学习是一个挑战。
Method: 提出一种参数化方法：所有线性收敛算法均可由基线线性收敛算法和一组可训练的指数衰减修正项表示，该参数化恰好覆盖所有线性收敛算法，不包含任何非线性收敛算法。
Result: 理论结果适用于非凸梯度主导函数、光滑强凸函数上的Nesterov加速法以及多面体可行集上的投影梯度法。数值实验显示，在病态线性方程组和模型预测控制中，该方法优于经典优化器。
Conclusion: 提供了一个统一框架，使得在保持线性收敛保证的前提下，通过学习优化算法提升平均性能成为可能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning What Matters: Probabilistic Task Selection via Mutual Information for Model Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning performance for large language models depends strongly on how training budget is distributed across a heterogeneous set of tasks. In practice, mixtures are often fixed using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant sources. We introduce TaskPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures via an energy-based model over tasks. Tasks form the nodes of a Markov random field: unary potentials capture per-task utility, and pairwise potentials encode inter-task relationships using behavioral divergences computed from predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models (e.g., Jensen--Shannon divergence and pointwise mutual information). Optimizing this objective yields mixtures that balance coverage against redundancy. We show that the resulting set function is weakly submodular under budget constraints, enabling approximation guarantees for discrete selection variants. Across multiple model families (LLaMA-7B, Qwen2-7B) and evaluation suites (BIG-Bench Hard), TaskPGM improves over standard mixing strategies and provides interpretable structure over task interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TaskPGM，一个通过能量模型学习连续任务混合的框架，用于大语言模型微调。它构建马尔可夫随机场，其中一元势表示任务效用，成对势基于单任务微调模型预测分布的行为差异（如JS散度和点互信息）编码任务间关系。优化该目标可得到平衡覆盖与冗余的混合比例。实验在LLaMA-7B和Qwen2-7B上相比标准混合策略取得改进，并提供可解释的任务结构。
Motivation: 现有监督微调常采用简单启发式（如均匀或按大小比例采样）混合任务，忽略任务间交互，导致迁移效率低和资源浪费。
Method: TaskPGM：以任务为节点构建马尔可夫随机场，一元势衡量任务自身效用，成对势通过单任务微调模型预测分布的行为差异（Jensen–Shannon散度和点互信息）计算。通过能量模型优化连续混合比例，并证明预算约束下集合函数为弱子模，提供离散选择的近似保证。
Result: 在LLaMA-7B和Qwen2-7B模型以及BIG-Bench Hard评测集上，TaskPGM优于标准混合策略，且能揭示任务间的可解释结构。
Conclusion: 文章表明基于能量模型的任务混合可以自动学习互信息驱动的权重，平衡覆盖与冗余，并具有理论上的子模性质保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Monocular 3D Keypoint Discovery from Multi-View Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: Most existing 3D keypoint estimation methods rely on manual annotations or calibrated multi-view images, both of which are expensive to collect. This paper introduces KeyDiff3D, a framework that can accurately predict 3D keypoints from a single image, thus eliminating the need for such expensive data acquisitions. To achieve this, we leverage powerful geometric priors embedded in a pretrained multi-view diffusion model. In our framework, the diffusion model generates multi-view images from a single image, serving as supervision signals to provide 3D geometric cues to our model. We also introduce a 3D feature extractor that transforms implicit 3D priors embedded in the diffusion features into explicit 3D feature volumes. Beyond accurate keypoint estimation, we further introduce a pipeline that enables manipulation of 3D objects generated by the diffusion model. Experimental results on diverse datasets, including Human3.6M, CUB-200-2011, Stanford Dogs, and several in-the-wild and out-of-domain inputs, highlight the effectiveness of our method in terms of accuracy, generalization, and its ability to enable manipulation of 3D objects generated by the diffusion model from a single image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KeyDiff3D框架，从单张图像无监督地预测3D关键点，利用预训练多视图扩散模型生成的几何先验作为监督信号。引入3D特征提取器将扩散特征转化为显式3D特征体积。在多个数据集上验证了准确性和泛化能力，并可操纵扩散模型生成的3D对象。
Motivation: 现有3D关键点估计依赖人工标注或校准的多视图图像，成本高。本文希望从单张图像中预测3D关键点，消除昂贵数据采集需求。
Method: 利用预训练多视图扩散模型的几何先验：扩散模型从单张图像生成多视图图像作为监督信号；引入3D特征提取器将扩散特征中的隐式3D先验转化为显式3D特征体积。
Result: 在Human3.6M、CUB-200-2011、Stanford Dogs等数据集上以及野外和域外输入上，该方法在准确性、泛化能力和操纵扩散模型生成的3D对象方面有效。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法可准确预测3D关键点并支持3D对象操纵，但未提及其局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is Diversity All You Need for Scalable Robotic Manipulation?
papers.abstract_en: Data scaling has driven remarkable success in foundation models for Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Computer Vision (CV), yet the principles of effective data scaling in robotic manipulation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we investigate the nuanced role of data diversity in robot learning by examining three critical dimensions-task (what to do), embodiment (which robot to use), and expert (who demonstrates)-challenging the conventional intuition of "more diverse is better". Throughout extensive experiments on various robot platforms, we reveal that (1) task diversity proves more critical than per-task demonstration quantity, benefiting transfer from diverse pre-training tasks to novel downstream scenarios; (2) multi-embodiment pre-training data is optional for cross-embodiment transfer-models trained on high-quality single-embodiment data can efficiently transfer to different platforms, showing more desirable scaling property during fine-tuning than multi-embodiment pre-trained models; and (3) expert diversity, arising from individual operational preferences and stochastic variations in human demonstrations, can be confounding to policy learning, with velocity multimodality emerging as a key contributing factor. Based on this insight, we propose a distribution debiasing method to mitigate velocity ambiguity, the yielding GO-1-Pro achieves substantial performance gains of 15%, equivalent to using 2.5 times pre-training data. Collectively, these findings provide new perspectives and offer practical guidance on how to scale robotic manipulation datasets effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大量实验系统研究了机器人操作中数据多样性的作用，考察任务、本体和专家三个维度。发现任务多样性比演示数量更关键，单本体高质量数据可有效跨本体迁移，但专家多样性会干扰策略学习。基于速度多模态的发现提出分布去偏方法，取得15%性能提升。
Motivation: 数据扩展在NLP和CV中成功，但机器人操作中数据扩展原则尚不清晰，论文旨在理解多样性的细微作用。
Method: 在多种机器人平台上进行大量实验，分别考察任务、本体、专家多样性对策略学习的影响，并提出分布去偏方法缓解专家多样性带来的速度多模态问题。
Result: 任务多样性比每个任务的演示数量更关键；单本体高质量数据训练的模型可高效跨平台迁移，微调缩放性质优于多本体预训练；专家多样性会干扰策略学习，速度多模态是主因；GO-1-Pro方法带来15%性能提升，相当于2.5倍预训练数据。
Conclusion: 这些发现为如何有效扩展机器人操作数据集提供了新视角和实用指导。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 任务多样性比每个任务的演示数量更关键；单本体高质量数据训练的模型可高效跨平台迁移，微调缩放性质优于多本体预训练；专家多样性会干扰策略学习，速度多模态是主因；GO-1-Pro方法带来15%性能提升，相当于2.5倍预训练数据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些发现为如何有效扩展机器人操作数据集提供了新视角和实用指导。

papers.title: Hierarchical Mask-Enhanced Dual Reconstruction Network for Few-Shot Fine-Grained Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot fine-grained image classification (FS-FGIC) is challenging as it requires distinguishing visually similar subclasses with extremely limited labeled examples. Existing methods suffer from critical limitations: metric-based methods lose spatial information and misalign local features, while reconstruction-based methods underuse hierarchical feature information and lack selective focus on discriminative key regions. We propose the Hierarchical Mask-enhanced Dual Reconstruction Network (HMDRN), integrating dual-layer feature reconstruction with mask-enhanced feature processing. HMDRN leverages complementary visual information from different network hierarchies via learnable weights, balancing high-level semantic representations with mid-level structural details. It incorporates a spatial binary mask-enhanced transformer module that selectively enhances discriminative regions while filtering background noise. On three fine-grained datasets, HMDRN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods with both Conv-4 and ResNet-12 backbones. Ablation studies validate each component's effectiveness, showing dual-layer reconstruction enhances inter-class discrimination while mask-enhanced transformation reduces intra-class variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出层次化掩码增强双重建网络（HMDRN）用于小样本细粒度图像分类，通过双层次特征重建和掩码增强变换，在三个细粒度数据集上用Conv-4和ResNet-12骨干网络均取得了优于现有方法的结果。
Motivation: 现有小样本细粒度分类方法中，基于度量学习的方法丢失空间信息且对齐局部特征不佳，基于重建的方法未充分利用层次特征且缺乏对判别性关键区域的选择性关注。
Method: 提出HMDRN，包含双层次特征重建（结合高层语义和中间层结构细节）和空间二值掩码增强Transformer模块，通过可学习权重平衡不同层次信息，并选择性增强判别区域、抑制背景噪声。
Result: 在三个细粒度数据集上，HMDRN使用Conv-4和ResNet-12骨干网络均一致优于现有方法。消融实验验证了各组件有效性，双层次重建增强类间判别性，掩码增强变换减少类内变异。
Conclusion: 所提方法通过层次化双重建和掩码增强有效提升了小样本细粒度分类性能，但摘要未提及跨领域泛化或计算效率等局限性。

papers.title: Topology-Aware Differential Privacy in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning transmits only model updates to protect client data, and differentially private SGD (DP-SGD) bounds content-level leakage through those updates. Neither mechanism accounts for what the communication topology of the federation itself reveals. In cross-silo deployments, a passive adversary with knowledge of the topology and organisational structure has access to information channels that DP-SGD leaves entirely unaddressed. We formalise this threat and derive a principled defense. We introduce TADI (Topology-Aware Distributional Inference), a shadow-trained channel decomposition that isolates per-client leakage into parameter, structural, and organisational components via four channel ablations, and prove an additive per-client mutual-information bound separating a controllable mechanism term from an uncontrollable prior-coupling floor. From this bound we derive Fulcrum, a closed-form balanced min-max optimal noise allocation that strictly dominates uniform DP-SGD whenever the federation's leverage profile is asymmetric, and degenerates exactly to uniform DP-SGD when it is not, making it safe to adopt unconditionally. Evaluated on Fed-ISIC2019, Fed-Heart-Disease, and synthetic CIFAR-10 across six topology families, Fulcrum delivers privacy gains of up to 1.967 nats at no measurable utility cost. The TADI channel decomposition confirms that the parameter channel is bounded by DP-SGD across all settings, the prior-coupling channel is empirically attained under matched-prior conditions, and the bound is conservative in a deployment-favourable direction under realistic cross-silo threat models.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Data from the experiments and source code can be found here: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20507155
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了联邦学习中通信拓扑泄露隐私的威胁，提出TADI（拓扑感知分布推断）框架，通过阴影训练通道分解将每个客户端的泄露分离为参数、结构和组织三个分量，并推导了可加性的逐客户端互信息界。基于该界提出Fulcrum噪声分配策略，在非对称杠杆分布下严格优于均匀DP-SGD，在对称时退化为均匀DP-SGD，可无条件安全采用。在Fed-ISIC2019、Fed-Heart-Disease和合成CIFAR-10上的六个拓扑族上，Fulcrum在无显著效用损失下实现了高达1.967 nats的隐私增益。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习隐私保护机制（如DP-SGD）仅关注模型更新中的内容泄露，忽略了通信拓扑本身可能泄露客户信息。在跨机构部署中，被动攻击者可利用拓扑和组织结构信息，而DP-SGD对此完全未加防护。
Method: 提出TADI（拓扑感知分布推断）框架，通过四种通道消融（参数、结构、组织）实现阴影训练通道分解，并证明逐客户端互信息可加性界，将可控的机制项与不可控的先验耦合下界分离。由此推导出Fulcrum噪声分配策略，以闭形式求解平衡的最小最大最优噪声分配。
Result: 在Fed-ISIC2019、Fed-Heart-Disease和合成CIFAR-10上的六个拓扑族中，Fulcrum在无显著效用损失下实现高达1.967 nats的隐私增益。TADI通道分解证实参数通道被DP-SGD在所有设置下约束，先验耦合通道在匹配先验条件下经验达到，且该界在真实跨机构威胁模型下是保守的。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了联邦学习拓扑层面的隐私泄露风险，并提供了形式化分析和普适防御方案。Fulcrum可无条件安全采用，在非对称拓扑中优于均匀DP-SGD。

papers.title: Semantic-decoupled Spatial Partition Guided Point-supervised Oriented Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Given its ability to reduce annotation costs, weakly supervised learning based on single-point annotations has emerged as a research focus in oriented object detection. Compared with the classical teacher-student paradigm, the simple model paradigm (e.g., PointOBB-v2) can substantially further reduce resources required for training while ensuring strong performance. The latter exhibits greater potential for low-cost training, yet such methods still face challenges of insufficient sample assignment and poor pseudo-label quality. In this paper, we propose a training-efficient framework named SSP, which synergizes rule-driven prior injection and data-driven label purification. Specifically, SSP introduces two designs: (1) Pixel-level Spatial Partition-based Sample Assignment, which compactly estimates the upper and lower bounds of object scales and mines high-quality positive samples and hard negative samples through spatial partitioning of pixel maps. (2) Semantic Spatial Partition-based Box Extraction, which derives instances from spatial partitions modulated by semantic maps and converts them into pseudo-boxes for supervising detectors. Experiments on DOTA-v1.0 and other datasets demonstrate SSP's superiority: it achieves +6.73% mAP improvement compared with the baseline, while requiring only 2 h of training time and 6 GB of GPU memory. Furthermore, when SSP is integrated with stronger detector, the mAP can reach 50.81%. The code is available at https://github.com/antxinyuan/ssp.
papers.journal_ref: Pattern Recognition, Volume 180, Part B, Article 114079 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SSP 框架，通过规则驱动的先验注入和数据驱动的标签净化，解决点监督旋转目标检测中样本分配不足和伪标签质量差的问题。在 DOTA-v1.0 等数据集上，SSP 相比基线提升 6.73% mAP，训练仅需 2 小时和 6 GB 显存。
Motivation: 点监督旋转目标检测中，现有方法面临样本分配不足和伪标签质量低的问题，限制了性能。
Method: 提出 SSP 框架，包含像素级空间分区样本分配（紧凑估计目标尺度上下界，通过像素图空间分区挖掘高质量正样本和难负样本）和语义空间分区框提取（通过语义图调制的空间分区提取实例并转换为伪框）。
Result: 在 DOTA-v1.0 等数据集上，SSP 相比基线提升 6.73% mAP，训练时间仅 2 小时，显存占用 6 GB；与更强检测器结合时 mAP 达 50.81%。
Conclusion: SSP 框架在点监督旋转目标检测中实现了高效且性能优越的训练，降低了资源需求。

papers.title: HEIST: A Graph Foundation Model for Spatial Transcriptomics and Proteomics Data
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell transcriptomics and proteomics have become a great source for data-driven insights into biology, enabling the use of advanced deep learning methods to understand cellular heterogeneity and gene expression at the single-cell level. With the advent of spatial-omics data, we have the promise of characterizing cells within their tissue context as it provides both spatial coordinates and intra-cellular transcriptional or protein counts. Proteomics offers a complementary view by directly measuring proteins, which are the primary effectors of cellular function and key therapeutic targets. However, existing models either ignore the spatial information or the complex genetic and proteomic programs within cells. Thus they cannot infer how cell internal regulation adapts to microenvironmental cues. Furthermore, these models often utilize fixed gene vocabularies, hindering their generalizability unseen genes. In this paper, we introduce HEIST, a hierarchical graph transformer foundation model for spatial transcriptomics and proteomics. HEIST models tissues as hierarchical graphs. The higher level graph is a spatial cell graph, and each cell in turn, is represented by its lower level gene co-expression network graph. HEIST achieves this by performing both intra-level and cross-level message passing to utilize the hierarchy in its embeddings and can thus generalize to novel datatypes including spatial proteomics without retraining. HEIST is pretrained on 22.3M cells from 124 tissues across 15 organs using spatially-aware contrastive and masked autoencoding objectives. Unsupervised analysis of HEIST embeddings reveals spatially informed subpopulations missed by prior models. Downstream evaluations demonstrate generalizability to proteomics data and state-of-the-art performance in clinical outcome prediction, cell type annotation, and gene imputation across multiple technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HEIST，一个用于空间转录组学和蛋白质组学的分层图Transformer基础模型。HEIST 将组织建模为分层图，上层为空间细胞图，下层为每个细胞的基因共表达网络，通过层内和跨层消息传递利用层次结构，无需重新训练即可泛化到新型数据（包括空间蛋白质组学）。模型在 124 个组织、15 个器官的 2230 万个细胞上预训练，使用空间感知对比学习和掩码自编码目标。无监督分析揭示先前模型遗漏的空间信息亚群，下游任务在临床结果预测、细胞类型注释和基因插补中取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有模型要么忽略空间信息，要么忽略细胞内复杂的遗传和蛋白质程序，无法推断细胞内调控如何适应微环境信号，且常使用固定基因词汇表，难以泛化到未见基因。
Method: 提出 HEIST，一种分层图Transformer，将组织建模为空间细胞图（上层）和每个细胞内的基因共表达网络图（下层），通过层内和跨层消息传递学习层次嵌入。预训练使用空间感知对比学习和掩码自编码目标。
Result: 预训练后在临床结果预测、细胞类型注释和基因插补等任务上达到最先进性能，并能零样本泛化到空间蛋白质组学数据。无监督分析发现了先前模型遗漏的空间信息亚群。
Conclusion: HEIST 通过分层图建模有效整合空间信息和细胞内基因/蛋白质程序，提升了泛化能力和下游任务性能。

papers.title: RoCA: Robust Cross-Domain End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has recently emerged as a new paradigm, offering significant potential. However, few studies have looked into the practical challenge of deployment across domains (e.g., cities). Although several works have incorporated Large Language Models (LLMs) to leverage their open-world knowledge, LLMs do not guarantee cross-domain driving performance and may incur prohibitive retraining costs during domain adaptation. In this paper, we propose RoCA, a novel framework for robust cross-domain E2E autonomous driving. RoCA formulates the joint probabilistic distribution over the tokens that encode ego and surrounding vehicle information in the E2E pipeline. Instantiating with a Gaussian process (GP), RoCA learns a set of basis tokens with corresponding trajectories, which span diverse driving scenarios. Then, given any driving scene, it is able to probabilistically infer the future trajectory. By using RoCA together with a base E2E model in source-domain training, we improve the generalizability of the base model, without requiring extra inference computation. In addition, RoCA enables robust adaptation on new target domains, significantly outperforming direct finetuning. We extensively evaluate RoCA on various cross-domain scenarios and show that it achieves strong domain generalization and adaptation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoCA，一个用于鲁棒跨域端到端自动驾驶的框架。RoCA 通过高斯过程对编码自车和周围车辆信息的 token 联合概率分布建模，学习一组基 token 及其轨迹，覆盖多种驾驶场景，从而概率性地推断未来轨迹。与基础 E2E 模型结合可提升泛化性，无需额外推理计算，并在新目标域上表现优于直接微调。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶跨域部署（如不同城市）面临性能下降问题，而引入大语言模型的方法不能保证跨域性能且域自适应成本高昂。
Method: RoCA 对 E2E 流水线中编码自车和周围车辆信息的 token 构建联合概率分布，通过高斯过程实例化，学习一组基 token 及其对应轨迹，并利用这些基 token 概率推断未来轨迹。在源域训练时与基础 E2E 模型联合使用。
Result: 在多种跨域场景下，RoCA 实现了强泛化性和自适应性能，显著优于直接微调，且无需额外推理计算。
Conclusion: RoCA 通过概率建模和基 token 方法有效提升端到端自动驾驶的跨域鲁棒性，为实际部署提供了可行方案。

summary_sections.method: RoCA 对 E2E 流水线中编码自车和周围车辆信息的 token 构建联合概率分布，通过高斯过程实例化，学习一组基 token 及其对应轨迹，并利用这些基 token 概率推断未来轨迹。在源域训练时与基础 E2E 模型联合使用。
summary_sections.result: 在多种跨域场景下，RoCA 实现了强泛化性和自适应性能，显著优于直接微调，且无需额外推理计算。
summary_sections.conclusion: RoCA 通过概率建模和基 token 方法有效提升端到端自动驾驶的跨域鲁棒性，为实际部署提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Cluster-Aware Causal Mixer for Online Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Early and accurate detection of anomalies in time-series data is critical due to the substantial risks associated with false or missed detections. While MLP-based mixer models have shown promise in time-series analysis, they do not maintain temporal causality during data processing. Moreover, real-world multivariate time series often contain numerous channels with diverse inter-channel correlations. Spurious correlations in the reconstructed time series lead to noisy representations, resulting in inaccurate anomaly detection. In addition, anomaly scoring methods that ignore temporal continuity can mislead sequential detection. To address these challenges, we propose a cluster-aware causal mixer for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Channels are grouped into clusters based on their correlations, and each cluster is embedded through a dedicated embedding layer. A causal mixer is introduced to integrate information while maintaining temporal causality. We further develop a sequential anomaly-scoring method that accumulates evidence over time and refines anomaly boundaries. Our proposed model operates in an online fashion, making it suitable for real-time time-series anomaly detection. Experimental evaluations across six public benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently achieves superior performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于聚类感知的因果混合器（Cluster-Aware Causal Mixer）用于多变量时间序列的在线异常检测。通过将通道按相关性聚类并使用独立嵌入层，结合保持时序因果性的混合器，以及累积证据的连续异常评分方法，在六个公开基准上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有MLP混合器模型在处理多变量时间序列时无法保持时序因果性，且真实数据中多通道间的虚假相关性导致噪声表示，影响异常检测准确性。同时，忽略时序连续性的异常评分方法会误导序列检测。
Method: 首先将多变量时间序列的通道根据相关性聚类，每个聚类使用专用嵌入层；然后提出因果混合器（causal mixer）在保持时序因果性的前提下整合信息；最后开发一种连续的异常评分方法，随时间累积证据并细化异常边界。模型以在线方式运行，适用于实时检测。
Result: 在六个公开基准数据集上，所提方法一致地取得了优于现有方法的性能（摘要未提供具体数值）。
Conclusion: 聚类感知和因果性保持是提升多变量时间序列在线异常检测的关键，但摘要未提及该方法在其他领域或更大尺度上的局限性。

papers.title: GenFT: A Generative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Method for Pretrained Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has emerged as a resource-efficient strategy for adapting Pretrained Foundation Models (PFMs) by learning a small number of task-specific updates $ΔW$. Existing methods often learn $ΔW$ largely independently of pretrained weights $W_0$, or exploit $W_0$ mainly through initialization or simple reparameterization. To further leverage the structural information encoded in $W_0$, we propose Generative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (GenFT), a $W_0$-conditioned PEFT method that uses a deterministic weight generator to produce task-specific updates. Specifically, GenFT performs row and column transformations with nonlinear activations to extract structured patterns from $W_0$, and introduces a shared-specific decomposition to balance cross-layer information reuse and layer-specific flexibility. GenFT is simple and parameter-efficient, achieving competitive or better average performance across NLP and CV benchmarks. We further provide a pilot study on LLaMA-7B to examine its feasibility for generative models. The code is available at GitHub https://github.com/xuguangning1218/GenFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为GenFT的参数高效微调方法，利用预训练权重W0的结构信息生成任务特定更新。通过行/列变换、非线性激活和共享-特定分解，GenFT在NLP和CV基准上达到与现有方法相当或更优的平均性能，并在LLaMA-7B上验证了可行性。
Motivation: 现有PEFT方法学习ΔW时多半独立于W0，或仅通过初始化/简单重参数化利用W0，未能充分挖掘W0中编码的结构信息。
Method: GenFT采用一个以W0为条件的确定性权重生成器，通过行/列变换和非线性激活提取W0中的结构模式，并引入共享-特定分解（shared-specific decomposition）以平衡跨层信息复用与逐层灵活性。
Result: 在NLP和CV基准上，GenFT达到与现有PEFT方法相当或更优的平均性能；在LLaMA-7B上的初步研究显示其适用于生成模型。
Conclusion: GenFT是一种简单且参数高效的PEFT方法，能有效利用预训练权重的结构信息，并具有良好的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reformulating Neural Operators in $d+1$ Dimensions for Embedding Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Neural Operators (NOs) are powerful architectures for learning mappings between function spaces. While most advances focus on refining kernel parameterizations over the $d$-dimensional physical domain, the evolution of lifted embeddings remains underexplored, which often drives models toward computationally expensive embedding-scaling designs to improve approximation. In this paper, we introduce an auxiliary function dimension that models embedding evolution in operator form, thereby reformulating the NO pipeline in $d+1$ dimensions. We instantiate this framework via Fourier-based operators acting jointly on the physical and auxiliary domains, yielding a basis-diversified auxiliary evolution module as an alternative to brute-force embedding scaling. Across more than ten increasingly challenging benchmarks, ranging from the 1D heat equation to the highly nonlinear 3D Rayleigh-Taylor instability, our model consistently achieves the lowest relative $L_2$ error among the evaluated baselines. Crucially, this advantage is empirically supported by (1) controlled budget-aware comparisons against scaled and ablated baselines; (2) robustness under mixed-resolution training and super-resolution inference; and (3) zero-shot generalization to unseen temporal regimes. In addition, we present a broader set of design choices for lifting and recovery operators, demonstrating their impact on our model's predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在 $d$ 维物理域上引入一个辅助函数维度来显式建模嵌入演化，从而将神经算子 (Neural Operator) 管道重构成 $d+1$ 维形式。通过傅里叶基算子联合作用于物理域和辅助域，实现了基多样化辅助演化模块，作为暴力嵌入缩放的替代方案。在从一维热方程到三维Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性的十余个基准上，模型取得了最低的相对 $L_2$ 误差，并展示了在混合分辨率训练、超分辨率推理和零样本时间泛化上的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的神经算子主要改进物理域上的核参数化，但忽略了嵌入演化过程，导致模型常依赖计算昂贵的嵌入缩放设计来提升逼近能力。本文旨在通过显式建模嵌入演化来避免这种开销。
Method: 引入一个辅助函数维度，将嵌入演化表示成算子形式，从而将神经算子管道扩展到 $d+1$ 维。具体实例化使用傅里叶算子联合作用于物理域和辅助域，形成基多样化辅助演化模块。同时提出了提升和恢复算子的多种设计选择。
Result: 在超过十个基准上（包括1D热方程和3D Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性），模型在所有评估基线中取得最低相对 $L_2$ 误差。优势通过预算感知对比、混合分辨率训练和超分辨率推理鲁棒性、以及零样本时间泛化得到验证。
Conclusion: 本文的 $d+1$ 维框架为神经算子的嵌入演化提供了一种替代暴力缩放的新思路，并展示了较好的泛化能力。但摘要未明确讨论其在下游应用中的局限性，例如降水临近预报等具体任务。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Do MLLMs Capture How Interfaces Guide User Behavior? A Benchmark for Multimodal UI/UX Design Understanding
papers.abstract_en: User interface (UI) design goes beyond visuals to shape user experience (UX), underscoring the shift toward UI/UX as a unified concept. While recent studies have explored UI evaluation using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they largely focus on surface-level features, overlooking how design choices influence user behavior at scale. To fill this gap, we introduce WiserUI-Bench, a novel benchmark for multimodal understanding of how UI/UX design affects user behavior, built on 300 real-world UI image pairs from industry A/B tests, with empirically validated winners that induced more user actions. For future design progress in practice, post-hoc understanding of why such winners succeed with mass users is also required; we support this via expert-curated key interpretations for each instance. Experiments across multiple MLLMs on WiserUI-Bench for two main tasks, (1) predicting the more effective UI image between an A/B-tested pair, and (2) explaining it post-hoc in alignment with expert interpretations, show that models exhibit limited understanding of the behavioral impact of UI/UX design. We believe our work will foster research on leveraging MLLMs for visual design in user behavior contexts.
papers.comment: ACL 2026 Main. Our code and dataset: https://github.com/jeochris/wiserui-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WiserUI-Bench，一个基于300个来自工业A/B测试的真实UI图像对的基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）对UI/UX设计如何影响用户行为的理解。每个图像对包含经验证更有效的版本及专家解释。实验表明，多个MLLMs在预测有效UI和后验解释任务上表现有限。
Motivation: 现有UI评估研究主要关注浅层视觉特征，忽略了设计选择对用户行为的驱动作用，缺乏衡量MLLMs理解UI/UX行为影响的基准。
Method: 构建WiserUI-Bench，包含300个A/B测试UI图像对，每个对标注了引发更多用户行为的获胜版本，并由专家提供关键解释。设计两个任务：1) 预测更有效的UI；2) 生成与专家解释一致的后验解释。
Result: 在多个MLLMs上的实验显示，模型在预测和解释任务上表现有限，表明其对UI/UX设计行为影响的理解不足。
Conclusion: 本文认为该基准将促进利用MLLMs理解用户行为背景下视觉设计的研究。

papers.title: CLASH: Evaluating Language Models on Judging High-Stakes Dilemmas from Multiple Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Navigating dilemmas involving conflicting values is challenging even for humans in high-stakes domains, let alone for AI, yet prior work has been limited to everyday scenarios. To close this gap, we introduce CLASH (Character perspective-based LLM Assessments in Situations with High-stakes), a meticulously curated dataset consisting of 345 high-impact dilemmas along with 3,795 individual perspectives of diverse values. CLASH enables the study of critical yet underexplored aspects of value-based decision-making processes, including understanding of decision ambivalence and psychological discomfort as well as capturing the temporal shifts of values in the perspectives of characters. By benchmarking 14 non-thinking and thinking models, we uncover several key findings. (1) Even strong proprietary models, such as GPT-5 and Claude-4-Sonnet, struggle with ambivalent decisions, achieving only 24.06 and 51.01 accuracy. (2) Although LLMs reasonably predict psychological discomfort, they do not adequately comprehend perspectives involving value shifts. (3) Cognitive behaviors that are effective in the math-solving and game strategy domains do not transfer to value reasoning. Instead, new failure patterns emerge, including early commitment and overcommitment. (4) The steerability of LLMs towards a given value is significantly correlated with their value preferences. (5) Finally, LLMs exhibit greater steerability when reasoning from a third-party perspective, although certain values (e.g., safety) benefit uniquely from first-person framing.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了CLASH数据集，包含345个高风险困境及3795个不同价值观的视角，用于评估语言模型在价值判断中的表现。对14个模型（包括GPT-5、Claude-4-Sonnet）的基准测试显示，即使是强大模型在处理矛盾决策、价值转变时表现不佳，且数学推理中的有效认知行为无法迁移到价值推理。
Motivation: 现有研究仅关注日常场景的价值决策，缺乏高风险困境中多视角价值判断的评估基准。
Method: 构建CLASH数据集，包含345个高影响力困境和3795个不同价值观的人物视角，并设计评估指标包括决策矛盾性、心理不适、价值时间变化。
Result: GPT-5和Claude-4-Sonnet在矛盾决策准确率仅24.06%和51.01%；模型能合理预测心理不适但无法理解价值转变；数学域有效行为不迁移至价值推理，出现早期承诺和过度承诺等新失败模式。
Conclusion: LLMs在高风险价值推理中存在根本性局限，且价值可导性受模型自身价值偏好影响，第三方视角下可导性更强但特定价值（如安全）受益于第一人称框架。
