papers.title: Output Type Before Quality: A Standards-Derived XAI Admissibility Rubric for Autonomous-Driving Safety
papers.abstract_en: Safety standards for ML-based autonomous driving specify the kind of evidence an assurance case must contain (directed cause-and-effect chains, quantified interventional effects, named root-cause variables), yet the XAI literature is organised by output type and technique family (saliency maps, feature attribution, counterfactuals, causal graphs, language traces). SHAP, the most-recommended ADS XAI method, returns a ranked feature list that no implementation effort can convert into a directed chain (Fig.1). We name this mismatch the evidence-type gap. From AMLAS, ISO 26262, ISO21448, ISO/PAS 8800 we derive 19 testable evidentiary criteria across 7 lifecycle stages with representative clause-cited derivations and score six XAI method classes structurally. Causal XAI emerges as structurally required to satisfy the derived criteria at three stages: hazard identification (+62% rubric gap), incident investigation (+50%), and data management (+50%); the verdict set is stable across thresholds T in (0%, 50%]$ and survives a worst-case single-cell flip down to T = 25%. At the remaining four stages, correlational or language-based methods are comparable or sufficient. The rubric identifies structural admissibility (necessary but not sufficient for compliance): an admissible method's specific output content may still be wrong, and validating that fidelity (the edges a fitted SCM produces, the cause a trace names) is the open assurance challenge. A single-VLA proof of concept on 1,996 real-world driving clips (79,840 rows, ten splits) is consistent with each method's observed output type matching its rubric prediction. XAI method selection for ADS safety assurance should be driven by lifecycle-stage evidence demand, not by method popularity.

papers.title: ORACLE-CT: Anatomy-Aware Support Pooling for CT Classification
papers.abstract_en: Abdominal CT disease classification is challenging because each scan is a large 3D volume with many possible findings, while diagnostic evidence is often confined to specific organs or anatomical compartments. Most study-level classifiers aggregate encoder features using anatomy-agnostic pooling or attention, creating a mismatch between localized disease evidence and global evidence aggregation. We propose ORACLE--CT, an encoder-agnostic anatomy-aware aggregation framework that uses multi-organ segmentation to define label-specific anatomical supports and restrict attention pooling to relevant regions. The framework supports single-organ, multi-organ union, comparative, localized, and global support strategies. We evaluate ORACLE--CT with three encoder families: DINOv3, I3D--ResNet-121, and the radiology-native Pillar--0 encoder. Models are trained end-to-end on MERLIN and evaluated internally and under frozen external transfer to Duke--Abdomen and AMOS. Compared with global average pooling, support-masked pooling improved MERLIN macro-AUROC/AUPRC from 0.838/0.638 to 0.858/0.676 for DINOv3 and from 0.829/0.617 to 0.848/0.659 for I3D--ResNet-121. On harmonized 10-label external evaluation, DINOv3 improved on Duke--Abdomen from 0.802/0.628 to 0.835/0.683 and on AMOS from 0.742/0.313 to 0.762/0.350, with similar gains for I3D--ResNet-121. For Pillar--0, most gains came from learned attention, with smaller additional benefit from anatomical masking. ORACLE--CT improves discrimination and external robustness while preserving an auditable link between predictions and anatomical evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ORACLE-CT，一个编码器无关的解剖感知聚合框架，用于腹部CT疾病分类。该方法利用多器官分割定义标签特定的解剖支撑区域，将注意力池化限制在相关区域。实验表明，与全局平均池化相比，支撑掩蔽池化在MERLIN、Duke-Abdomen和AMOS数据集上提升了AUROC和AUPRC，同时保持了预测与解剖证据之间的可审计联系。
Motivation: 腹部CT扫描是3D体积，诊断证据通常局限于特定器官，而现有分类器使用与解剖无关的池化，导致局部证据与全局聚合不匹配。
Method: 提出ORACLE-CT框架，使用多器官分割定义标签特定的解剖支撑区域，并限制注意力池化到这些区域，支持多种支撑策略（单器官、多器官联合、比较、局部和全局）。
Result: 在MERLIN上，DINOv3的宏AUROC/AUPRC从0.838/0.638提升到0.858/0.676；在Duke-Abdomen上从0.802/0.628到0.835/0.683；在AMOS上从0.742/0.313到0.762/0.350。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ORACLE-CT提高了区分能力和外部鲁棒性，同时保持了预测与解剖证据之间的可审计联系。

papers.title: Horse Eye Blink Detection and Classification for Equine Affective State Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Automated detection of equine facial action units (AUs) is a promising yet under-explored avenue for pain and affective state assessment in horses. Half and full-blink movements are recognised indicators of pain and stress, but as micro-expressions, their subtle, fine-grained nature makes them easily missed by the naked eye and only discernible through frame-by-frame video inspection, making reliable automated detection from video a particularly demanding task. We develop and evaluate three methods for automated blink classification from horse videos: a frame-based YOLOv12 detector, an optical flow magnitude thresholding approach, and a fine-tuned VideoMAE model, tested on a publicly available dataset. We achieve a macro-F1 score of 0.898 when doing blink classification and 0.926 on binary blink detection. Our results highlight both the potential and the inherent challenges of fine-grained AU detection for equine welfare monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对马匹情感状态评估中的眼部眨眼检测与分类问题，开发并评估了三种方法：基于帧的YOLOv12检测器、光流幅度阈值方法和微调的VideoMAE模型。在公开数据集上，眨眼分类的macro-F1达到0.898，二值眨眼检测的F1达到0.926。
Motivation: 自动检测马匹面部动作单元（AU）用于疼痛和情感评估的研究不足，而眨眼作为疼痛和压力的微表情指标，容易被人眼忽略，需要可靠的自动化方法。
Method: 提出并比较三种自动化眨眼分类方法：YOLOv12帧级检测、光流幅度阈值分割以及微调VideoMAE模型。
Result: 在公开马匹视频数据集上，眨眼分类macro-F1为0.898，二值眨眼检测F1为0.926。
Conclusion: 结果表明细粒度AU检测在马匹福利监测中有潜力，但也面临固有挑战。

papers.title: Disentangled Fine-Grained Prototype Learning for Incomplete Image-Tabular Classification
papers.abstract_en: The missing-modality problem poses a significant challenge in image-tabular multimodal learning across a wide range of multimedia applications, including product understanding, recommendation systems, and medical diagnosis. This challenge is particularly pronounced when the two modalities are highly heterogeneous, as images and tabular attributes differ substantially in their semantic granularity and data distributions. Existing methods learn modality-invariant representations through disentanglement and alignment over global token-averaged features, capturing only coarse cross-modal consistency and overlooking fine-grained semantic and distributional misalignment, which hampers the exploitation of complementary cues under missing modalities. To address this, we propose DFPL, a novel framework for fine-grained prototype learning. Specifically, Shared-Specific Prototype Modeling (SSPM) extracts compact and diverse shared and modality-specific prototypes, and further performs prototype-level disentanglement to suppress redundant intra-modality correlations. Additionally, we propose a Prototype-guided Fine-grained Alignment (PFA) module that jointly enforces prototype-level distribution matching and prototype-to-class semantic alignment within a unified prototype space, thereby preserving both fine-grained distributional and semantic consistency across modalities. We further introduce a Class-aware Multi-scale Aggregation (CMA) module to adaptively aggregate shared semantics and modality-specific characteristics from global and prototype levels for robust predictions. Extensive experiments on three diverse image-tabular benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to the previous approaches under various missing-modality settings. Code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像-表格多模态学习中的缺失模态问题，提出解耦细粒度原型学习框架 DFPL。通过共享-特定原型建模、原型级细粒度对齐和类别感知多尺度聚合，在三个基准上实现了优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有方法仅利用全局令牌平均特征进行跨模态解耦与对齐，忽略了细粒度的语义和分布错配，限制了缺失模态下互补信息的有效利用。
Method: 提出共享-特定原型建模 (SSPM) 提取紧凑且多样化的共享与特定模态原型，并实现原型级解耦；原型引导细粒度对齐 (PFA) 联合执行原型级分布匹配与原型-类别语义对齐；类别感知多尺度聚合 (CMA) 自适应融合全局与原型级的共享及特定特征。
Result: 在三个图像-表格多模态基准上，所提方法在各种缺失模态设置下均达到优于先前方法的性能。
Conclusion: DFPL 通过细粒度原型学习有效缓解了异构模态缺失带来的挑战，代码将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Insurance of Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are transforming the risk landscape by extending beyond information generation to autonomous planning, tool invocation, decision execution, and persistent modification of digital and physical environments. These capabilities introduce novel exposures that do not fit neatly within traditional insurance categories such as cyber, professional liability, product liability, or directors and officers coverage. This paper examines the emerging insurance market for agentic AI and develops a framework for understanding its underwriting, pricing, reinsurance, and product-design implications. We characterize agentic AI as a continuum of autonomy and delegated authority, emphasizing the distinction between informational outputs and systems capable of independently generating insured events through external actions. We analyze major risk pathways, including hallucinations, prompt-injection attacks, autonomous decision errors, model drift, dependency failures, and cyber-physical harms, and evaluate how existing insurance products are adapting to address these exposures. The paper further proposes an actuarial framework based on exposure assessment, scenario analysis, dependency mapping, and accumulation-risk management, drawing parallels to the evolution of cyber insurance. Finally, we present a coordinated insurance architecture that integrates cyber, technology errors and omissions, product liability, performance-warranty, and affirmative AI-liability coverages through explicit allocation mechanisms and dedicated AI aggregates. The analysis suggests that the future of agentic-AI insurance lies not in a single monoline product but in a layered ecosystem of complementary coverages supported by improved governance, transparency, telemetry, and regulatory clarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了代理型人工智能（Agentic AI）系统带来的新型风险及其保险市场，提出了承保、定价、再保险和产品设计的框架。通过分析主要风险路径（如幻觉、提示注入、自主决策错误等），提出了基于暴露评估、情景分析和累积风险管理的精算框架，并设计了整合多种责任保险的协调架构。
Motivation: 现有保险类别（如网络、专业责任、产品责任等）无法涵盖Agentic AI的自主规划、工具调用、决策执行和环境修改能力带来的新型风险暴露。
Method: 将Agentic AI描述为自主性和授权委托的连续谱，分析主要风险路径，提出基于暴露评估、情景分析、依赖映射和累积风险管理的精算框架，并设计协调的保险架构。
Result: 分析了现有保险产品的适应情况，提出了一个协调的保险架构，整合网络、技术错误与遗漏、产品责任、性能保证和肯定性AI责任保险。
Conclusion: 未来Agentic AI保险不在于单一产品，而在于由改进的治理、透明度、遥测和监管清晰度支持的多层互补保险生态系统。

papers.title: Brick-Composer: Using MLLMs for Assembly with Diverse Bricks
papers.abstract_en: We dream of AI agents that can read arbitrary designs and construct real-world objects from reusable building blocks. As a first step toward this vision, we study whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) possess the visual grounding and spatial reasoning capabilities required for brick assembly. We formulate brick assembly as a sequential decision-making problem, where each step involves two subtasks: brick selection, identifying the target brick from candidate components, and brick pose estimation, predicting where and how the selected brick should be placed. To support this study, we introduce BC-Bench (Brick Construction Benchmark), the first benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on assembly with diverse bricks. Experiments show that current state-of-the-art MLLMs remain far from reliable builders, struggling with fine-grained brick selection and failing at precise pose estimation. To bridge this gap, we propose Brick-Composer, a learning framework that equips MLLMs with assembly skills through three complementary signals: Human Design Sparks, which provide affordance-rich construction demonstrations; World Feedback, which grounds predicted actions in visual and physical consequences; and Synthetic Experience, which scales learning beyond existing object designs. Brick-Composer improves brick selection accuracy by over three times, substantially reduces pose estimation errors, and raises strict step-level assembly success from less than 1% to around 15%. After training, a Qwen-3-8B can correctly compose up to 42% of the steps for a complete object, suggesting that MLLMs can acquire assembly capabilities through targeted, physically grounded learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在砖块组装任务中的能力，将组装定义为顺序决策问题，包含砖块选择和姿态估计两个子任务。作者构建了BC-Bench基准，并发现现有MLLM表现不佳。为此提出Brick-Composer框架，通过人类设计火花、世界反馈和合成经验三种信号提升组装能力，使砖块选择准确率提高三倍以上，并将步骤级组装成功率从不足1%提升至约15%。
Motivation: AI代理需具备从任意设计图构建真实物体的能力，当前MLLM在砖块组装所需的视觉定位和空间推理能力上存在不足，缺乏相关评估基准和训练方法。
Method: 将砖块组装建模为顺序决策问题，每步包含砖块选择和姿态估计。提出Brick-Composer框架，利用三种互补信号：人类设计火花（提供丰富交互演示）、世界反馈（基于视觉和物理后果调整预测）和合成经验（扩展学习范围）。
Result: Brick-Composer使砖块选择准确率提升三倍以上，姿态估计误差大幅降低，步骤级组装成功率从<1%提升至约15%；Qwen-3-8B模型能正确完成完整物体组装步骤的42%。
Conclusion: MLLM通过针对性的物理接地学习可以获得组装能力，但当前仍远未达到可靠构建者水平，尤其在精确姿态估计上存在困难。

papers.title: Multilingual Coreference Resolution via Cycle-Consistent Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Coreference resolution is a core NLP task, having a broad range of downstream applications, e.g.~machine translation, question answering, document summarization, etc. While the task is well-studied in English, comparatively less attention is dedicated to coreference resolution in other languages, especially low-resource ones. To mitigate this gap, we propose a novel coreference resolution pipeline that harnesses machine translation (MT) from English to a target low-resource language, to generate or expand training data. To automatically validate the quality of the translated samples, we back-translate the samples and assess the similarity with the original English samples via cosine similarity in the latent space of a BERT model. The resulting similarity scores are integrated into the loss function to weight training samples according to their MT cycle consistency. Extensive experiments on four low-resource languages show that our pipeline brings significant performance gains in coreference resolution. Moreover, our pipeline enables accurate coreference resolution in languages where no previous corpora were available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用机器翻译生成或扩充低资源语言共指消解训练数据的流水线。通过将英语样本翻译为目标语言，再反向翻译回英语，使用BERT计算余弦相似度评估翻译质量，并将相似度作为样本权重集成到损失函数中。在四种低资源语言上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了共指消解性能，甚至在无先前语料库的语言中也能获得准确结果。
Motivation: 共指消解在英语中研究充分，但低资源语言（尤其是极低资源语言）缺乏标注数据和模型研究。
Method: 提出基于循环一致性机器翻译的流水线：先利用机器翻译将英语共指样本翻译为低资源语言，再反向翻译回英语；通过BERT计算原始英语与反向翻译样本的余弦相似度，将其作为训练样本权重集成到损失函数中。
Result: 在四种低资源语言上的实验显示，该流水线带来显著的共指消解性能提升，并能在先前无语料库的语言中实现准确共指消解。
Conclusion: 循环一致性机器翻译可有效生成低资源语言共指消解训练数据，无需人工标注，且通过质量加权提升模型效果。

papers.title: GOTabPFN: From Feature Ordering to Compact Tokenization for Tabular Foundation Models on High-Dimensional Data
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how to make small tabular foundation models effective for High-Dimensional, Low-Sample Size (HDLSS) tabular prediction without retraining large backbones. We introduce Graph-guided Ordering with Local Refinement (GO-LR), show its equivalence to weighted Minimum Linear Arrangement, and interpret the practical solver as a TSP-path-style surrogate. We propose GOTabPFN,which builds on GO-LR, and a Neuro-Inspired Subunit Compression (NSC) unit to pool locally adjacent ordered features into meta-features, yielding a compact representation that makes TabPFN-style prediction practical in HDLSS regimes. Across tabular benchmarks, GOTabPFN improves stability and accuracy under tight token budgets.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Code and resources are available at: GitHub: https://github.com/zadid6pretam/GOTabPFN; PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/gotabpfn/; Project webpage: https://www.zadidhabib.com/gotabpfn.html; Hugging Face Space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/zadid6pretam/GOTabPFN and https://zadid6pretam-GOTabPFN.hf.space
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维低样本（HDLSS）表格预测任务，提出无需重训大型骨干网络的小型基础模型 GOTabPFN。其核心包含图引导排序与局部细化（GO-LR）模块（等价于加权最小线性排列的 TSP 路径求解）和神经启发子单元压缩（NSC）单元，后者将局部相邻有序特征池化为元特征，从而在紧凑 token 预算下实现 TabPFN 风格预测。实验表明，该模型在多个表格基准上提升了稳定性和准确性。
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型在高维低样本场景下性能不佳，且重训大型骨干网络代价高昂，亟需一种轻量级方法使小模型也能有效处理此类数据。
Method: 提出 GO-LR 模块对特征进行排序，并通过 NSC 单元将相邻有序特征压缩为元特征，形成紧凑的 token 表示，使 TabPFN 风格的 transformer 预测器能在 HDLSS 设定下稳定运行。
Result: 在多个表格基准上，GOTabPFN 在严格 token 预算下相比基线方法提升了稳定性和准确性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 该方法为高维低样本表格预测提供了一种无需重训大模型的实用方案，但局限性可能包括对特征顺序的依赖性以及当前仅在表格数据上验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sharp First-Order Lower Bounds for Higher-Order Smooth Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study the deterministic first-order oracle complexity of finding \(ε\)-stationary points in smooth nonconvex optimization when the objective satisfies higher-order smoothness assumptions. While the classical \(ε^{-2}\) rate is optimal under only Lipschitz gradients, higher-order smoothness leads to accelerated first-order upper bounds, most notably the \(ε^{-7/4}\) rate under Lipschitz Hessians and the \(ε^{-5/3}\) rate under Lipschitz third derivatives. The matching lower bounds, however, have remained open. We resolve this gap by proving a new dimension-free first-order lower bound for higher-order smooth nonconvex functions, valid for every finite smoothness order. In particular, our construction gives a matching \(Ω(ε^{-7/4})\) lower bound in the Hessian-Lipschitz case and a matching \(Ω(ε^{-5/3})\) lower bound in the third-order-smooth regime. The hard instance is based on a \emph{block-chain} mechanism that enforces blockwise oracle revelation while preserving the smoothness structure needed for the scalar hard instance. The lower-bound construction was discovered with the assistance of ChatGPT 5.5 Pro and subsequently verified by the authors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高阶光滑非凸优化中寻找ε-稳定点的确定性一阶复杂度下界。作者证明了一个维度无关的下界，在Hessian-Lipschitz情况下匹配Ω(ε^{-7/4})，在三阶光滑下匹配Ω(ε^{-5/3})，填补了已知上界与下界之间的空白。构造基于块链机制，并借助ChatGPT辅助发现。
Motivation: 经典一阶复杂度下界ε^{-2}在只有Lipschitz梯度时是最优的，但高阶光滑条件下已有更快的上界（如ε^{-7/4}、ε^{-5/3}），匹配的下界一直缺失。
Method: 提出了一个基于块链（block-chain）机制的硬实例构造，迫使每次只能揭示一个块的信息，同时保持标量硬实例所需的光滑结构；该构造有ChatGPT辅助发现。
Result: 证明了维度无关的一阶下界：Hessian-Lipschitz下Ω(ε^{-7/4})，三阶光滑下Ω(ε^{-5/3})，与已知上界匹配。
Conclusion: 该工作完全解决了高阶光滑非凸优化中确定性一阶下界问题，为未来算法设计提供了信息论极限。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Navigation
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces a hybrid deep learning approach integrated with an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) to enhance pose estimation accuracy in Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) for autonomous navigation. The proposed model employs a Vision Transformer (ViT) network to effectively capture temporal dependencies from inertial measurement unit (IMU) data and utilizes a Multiscale Convolutional Neural Network (MCNN) to learn optical flow-based motion cues from visual data. An adaptive sensor fusion module dynamically weights IMU and visual features by leveraging estimated uncertainty, thus improving robustness in diverse and challenging environmental conditions. Additionally, a novel uncertainty-aware loss function is proposed to explicitly incorporate prediction uncertainty into the learning process, enabling robust and accurate navigation under noisy, incomplete, or unreliable sensor inputs. Comprehensive evaluations of the KITTI dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms baseline approaches, achieving superior performance in terms of Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) and Relative Pose Error (RPE). The lightweight and computationally efficient model processes data at 155 FPS on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, making it highly suitable for deployment in resource-constrained autonomous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）的混合深度学习方法，用于提升自主导航中视觉惯性里程计（VIO）的位姿估计精度。模型采用视觉Transformer（ViT）提取IMU时序特征、多尺度CNN（MCNN）学习光流运动线索，并通过不确定性感知的自适应融合模块动态加权IMU与视觉特征。实验在KITTI数据集上显示，该方法在绝对轨迹误差（ATE）和相对位姿误差（RPE）上显著优于基线，且推理速度达到155 FPS（NVIDIA A100）。
Motivation: 现有VIO方法在环境变化或传感器噪声下鲁棒性不足，需要一种能够自适应融合多模态传感器信息并考虑不确定性的方法。
Method: 提出混合架构：ViT处理IMU时序，MCNN处理视觉光流；自适应融合模块根据估计的不确定性动态调整视觉与IMU特征的权重；设计不确定性感知损失函数，将预测不确定性显式纳入学习过程。
Result: 在KITTI数据集上，所提方法在ATE和RPE上均显著优于基线，处理速度达155 FPS，且模型轻量高效。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知的自适应传感器融合能有效提升VIO在挑战性环境下的鲁棒性和精度，适合资源受限的自主系统。

papers.title: Ten Headache Specialists versus Artificial Intelligence for Clinical Literature Summarization: A Critical Evaluation and Comparison
papers.abstract_en: Summarizing the latest medical literature to guide clinical decision-making is essential for evidence-based medicine and high-quality patient care. Yet clinicians face increasing challenges due to limited time with patients and a rapidly growing volume of published articles. Although retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in clinical summarization, human evaluations of their effectiveness in synthesizing broader scientific literature and direct comparisons to expert-written syntheses remain scarce. We constructed a RAG-based agentic AI framework using three state-of-the-art LLMs: Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Llama 3.1. A headache specialist created 13 questions, three for prompt optimization and ten for evaluation. Ten headache specialists across the United States and Canada each wrote a summary for one question, yielding four summaries per question (expert, Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Llama). The experts, blinded to authorship, critically evaluated the summaries, excluding the topic for which they wrote a summary, based on correctness, completeness, conciseness, and clinical utility, scoring each from 1 to 10 using standardized rubrics. They also ranked the summaries by preference and indicated whether they believed each summary was written by an expert or an LLM. Our study, comparing LLM- and expert-written literature summaries evaluated by headache specialists, showed that expert-written summaries were preferred, although experts sometimes found it challenging to distinguish between human- and AI-generated summaries. We also identified key expert-valued features beyond standard evaluation metrics that can guide future refinement of both human and AI literature summarization pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了检索增强大型语言模型（Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1）与十位头痛专科医生在临床文献摘要方面的表现。专家评估了摘要的正确性、完整性、简洁性和临床实用性，结果显示专家撰写的摘要更受青睐，但专家有时难以区分人类与AI生成的摘要。研究还识别了超出标准评估指标的专家重视特征。
Motivation: 临床医生面临患者时间有限和文献快速增长的双重挑战，需要高效的文献摘要工具，但缺乏对AI摘要与专家摘要的直接比较和人类评估。
Method: 构建基于RAG的智能体AI框架，使用三种LLM；十位头痛专家各撰写一个主题的摘要，每个问题得到四份摘要（专家、Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama）。专家盲评这些摘要，根据正确性、完整性、简洁性和临床实用性打分（1-10），并进行偏好排序和作者判断。
Result: 专家撰写的摘要普遍更受偏好，但专家有时难以区分人类与AI生成的摘要。
Conclusion: 研究表明尽管专家摘要仍占优势，但AI摘要已具有相当竞争力；识别出的专家重视特征可为未来文献摘要流程改进提供指导。

papers.title: DP-MacAdam: Differentially Private Mechanism with Adaptive Clipping and Adaptive Momentum
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) has become the standard framework for privacy-preserving machine learning, yet its reliance on a fixed gradient clipping threshold to limit sensitivity remains a significant practical limitation. Adaptive clipping algorithms such as AdaClip shift and scale the gradient prior to clipping and adding noise so that the clipped gradient yields a more informative descent direction. The shift and scaling parameters are selected adaptively based on the empirical mean and variance. However, in existing adaptive clipping algorithms, these empirical estimates have not been also used for momentum to accelerate training itself. On the other hand, DP-Adam is an algorithm that exploits Adam-like momentum updates based on the gradient mean and variance to accelerate training, but does not exploit these estimates for adaptive clipping. In this work, we propose Differentially Private Mechanism with Adaptive Clipping and Adaptive Momentum (DP-MacAdam), a novel algorithm that combines these two approaches so as to use the same mean and variance estimates for both clipping and momentum. We perform an analysis showing that DP-MacAdam estimates the gradient variances in a bias-free manner. In addition, we empirically evaluate the privacy and accuracy of DP-MacAdam, demonstrating that it achieves improved model utility compared to DP-SGD, AdaClip, and DP-Adam baselines, without requiring manual tuning of the clipping threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DP-MacAdam，一种结合自适应剪切和自适应动量的差分隐私机制，利用相同的均值和方差估计同时进行剪切和动量更新，无需手动调节剪切阈值。
Motivation: 现有 DP-SGD 依赖固定剪切阈值，自适应剪切算法（如 AdaClip）和动量版（如 DP-Adam）各自利用估计值但未结合，导致效率或隐私预算浪费。
Method: 提出 DP-MacAdam，利用梯度均值和方差估计同时进行自适应剪切和 Adam 风格动量更新，并证明其无偏方差估计。
Result: 实验表明，相比 DP-SGD、AdaClip 和 DP-Adam，DP-MacAdam 在模型效用上有所提升，且无需手动调节剪切阈值。
Conclusion: 抽象强调结合两种自适应机制可以提升差分隐私训练的效率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 DP-MacAdam，利用梯度均值和方差估计同时进行自适应剪切和 Adam 风格动量更新，并证明其无偏方差估计。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明，相比 DP-SGD、AdaClip 和 DP-Adam，DP-MacAdam 在模型效用上有所提升，且无需手动调节剪切阈值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 抽象强调结合两种自适应机制可以提升差分隐私训练的效率。

papers.title: Selective-Advantage Entropy-Adaptive Horizon GRPO: Asymmetric Token-Level Discounting for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) has emerged as an effective reinforcement-learning algorithm for aligning language models on reasoning tasks, but it treats every token position and every sampled rollout symmetrically. We introduce two complementary extensions: (i) Adaptive-Horizon GRPO (AH-GRPO), which weights each token's policy gradient using a cumulative entropy-based discount that reduces the effective horizon when the model is uncertain, and (ii) Selective-Advantage AH-GRPO (SA-AH-GRPO), which applies this discounting only to negative-advantage rollouts, leaving positive-advantage, successful trajectories unattenuated. We evaluate standard GRPO with alpha = 0, AH-GRPO with alpha = 0.5, and SA-AH-GRPO with alpha = 0.5 on the GSM8K mathematical reasoning benchmark using both Qwen 2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen 2.5-3B-Instruct fine-tuned with LoRA. On the 3B model, SA-AH-GRPO achieves Pass@1 = 0.858 at its peak at step 30 and maintains 0.846 at 180 steps, with training variance reduced to 0.0246, a 3.6 times reduction relative to GRPO while matching its peak accuracy. On the 1.5B model, SA-AH-GRPO achieves a peak Pass@1 of 0.686, improving over the zero-shot baseline of 0.637. Our analysis shows that asymmetric discounting preserves the full gradient signal on correct solutions, prevents entropy collapse, and substantially stabilises training, suggesting a principled inductive bias for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards on structured generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GRPO在语言模型强化学习中的对称性缺陷，提出两种扩展：自适应视界GRPO（AH-GRPO）和选择性优势AH-GRPO（SA-AH-GRPO），后者仅对负优势轨迹进行熵折扣。在GSM8K数学推理任务上，3B模型达到0.858的峰值Pass@1，训练方差降低3.6倍，且未损失峰值准确率。
Motivation: 现有GRPO对称处理所有token位置和样本，未区分模型不确定性高的token和成功/失败轨迹，导致训练不稳定和熵崩塌。
Method: 提出AH-GRPO，基于累积熵对每个token的策略梯度进行折扣；进一步提出SA-AH-GRPO，仅对负优势轨迹应用折扣，正优势轨迹保持不变。
Result: 在GSM8K上，3B模型SA-AH-GRPO峰值Pass@1为0.858，180步时仍保持0.846，方差0.0246（相对GRPO降低3.6倍）；1.5B模型峰值Pass@1为0.686，优于零样本基线0.637。
Conclusion: 不对称折扣保留了正确轨迹的完整梯度信号，防止熵崩塌，显著稳定训练，为结构化生成任务中可验证奖励的强化学习提供了有效的归纳偏置。

papers.title: Zero knowledge verification for frontier AI training is possible
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI governance frameworks increasingly use cumulative training compute as the primary criterion for designating high-impact models, but enforcement rests on self-reporting because no technical verification primitive for training exists. Any future international agreement on frontier AI faces the same problem at higher stakes: coordinated regulation of technologies with significant externalities has historically rested on technical verification, without which agreements are declaratory. Recent governance analyses judge zero-knowledge proofs a promising candidate but currently impractical at frontier scale [26, 4]. We argue the impracticality is paradigm-bound rather than fundamental, and propose a verification architecture for frontier dense pre-training combining a pre-committed training specification, inter-node network observations, and on-the-fly Merkle commitments of intermediate computation, verified through a zero-knowledge Virtual Machine (zkVM) with native BF16/FP32 precompiles. The proof checks the actual floating-point computation the GPU performed rather than a fixed-point approximation, and preserves model-architecture confidentiality through a private training specification. The protocol produces three proof types: a genesis proof at initialisation, in-training step proofs across the run, and ex-ante attestations enforcing policy-relevant claims as running invariants, turning the training record into a governance-enforceable artefact. We estimate a deployable proof of concept within approximately 36 months at single-digit-percent training-side overhead, against a six-to-ten-year cycle for verification-grade custom silicon. Thirteen open research and engineering problems are catalogued as a research agenda for external contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了为前沿AI密集预训练实现零知识验证在技术上是可行的，提出了一种结合预提交训练规范、节点间网络观测、中间计算Merkle承诺以及原生BF16/FP32预编译的zkVM验证架构。协议可生成三种证明类型，将训练记录转化为可治理的工件，并预计在36个月内以个位数百分比训练开销实现可部署的概念验证。
Motivation: 前沿AI治理框架依赖累计训练算力作为高影响模型的标准，但缺乏技术验证原语，导致执行依赖自我报告，任何未来国际协议都面临同样问题。
Method: 提出验证架构：预提交训练规范 + 节点间网络观测 + 中间计算的即时Merkle承诺，通过支持原生BF16/FP32预编译的零知识虚拟机（zkVM）验证GPU实际浮点计算，同时通过私有训练规范保护模型架构机密性。
Result: 摘要估计在约36个月内可实现可部署概念验证，训练开销为个位数百分比，相比之下验证级定制芯片需6-10年周期。
Conclusion: 零知识验证的不可行性来源于范式而非根本，所提架构可生成三种证明类型（创世证明、训练中步骤证明、事前声明证明），使训练记录成为可治理的工件。

papers.title: Minimizing the Hidden Cost of Scales: Graph-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is critical for the efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs). Recent ultra-low-bit PTQ methods rely on rigid weight-saliency assumptions or position heuristics, introducing substantial hidden scaling overhead. We propose SAGE-PTQ (Saliency-Aware Graph-guided Efficient PTQ), a novel ultra-low-bit quantization framework for LLMs that minimizes hidden scaling cost. SAGE-PTQ separates salient and unsalient weights using distributional statistics, then models subsampled unsalient weights as a sparse graph to estimate the optimal number of groups per layer. SAGE-PTQ applies dual-mode quantization, assigning multi-bit precision to salient weights and binarizing unsalient weights. To reduce scaling overhead, SAGE-PTQ uses one per-channel scale for salient weights and one scalar per unsalient group. Finally, SAGE-PTQ implements adaptive saliency thresholding to select the optimal saliency ratio per matrix. SAGE-PTQ achieves 1.03 weight bits and only 0.004 scaling bits per matrix on average, outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as BiLLM and PB-LLM. On LLaMA-3-8B, SAGE-PTQ achieves 6.74 WikiText2 perplexity, compared to 55.8 for BiLLM, while using less than 50% of BiLLM's GPU memory. On LLaMA-2-70B, SAGE-PTQ provides 1.5x faster decoding on one NVIDIA L40 GPU, demonstrating practical inference efficiency.
papers.comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables, including appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE-PTQ，一种针对大语言模型的超低位量化框架，通过图引导的方式最小化隐藏缩放开销。该方法将权重分为显著和非显著，对非显著权重建模为稀疏图并分组，对显著权重用多比特量化，非显著权重二值化，并采用自适应显著性阈值。在LLaMA-3-8B上达到1.03权重比特和仅0.004缩放比特每矩阵，困惑度6.74，显著优于BiLLM。在LLaMA-2-70B上解码速度提升1.5倍。
Motivation: 现有超低位PTQ方法依赖于刚性的权重视觉重要性假设或位置启发式，引入大量隐藏缩放开销（hidden scaling overhead），导致效率低下。
Method: 提出SAGE-PTQ框架，包括：利用分布统计分离显著和非显著权重；将子采样的非显著权重建模为稀疏图，估计每层最佳组数；应用双模量化，对显著权重多比特，非显著权重二值化；为减少缩放开销，显著权重使用每通道缩放，非显著权重每组一个标量缩放；自适应显著性阈值选择每矩阵最优显著性比例。
Result: 在LLaMA-3-8B上，SAGE-PTQ达到1.03权重比特、0.004缩放比特每矩阵平均，WikiText2困惑度6.74，而BiLLM为55.8，且GPU内存使用少于BiLLM的50%。在LLaMA-2-70B上，在单个NVIDIA L40 GPU上解码速度提升1.5倍。
Conclusion: SAGE-PTQ通过图引导和自适应阈值显著降低了超低位量化中的缩放开销，实现了优于现有方法的精度和效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Assessing the Carbon Emissions and Energy Consumption of U.S. Hyperscale Data Centers
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of hyperscale data centers (HDCs) in the US, mainly driven by the adoption of artificial intelligence, has raised concerns about this industry's environmental footprint. We compiled facility-level information on 403 US hyperscale data centers operating between May 2024 and April 2025 and estimated their electricity consumption, electricity sources, and attributable CO2 emissions. Across different facility-load scenarios, these HDCs consumed approximately 68-99 TWh of electricity and were associated with about 37-54 million metric tons of CO2. Under the central scenario, HDC electricity demand corresponded to approximately 1.8% of total US electricity consumption, with roughly 54% of attributed generation supplied by fossil-fuel sources. The HDC electricity-weighted average carbon intensity was approximately 545 gCO2/kWh, about 48% above the contemporaneous US national grid-average carbon intensity of 370 gCO2/kWh. Our approach provides an attributional tool for assessing the environmental footprint of hyperscale data centers using the most recent EPA eGRID plant-level data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文汇编了2024年5月至2025年4月期间美国403个超大规模数据中心（HDC）的设施级信息，估算了其电力消耗、电力来源及可归因的CO2排放。在不同设施负载情景下，这些HDC消耗了约68-99 TWh电力，排放约37-54百万吨CO2。中央情景下，HDC电力需求约占美国总电力消耗的1.8%，其中约54%的发电来自化石燃料。HDC电力加权平均碳强度约为545 gCO2/kWh，比同期美国国家电网平均碳强度370 gCO2/kWh高出约48%。该方法基于最新EPA eGRID电厂级数据，为评估超大规模数据中心的环境足迹提供了归因工具。
Motivation: 人工智能的广泛采用推动了美国超大规模数据中心的快速增长，引发了对该行业环境足迹的担忧，但缺乏设施级碳排放和能源消耗的系统评估。
Method: 编译了403个美国超大规模数据中心的设施级信息，利用EPA eGRID电厂级数据估算电力消耗、电力来源及可归因的CO2排放，并考虑不同设施负载情景。
Result: 超大规模数据中心消耗约68-99 TWh电力，排放约37-54百万吨CO2；中央情景下电力需求占美国总用电1.8%，约54%来自化石燃料；碳强度545 gCO2/kWh，高出国家电网平均48%。
Conclusion: 该归因分析工具揭示了超大规模数据中心的高碳强度，指出了其高于国家电网平均水平的碳排放特征。

papers.title: Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Real-world data spans tables, documents, and semi-structured files with implicit semantics. Querying this data requires integrating evidence across inconsistent schemas and formats, yet existing approaches either demand costly manual engineering or bypass structure entirely. We present a system that automatically discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data and uses it as a shared contract for knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval. A closed-world field catalog constrains LLM-based schema discovery to attested fields; deterministic structural analysis infers identity keys, foreign keys, and source hierarchy; and the resulting schema drives extraction, deduplication, and cross-source linking into a provenance-aware knowledge graph. At query time the schema -- optionally extended via a monotonic protocol -- conditions a multi-tool agent routing retrieval across structured lookup, graph traversal, and vector search, returning grounded answers with traceable citations. In controlled zero-shot comparisons using the same LLM, data, and evaluation harness, the system improves over retrieval-only and decomposition-based baselines across four QA benchmarks, with ablations showing that schema-conditioned routing, structural intelligence, and schema-guided construction each contribute to the gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个系统，从多源原始数据自动发现可执行模式（executable schema），用于知识图谱构建和查询时检索。该系统通过封闭世界字段目录约束大模型模式发现、确定性结构分析推断键和层级、生成可追溯的知识图谱，并在查询时使用模式条件化多工具代理进行检索，在四个问答基准上优于基线方法。
Motivation: 现实数据跨表格、文档和半结构化文件，语义隐含，查询需整合不一致的模式和格式，现有方法要么需要昂贵的人工工程，要么完全跳过结构。
Method: 系统自动从原始多源数据发现可执行模式，通过封闭世界字段目录约束大模型模式发现到已证字段，使用确定性结构分析推断身份键、外键和源层级，驱动提取、去重和跨源链接到具有溯源的知识图谱；查询时模式可选通过单调协议扩展，调度多工具代理进行结构化查找、图遍历和向量检索。
Result: 在零样本比较中，使用相同大模型、数据和评估框架，该系统在四个问答基准上优于仅检索和分解式基线，消融实验显示模式条件化路由、结构分析和模式引导构建均有贡献。
Conclusion: 可执行模式合同能够自动从多源数据中提取结构并用于检索，提升问答性能，无需手动工程。

summary_sections.motivation: 现实数据跨表格、文档和半结构化文件，语义隐含，查询需整合不一致的模式和格式，现有方法要么需要昂贵的人工工程，要么完全跳过结构。
summary_sections.method: 系统自动从原始多源数据发现可执行模式，通过封闭世界字段目录约束大模型模式发现到已证字段，使用确定性结构分析推断身份键、外键和源层级，驱动提取、去重和跨源链接到具有溯源的知识图谱；查询时模式可选通过单调协议扩展，调度多工具代理进行结构化查找、图遍历和向量检索。
summary_sections.result: 在零样本比较中，使用相同大模型、数据和评估框架，该系统在四个问答基准上优于仅检索和分解式基线，消融实验显示模式条件化路由、结构分析和模式引导构建均有贡献。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可执行模式合同能够自动从多源数据中提取结构并用于检索，提升问答性能，无需手动工程。

papers.title: When Evidence is Sparse: Weakly Supervised Early Failure Alerting in Dialogs and LLM-Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Early failure alerting requires deciding, while a dialog or agent trajectory is still unfolding, whether to flag it as likely to fail. This is challenging because supervision is typically available only as a trajectory-level success/failure label while alerts must be raised from partial interactions. Prior early-classification methods often bridge this gap by assigning the terminal label to every prefix, treating every turn as failure evidence. We hypothesize that this prefix-label assumption is poorly matched to multi-turn language interactions, where evidence of eventual failure is sparse and often delayed. In this paper, we introduce a two-stage approach that learns from this sparse evidence structure and uses the resulting risk estimates for controllable early alerting. Specifically, our attention-based failure predictor learns sparse turn-level failure evidence from trajectory labels and uses it to estimate failure risk from partial histories. We then pair this predictor with $α$-STOP, a single preference-conditioned stopping policy that selects an accuracy-earliness operating point at inference time rather than training a separate trigger for each preference. Across five benchmarks spanning customer support, task-oriented dialog, persuasion, tool use, and planning, we first show that high-relevance failure evidence occupies only 4.7-11.3% of turns and first appears after 59.0-83.6\% of trajectories on average. We further show that the attention-based predictor improves Pareto-frontier quality (hypervolume) by 1-10\% over naive prefix supervision, and that the full system improves frontier quality by 3-42\% over state-of-the-art trigger policies while reducing training cost per operating point by 1-3 orders of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对话和LLM-agent轨迹的早期失败警报问题，指出失败证据稀疏且延迟，提出基于注意力的失败预测器学习轮次级别证据，并结合α-STOP策略实现可控早期警报。实验表明该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有早期分类方法将轨迹级别标签分配给每个前缀，但多轮对话中失败证据稀疏且延迟，导致次优性能。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：首先使用基于注意力的失败预测器从轨迹标签中学习稀疏的轮次级别失败证据，然后与α-STOP策略结合，该策略通过单一偏好条件停止策略选择准确率-早期性权衡操作点。
Result: 在五个基准上，失败证据仅占4.7-11.3%的轮次，且首次出现平均在轨迹的59.0-83.6%之后。注意力预测器改进Pareto前沿质量1-10%，完整系统改进3-42%，每个操作点训练成本降低1-3个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调处理稀疏证据结构对于多轮语言交互早期失败警报的重要性，所提方法在多个领域实现更好权衡。

papers.title: CausalPOI: Spatio-Temporal Graph-Based Causal Modeling for Cold-Start POI Check-in Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: As urban environments continue to evolve rapidly, accurately modeling the dynamic behaviour of Points of Interest is essential for supporting data-driven urban planning and commercial decision-making. While recent advancements in spatio-temporal graph learning have improved POI forecasting, most methods rely on proximity-based graphs and correlation-driven modeling, which overlook the functional dependencies between POIs and fail to capture the causal effects of urban interventions. In this paper, we introduce a novel research problem -- cold-start POI check-in forecasting, which aims to predict the future check-in pattern of a newly introduced POI, by modeling its temporal evolution and functional interactions with nearby POIs in a structured urban spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose CausalPOI, a spatio-temporal graph-based causal representation learning framework. CausalPOI leverages Spatio-Temporal Functional Interaction Graph to model semantic and spatial relationships between POIs, and constructs structurally aligned treatment and control graphs to simulate factual and counterfactual scenarios. Extensive experiments on real-world SafeGraph datasets demonstrate that CausalPOI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across the board, validating its effectiveness in spatio-temporal forecasting, semantic interaction modeling, and causal effect estimation, providing a more interpretable and actionable foundation for urban intervention analysis. Source code is available at Github.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果POI预测问题，即预测新引入POI的未来签到模式。通过时空功能交互图建模POI间的语义和空间关系，并构建结构对齐的处理/控制图模拟事实与反事实场景。在SafeGraph数据集上，CausalPOI显著优于基线，提供可解释的城市干预分析基础。
Motivation: 现有时空图学习依赖邻近图和相关性建模，忽略了POI间的功能依赖性和城市干预的因果效应，无法应对新POI的冷启动预测。
Method: 提出CausalPOI框架，构建时空功能交互图（Spatio-Temporal Functional Interaction Graph）建模语义与空间关系，并通过结构对齐的处理/控制图进行因果表示学习。
Result: 在真实SafeGraph数据集上，CausalPOI在时空预测、语义交互建模和因果效应估计方面全面超越现有基线。
Conclusion: 为城市干预分析提供了更可解释和可操作的基础，验证了因果建模在POI预测中的有效性。

papers.title: A Motivational Architecture for Conversational AGI
papers.abstract_en: Motivational architectures in cognitive AI have largely been designed for physical agents regulating bodily needs. Conversational agents operate in a different regime: their sensorimotor loop is linguistic, their environment is a user's evolving mental state, and their consequential actions are speech acts, tool invocations, and strategic silences. This paper proposes a conversational reinterpretation of the OpenPsi motivational lineage, coupled to MetaMo's higher-level motivational scaffold, for agents built on a modular execution substrate. Homeostasis is recast in dialogue-native terms: the agent regulates competence, uncertainty reduction, affiliation, affinity, legitimacy, nurturing, and aesthetic coherence rather than bodily deficits. We propose three contributions: a ten-stage motivational processing pipeline that architecturally separates cognitive modulation from situational appraisal; a dual decision strategy blending urgency-driven fast response with deliberative multi-goal optimization; and an architecturally useful distinction between pre-action feelings and post-action emotions as functionally different forms of affect. We specialize the framework to two example agents -- CompanionAgent and ResearchAgent -- and sketch its extension to social robotics and domain-generic human-level AGI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向对话式AGI的动机架构，将OpenPsi和MetaMo动机框架重新诠释为对话域中的调节机制，包括十个阶段的动机处理流水线、双决策策略以及情感的功能区分，并具体化为CompanionAgent和ResearchAgent示例。
Motivation: 现有动机架构主要针对物理智能体调节身体需求，而对话智能体的传感器-运动循环是语言性的，需要重新定义动机概念。
Method: 提出了对话领域的动机架构，包括十个阶段的动机处理流水线、融合紧迫性快速响应与深思熟虑的多目标优化的双决策策略，以及前行动情感与后行动情绪的功能区分。
Result: 将框架具体化为CompanionAgent和ResearchAgent两个示例，并概述了向社交机器人和通用AGI的扩展。
Conclusion: 该架构有望作为对话式AGI的动机基础，但摘要中未提及实证评估。

papers.title: Would you still call this Dax? Novel Visual References in VLMs and Humans
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), like human learners, are frequently exposed to new visual concepts, but how they map novel visual references to language after exposure remains largely underexplored, particularly when those references contradict prior knowledge from pre-training. To study this, we present the Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD): 19,176 images spanning 90 visual concepts across different levels of visual novelty, each with up to 20 increasingly perturbed versions of the original object to probe generalization. Unlike prior work on visual augmentations of familiar concepts, NVRD comprises entirely novel, open-ended stimuli constructed from scratch, mirroring how humans encounter genuinely new concepts. We evaluate 3 open- and 2 closed-source models alongside 2,400 human judgments for direct human-model comparison, and find that (i) models struggle to acquire novel concepts in-context when they contradict prior knowledge, and (ii) while models and humans show correlated sensitivity to visual perturbations, models significantly overgeneralize, extending learned labels to stimuli that humans reject. We contribute NVRD as a corpus and benchmark for research on visual concept learning in both humans and machines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）如何在新视觉概念与语言之间建立映射，特别是当这些概念与预训练知识矛盾时。作者构建了NVRD数据集（19,176张图像，90个视觉概念，每个概念有最多20个扰动版本），并评估了5个VLM模型（3个开源、2个闭源）以及2,400个人类判断。结果发现：模型在上下文学习新概念时，若与先验知识矛盾则表现困难；模型和人类对视觉扰动的敏感性相关，但模型显著过度泛化，将学习到的标签扩展到人类拒绝的刺激上。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注熟悉概念的视觉增强，而VLM如何学习真正新颖的视觉概念（尤其是与先验知识矛盾时）仍未被充分探索，且缺乏直接的人-模型对比。
Method: 提出了Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD)，包含90个从零构建的完全新颖的视觉概念，每个概念有多个扰动版本；通过人机对比实验评估VLM在新概念学习中的泛化行为。
Result: 模型在上下文学习新概念时，若与预训练知识矛盾则表现不佳；模型对人类拒绝的刺激表现出过度泛化，尽管模型与人类对视觉扰动的敏感性相关。
Conclusion: NVRD可作为人类和机器视觉概念学习研究的语料库和基准，揭示了当前VLM在新颖概念泛化上的局限。

papers.title: Mutation Without Variation: Convergence Dynamics in LLM-Driven Program Evolution
papers.abstract_en: When an LLM repeatedly mutates a program, does it explore new forms or circle back to the same ones? We study this question by analyzing LLM-driven mutation chains in the absence of selection pressure within a domain-specific language, varying prompt design, model family, and stochastic replication. We find that LLM-based mutation consistently converges toward restricted attractor regions in program space. Convergence is especially severe at the structural level: in 87% of chains, over 93% of mutations revisit a previously seen structural form, with most variation confined to terminal substitutions within recurring templates. Cycle analysis reveals short cycles and self-loops dominating the transition structure. The rate of convergence varies with prompt wording and model choice, but the phenomenon is robust across conditions. A classical GP subtree mutation operator does not exhibit comparable convergence, suggesting that the effect is intrinsic to the LLM mutation pipeline. These findings reveal a tension at the heart of LLM-driven program evolution: the same capabilities that enable semantics-aware program transformation also carry a systematic bias toward structural homogeneity that must be accounted for if such systems are to sustain open-ended exploration. Source code is available at https://github.com/can-gurkan/lmca.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO '26) Workshop on Large Language Models for and with Evolutionary Computation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在无选择压力下重复变异程序时的探索行为。实验发现，LLM驱动的变异链会持续收敛到程序空间中的受限吸引子区域，其中87%的链中超过93%的变异会重复之前见过的结构形式，且循环分析显示短循环和自环主导过渡结构。经典GP子树变异算子未表现出类似收敛，表明该现象是LLM变异管道的固有特性。
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动程序进化缺乏对变异多样性的系统性分析，需要理解LLM是否能在无选择压力下保持开放探索，而非退化到重复模式。
Method: 在领域特定语言中构建LLM驱动的变异链（无选择压力），改变提示设计、模型族和随机复制次数，通过结构相似性和循环分析量化收敛现象。
Result: 87%的链中超过93%的变异是重复之前见过的结构形式，变异主要限于模板内的终端替换；循环分析显示短循环和自环占主导；经典GP子树变异无类似收敛。
Conclusion: LLM驱动程序变异固有地偏向结构同质性，这阻碍了开放探索，需要在系统设计中加以考虑。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agents' Last Exam
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI systems have achieved strong results on a wide range of benchmarks, yet these gains have not translated into economically meaningful deployment across many professional domains. We argue that this gap is largely an evaluation problem: widely used benchmarks lack sustained performance measurement on real and economically valuable workflows. This paper introduces Agents' Last Exam (ALE), a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on long-horizon, economically valuable, real-world tasks with verifiable outcomes. Developed in collaboration with 250+ industry experts, ALE covers non-physical industries defined with reference to O*NET / SOC 2018 (the U.S. federal occupational taxonomy). It is organized around a task taxonomy with 55 subfields grouped into 13 industry clusters covering 1K+ tasks. Current results show that the hardest tier remains far from saturated: across mainstream harness and backbone configurations, the average full pass rate is 2.6%. ALE is designed as a living benchmark: its task pool grows continuously as new workflows and industries are onboarded. More broadly, ALE is intended not merely as another leaderboard, but as an instrument for closing the gap between benchmark success and GDP-relevant impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agents' Last Exam (ALE)，一个由250+行业专家共同设计、覆盖55个子领域（13个行业集群）的基准，用于评估AI代理在长期、经济价值高的真实世界任务上的表现。当前结果最难的层级平均完整通过率仅2.6%，表明该基准尚未饱和，旨在弥合基准成功与GDP相关影响之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有AI基准无法衡量真实世界经济价值高的长期任务表现，导致学术成功与行业部署之间存在鸿沟。
Method: 与250+行业专家合作，基于O*NET/SOC 2018职业分类，构建包含55个子领域、13个行业集群、1000+任务的分类体系，并作为持续更新的活基准。

papers.title: Harnessing Generalist Agents for Contextualized Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Time series are often embedded in rich contexts that are essential for holistic modeling. Moreover, real-world practitioners often require end-to-end workflows for analyzing temporal dynamics, where widely studied tasks such as forecasting are only one step in a broader solution loop. While generalist AI agents offer a promising interface for such workflows under complex contexts, they still operate primarily in textual spaces that are not fully aligned with structured temporal signals. In this work, we introduce TimeClaw, an agentic harness framework for time series that equips generalist LLM agents with the time series-native runtime support needed for contextualized temporal reasoning. TimeClaw integrates executable temporal tools for grounded and auditable analysis, experience-driven capability evolution for creating reusable analytical routines, and episodic multimodal memory for retrieving relevant reasoning traces. Together, these components unlock harnessed open-ended temporal reasoning with contextual information. Extensive evaluation on multiple benchmarks covering diverse tasks across energy, finance, weather, traffic, and other real-world domains demonstrates improved performance of TimeClaw. Code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/TimeClaw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TimeClaw，一个面向时间序列的通用 agent 框架，为大语言模型（LLM）代理提供时间序列原生运行时支持，使其能在丰富上下文中进行端到端的时间推理。框架集成了可执行的时间工具、经验驱动的能力进化机制和情景多模态记忆，在能源、金融、天气等多个领域的基准测试中取得改进。
Motivation: 时间序列常嵌入丰富的上下文，而现实中用户需要端到端分析工作流，但通用 AI 代理主要在文本空间中操作，未能充分利用结构化时间信号。
Method: TimeClaw 框架包含三个组件：可执行的时间工具用于接地分析、经验驱动能力进化以生成可复用的分析例程、情景多模态记忆检索相关推理轨迹。
Result: 在覆盖能源、金融、天气、交通等多个领域的多个基准上，TimeClaw 展现出改进的性能。
Conclusion: TimeClaw 通过将通用 LLM 代理与时间序列原生运行时结合，实现了开放式的上下文时间推理，但方法偏通用，未针对特定时间序列任务（如降水和临近预报）做专门优化。

papers.title: Trust, but Don't Verify: Epistemic Blind Spots in LLM Source Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly act as epistemic proxies, synthesizing evidence from multiple sources to inform decisions. Whether they evaluate the quality of that evidence, or merely aggregate it based on surface presentation, remains poorly understood. We show that models possess the capability to detect fabricated statistics (correct identification rates of 0.76-1.00 for methodology in isolation) but do not recruit this capability during multi-source synthesis, producing similar numeric estimates whether the statistics are fabricated or valid. Specifically, source influence is governed by a methodology-register gate that responds to the distributional register of analytical text but not to numeric validity: for example, statistically impossible confidence intervals receive the same weight as valid ones. The behavioral dissociation replicates across five models from three families (Claude, Qwen, OLMo) and three professional domains. Mechanistic analyses, including causal tracing, linear probes, and component-level attribution, converge on the same account: the model encodes and causally uses a methodology-register representation that transfers across domains (probe AUC 0.83-0.92), while numeric-validity signals, decodable in isolation, are suppressed to chance during multi-source synthesis. Prompting-based mitigations, even an oracle checklist naming the exact statistical checks, produce blanket skepticism rather than selective discernment, and the post-training pipelines we examine reinforce the stylistic shortcut without building numeric verification. Unlike sycophancy, which tracks user preference, this failure tracks whether a source presents as analytically credible, not whether its claims are internally consistent. We term this epistemic alignment: like preference and safety alignment, the question is not capability but deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在多源证据合成时是否评估证据质量。模型能孤立检测虚构统计（正确率0.76-1.00），但在多源合成中依赖方法论-注册信号而非数值有效性，导致虚构统计与有效统计获得相同权重。该行为跨五个模型（Claude、Qwen、OLMo）和三个领域复制，机制分析表明数值有效性信号在多源合成中被抑制。
Motivation: 现有研究未充分理解LLM在多源证据合成时是否真正评估证据质量，还是仅基于表面呈现聚合信息。
Method: 通过实验检测模型对虚构统计的识别能力，对比孤立检测与多源合成条件下的表现；使用因果追踪、线性探针和组件级归因进行机制分析；测试基于提示的缓解措施。
Result: 模型孤立检测虚构统计准确率高（0.76-1.00），但多源合成时数值有效性信号被抑制（探针AUC降至随机），而方法论-注册表示被编码和因果使用（AUC 0.83-0.92）。基于提示的缓解导致全面怀疑而非选择性辨别。
Conclusion: 模型存在认知对齐问题：不是能力不足，而是部署时未利用数值验证能力，反而依赖文体捷径。与谄媚不同，此失败追踪来源的分析可信性而非内部一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReasoningFlow: Discourse Structures for Understanding LLM Reasoning Traces
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) produce reasoning traces with non-linear structures, such as backtracking and self-correction, that complicate the evaluation and monitoring of the reasoning process. We introduce ReasoningFlow, a framework that captures the discourse structures of LRM reasoning traces into fine-grained directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). We develop and validate our annotation schema through careful manual annotation of 31 traces (2.1k steps), achieving high inter-annotator agreement, then scale to automatic annotation of 1,260 traces (247.7k steps) spanning three tasks (math, science, argumentation) and five models (Qwen2.5-32B-Inst, QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-oss-120B). By analyzing ReasoningFlow graphs, we find: (1) LRMs exhibit structurally similar traces, despite being trained from different base models and potentially non-overlapping post-training data. (2) ReasoningFlow reveals diverse fine-grained reasoning behaviors (e.g., local verification, self-reflection, and assumptions) that can be used for better reasoning trace monitorability. (3) In LRMs, most of the erroneous steps are not used to derive final answers. (4) Mechanistic causal dependencies between steps do not reflect the language-level discourse structure. We release the dataset and code in: https://github.com/jinulee-v/reasoningflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReasoningFlow框架，将大型推理模型（LRM）的推理轨迹转化为细粒度有向无环图（DAG），并基于手动和自动标注分析其语篇结构。研究发现不同LRM的推理结构相似、多数错误步骤不用于最终答案、以及因果依赖与语言层面的语篇结构不一致。
Motivation: LRM产生的推理轨迹具有非线性结构（如回溯、自我修正），难以评估和监控，现有方法缺乏细粒度的语篇结构分析框架。
Method: 开发并验证一套标注方案，先手动标注31条轨迹（2100步）以达成高一致性，再扩展到1260条轨迹（24.77万步）的自动标注，覆盖数学、科学和论证三类任务及五种模型，构建ReasoningFlow图。
Result: 不同基础模型训练出的LRM推理结构相似；ReasoningFlow可揭示局部验证、自我反思、假设等细粒度行为；大多数错误步骤不用于推导最终答案；因果依赖关系与语言层面的语篇结构不匹配。
Conclusion: ReasoningFlow框架能有效提升推理轨迹的可监控性，并揭示LRM推理行为的共性特征，数据集和代码已开源。

papers.title: LeanMarathon: Toward Reliable AI Co-Mathematicians through Long-Horizon Lean Autoformalization
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon autoformalization of research mathematics fails not only at hard lemmas, but at scale: statements drift, dependencies tangle, context decays, and local repairs corrupt distant work. We present LeanMarathon, a multi-agent harness for reliable research-level Lean autoformalization. Its core abstraction is an evolving blueprint: a Lean file that serves simultaneously as formal proof skeleton, natural-language proof graph, and shared system of record. Four contract-scoped agents construct, audit, prove, and repair this blueprint. These agents are coordinated by a two-stage orchestrator that first stabilizes target fidelity through adversarial review and then discharges the proof directed acyclic graph (DAG) from its dynamic leaves upward in parallel CI-gated rounds. LeanMarathon turns one brittle multi-hour run into many local, recoverable, parallel transactions. We evaluate LeanMarathon on two recent research papers spanning four Erdős problems (#1051, #1196, #164, #1217). Across three autonomous runs, it formalizes all seven target theorems with no sorry, proving 258 lemmas and theorems. These results show that reliable AI co-mathematics requires not only stronger provers, but durable harnesses that preserve target fidelity across long mathematical developments. The code can be found at https://github.com/YuanheZ/LeanMarathon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LeanMarathon，一个多智能体框架，用于实现可靠的长周期研究级数学定理的Lean自动形式化。其核心是演化蓝图（evolving blueprint），结合四个契约范围的智能体（构造、审计、证明、修复）和两阶段协调器，将脆弱的长时间运行分解为多个局部、可恢复的并行事务。在四个Erdős问题的两个研究论文上，自主运行三次，形式化了全部七个目标定理，证明了258个引理和定理。
Motivation: 长周期自动形式化在规模上面临陈述漂移、依赖缠绕、上下文衰减和局部修复破坏远处工作的困难，现有方法难以可靠地完成研究级数学的形式化。
Method: 提出多智能体框架LeanMarathon，核心是演化蓝图（一个Lean文件，同时作为形式化证明骨架、自然语言证明图和共享记录系统）。四个智能体（构造、审计、证明、修复）由两阶段协调器控制：第一阶段通过对抗性审查稳定目标保真度，第二阶段从动态叶子节点向上以并行CI门控回合完成证明有向无环图。
Result: 在两个近期研究论文（涵盖四个Erdős问题）上，三个自主运行中，所有七个目标定理均被形式化且无sorry，共证明258个引理和定理。
Conclusion: 可靠的AI协同数学不仅需要更强的证明器，还需要能保持目标保真度的持久框架，以应对长周期数学开发。

papers.title: UniPixie: Unified and Probabilistic 3D Physics Learning via Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Existing feed-forward networks excel at predicting a single set of physical properties from visual appearance, but this point-estimate paradigm fundamentally fails to capture the real world's inherent physical ambiguity. We address this by reframing physics prediction as a task of learning a controllable, continuous distribution of material properties. We introduce UNIPIXIE, a framework trained to predict a continuous and parameterized path of physically plausible material properties from a single visual input. By learning a direct mapping along an object's softest-to-stiffest spectrum on our PIXIEMULTIVERSE dataset, UNIPIXIE allows for controllable generation of diverse, physically valid material fields via a single intuitive parameter. Crucially, UNIPIXIE introduces a novel unified architecture to produce simulation-ready parameters for diverse physics solvers, including continuum-based Material Point Method (MPM), reduced-order deformation based on Linear Blend Skinning (LBS), and anchor-based Spring-Mass systems, addressing a key portability issue in prior work. Experiments show our approach not only generates a rich variety of plausible dynamics but also reduces Young's Modulus prediction error by over 50% against the strongest deterministic baseline, bridging the gap between static point estimates and the continuous nature of physical reality. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/
papers.comment: Published at CVPR 2026 as a Highlight. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniPixie，一个基于流匹配（flow matching）的统一概率框架，用于从单张图像预测3D物体的物理属性。该方法通过学习从最软到最硬的材料属性连续路径，实现可控生成多样化的物理有效材料场，并支持多种物理求解器（MPM、LBS、弹簧质点系统）。实验表明，相比最强的确定性基线，杨氏模量预测误差降低超过50%。
Motivation: 现有前馈网络仅能预测单一物理属性集（点估计），无法捕捉真实世界中固有的物理歧义性，且缺乏跨不同物理求解器的可移植性。
Method: 提出UniPixie，通过流匹配学习一个参数化的连续路径，映射从最软到最硬的材料属性分布；构建PIXIEMULTIVERSE数据集用于训练；设计统一架构输出适用于多种求解器（MPM、LBS、弹簧质点系统）的仿真参数。
Result: 在杨氏模量预测上，相比最强确定性基线，误差降低超过50%，并能生成丰富多样的合理动力学。
Conclusion: 将物理预测重新定义为学习可控连续分布，突破了点估计的局限，并提高了不同求解器间的可移植性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Willing but Unable: Separating Refusal from Capability in Code LLMs via Abliteration
papers.abstract_en: Producing a labeled vulnerable code at scale is a recurring obstacle for learning-based vulnerability detection: mined corpora carry substantial label noise, and existing LLM-based augmentation propagates these inaccuracies because it transforms vulnerable seeds rather than synthesising vulnerabilities from a specification. A complementary route is to start from safe code and ask an instruction-tuned LLM to inject a specified CWE (which would shift the labeling burden from open-ended detection to bounded binary confirmation) but safety-aligned code LLMs systematically refuse such prompts. This paper is a preliminary feasibility study of abliteration, a low-rank weight edit that orthogonally projects out the refusal direction in the residual stream, as a tool to remove this barrier. We use Python and CWE-89 (SQL injection) as a case study, evaluating the Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct family at 3B, 7B, and 14B parameters on safe samples drawn from PromSec and SafeCoder, replicated three times per condition. We find that (i) refusal on injection prompts is strongly size- and prompt-context-dependent: the 14B refuses 100% of prompts, the 7B refuses 73% of PromSec but only 5% of SafeCoder, whereas the 3B is essentially never blocked; (ii) abliteration reduces refusal to zero or near-zero across all sizes while leaving syntactic validity above 93%, supporting the view that, in this setting, refusal can be detached from measured code-generation capability; and (iii) the post-abliteration injection rate remains capacity-bound (88-97% on the 14B, 89-90% on the 7B, and 25-48% on the 3B) separating willingness, which abliteration unlocks, from capability, which scales with parameters. Vulnerability verdicts are produced by a three-tool detector ensemble (CodeQL, Semgrep, Bandit) followed by manual adjudication by two authors on detector-positive outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索abliteration（一种低秩权重编辑方法）在代码LLM中的应用，通过正交投影去除残差流中的拒绝方向，使安全对齐的代码模型能够响应生成指定CWE漏洞的指令，从而解决漏洞数据标注中的拒绝障碍。以Python和CWE-89（SQL注入）为案例，评估Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct系列模型（3B、7B、14B），发现abliteration能将拒绝率降至接近零，同时保持语法有效性高于93%，且注入成功率受模型容量限制。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的漏洞数据增强方法受限于安全对齐模型的拒绝行为，难以从安全代码按需生成指定CWE漏洞。本文旨在通过abliteration解除这一障碍，为大规模漏洞数据集构建提供新途径。
Method: 采用abliteration方法，即对指令微调LLM的残差流进行低秩权重编辑，正交投影出并移除拒绝方向（refusal direction），使模型能执行原本拒绝的漏洞注入提示。实验使用Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（3B/7B/14B），在PromSec和SafeCoder安全样本上评估CWE-89注入。
Result: （i）拒绝行为与模型大小和提示上下文强相关：14B模型100%拒绝，7B在PromSec上拒绝73%但在SafeCoder上仅5%，3B几乎没有拒绝；（ii）abliteration将拒绝率降至零或接近零，语法有效性保持在93%以上；（iii）abliteration后的注入率受限于模型容量：14B达88-97%，7B为89-90%，3B仅25-48%，表明意愿（willingness）与能力（capability）可分。
Conclusion: 初步结果表明abliteration能有效解除安全对齐代码LLM的拒绝屏障，将意愿与能力分离，为基于LLM的漏洞合成提供了可行路径。但研究仅局限于Python和CWE-89，且依赖静态分析工具的检测结果，泛化性和完整漏洞验证仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: VASO: Formally Verifiable Self-Evolving Skills for Physical AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reusable robot skills are becoming the basic units through which embodied agents turn open-ended instructions into long-horizon physical behavior. We argue that, while foundation models have collapsed the cost of creating these skills, the cost of trusting them has not. Existing skill-evolution loops refine skills through execution feedback, unit tests, environment reward, or LLM self-critique, but these signals provide only trace-level evidence: they show that a skill worked on sampled executions, not that skill-induced plans satisfy temporal safety contracts under untested conditions. We introduce VASO, a framework for verification-guided self-evolution of LLM-generated robot skill contracts. In VASO, each skill is represented as a semantic contract with two coupled interfaces: a formal interface that aligns robot states, observations, and control commands with logical propositions for model checking, and a planner-facing interface that guides executable behavior generation. A model checker first filters logically inconsistent skill contracts, then verifies plans induced by the skill against global and local temporal specifications. When verification fails, VASO translates the counterexample trace into a textual gradient that updates the reusable skill contract while keeping foundation-model weights frozen. On Clearpath Jackal and PX4 quadcopter tasks, VASO reaches 97.2% formal-specification compliance using fewer than 100 optimization samples, outperforming execution-feedback, prompt-optimization, and fine-tuning baselines. To our knowledge, VASO is the first framework that closes the loop between formal verification and self-evolving LLM-generated skills for physical AI agents: formal counterexamples become optimization feedback for reusable robot skill contracts, rather than merely verifying one-off plans, tuning planner prompts, or fine-tuning model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VASO，一个验证引导的自演化框架，用于对 LLM 生成的机器人技能合约进行形式化验证。每个技能被表示为语义合约，包含形式化接口（用于模型检查）和规划接口（用于行为生成）。模型检查器过滤逻辑不一致的合约并验证时序规范，失败时将反例轨迹转化为文本梯度更新技能合约。在 Clearpath Jackal 和 PX4 四旋翼任务中，VASO 以少于 100 个优化样本达到 97.2% 的规范符合率，优于执行反馈、提示优化和微调基线。
Motivation: 现有技能演化循环依赖执行反馈、单元测试或 LLM 自我批评，只能提供轨迹级证据，无法保证技能在未测试条件下的时序安全契约。
Method: 将每个技能表示为具有形式化接口（对齐状态、观测、控制命令与逻辑命题）和规划接口的语义合约，通过模型检查器验证技能触发的规划是否符合全局和局部时序规范，验证失败时利用反例轨迹生成文本梯度更新技能合约，保持基础模型权重冻结。
Result: 在 Clearpath Jackal 和 PX4 四旋翼任务上，VASO 在不到 100 个优化样本下达到 97.2% 的形式规范符合率，优于执行反馈、提示优化和微调基线。
Conclusion: VASO 是首个闭环形式化验证与自演化 LLM 生成技能的框架，将形式反例作为可重用技能合约的优化反馈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human oversight of agentic systems in practice: Examining the oversight work, challenges, and heuristics of developers using software agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous software agents hold promise to increase developer productivity but make mistakes and exhibit novel failure modes, making human oversight central to successful human-agent collaboration. Existing research on agent oversight is largely conceptual; normative frameworks exist, but how users actually oversee agents is less known. In this paper, we bridge this gap by providing early empirical anchors for the theoretical discourse on agent oversight. Drawing on interviews with 17 experienced developers, we conduct an exploratory inquiry examining what forms of emergent oversight work developers perform, when, and how. We also document the oversight challenges developers face and the strategies they have started using to address them. We found at least four forms of emergent oversight work: a priori control, co-planning, real-time monitoring, and post hoc review. We show that oversight work is not only reactive and retrospective, as portrayed in existing research, but also preventative and proactive. We describe situated oversight challenges (e.g., difficulty reviewing agent-generated code) and outline heuristics developers adopt to address such challenges (e.g., using test results as guarantees for code correctness). We conclude with high-level takeaways, future research directions, implications for the human-centered design of software agents and for software engineering practice, and limitations of our research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对17位经验丰富的开发者进行访谈，实证探索了在自主软件代理（agentic systems）使用中人类监督的实践形式。研究发现至少四种涌现监督工作：先验控制、共同规划、实时监控和事后审查，并指出监督工作不仅是反应性和回顾性的，还包括预防性和主动性的方面。文章还记录了开发者面临的监督挑战（如审查代理生成代码的困难）以及他们采用的启发式策略（如使用测试结果作为代码正确性的保证）。
Motivation: 现有关于代理监督的研究多为概念性的规范框架，缺乏对用户实际如何监督代理的实证理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，为理论讨论提供早期经验锚点。
Method: 采用探索性研究设计，对17名有经验的开发者进行半结构化访谈，分析他们执行监督工作的形式、时机、方式，以及面临的挑战和应对策略。
Result: 识别出至少四种涌现监督工作：先验控制、共同规划、实时监控和事后审查；发现监督工作既有反应性和回顾性，也有预防性和主动性；记录了情境化挑战（如审查代理生成代码的困难）和开发者采用的启发式策略（如依赖测试结果作为代码正确性保证）。
Conclusion: 研究为代理监督的理论提供了实证基础，并提出了对以人为中心的软件代理设计和软件工程实践的启示，同时指出了研究的局限性及未来方向。

papers.title: Residual Modeling for High-Fidelity Learned Compression of Scientific Data
papers.abstract_en: Lossy compression is essential for massive spatiotemporal data from scientific simulations. Learned compressors can achieve high compression ratios at moderate accuracy targets, but their aggregate reconstruction losses do not guarantee accuracy for each block. Existing Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) methods add a per-block residual correction by retaining SVD/PCA-style coefficients until the target is met. This works at moderate tolerances, but in the high-fidelity regime with block-level NRMSE from 10^-6 to 10^-4, the number of retained coefficients grows quickly and the correction stream dominates the total rate. We propose a residual-centric view: the learned residual is structurally different from the original scientific field and should be coded with a representation designed for that residual. We introduce two residual coders. LBRC is a deterministic, training-free pipeline that adaptively quantizes the learned residual to the target NRMSE and losslessly encodes the resulting integer residual using 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding. NGLR adds a causal neural predictor that outputs a normalized bias for an integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction in the same deterministic integer pipeline, reducing the entropy of the remaining residual code while preserving deterministic decoding. The predictor weights are serialized and counted in the bitstream. Across E3SM, JHTDB, and ERA5 at block-level NRMSE targets from 10^-6 to 10^-4, LBRC improves compression ratio over GAE by 30-60% and is broadly competitive with SZ. NGLR adds a further 10-40% over LBRC and outperforms SZ in the evaluated high-fidelity regime. These results show that residual representations tailored to learned-compressor residuals can preserve the advantage of learned compression when global residual correction becomes rate-dominant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高保真度科学数据有损压缩中，现有学习方法在块级误差约束下残差校正开销过大的问题，提出残差建模视角。作者设计了两种残差编码器：LBRC（确定性无训练流水线）和NGLR（添加因果神经预测器）。在E3SM、JHTDB和ERA5数据集上，块级NRMSE目标10^-6到10^-4下，LBRC相比GAE提升压缩比30-60%，NGLR进一步提升10-40%，优于SZ。
Motivation: 现有Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE)方法在高保真度（块级NRMSE 10^-6到10^-4）下，残差校正系数快速增加，导致校正流占主导，压缩比下降。
Method: 提出残差中心视角，认为学习残差与原始科学场结构不同，应使用针对残差设计的表示。LBRC是确定性、无训练流水线，自适应量化残差至目标NRMSE，并使用3D Lorenzo差分、zigzag映射、位平面编码和熵编码。NGLR添加因果神经预测器，对整数化Lorenzo预测输出归一化偏置，降低残差熵，同时保持确定性解码。
Result: 在E3SM、JHTDB和ERA5数据集上，块级NRMSE目标10^-6到10^-4下，LBRC相比GAE压缩比提升30-60%，与SZ竞争力相当。NGLR在LBRC基础上进一步提升10-40%，在该高保真度区域优于SZ。
Conclusion: 针对学习压缩器残差定制的残差表示可以在全局残差校正成为速率主导时保持学习压缩的优势。

papers.title: Stability vs. Manipulability: Evaluating Robustness Under Post-Decision Interaction in LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge evaluation is widely used in benchmarking pipelines, where model outputs are compared and ranked using automated evaluators. These pipelines typically assume that judgments are stable properties of fixed inputs. We show that this assumption does not hold under interaction. We study post-decision manipulability: the extent to which an evaluation outcome can be altered through subsequent conversation with the judge after an initial decision has been made. Across controlled experiments on MT-Bench and AlpacaEval, we find that LLM judges are highly stable under repeated and neutral reevaluation, yet become substantially reversible under targeted post-decision challenge. An anti-baseline challenge protocol shows that stable judgments can be overturned through motivated interaction, while a counterbalanced target-validation protocol separates this reversibility from net target-directed steering. These reversals have practical consequences: they can degrade agreement with human preferences, shift benchmark rankings, and produce harmful evaluation changes despite high self-reported confidence. Authority framing is especially destabilizing, and revised judgments are often accompanied by low-overlap justifications, suggesting post hoc rationalization rather than reliable error correction. We introduce the Evaluation Robustness Score (ERS) to quantify interactional robustness by combining reversal susceptibility with counterbalanced directional effects. Our findings identify post-decision interaction as a distinct failure mode for LLM-as-judge evaluation and motivate evaluation protocols that measure not only static agreement, but robustness under challenge.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 GEM (Generation, Evaluation and Metrics) Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM作为评估者时，在决策后交互中的鲁棒性，发现其在中立重评下高度稳定，但在针对性挑战下容易被逆转，并引入评估鲁棒性评分（ERS）来量化交互鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-judge评估假设判定是固定输入的稳定属性，但本文指出在交互环境下该假设不成立，需要研究后决策可操纵性。
Method: 在MT-Bench和AlpacaEval上开展受控实验，采用反基线挑战协议和平衡目标验证协议，测量逆转率和方向性效应，并提出评估鲁棒性评分（ERS）。
Result: LLM评委在中立重评下高度稳定，但在针对性挑战下逆转率高；权威框架显著增加不稳定性；修订后的判断常伴随低重叠理由，表明事后合理化而非可靠纠错。
Conclusion: 后决策交互是LLM-as-judge评估的独特失效模式，评估协议不仅要关注静态一致性，还需测量面对挑战的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Can AI Refute Economic Theory? Evidence from Beyond the Knowledge Cutoff
papers.abstract_en: Can artificial intelligence (AI) refute economic theory? I document experiments in which I asked several AI models (Gemini, Refine, Claude, and ChatGPT) to check the correctness of four published papers in economic theory, each containing an error that I helped identify or correct. ChatGPT Pro performed best, occasionally constructing counterexamples and corrected proofs, while other models fared worse. However, no model located a true error without substantial human guidance, and data contamination complicates interpretation. I argue that a competent human paired with a frontier model can outperform current peer review, but AI cannot yet refute economic theory on its own.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验测试多个AI模型（Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT等）能否识别并修正四篇已发表经济学论文中的错误，发现即使表现最好的ChatGPT Pro也无法在没有大量人类引导的情况下独立定位真实错误。
Motivation: 现有同行评审存在疏漏，AI可能辅助识别论文错误，但其独立验证经济学理论的能力尚未明确。
Method: 将四篇包含已知错误的已发表经济学论文提供给AI模型，要求其检查正确性，记录模型能否发现错误、构建反例或修正证明。
Result: ChatGPT Pro偶尔能构建反例和修正证明，但所有模型均无法在无人类引导下找到真实错误；数据污染问题也影响结果可信度。
Conclusion: 前沿AI模型与人类专家结合可超越当前同行评审，但AI尚无法独立反驳经济理论。

papers.title: Synthetic Contrastive Reasoning for Multi-Table Q&A
papers.abstract_en: Multi-table question answering requires models to retrieve relevant evidence, link schemas, and perform compositional reasoning across relational tables. Existing multi-table Q&A resources typically provide questions and final answers but lack reasoning supervision that explains how answers are derived. To address this gap, we construct a synthetic contrastive reasoning-trace dataset for MMQA by generating validated positive traces and plausible negative traces with heterogeneous LLMs. We then use the resulting preference pairs to fine-tune open-weight LLMs with Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO). Across Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, CPO achieves absolute average improvements over Q&A supervised fine-tuning ranging from 9.7%-16.3%, with gains up to 21 percentage points on MMQA. Ablations show that heterogeneous positive and negative trace generators strengthen the contrastive signal, and automated as well as human evaluations indicate that the generated pairs are largely faithful, coherent, and meaningfully contrastive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多表问答中缺乏推理监督的问题，构建了合成对比推理轨迹数据集，并使用对比偏好优化(CPO)微调开源大语言模型。在Qwen3-14B、Mistral-8B和Llama-3.1-8B上，CPO相比监督微调在MMQA上平均提升9.7%-16.3%，最高提升21个百分点。消融实验表明异构正负轨迹生成器增强了对比信号。
Motivation: 现有多表问答数据集仅提供问题和最终答案，缺乏解释答案推导过程的推理监督，限制了模型在跨表组合推理上的能力。
Method: 利用异构大语言模型生成经过验证的正向推理轨迹和合理的负向轨迹，构建合成对比偏好对，然后使用对比偏好优化(CPO)对开源权重模型进行微调。
Result: 在Qwen3-14B、Mistral-8B和Llama-3.1-8B上，CPO相比问答监督微调在MMQA上平均绝对提升9.7%-16.3%，最高提升21个百分点；自动和人工评估表明生成的轨迹忠实、连贯且具有有意义的对比性。
Conclusion: 合成对比推理轨迹数据结合CPO能有效提升多表问答的推理性能，异构生成器对对比信号质量至关重要。

papers.title: Generalized TV--$\ell_p$ Structured Priors for Bayesian $T_1$ Mapping
papers.abstract_en: We propose an extended family of structured spatial priors that incorporates the total variation (TV) function with $\ell_p$ norms. The prior is proven to be proper and incorporated into a Bayesian regression framework to enable uncertainty quantification in $T_1$ mapping, with posterior inference performed using the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS). This TV--$\ell_p$ construction is proven to constitute a well-defined family of prior distributions, and it naturally enforces spatial consistency and smooth variations in the estimated parameter maps. The method was evaluated in comparison to maximum-likelihood estimation and several Bayesian alternative priors based on the uniform, Gamma, and bounded TV priors. The evaluation includes experiments on synthetic brain and cardiac $T_1$ mapping datasets, as well as a real in-vivo breast $T_1$ mapping dataset. The results show that the TV--$\ell_p$ prior yields more concentrated posterior densities, indicating reduced uncertainty. It also consistently achieves lower variance and smaller (negative) bias, leading to more reliable estimates. Overall, embedding a TV-based structured penalty along with $\ell_p$ norms in a prior in a Bayesian model improves spatial coherence in $T_1$ maps and enhances uncertainty quantification, offering a robust approach for $T_1$ mapping with uncertainties.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:015
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一族广义的结构化空间先验，将全变分（TV）函数与ℓ_p范数结合，并证明了该先验的适定性。将该先验嵌入贝叶斯回归框架，利用No-U-Turn采样器（NUTS）进行后验推断，以实现T1映射中的不确定性量化。在合成脑部/心脏T1映射数据集以及真实体内乳腺T1映射数据集上的实验表明，相比极大似然估计和多种贝叶斯备选先验（均匀、Gamma、有界TV先验），TV-ℓ_p先验产生了更集中的后验密度、更低的方差和更小的（负）偏差，从而提升了估计的可靠性和空间一致性。
Motivation: 现有T1映射方法缺乏有效的空间正则化与不确定性量化，且传统TV先验在灵活性和理论性质上存在局限。
Method: 定义一族TV-ℓ_p结构化先验（ℓ_p范数嵌入TV函数），证明其适定性，将其作为贝叶斯线性回归的先验，并使用NUTS进行后验采样。
Result: 在合成和真实T1映射数据集上，TV-ℓ_p先验相比基线方法实现了更集中的后验密度、更低方差和更小负偏，表明不确定性降低且估计更可靠。
Conclusion: 将TV与ℓ_p范数结合的贝叶斯先验能有效提升T1映射的空间一致性和不确定性量化，为带不确定性的T1映射提供了一种稳健方法。

papers.title: Learning-Augmented Online Minimization with Dual Predictions
papers.abstract_en: We present learning-augmented algorithms for two general classes of online minimization problems: metrical task systems and laminar set cover. Both algorithms achieve improved theoretical guarantees using machine-learned predictions of an optimal solution to the dual linear program. Unlike optimal primal solutions, which can change drastically under tiny instance perturbations, these dual solutions are much more stable, which ensures the existence of good (and learnable) predictions for families of similar instances. While previous work has used dual predictions in offline settings and for online maximization problems, our algorithms are, to the best of our knowledge, the first demonstration that such dual predictions can be effective for online minimization. Our theoretical results are complemented by experiments on the $k$-server problem and the parking permit problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对度规任务系统（metrical task systems）和层状集覆盖（laminar set cover）两类在线最小化问题，提出利用对偶线性规划最优解的机器学习预测作为指导的学习增强算法。由于对偶解相比原始解具有更高的稳定性，因此能在相似实例族中保证预测的可学习性。这是首次将对偶预测成功应用于在线最小化问题，并通过k-服务器问题和停车许可证问题的实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有多数学习增强在线算法依赖于原始解的预测，但原始解对实例扰动过于敏感；对偶解虽更稳定且适合迁移学习，却未被用于在线最小化场景。
Method: 分别针对度规任务系统和层状集覆盖设计两种在线算法，利用机器学习预测的对偶线性规划最优解来调整在线决策，其中对偶预测的稳定性确保了理论保证的成立。
Result: 理论上改进了算法的竞争比（competitive ratio）保证，在k-服务器问题和停车许可证问题的实验中取得了正向效果。
Conclusion: 该工作表明对偶预测是实现在线最小化学习增强的一种有效且可行的范式，其稳定性为跨实例迁移提供了基础。

papers.title: Deep Learning-assisted AMD Staging based on OCT and OCT Angiography
papers.abstract_en: To develop and evaluate deep learning models for automated grading of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) severity using optical coherence tomography (OCT) and OCT angiography (OCTA) data. Two hundred seventy-one participants aged >= 50 years with varying AMD severities. Central macular 6 x 6 mm OCT/OCTA volumes were acquired using a swept-source OCTA system (SOLIX; Visionix/Optovue Inc., CA). AMD severity was graded into four stages (No AMD, Early AMD, Intermediate AMD, and Advanced AMD) according to the AREDS simplified severity scale. Three deep learning models were developed using different input modalities: (1) biomarker maps derived from segmented pathological features, including retinal fluid, drusen, geographic atrophy (GA), and macular neovascularization (MNV); (2) two-dimensional (2D) en face OCT and OCTA projections; and (3) three-dimensional (3D) OCT/OCTA volumes. EfficientNet-based architectures were trained using normalized inputs, data augmentation, and five-fold cross-validation. A total of 2,030 OCT/OCTA volumes from 351 eyes of 271 participants were analyzed. All models demonstrated strong AMD staging performance with substantial agreement with the reference standard (QWK >= 0.83). The biomarker-based model achieved the highest overall performance (QWK = 0.85 +/- 0.03, mean +/- standard deviation) and the best detection of early AMD (F1-score = 0.59 +/- 0.14). The 3D model achieved performance comparable to the 2D OCT/OCTA model (QWK = 0.83 +/- 0.04 vs. 0.83 +/- 0.09), while the 2D OCT/OCTA model showed the highest precision (0.79 +/- 0.06) and most accurately identified eyes without AMD. Deep learning models using OCT/OCTA data can accurately and automatically grade AMD severity. Among the evaluated approaches, the biomarker-based model provided the most balanced performance and showed particular value for early AMD detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发和评估了基于 OCT 和 OCTA 数据的深度学习模型，用于自动分期年龄相关性黄斑变性 (AMD)。使用 271 名参与者的 2030 个 OCT/OCTA 体积，根据 AREDS 简化严重程度评分分为四个阶段。比较了三种模型：基于生物标志物图、2D en face 投影和 3D 体积，均采用 EfficientNet 架构，通过五折交叉验证评估。所有模型均表现出与参考标准高度一致的性能 (QWK >= 0.83)，其中生物标志物模型整体最优 (QWK=0.85)，尤其对早期 AMD 检测有效 (F1=0.59)。
Motivation: 需要自动化且准确的 AMD 严重程度分级方法，以辅助临床诊断和治疗决策。
Method: 开发了三种基于 EfficientNet 的深度学习模型：1) 使用分割出的病理特征（视网膜液、玻璃膜疣、地理萎缩、黄斑新生血管）生成的生物标志物图；2) 二维 en face OCT 和 OCTA 投影；3) 三维 OCT/OCTA 体积。采用归一化输入、数据增强和五折交叉验证进行训练。
Result: 所有模型的 QWK 均 ≥0.83。生物标志物模型整体最优 (QWK=0.85±0.03)，早期 AMD 检测的 F1 分数最高 (0.59±0.14)。3D 模型与 2D 模型性能相当 (QWK=0.83±0.04 vs 0.83±0.09)，2D 模型精确度最高 (0.79±0.06) 且最准确识别无 AMD 眼。
Conclusion: 基于 OCT/OCTA 的深度学习模型可以准确、自动地进行 AMD 严重程度分级。其中生物标志物模型提供了最均衡的性能，在早期 AMD 检测方面尤其有价值。
